2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200721180342/http://www.dipionline.it/dizionario/ricerca?lemma=Totti|url-status=live}}}} (born 27 September 1976) is an Italian former professional [[Association football|footballer]] who played for [[AS Roma|Roma]] and the [[Italy national football team|Italy national team]]. He was a technically gifted and creative [[Squad number (association football)|number 10]], regarded as one of the greatest in the role, who played as an [[advanced playmaker|offensive playmaker]] (''trequartista'') and as a [[forward (association football)|forward]]. Totti [[List of one-club men in association football|spent his entire club career]] at Roma, winning a [[Serie A]] title, two [[Coppa Italia]] titles, and two [[Supercoppa Italiana]] titles. With Roma, he scored 307 goals and provided 205 assists across club competitions; in [[Serie A]] history, he is the [[Football records in Italy#Goalscoring|second-highest scorer of all time]] (250 goals) and the [[Football records and statistics in Italy#Most assists in Serie A|top assist-provider of all time]].{{cite news |url=http://www.gazzettagiallorossa.it/2013/03/as-roma-totti-a-caccia-del-record/ |title=AS ROMA Totti a caccia del record |work=Gazzetta Giallorossa|access-date=18 February 2015 |language=it|archive-date=4 April 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230404155215/http://www.gazzettagiallorossa.it/2013/03/as-roma-totti-a-caccia-del-record/|url-status=live}} Totti is the [[AS Roma statistics and records#Top all-time goalscorers|top goalscorer]] and the [[AS Roma statistics and records#All competitions appearances|most capped player]] in Roma's history, holds the record for the most goals scored in Serie A while playing for a single club, and also holds the record for the youngest club captain in the history of Serie A. During his career at Roma, Totti has been referred to as ''Er Bimbo de Oro'' (The Golden Boy), ''Er Pupone'' (The Big Baby), ''L'Ottavo Re di Roma'' (The Eighth King of Rome), ''L'Imperatore'' (The Emperor) and ''Er Capitano'' (The Captain) by the Italian sports media. In 2013, the ''New York Times'' described him as a "Roman god in his game."{{Cite news |last=Hughes |first=Rob |date=16 April 2013 |title=After 2 Decades of Creativity: Why Stop Now? |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2013/04/17/sports/soccer/20-creative-years-of-francesco-totti-why-stop.html |work=The New York Times}} Totti experienced global success on the world stage winning the [[2006 FIFA World Cup]] and appearing in the finals of [[UEFA Euro 2000]] with [[Italy national football team|Italy]]; he was selected in the All-Star team for both tournaments. Totti also represented his country at the [[2002 FIFA World Cup|2002 World Cup]] and [[UEFA Euro 2004|Euro 2004]]. Previously, he played with Italy youth teams, scoring 18 goals and winning the [[1996 UEFA European Under-21 Championship]] and the [[Football at the 1997 Mediterranean Games|1997 Mediterranean Games]]. With the senior Italy national team, he scored 9 goals and provided 25 assists in 58 appearances. He is the top Italian assist-provider in [[FIFA World Cup]] history (6 assists). In 2007 due to recurring physical problems, Totti announced his international retirement to focus solely on club play with Roma. Totti won the 2007 [[European Golden Shoe]] and a record [[Oscar del Calcio|eleven awards]] from the [[Italian Footballers' Association]]: five [[Serie A Italian Footballer of the Year]] awards, two [[Serie A Footballer of the Year]] awards, two Serie A Goal of the Year awards, one Serie A Goalscorer of the Year award, and one [[Serie A Young Footballer of the Year]] award. He was also awarded the 2010 [[Golden Foot]] and was selected in the [[European Sports Media]] team of the season three times. In 2004, he was named in the [[FIFA 100]], a list of the world's greatest living players as selected by [[Pelé]], as part of [[FIFA]]'s centenary celebrations.{{cite news |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/football/3533891.stm |title=Pele's list of the greatest |date=4 March 2004|access-date=31 May 2011 |work=BBC Sport|archive-date=3 March 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150303061731/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/3533891.stm|url-status=live}} In 2011, Totti was recognised by [[International Federation of Football History & Statistics|IFFHS]] as the most popular footballer in Europe.{{cite news |url=http://www.iffhs.de/?32a00e42f0ae2300bf11504e52d17f7370eff3702bb1c2bbb6e28e05 |title=The World's Most Popular Footballer Amongst Currently Active Players in 2011|access-date=25 January 2012 |publisher=IFFHS.de|archive-date=23 January 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120123011321/http://www.iffhs.de/?32a00e42f0ae2300bf11504e52d17f7370eff3702bb1c2bbb6e28e05|url-status=live}} In 2015, ''[[France Football]]'' rated him as one of the ten-best footballers in the world who are over age 36.{{cite web |url=http://www.francefootball.fr/news/Le-top-10-des-meilleurs-vieux/559763 |title=Le top 10 des meilleurs vieux|trans-title=The top 10 of the best oldies |publisher=France Football |language=fr |author1=Thomas Simon |date=19 May 2015|access-date=5 February 2019|archive-date=22 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201022011421/https://www.francefootball.fr/news/Le-top-10-des-meilleurs-vieux/559763|url-status=live}} Following his retirement in 2017, Totti was awarded the [[Globe Soccer Awards|Player's Career Award]] and the [[UEFA President's Award]]. == Early life == Totti was born in [[Rome]] to parents Lorenzo and Fiorella Totti. He was raised in the [[Porta Metronia]] neighbourhood.{{cite news |first=Gaetano |last=Imparato |title=Francesco Totti |url=http://archiviostorico.gazzetta.it/1998/aprile/25/FARNCESCO_TOTTI_gm_0_980425207.shtml |work=La Gazzetta dello Sport|access-date=4 June 2015 |language=it |format=25 April 1998|archive-date=5 April 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230405001154/http://archiviostorico.gazzetta.it/1998/aprile/25/FARNCESCO_TOTTI_gm_0_980425207.shtml|url-status=live}} As a youngster he idolised ex-Roma captain [[Giuseppe Giannini]],{{cite news |url=http://archiviostorico.gazzetta.it/1997/luglio/19/Roma_scelto_nuovo_Principe_Totti_ga_0_9707193484.shtml |title=La Roma ha scelto un nuovo Principe: Totti |work=La Gazzetta dello Sport |language=it |first=Gaetano |last=Imparato |date=19 July 1997|access-date=4 June 2015|archive-date=4 April 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230404155212/http://archiviostorico.gazzetta.it/1997/luglio/19/Roma_scelto_nuovo_Principe_Totti_ga_0_9707193484.shtml|url-status=live}} and regularly played football with older boys.{{cite magazine |url=http://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/long-read-francesco-totti-romes-greatest-son-who-never-got-love-he-deserved#:isr8gB319QtYcA |title=The long read: Francesco Totti – Rome's greatest son who never got the love he deserved |last=Murray |first=Andrew |date=1 April 2016 |magazine=FourFourTwo|access-date=12 April 2016|archive-date=4 July 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180704153439/https://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/long-read-francesco-totti-romes-greatest-son-who-never-got-love-he-deserved#:isr8gB319QtYcA|url-status=live}} Totti began to play youth team football in 1984, with [[Fortitudo-Pro Roma S.G.S.|Fortitudo]], later joining [[ASD Trastevere Calcio|Trastevere]] and [[AS Lodigiani|Lodigiani]]. After he came to the attention of scouts, his mother refused a lucrative offer from [[AC Milan|Milan]] in order to keep him in his home town. Although his youth club initially had come to an agreement to sell Totti to the [[SS Lazio|Lazio youth side]], one of [[AS Roma|Roma's youth coaches]], Gildo Giannini, persuaded his parents to let him |url=http://www.repubblica.it/online/campionato_partite/romaudinese/romaudinese/romaudinese.html |title=Una magia di Totti trascina la Roma |work=la Repubblica |language=it |date=10 December 2000|access-date=29 July 2016|archive-date=4 March 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304124545/http://www.repubblica.it/online/campionato_partite/romaudinese/romaudinese/romaudinese.html|url-status=live}} He continued his goalscoring form by scoring against Napoli at home in a 3–0 victory on 28 January 2001, as Roma finished the first half of the league season in first place.{{cite news |url=http://www.repubblica.it/online/campionato_partite/romanapoli/romanapoli/romanapoli.html |title=La Roma ad un passo dal titolo d'inverno |work=la Repubblica |language=it |date=28 January 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160821082517/http://www.repubblica.it/online/campionato_partite/romanapoli/romanapoli/romanapoli.html|url-status=live}}{{cite web |url=http://www2.raisport.rai.it/news/sport/calcio/200101/28/3a74626e054c3/ |title=Roma campione d'inverno |publisher=RaiSport |language=it |date=28 January 2001|access-date=29 July an important role in keeping the club at the top of the table throughout the remainder of the season, gaining a comfortable lead over rivals [[Juventus FC|Juventus]].{{cite news |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/europe/1299925.stm |title=Rome giants in title crunch |work=BBC Sport |date=27 April 2001|access-date=29 July 2016|archive-date=17 September 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160917003847/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/europe/1299925.stm|url-status=live}} On 17 June 2001, at the [[Stadio Olimpico]], Roma beat [[Parma AC|Parma]] 3–1, with their three main attackers, Totti, [[Vincenzo Montella]] and [[Gabriel Batistuta]] scoring one goal each, as Roma were crowned champions of Italy for the [[2000–01 AS Roma season|third time]] in their history.{{cite news |url=http://www.repubblica.it/online/campionato_partite/romaparma/romaparma/romaparma.html |title=Roma, show all'Olimpico per la festa scudetto |work=la Repubblica |language=it |date=17 June 2011|access-date=29 July 2016|archive-date=29 June with 13 goals, equalling what was at the time his personal goalscoring record in a single Serie A season. On 19 August 2001, Totti won his first [[2001 Supercoppa Italiana|Supercoppa Italiana]], scoring and assisting in the 3–0 win against [[ACF Fiorentina|Fiorentina]].{{cite web |url=http://www2.raisport.rai.it/news/rubriche/coppe978/200108/19/3b800d4b05ba6/ |title=SupeRoma Supercoppa |publisher=RaiSport |language=it |date=19 August 2001|access-date=29 July 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181223121320/http://www2.raisport.rai.it/news/rubriche/coppe978/200108/19/3b800d4b05ba6/|archive-date=23 December 2018|url-status=dead}} Totti was named the [[Serie A Italian Footballer of the Year]] for both 2000 and 2001,{{cite news |url=http://www.repubblica.it/online/calcio/oscarpar/oscarpar/oscarpar.html |title=Oscar: Zidane batte Totti è lui il più bravo calciatore |work=la Repubblica |language=it |date=2 October 2001|access-date=29 July 2016|archive-date=4 March 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304030838/http://www.repubblica.it/online/calcio/oscarpar/oscarpar/oscarpar.html|url-status=live}}{{cite web |url=http://www.assocalciatori.it/Pagine/AlbodOro/tabid/161/language/en-US/Default.aspx |title=Albo d'Oro |publisher=AIC |language=it |access-date=29 July 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111223192332/http://www.assocalciatori.it/Pagine/AlbodOro/tabid/161/language/en-US/Default.aspx |archive-date=23 December 2011}} and won the [[Serie A Footballer of the Year]] Award for the first time in his career in 2000. He received his first [[Ballon d'Or]] nomination in [[2000 Ballon d'Or|2000]], finishing 14th in voting, and fifth the [[2001 Ballon d'Or|following year]].{{cite news |url=http://www2.raisport.rai.it/news/sport/calcio/200112/17/3c1e290503e87/ |title=A Owen il Pallone d'Oro |publisher=RaiSport |language=it |date=17 December 2001 |access-date=31 May 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120513201702/http://www2.raisport.rai.it/news/sport/calcio/200112/17/3c1e290503e87/|archive-date=13 May 2012|url-status=dead}} Due to his performances and leadership, Totti had established himself as a hero to the Roma fans, who were also able to identify with his background as a Rome native and lifelong supporter. [[File:Totti 2002.jpg|thumb|upright=0.7|left|Totti in 2002]] Over the following seasons, Totti played in a free role as either a forward or second striker in a [[Formation (association football)#3–5–2|3–5–2 formation]], often alongside either Batistuta or the newly acquired youngster [[Antonio Cassano]]. He scored his first hat-trick in Serie A, in a 3–2 away win over [[Brescia Calcio|Brescia]] on 30 September 2002.{{cite news |first1=Massimo |last1=Cecchini |first2=Luigi |last2=Garlando |url=http://archiviostorico.gazzetta.it/2002/settembre/30/pensa_Totti_ga_0_0209304391.shtml |title=Ci pensa Totti |work=La Gazzetta dello Sport |language=it |date=30 September 2002 |access-date=16 February 2016 |archive-date=17 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160317003348/http://archiviostorico.gazzetta.it/2002/settembre/30/pensa_Totti_ga_0_0209304391.shtml |url-status=live}} Totti also scored the only goal in Roma's decisive 1–0 victory at the [[Santiago Bernabéu Stadium|Santiago Bernabéu]] against [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] on 30 October 2002; this was the first time in 35 years that an Italian team had won a match in [[Madrid]].{{cite news |url=http://www.corrieredellosport.it/624/2011/10/30-201566/2002+Champions+League,+Totti+eroe+a+Madrid |title=2002 Champions League, Totti eroe a Madrid |work=Corriere dello Sport |language=it |date=30 October 2011|access-date=13 April 2014|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140414165659/http://www.corrieredellosport.it/624/2011/10/30-201566/2002+Champions+League,+Totti+eroe+a+Madrid|archive-date=14 April 2014}} He continued his goalscoring exploits against [[Valencia CF|Valencia]], scoring two goals in a 3–0 win.{{cite news |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/champions_league/2797715.stm |title=Totti shoots down Valencia |work=BBC Sport |date=25 February 2003|access-date=18 April 2014|archive-date=14 April 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140414184552/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/champions_league/2797715.stm|url-status=live}} Despite this, Roma only finished third in their [[UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] group, and in eighth position in Serie A,{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesi/ital03.html |title=Italy 2002/03 |website=RSSSF |first1=Dario |last1=Desio |first2=Giacomo |last2=Giusti |first3=Francesco |last3=Gullo |date=31 August 2003|access-date=20 October 2015|archive-date=20 July 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220720004417/https://www.rsssf.org/tablesi/ital03.html|url-status=live}} although they managed to reach the [[2003 Coppa Italia final]]. In the final against Milan, Totti scored three times from free kicks over both legs (one goal at home and two at the [[San Siro]]), but Roma lost out to Milan 6–3 on aggregate.{{cite news |url=http://www.repubblica.it/online/calcio2002_serie_a/milancop/milancop/milancop.html |title=Al Milan anche la Coppa Italia |work=la Repubblica|access-date=25 July 2014|archive-date=8 August 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180808073606/http://www.repubblica.it/online/calcio2002_serie_a/milancop/milancop/milancop.html|url-status=live}} In 2003, Totti won his second Serie A Footballer of the Year Award. In the [[2003–04 Serie A|2003–04 season]], Totti played a key role, as Roma finished runner-up to Milan in the ''[[Scudetto]]'' race.{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesi/ital04.html |title=Italy 2003/04 |website=RSSSF |first1=Andrea |last1=Ferrigno |first2=Giacomo |last2=Giusti |date=19 August 2005 |access-date=22 October 2015 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160207154304/http://www.rsssf.com/tablesi/ital04.html |archive-date=7 February 2016}} Throughout the league season, he scored 20 goals, his best haul in Serie A up to that point, which allowed him to win his second Guerin d'Oro, as the player with the best average rating in Serie A throughout the season. Moreover, the Roma captain notably scored trademark chipped goals on two occasions throughout the season, against Brescia and [[Empoli FC|Empoli]].{{cite web |url=http://www.corrieregiallorosso.com/corriere/totti-e-il-suo-marchio-di-fabbrica-tra-cucchiai-e-pallonetti-e-il-suo-colpo-preferito/ |title=Totti e il suo "marchio di fabbrica": tra cucchiai e |url=http://www.abc.net.au/news/2004-12-20/totti-breaks-record-udinese-close-gap/605630 |title=Totti breaks record, Udinese close gap |publisher=abc.net.au |date=19 December 2004|access-date=27 July |date=26 July 2006|access-date=14 November 2016|archive-date=20 July 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220720013840/https://www.rsssf.org/tablesi/ital05.html|url-status=live}} Totti |url=http://www.repubblica.it/2006/04/sezioni/sport/calcio/semifinale-coppa-italia/semifinale-coppa-italia/semifinale-coppa-italia.html |title=Colpo Tommasi, Roma in finale Troverà l'Inter, come nel Roma's new coach for the [[2005–06 AS Roma season|2005–06 season]], [[Luciano Spalletti]], went with a [[Formation (association football)#4–3–2–1 (the "Christmas tree" formation)|4–2–3–1 formation]], deploying Totti in a newer, more offensive role as a lone striker. Despite his new attacking role, Totti usually dropped deep to pick up the ball in midfield rather than operating in the penalty area, thus creating space for the attacking midfielders and wingers to making offensive runs; the resulting system was later described as a [[Formation (association football)#4–6–0|4–6–0]], while Totti's particular attacking role was dubbed the "[[false 9]]".{{cite web |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/1435904-great-team-tactics-francesco-totti-roma-and-the-first-false-nine |title=Great Team Tactics: Francesco Totti, Roma and the First False Nine |website=Bleacher Report |first=Sam |last=Tighe |date=6 December 2012|access-date=27 July 2016|archive-date=10 January 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200110231026/https://bleacherreport.com/articles/1435904-great-team-tactics-francesco-totti-roma-and-the-first-false-nine|url-status=live}} In this new position, Totti continued to score frequently, managing 15 goals in 24 league matches. In the spring of 2005, he renewed his contract until 2010, with an annual salary of €5.4 million.{{cite web |url=http://edition.cnn.com/2005/SPORT/football/05/31/italy.totti/ |title=Totti agrees Roma |title=Totti's broken ankle takes shine off Roma's 10th straight victory |work=The Guardian |date=20 February 2006|access-date=31 May 2011}} Totti was at risk of missing the [[2006 FIFA World Cup|2006 World Cup]], but returned to the side on 11 May 2006 as a substitute in Roma's 3–1 [[2006 Coppa Italia final|Coppa Italia final]] defeat to Inter.{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesi/italcup06.html |title=Italy Cup 2005/06 |website=RSSSF |first=Antonio |last=Zea |date=25 May 2006 |access-date=7 January 2016 |url-status=live |url=http://www.tribalfootball.com/articles/roma-doc-explains-totti-plate-decision-134941 |title=Roma doc explains Totti plate decision |publisher=Tribal Football |date=17 June 2006|access-date=31 May given [[Off-label use|off-label]] treatments of [[teriparatide]] to speed-up his fracture recovery.{{cite web |url=http://www.internalmedicinenews.com/index.php?id=2049&type=98&tx_ttnews%5btt_news%5d=93933&cHash=da03e20e36 |title=Accelerating Fracture Healing With Teriparatide |first=Bruce |last=Jancin and once in the round of 16 tie against [[Olympique Lyonnais|Lyon]]) and the [[2006–07 Coppa Italia|Coppa Italia]], in addition to 15 assists in 50 games across all competitions. once again expected to be Italy's star player in the number 10 role, Totti acquired a measure of infamy at [[UEFA Euro 2004|Euro 2004]] after he spat at [[Denmark national football team|Danish]] midfielder [[Christian Poulsen]] in a goalless draw in Italy's opening group match of the tournament on 14 June 2004. He was subsequently banned until the semi-finals,{{cite news |url=http://www.repubblica.it/diretta/online/sport-calcio-tottiday/index.html |title=Il giorno di Totti |work=la Repubblica |language=it|access-date=29 January 2015|archive-date=18 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190518185151/http://www.repubblica.it/diretta/online/sport-calcio-tottiday/index.html|url-status=live}} but never made it back to action and finished the competition scoreless due to Italy's elimination in the first round on direct encounters, following a three-way five point tie with [[Sweden men's national football team|Sweden]] and Denmark.{{cite web |url=http://www.storiedicalcio.altervista.org/europei_2004.html |title=La Storia dei Campionati Europei di Calcio – 2004: GRECIA |publisher=Storie di Calcio |language=it|access-date=29 January 2015|archive-date=1 November 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161101011536/http://www.storiedicalcio.altervista.org/europei_2004.html|url-status=live}} === 2006 World Cup === [[File:Italia Campione del Mondo.jpg|thumb|right|Totti (right), [[President of Italy]] [[Giorgio Napolitano]] and the team celebrate victory in the [[2006 FIFA World Cup|2006 World Cup]]]] Despite injury troubles, Totti recovered in time to join the national team for their victorious [[2006 FIFA World Cup|2006 World Cup]] campaign, despite a lack of match practice during his three months on the sidelines. Italy manager [[Marcello Lippi]] showed enormous faith in Totti, assuring him during his rehabilitation that his spot in Italy's World Cup squad was secure and to focus on recuperating. This encouragement and show of faith fueled Totti's desire to work even harder to overcome what could have been a career-ending injury and make it to the World Cup against all odds (and much of the Italian media's opinion).{{cite news |title=Aspettando Godot, anche al Mondiale |url=http://www.gazzetta.it/Speciali/Mondiale_2006/Primo_Piano/2006/06_Giugno/22/godot.html |work=La Gazzetta dello Totti finished the tournament with the joint-highest number of assists, along with [[Juan Román Riquelme]] (4).{{cite news |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/28123120|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160401063434/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/28123120|url-status=dead|archive-date=1 April 2016 |title=World Cup 2014: Today at the tournament – day 23 |work=BBC Sport|access-date=29 January 2015}} Totti set up Pirlo's goal from a short corner in Italy's opening 2–0 win against [[Ghana national football team|Ghana]],{{cite news |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/world_cup_2006/4852746.stm |title=BBC SPORT | Football | World Cup 2006 | Italy 2–0 Ghana |work=BBC News |date=12 June 2006 |access-date=28 June 2012 |archive-date=18 May 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190518185159/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/world_cup_2006/4852746.stm |url-status=live}}{{cite web |url=http://www.calcioblog.it/post/784/mondiali-2006-italia-2-ghana-0 |title=Mondiali 2006: Italia 2 Ghana 0 |date=12 June 2006|access-date=29 January 2015|archive-date=29 January 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150129183332/http://www.calcioblog.it/post/784/mondiali-2006-italia-2-ghana-0|url-status=dead}} [[Marco Materazzi]]'s goal from a corner in Italy's final group match, a 2–0 win against the [[Czech Republic national football team|Czech Republic]],{{cite news |url=http://www.repubblica.it/speciale/2006/mondiali/dati/dirette/1596550.html |title=Rep. June 2010}} === Retirement === Totti intended to retire from international football after the 2006 World Cup, but reneged on his decision and remained undecided on his future for over a year, not being called up in the meantime. He made his retirement official on 20 July 2007, at the beginning of the [[2007–08 Serie A]] season, due to recurring physical problems{{cite news |url=http://www.corriere.it/Primo_Piano/Sport/2007/07_Luglio/20/totti_lascia_nazionale.shtml |title=Totti dice addio alla Nazionale |work=Corriere della Sera |language=it |date=20 July 2007|access-date=29 January 2015|archive-date=17 June 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130617122609/http://www.corriere.it/Primo_Piano/Sport/2007/07_Luglio/20/totti_lascia_nazionale.shtml|url-status=live}} and in order to focus solely on club play with Roma. Italy's coach at the time, [[Roberto Donadoni]], attempted to get Totti to change his mind for the remaining [[UEFA Euro 2008|Euro 2008]] qualifiers but was not successful.{{cite news |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/europe/6908413.stm |title=Totti ends international career |work=BBC Sport |date=20 July 2007|access-date=1 June 2012|archive-date=28 July 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130728103150/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/europe/6908413.stm|url-status=live}} After Marcello Lippi's reappointment as the national team's manager following Euro 2008, Totti announced that he would play in the [[2010 FIFA World Cup|2010 World Cup]] finals in South Africa if he were to receive a call-up;{{cite news |url=http://www.gazzetta.it/Calcio/SerieA/Roma/02-01-2010/totti-apertura-mondiale-602515730259.shtml |title=Totti, apertura Mondiale "Se Lippi chiama dico sì" |work=La Gazzetta dello Sport |language=it |date=2 January 2010|access-date=29 January 2015|archive-date=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151222170340/http://www.gazzetta.it/Calcio/SerieA/Roma/02-01-2010/totti-apertura-mondiale-602515730259.shtml|url-status=live}} however, there was no official statement release from Totti or Lippi about a possible comeback.{{cite news |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2009/oct/13/francesco-totti-return-italy |title=Francesco Totti considers Italy comeback |work=The Guardian |date=13 October 2009|access-date=13 July 2014}} For the final tournament, Totti was not named in the 23-man squad, and Italy was subsequently eliminated, failing to win a match and finishing last in their group, their worst-ever World Cup performance. [[Diego Maradona]] and former national teammates [[Fabio Cannavaro]] and [[Gianluigi Buffon]] said one of the reasons for Italy's early exit was due to the lack of creative players like Totti in the team.{{cite web |url=http://www.forzaroma.info/2010/06/26/maradonaqlitalia-eliminata-mi-dispiace-ma-ci-voleva-uno-come-tottiq-21779/27549 |title=Maradona:"L'Italia eliminata? Mi dispiace, ma ci voleva uno come Totti ..." |publisher=Forzaroma.info |language=it |date=26 June 2010|access-date=13 July 2014|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140714192852/http://www.forzaroma.info/2010/06/26/maradonaqlitalia-eliminata-mi-dispiace-ma-ci-voleva-uno-come-tottiq-21779/27549|archive-date=14 July 2014}} In March 2013, Lippi's successor as Italy's coach, [[Cesare Prandelli]], stated that he would consider Totti for the [[2014 FIFA World Cup|2014 World Cup]] squad.{{cite news |url=http://www.gazzetta.it/Calcio/Mondiali/26-03-2014/mondiale-prandelli-balotelli-ascolta-seedorf-tira-fuori-tue-emozioni-80316055172.shtml |title=Mondiale, Prandelli: "Cassano e Totti? the Netherlands. One of his most famous lobbed goals, in which he dribbled past Inter's [[Marco Materazzi]] before chipping the ball over goalkeeper [[Júlio César (football goalkeeper, born 1979)|Júlio César]], was later named the best goal in Serie A of the 2005–06 season.{{cite news |url=http://video.repubblica.it/sport/totti-i-cinque-gol-indimenticabili-il-pallonetto-contro-l-inter/121245/119730 |work=la Repubblica |title=Totti, i cinque gol indimenticabili: il pallonetto contro l'Inter |first=Pier Luigi |last=Pisa |language=it |date=4 March 2013|access-date=15 June 2015|archive-date=1 February 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160201045553/http://video.repubblica.it/sport/totti-i-cinque-gol-indimenticabili-il-pallonetto-contro-l-inter/121245/119730|url-status=live}} He scored another notable goal using this technique against Lazio in the 2002 ''Derby della Capitale'', which ended in a 5–1 win for Roma.{{cite news |url=http://video.repubblica.it/sport/totti-la-rete-nel-derby-del-2002/121249?video |title=Totti, la rete nel derby del 2002 |work=la Repubblica |first=Pier Luigi |last=Pisa |language=it |date=4 March 2013|access-date=15 June 2015|archive-date=22 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150922234220/http://video.repubblica.it/sport/totti-la-rete-nel-derby-del-2002/121249?video|url-status=live}} The title of Totti's 2006 autobiography ''Tutto Totti'': ''Mo je faccio er cucchiaio'' ({{langx|en|All about Totti}}: ''I'm gonna chip him now'') referenced this technique, as well as the statement made to his Italy teammates before his memorable Euro 2000 semi-final shootout penalty against the Netherlands.''Mo je faccio er cucchiaio'' ({{langx|it|adesso gli faccio il cucchiaio}}) is actually [[Romanesco dialect|Romanesco]], the Roman-Italian dialect Totti regularly speaks. Having served as Roma's captain for several years, Totti was praised for his leadership.{{cite web |url=http://www.football-italia.net/44948/totti-leadership |title=Totti on leadership |publisher=Football Italia |date=7 February 2014|access-date=2 October 2016|archive-date=3 October 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161003055619/http://www.football-italia.net/44948/totti-leadership|url-status=live}} Italian former footballer [[Roberto Mancini]] likened Totti's playing style to his own in 2016, due to his movement, quality, and intuition.{{cite web |url=https://www.fcinter1908.it/copertina/mancini-totti-prima-lui-e-poi-gli-altri-dieci-la-roma-dovrebbe/ |title=Mancini: "Totti? Prima lui, poi gli altri 10. E' di un altro livello, rinnovo d'obbligo" |publisher=FC Inter 1908 |language=it-IT |date=9 May 2016 |access-date=25 March 2024 |archive-date=25 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240325172653/https://www.fcinter1908.it/copertina/mancini-totti-prima-lui-e-poi-gli-altri-dieci-la-roma-dovrebbe/ |url-status=live}} Despite his talent and ability, however, Totti drew criticism at times for his character and lack of discipline on the pitch, which occasionally caused him to commit bad fouls and receive unnecessary bookings; with [[Football records and statistics in Italy#Discipline|eleven red cards and 109 yellow cards, he has the joint-sixth highest number of sending offs in Serie A history, and the seventh most bookings in the league's history]].{{cite news |url=http://www.timesofmalta.com/articles/view/20101101/football/ranieri-defends-irate-totti-after-red-card.334125 |title=Ranieri defends irate Totti after red card |work=[[Times of Malta]] |date=1 November 2010|access-date=2 October 2016|archive-date=3 October 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161003102942/http://www.timesofmalta.com/articles/view/20101101/football/ranieri-defends-irate-totti-after-red-card.334125|url-status=live}}{{cite web |url=http://romanews.eu/it,a112023/Totti-11-Espulsioni-Nessuno-Rosso-Come-Lui-Giocatori-In-Attivita-Serie-Br,m82 |title=Totti, 11 espulsioni. Nessuno 'rosso' come lui tra i giocatori in attività della Serie A |publisher=RomaNews.eu |language=it|access-date=11 September 2014|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140808122414/http://romanews.eu/it,a112023/Totti-11-Espulsioni-Nessuno-Rosso-Come-Lui-Giocatori-In-Attivita-Serie-Br,m82 |archive-date=8 August 2014}}{{cite web |url=http://www.contra-ataque.it/2016/02/16/calciatori-espulsi-serie-a-montero.html |title=I calciatori più espulsi nella storia della Serie A: Montero irraggiungibile |publisher=contra-ataque.it |language=it |author1=Claudio Agave |work=Contrataque |date=16 February 2016 |access-date=2 May 2017 |archive-date=1 June 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170601024056/http://www.contra-ataque.it/2016/02/16/calciatori-espulsi-serie-a-montero.html |url-status=dead }}{{cite web |title=I 10 calciatori più ammoniti della storia della Serie A |url=https://www.90min.com/it/posts/i-10-calciatori-piu-ammoniti-della-storia-della-serie-a |publisher=90min.com |access-date=10 May 2026 |language=it-IT |date=24 November 2023}} === Goal celebrations === Totti was known for his exuberant and humorous [[goal celebration]]s. One of his famous celebrations took place on 11 April 1999 in the second ''Derby della Capitale'' of the [[1998–99 Serie A|1998–99 season]], in which he scored during the final minutes of the game and celebrated by flashing a T-shirt under his jersey, which read ''"Vi ho purgato ancora"'' ("I've purged you guys again"), in reference to events at the previous derby against Lazio on 29 November 1998 when Totti helped Roma come back from 3–1 down with an assist to [[Eusebio Di Francesco]] for 3–2 and finally a goal of his own for 3–3.{{cite news |title=Dal "Sei unica" al selfie, tutte le esultanze di capitan Totti nei derby|trans-title=From "you're one of a kind" to a selfie, all of captain Totti's goal celebrations in the Rome derby matches |url=http://roma.repubblica.it/cronaca/2015/01/12/foto/dal_sei_unica_al_selfie_tutte_le_esultanze_di_capitan_totti-104794789/1/#1 |work=la Repubblica|access-date=4 May 2015 |language=it |date=12 January 2015}} Another derby goal against Lazio saw him take over a sideline camera and aim it at the Roma fans. Totti has displayed numerous T-shirts with messages on them from under his jersey over the years, including two for his wife; ''"6 Unica"'' ("You're One of a kind") and ''"6 Sempre Unica"'' ("You're Still the One"), and a political one ''"Liberate Giuliana"'' ("Free Giuliana") in honor of [[Giuliana Sgrena]], an Italian journalist kidnapped in 2005 by insurgents in Iraq who was later freed. The most recent message was ''"Scusate il Ritardo"'' ("Sorry for the delay") which he flashed on 8 January 2012 as an apology to fans for his goalscoring drought after scoring his first goal of the season versus Chievo. As a tribute to his then-pregnant wife, [[Ilary Blasi]], Totti imitated a childbirth scene by stuffing the ball under his shirt and lying on his back while his teammates extracted the ball. His current ritual of sucking his thumb after a goal began after his son was born and continued after the birth of his daughter. Blasi has revealed that Totti also sucks his thumb in dedication to her and not just for their children.{{cite web |url=http://www.francescototti.com/main.html |title=Face to Face|access-date=1 June 2012 |work=Totti.com|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120615170114/http://www.francescototti.com/main.html|archive-date=15 June 2012}}{{cite web |url=http://www.footballitaliano.org/2626/tottis-goal-celebration-is-for-wife-blasi.html |title=Totti's Goal Celebration Is For Wife Blasi |date=5 January 2009|access-date=31 May 2011 |publisher=Football Italiano|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100113115443/http://www.footballitaliano.org/2626/tottis-goal-celebration-is-for-wife-blasi.html|archive-date=13 January 2010 |url-status=dead}} On 11 January 2015, Totti scored twice against Lazio in the ''Derby della Capitale'' as Roma came back from 2–0 down; he then took a [[selfie]] with Roma fans.{{cite news |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/30719796 |title=Roma 2–2 Lazio |work=BBC Sport |date=11 January 2015|access-date=16 February 2016}} == After retirement == On 17 July 2017, Totti confirmed his retirement from professional football and announced that he had accepted an offer from his former team to become a club director.{{cite web |url=http://www.espnfc.com/as-roma/story/3159323/francesco-totti-confirms-retirement-and-accepts-offer-to-be-club-director-at-roma |title=Francesco Totti confirms retirement, accepts offer as club director at Roma |publisher=ESPN FC |author1=Ben Gladwell |date=17 July 2017|access-date=17 July 2017}} On 18 September, Totti began studying for a course in order to obtain his UEFA B coaching licence.{{cite web |url=http://www.espnfc.com/as-roma/story/3207932/roma-director-francesco-totti-starts-uefa-b-licence-coaching-course |title=Roma director Francesco Totti starts UEFA B Licence coaching course |publisher=ESPN FC |author1=Ben Gladwell |date=19 September 2017|access-date=21 September 2017}} However, he withdrew from the course two weeks later, as he was unable to attend the course regularly due to his commitments as a director of Roma; his former teammate Simone Perrotta took his place.{{cite web |url=http://www.espnfc.com/as-roma/story/3220213/roma-director-francesco-totti-withdraws-from-coaching-course-after-two-weeks |title=Roma director Francesco Totti quits coaching course after two weeks |publisher=ESPN FC |author1=Ben Gladwell |date=4 October 2017|access-date=5 October 2017}} On 17 June 2019, he announced his resignation from his role at Roma, in an hour-long press conference held at the Italian Olympic Committee headquarters, where he publicly accused chairman James Pallotta and the management for not involving him enough in the club's decision making, stating he would reconsider a comeback only under a different ownership. This marked the end of his 30-year association with the club.{{cite news |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2019/jun/17/francesco-totti-hits-out-at-roma-hierarchy-as-he-leaves-club-after-30-years |newspaper=The Guardian |title=Francesco Totti hits out at Roma hierarchy as he leaves club after 30 years |access-date=18 June 2019 |date=17 June 2019}}{{cite news |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/48663777 |title=Francesco Totti leaves Roma after 30 years as he resigns as director |date=17 June 2019 |work=BBC Sport|access-date=27 August 2019}} == Outside of professional football == === Personal life === [[File:Totti 2007.jpg|thumb|Totti in 2007]] Totti married [[Ilary Blasi]], a former [[showgirl]] and a co-host of [[Italia 1]]'s ''[[Le Iene]]'', on 19 June 2005 at the Basilica of [[Santa Maria in Aracoeli]]. Their wedding was aired on television, with the proceeds being donated to charity. They had their first child on 6 November 2005. Their second child, a daughter, was born on 13 May 2007. The couple had often been referred to as the "Italian [[Posh and Becks|Beckhams]]", and their private lives are often speculated upon in Italian magazines and tabloids.{{cite news |url=http://www.lastampa.it/2009/02/06/societa/i-beckham-de-noantri-97q3FKw7MjHUJMK5VMiGmI/pagina.html |title=I Beckham de noantri |newspaper=La Stampa |language=it |date=6 February 2009|access-date=12 April 2016}} On 10 March 2016, the couple had their third child.{{cite news |url=http://www.gazzetta.it/Calcio/Serie-A/Roma/10-03-2016/totti-nata-figlia-la-terza-volta-capitano-roma-diventa-papa-140968765899.shtml |title=Totti, è nata la figlia Isabel: il capitano della Roma è papà per la terza volta|trans-title=Totti, his daughter Isabel is born: the Roma captain is a father for the third time |work=La Gazzetta dello Sport |language=it |first=Chiara |last=Zucchelli |date=10 March 2016 |access-date=11 March 2016}} On 12 October 2020, Totti's father, Enzo, died at 76 years old due to [[COVID-19]], amid the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy|pandemic in Italy]].[https://roma.repubblica.it/cronaca/2020/10/12/news/roma_morto_enzo_il_papa_di_francesco_totti_era_positivo_al_coronavirus-270340777/ Roma, è morto Enzo Totti, il papà di Francesco. Era positivo al coronavirus], ''la Repubblica'' In the aftermath, Totti struggled with his [[Mental health in association football|mental health]] and discovered evidence of Blasi's infidelity.{{Cite web |date=2023-11-27 |title=Ilary Blasi, Corona: "Anche lei tradiva Totti, prima del ragazzo del caffè ce ne sono stati altri" |url=https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/topnews/2022/07/11/ilary-blasi-allansa-il-mio-matrimonio-con-totti-e-finito_a5b8c9aa-ed21-48d7-8b4d-e0402aafc90d.html |title=Ilary Blasi all'ANSA, il mio matrimonio con Totti è finito |publisher=ansa.it |date=11 July 2022 |language=Italian}} Totti then started a relationship with Noemi Bocchi.{{Cite web |date=2024-08-31 |title=Francesco Totti e gli |access-date=2024-09-02 |website=Corriere della Sera |language=it-IT}} In October 2024, Totti ended his relationship with Bocchi, and began a new relationship with sports journalist Marialuisa Jacobelli.{{cite news |title=Francesco Totti e Marialuisa Jacobelli in hotel a Roma, lei: "C'è una liaison" |url=https://www.tgcom24.mediaset.it/people/francesco-totti-marialuisa-jacobelli-hotel-roma-liaison-flirt_89283074-202402k.shtml |access-date=24 October 2024 |agency=tgcom24.mediaset.it |url=https://www.vanityfair.it/article/francesco-totti-marialuisa-jacobelli-flirt-albergo |access-date=24 October 2024 |agency=vanityfair.it |publisher=vanityfair.it |date=24 October 2024}} Totti is a [[Roman Catholic]].{{cite news |url=http://www.gazzetta.it/Sport_Vari/Altro/11-02-2013/papa-totti-sorpreso-molto-triste-petrucci-persona-straordinaria-914250723085.shtml |title=Papa, Totti: "Sorpreso e molto triste" Buffon: "Grande responsabilità". |work=La Gazzetta dello Sport |language=it |date=11 February 2013 |access-date=12 April 2016}} Totti's brother Riccardo serves as his agent,{{cite web |url=http://www.topendsports.com/athletes/football-soccer/totti-francesco.htm |title=Francesco Totti: Football (Soccer) |publisher=Topend Sports|access-date=23 February 2017}} and manages many of his brand and business interests, under the name Number Ten, including the Francesco Totti Academy, a football training school, and the Totti Soccer School, a football camp for children with disabilities. Totti also owns a motorcycle racing team called Totti Top Sport.{{cite news |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/jun/19/football-star-flats-homeless-housing-francesco-totti-rome |title=The football star, the run-down flats and the sky-high rent for homeless housing |work=The Guardian |first=John |last=Hooper |date=19 June 2015|access-date=12 April 2016}} === Philanthropy === Totti became a [[UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador#Italy|goodwill ambassador]] for [[UNICEF]] in 2003,{{cite web |url=http://www.unicef.org/people/people_14222.html |title=Goodwill ambassadors |publisher=UNICEF|access-date=18 June 2010|archive-date=7 June 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110607113503/http://www.unicef.org/people/people_14222.html|url-status=dead}}{{cite web |url=http://www.unicef.org/infobycountry/italy_francesco_totti.html |title=Francesco Totti |publisher=UNICEF|access-date=18 June 2010|archive-date=7 June 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110607113613/http://www.unicef.org/infobycountry/italy_francesco_totti.html|url-status=dead}} and an ambassador for the FIFA/SOS Children's Villages in January 2006. As a fundraiser for a children's charity, he published two best-selling, self-effacing joke books, containing jokes the locals often told about him and his teammates. Some of the jokes were filmed in short sketches, featuring himself with good friends and national teammates Alessandro Del Piero, Gianluigi Buffon, Christian Vieri, Antonio Cassano, Marco Delvecchio, [[Alessandro Nesta]] and former national team coach Giovanni Trapattoni in a short show called ''La sai l'ultima di Totti''. On 16 January 2008, he appeared as "PaperTotti" in the [[Disney comics|Disney]] comic series ''[[Topolino]]''. The proceeds of the subscriptions were given to charity. The Roma captain's official testimonial was a fundraising match between singers and celebrities played on 12 May 2008 to help raise money for the construction of the Campus Produttivo della Legalità e della Solidarietà (Productive Campus of Legality and Solidarity).{{cite news |title=Maradona, Totti, Zico, Rocchi e altri fenomeni All'Olimpico la Partita del cuore |url=http://www.ilmessaggero.it/home_roma/citta/maradona_totti_zico_rocchi_e_altri_fenomeni_alolimpico_la_partita_del_cuore/notizie/24014.shtml |date=11 May 2008|access-date=17 April 2014 |work=Il Messaggero |language=it|archive-date=18 April 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140418220636/http://www.ilmessaggero.it/home_roma/citta/maradona_totti_zico_rocchi_e_altri_fenomeni_alolimpico_la_partita_del_cuore/notizie/24014.shtml|url-status=dead}} In 2009, Totti helped launch a new campaign promoting Football Adopting Abandoned Children, which came about in collaboration with the Friends of Children and the Association of Italian Players. In the project, he adopted a team of around eleven young Kenyans to play football in [[Nairobi]], and then to coach them along the way.{{cite web |url=http://www.goal.com/en/news/10/italy/2009/06/20/1335771/roma-captain-francesco-totti-to-coach-team-of-abandoned-children- |title=Roma Captain Francesco Totti To Coach Team Of Abandoned Children For Charity |publisher=Goal.com |date=20 June 2009|access-date=3 July 2015}} In 2015, Totti and several of his teammates took to the pitch for "Tennis with Stars" in the [[Foro Italico]] in Rome, an event to help disadvantaged children. Tennis players such as [[Novak Djokovic]] and [[Flavia Pennetta]] participated at the event.{{cite news |url=http://www.repubblica.it/sport/tennis/2015/05/11/foto/djokovic_e_totti_danno_spettacolo-114139648/1/#1 |title=Tennis, Internazionali: Djokovic e Totti danno spettacolo per beneficenza |work=la Repubblica |date=11 May 2015|access-date=27 June 2015 |language=it}} On 27 September 2016, Totti celebrated his 40th birthday live on his new [[Facebook]] page,{{cite web |url=http://www.espnfc.us/club/as-roma/104/blog/post/2959339/roma-legend-francesco-totti-40-things-to-know-on-his-40th-birthday |title=Roma legend Francesco Totti: 40 things to know on his 40th birthday |publisher=ESPN FC |first=Terry |last=Daley |date=27 September 2016 |access-date=2 October 2016}} at the Tor Crescenza castle in Rome.{{cite news |first=Maria Egizia |last=Fiaschetti |url=http://roma.corriere.it/notizie/cronaca/16_settembre_30/quartant-anni-totti-maria-sensi-non-ci-ha-invitati-ingrato-64b17d2e-8733-11e6-b094-d674d9773420.shtml |title=Quarant'anni di Totti, Maria Sensi: "Non ci ha invitati. Ingrato" |work=Corriere della Sera |language=it |date=30 September 2016|access-date=2 October 2016}} Totti recorded a video message for a comatose hospital patient who awoke from her coma when his voice was played; Totti visited the patient in the hospital in September 2020.{{Cite news |title=Football Legend Francesco Totti Visits Girl Awakened From Coma By His Voice |url=https://sports.ndtv.com/football/football-legend-francesco-totti-visits-girl-awakened-from-coma-by-his-voice-2302296|access-date=30 September 2020 |newspaper=Ndtvsports.com}} === Television, cinema and publicity === In 2002, [[Fiat]] principal executive [[Gianni Agnelli]], a lifelong fan and ex-president of Juventus, chose Totti to publicize the launch of the new Stilo instead of a Juventus player.{{cite news |title=Ma la Fiat tradisce i bianconeri Totti il testimonial della Stilo |url=http://ricerca.repubblica.it/repubblica/archivio/repubblica/2002/04/14/ma-la-fiat-tradisce-bianconeri-totti-il.html |date=14 April 2002|access-date=16 April 2014 |work=la Repubblica |language=it}} Having been signed to sportswear company [[Nike, Inc.|Nike]], Totti featured in Nike's "[[Secret Tournament]]" advertisement, directed by [[Terry Gilliam]], in the buildup to the 2002 World Cup in Korea and Japan. He appeared alongside [[Ronaldo (Brazilian footballer)|Ronaldo]], [[Ronaldinho]], Luís Figo, [[Roberto Carlos]] and [[Hidetoshi Nakata]], with former player [[Eric Cantona]] the tournament "referee".{{cite news |title=A lighter shoe, cooler kits, a faster ball, a Secret Tournament – every touch counts |url=http://www.nikebiz.com/story/stry_scorpion.shtml |work=NikeBiz |publisher=Nike |access-date=16 February 2015 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020602055510/http://www.nikebiz.com/story/stry_scorpion.shtml |archive-date=2 June 2002}}{{cite news |first=Claire |last=Cozens |title=Cantona hosts World Cup with a difference |url=https://www.theguardian.com/media/2002/apr/03/advertising.worldcupfootball2002?INTCMP=ILCNETTXT3487 |work=The Guardian |date=3 April 2002 |access-date=16 February 2015}} Totti has featured in [[EA Sports]]' [[FIFA (video game series)|''FIFA'' video game series]]; he appeared on the cover of the Italian edition of ''[[FIFA 2002]]''.{{cite web |title=Fifa 2002 & Totti |url=http://www2.raisport.rai.it/news/rubriche/giochi/200106/27/3b3a505001915/ |publisher=Rai Sport|access-date=17 March 2015 |language=it|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151222104504/http://www2.raisport.rai.it/news/rubriche/giochi/200106/27/3b3a505001915/|archive-date=22 December 2015|url-status=dead}} He also featured on the cover of ''[[Pro Evolution Soccer 4]]'', along with [[Thierry Henry]] and Italian referee [[Pierluigi Collina]].{{cite news |url=http://www.totalvideogames.com/Pro-Evolution-Soccer-4/news/Konami-Sign-Henry-Totti-and-Collina-6062.html |title=Konami Sign Henry, Totti and Collina News |date=9 September 2004|access-date=31 May 2011 |publisher=totalvideogames.com|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150503200655/http://www.totalvideogames.com/Pro-Evolution-Soccer-4/news/Konami-Sign-Henry-Totti-and-Collina-6062.html|archive-date=3 May 2015}} Between 2005 and 2008, his sponsors changed to sportswear company [[Diadora]] and soft drink [[Pepsi Twist]], with a commercial filmed in the camps of Trigoria by director [[Gabriele Muccino]]. Since May 2006, he has appeared in advertisements for telephone company [[Vodafone]]. In December 2006, Totti and his wife Ilary Blasi lent their voices to an Italian dubbing of an episode of the television series ''[[The Simpsons]]'' entitled "[[Marge and Homer Turn a Couple Play]]", in which Totti voiced Buck Mitchell.{{cite news |title=Totti voce dei Simpson: "Che intelligenti!" |url=http://archiviostorico.gazzetta.it/2008/maggio/03/Totti_voce_dei_Simpson_Che_ga_10_080503024.shtml |date=3 May 2008|access-date=30 April 2014 |work=La Gazzetta dello Sport |first=Stefano |last=Boldrini |language=it}} In 2007, he appeared in the movie ''L'allenatore nel Pallone 2'', in the role of a defense attorney. Since 2008, he has participated several times in the television program ''[[C'è posta per te]]'', in the second series of the Italian drama ''Cesaroni'', in the reality show ''[[Grande Fratello (season 8)|Grande Fratello]] 8'' and in an episode of ''Paperissima''.
