In the Netherlands' first match of the [[2014 FIFA World Cup|2014 World Cup]], Robben scored two goals in a 5–1 win over Spain.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.espn.co.uk/football/sport/story/315307.html |title=Van Gaal masterminds Dutch destruction of Spain |publisher=ESPN |date=13 June 2014 |access-date=13 June 2014 |archive-date=8 February 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150208181026/http://www.espn.co.uk/football/sport/story/315307.html |url-status=dead }}</ref><!--Don't add information about his run of 37km/h as it was FIFA error, and for current official tracking statistics he ran 31.03 and 28.69 km/h--> In the Netherlands' second group stage match, a 3–2 win over [[Australia men's national soccer team|Australia]], Robben scored the team's opening goal as they qualified for the [[2014 FIFA World Cup knockout stage|knockout stage]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/25285148 |title=Australia 2–3 Netherlands |access-date=19 June 2014 |website=BBC Sport |date=18 June 2014 |first=Mandeep |last=Sanghera}}</ref> In the round of 16 knock-out match with [[Mexico national football team|Mexico]], the Netherlands won on a penalty awarded after Robben went down following a challenge from [[Rafael Márquez]]. The [[Associated Press]] said that Robben's "theatrical" fall "did little to defuse the debate about his reputation for diving".<ref>{{cite news |url=https://abcnews.go.com/Sports/wireStory/robben-falls-theatrically-earn-decisive-penalty-24356894 |title=Robben Falls Theatrically to Earn Decisive Penalty |agency=Associated Press |date=29 June 2014 |access-date=29 June 2014|website=ABC News |first=Mike |last=Corder}}</ref> Robben maintained that the penalty was correct but admitted to falling easily earlier in the match, telling [[Nederlandse Omroep Stichting|a Dutch TV channel]] that "the one [at the end] was a penalty, but the other one was a dive in the first half. I shouldn't be doing that".<ref>{{cite web |url=http://m.nbcsports.com/content/arjen-robben-apologizes-early-match-diving-agrees-penalty-call |title=Arjen Robben apologizes for early-match diving, but agrees with penalty call|website=NBC Sports|publisher=NBC|date=29 June 2014 |access-date=29 June 2014 |first=Kyle |last=Bonn |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140714154108/http://m.nbcsports.com/content/arjen-robben-apologizes-early-match-diving-agrees-penalty-call |archive-date=14 July 2014 }}</ref>

In the [[2014 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Quarter-finals|quarter-final]], Robben scored the Netherlands' second kick in a 4–3 penalty shootout victory against [[Costa Rica national football team|Costa Rica]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/28069208 |title=Netherlands 0–0 Costa Rica|website=BBC Sport|date=5 June 2014 |access-date=6 June 2014}}</ref> On 11 July, Robben was named on the ten-man shortlist for FIFA's [[2014 FIFA World Cup#Golden Ball|Golden Ball]] award for the tournament's best player.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/28274011 |title=World Cup 2014: Fifa announces Golden Ball shortlist |date=11 July 2014 |access-date=12 July 2014 |website=BBC Sport}}</ref> On 28 August 2015, Robben was named [[Captain (association football)|captain]] of the Netherlands, replacing [[Robin van Persie]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Arjen Robben replaces Robin van Persie as new Netherlands captain |url=http://www.espnfc.com/netherlands/story/2585060/arjen-robben-named-netherlands-captain-over-robin-van-persie|website=ESPN FC|publisher=ESPN|access-date=28 August 2015 |date=28 August 2015}}</ref>

On 10 October 2017, Robben retired from international football after the team's unsuccessful [[2018 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)|2018 World Cup qualifying campaign]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/41547452 |title=Arjen Robben retires from international duty |website=BBC Sport |date=10 October 2017}}</ref> He made 96 appearances between 2003 and 2017 for the ''Oranje'' and scored 37 goals.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/miscellaneous/robben-intl.html |title=Arjen Robben {{!}} International Appearances |first=Karel |last=Stokkermans |date=11 September 2019 |access-date=12 September 2019|website=[[RSSSF]]}}</ref>

== Style of play ==
[[File:CSKA-Bavaria (15).jpg|thumb|294x294px|Robben taking a shot during the [[2014–15 UEFA Champions League|2014–15 Champions League]] ]]
Throughout most of his career, Robben was regarded as one of the best wingers in the world, with [[ESPN]] stating he is "able to take on and beat defenders at the drop of a hat, Robben's ability to get to the byline and deliver in accurate [[Cross (football)|crosses]] instils fear into any defence".<ref name=":0">{{cite web |url=http://www.espnfc.com/player/_/id/11137/arjen-robben?cc=5739 |title=Arjen Robben |publisher=ESPN FC |access-date=18 May 2014}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{cite web |url=http://msn.foxsports.com/foxsoccer/world/lists/power-rankings-top-right-wingers-world-soccer-professional-club-international-070612#photo-title=Arjen+Robben%252C+Bayern+Munich%252FNetherlands&photo=31181501 |title=World Power Rankings: Top 10 Right Wingers |work=Fox Sports |date=6 July 2012 |access-date=18 May 2014}}</ref> Usually deployed on the [[Winger (association football)|right wing]], Robben employed his signature move by cutting inside on his stronger left foot to move to a more central attacking position, and used his speed and [[Dribbling#Association football|dribbling]] skills to take on defenders until he found the space to make an attempt on goal.<ref name="Sports"/> Robben had a noticeable preference for using his dominant foot throughout his career: he scored 134 league goals with his left foot, while only ten league goals came with his weaker right foot.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/3692383/2022/10/15/antony-left-foot-robben/ |first2=Laurie |title='One-trick pony'? Antony has a trademark move - but how one-footed is he? |work=The Athletic |last1=Carey |first1=Mark |last2=Whitwell |date=15 October 2022 |access-date=1 May 2024 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2042445-ranking-the-top-15-players-who-were-completely-one-footed |title=Ranking the Top 14 Completely One Footed Players of All Time |publisher=Bleacher Report |last1=Murray |first1=Shane |date=26 April 2014 |access-date=1 May 2024 }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2013/11/08/sports/soccer/q-and-a-with-bayern-munichs-arjen-robben.html?pagewanted=all&_r=0 |title=Q. and A. With Bayern Munich's Arjen Robben |newspaper=The New York Times |date=7 November 2013 |access-date=24 December 2014 |url-access=registration}}</ref>

During the course of a match Robben would often drift to the left wing, with his teammate, in the case of Bayern Munich, [[Franck Ribéry]], switching over to the right. Together they were affectionately referred to by the nickname ''Robbery''.<ref>{{cite news|title=Bayern Munich's Arjen Robben and Franck Ribery: An exclusive double interview with 'Robbery'|website=Bundesliga.com|url=https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/arjen-robben-franck-ribery-exclusive-interview-bayern-munich-robbery-4524|access-date=16 July 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Thorogood|first1=James|date=5 May 2019|title=Opinion: The magic of 'Robbery' will be impossible to recreate|work=Deutsche Welle|url=https://www.dw.com/en/opinion-the-magic-of-robbery-will-be-impossible-to-recreate/a-48610277|access-date=16 July 2019}}</ref> Another factor in his playing style is his relationship with the right-sided full-back. At Bayern, this partnership with [[Philipp Lahm]] had benefits for the team's efficiency and chemistry. Robben's defensive work improved when he went to Bayern where he often tracked back and covered for his partner when he pushed forward and became a temporary right back.<ref name="Sports">{{cite magazine |url=http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/soccer/news/20130522/arjen-robben-champions-league-final/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130705102038/http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/soccer/news/20130522/arjen-robben-champions-league-final/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=5 July 2013 |title=Robben can put past failures to bed with Champions League triumph |magazine=Sports Illustrated |date=22 May 2013 |access-date=18 May 2014 |first=Raphael |last=Honigstein}}</ref>

Robben was often accused of [[Diving (association football)|diving]], and at times he openly admitted to the charges.<ref name=MexicoDive/><ref>{{cite web |last1=Law |first1=Matt |title=Arjen Robben says Arsenal fans made him a 'cornered dog' over dive accusations in Champions League victory Earlier in his career, Robben also drew criticism from pundits and other players for his perceived selfishness, his lack of composure in important games, and for his struggles with injuries throughout his career, which were initially thought to have limited his potential; however, he worked to develop his physique and the mental aspect of his game, and became a more consistent and world class team player as his career progressed, who was known for providing a good number of assists as well as scoring goals himself.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSKBN2CR0XA/ |title=Dutch veteran Robben dreams of Euro 2020 after months of injuries |work=Reuters |date=10 May 2021 |access-date=1 May 2024 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/37398084/robben-transformation-team-player |title=Robben's transformation to team player |work=ESPN.com |date=3 July 2014 |access-date=1 May 2024 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.beinsports.com/en-mena/football/bundesliga/articles/lewandowski-glad-to-overcome-robben-problem-1 |title=Lewandowski glad to overcome Robben problems |publisher=beIN SPORTS |date=3 February 2017 |access-date=1 May 2024 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2050307-8-insane-arjen-robben-stats-no-one-talks-about |title=8 Insane Arjen Robben Stats No One Talks About |publisher=Bleacher Report |last1=Whitney |first1=Clark |date=7 May 2014 |access-date=1 May 2024 }}</ref>

== Post-retirement ==
In August 2025, Robben competed in the CUPRA FIP Bronze tournament in Westerbork, appearing on the professional [[padel]] circuit. According to the [[International Padel Federation|International Padel Federation (FIP)]], he and partner Werner Lootsma won a qualifying match before being eliminated in the first round of the main draw.<ref>{{cite web |date=30 August 2025 |title=Robben from football to padel: debut in the CUPRA FIP Tour. And the Dutch stars congratulate him: "The best footballer with a pala" |url=https://www.padelfip.com/2025/08/robben-from-football-to-padel-debut-in-the-cupra-fip-tour-and-the-dutch-stars-congratulate-him-the-best-footballer-with-a-pala/ |access-date=16 November 2025 |website=padelfip.com |publisher=International Padel Federation}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Dale |first=Mike |date=2 September 2025 |title=Ex-Chelsea and Real Madrid star Arjen Robben plays on FIP padel tour |url=https://thepadelpaper.com/arjen-robben-padel-fip-bronze-westerbork/ |access-date=16 November 2025 |website=The Padel Paper |publisher=The Padel Paper}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
[[File:Bernadine und Arjen Robben 2656.jpg|thumb|right|Robben with his wife Bernadien in 2014]]
Robben married his girlfriend Bernadien Eillert on 9 June 2007 in Groningen.<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea striker Robben to tie knot |url=https://int.soccerway.com/news/2007/January/26/chelsea-striker-robben-to-tie-knot/ |agency=Agence France-Presse |date=10 June 2007 |access-date=24 April 2014}}</ref> The two met while in high school in the city, at the Kamerlingh Onnes,<ref>{{cite news |title=Arjen Robben dropped by |url=http://english.psv.nl/web/show/id=58980/contentid=8008 |publisher=PSV Eindhoven |date=7 January 2005 |access-date=3 August 2008 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080701021348/http://english.psv.nl/web/show/id%3D58980/contentid%3D8008 |archive-date=1 July 2008 |url-status=dead }}</ref> and have two sons, Luka (born 2008) and Kai (born 2012) and a daughter, Lynn (born 2010).<ref>{{cite news |title=Robben to AS |url=http://www.realmadrid.com/cs/Satellite/en/1193040487651/1202758365502/noticia/Noticia/Robben_to_AS.htm |publisher=Real Madrid C.F. |date=26 December 2008 |access-date=29 January 2009 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090131165712/http://www.realmadrid.com/cs/Satellite/en/1193040487651/1202758365502/noticia/Noticia/Robben_to_AS.htm |archive-date=31 January 2009 |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.fcbayern.t-home.de/en/teams/profis/12283.php |title=Arjen Robben |work=Bayern Munich |access-date=25 March 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100413231450/http://www.fcbayern.t-home.de/en/teams/profis/12283.php |archive-date=13 April 2010 |url-status=live}}</ref> Robben's father, Hans, worked as his [[sports agent|agent]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Robben happy with Real interest |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2007/aug/09/newsstory.realmadrid |work=The Guardian |date=9 August 2007 |access-date=27 January 2009 |location=London |first=Stephen |last=Bradfield}}</ref>

== Sponsorship ==
Robben has a sponsorship deal with German sportswear and equipment supplier [[Adidas]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://news.adidas.com/GB/Athletes-And-Ambassadors/Robben/s/ce624fe0-315e-4a9f-a2bd-7457ed98b38d |title=Arjen Robben: FiFA World Cup 2014 Player |publisher=adidas.com |access-date=8 September 2014}}</ref> Robben featured in EA Sports' [[FIFA (video game series)|''FIFA'' video game series]] before his retirement, and was the third-highest-rated player in ''[[FIFA 15]]''.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://ftw.usatoday.com/2014/09/the-10-highest-rated-players-in-fifa-15 |title=The 10 highest rated players in 'FIFA 15' |work=USA Today |date=7 September 2014 |access-date=8 September 2014 |first=Nick |last=Schwartz}}</ref>

'''Kevin De Bruyne''' ({{IPA|nl|ˈkɛvɪn də ˈbrœynə}}; born 28 June 1991) is a Belgian professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[midfielder]] for {{Italian football updater|Napoli}} club [[SSC Napoli|Napoli]] and the [[Belgium national football team|Belgium national team]].<ref>{{cite news |date=12 June 2025 |title=Kevin de Bruyne: Napoli sign former Manchester City midfielder |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cx2q3v2re7go |access-date=12 June 2025 |website=BBC Sport}}</ref> Widely regarded as one of the greatest players of his generation and one of the best players in [[Premier League]] history, De Bruyne has been described as a "complete" footballer.<ref>{{cite news|last=Walsh|first=Euan|url=https://www.givemesport.com/best-footballers-of-the-2020s/|title=10 Greatest Footballers of the 2020s so Far [Ranked]|publisher=GiveMeSport|date=20 June 2024|accessdate=20 June 2024|archive-date=7 November 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241107113427/https://www.givemesport.com/best-footballers-of-the-2020s/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.goal.com/en-gb/lists/european-team-2020s-so-far/blt2ca0612a10f97532#cs00e7ba8a53499e5a |title=European Team of the 2020s so far: Robert Lewandowski and Kylian Mbappe make the cut – but no room for Harry Kane, Erling Haaland, Vinicius Jr or Jude Bellingham |website=Goal.com |date=3 January 2025 |access-date=3 January 2025 |archive-date=6 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250406215628/https://www.goal.com/en-gb/lists/european-team-2020s-so-far/blt2ca0612a10f97532#cs00e7ba8a53499e5a |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name=":6">{{cite web|last=White|first=Mark|url=https://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/ranked-the-100-best-premier-league-players-ever/4|title=Ranked! The 100 best Premier League players ever|website=FourFourTwo|date=25 March 2025|access-date=25 March 2025|archive-date=25 March 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250325172753/https://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/ranked-the-100-best-premier-league-players-ever/4|url-status=live}}</ref>

After spending most of his youth career at [[KAA Gent|Gent]], De Bruyne began his professional senior career at [[KRC Genk|Genk]], where he was a regular player when they won the [[2010–11 Belgian Pro League]]. In 2012, he joined English club [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]], where he was used sparingly and then loaned to [[SV Werder Bremen|Werder Bremen]]. He signed with [[VfL Wolfsburg]] for £18 million in 2014, establishing himself as one of the best players in the [[Bundesliga]] and was integral in the club's [[2014–15 DFB-Pokal]] win. In the summer of 2015, De Bruyne joined [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]] for a then-club record £54 million. Making 422 appearances for the club, he won the [[UEFA Champions League]], six Premier League titles, five [[EFL Cup|League Cups]], and two [[FA Cup]]s. In [[2017–18 Premier League|2017–18]], he had a significant role in City becoming the only Premier League team to [[Premier League records and statistics#Points|attain 100 points]] in a single league season. In [[2019–20 Premier League|2019–20]], De Bruyne equalled the then-record for most assists in a Premier League season and was named [[Premier League Player of the Season|Player of the Season]], the award he won for the second time in [[2021–22 Premier League|2021–22]]. He was again heavily involved in [[2022–23 Manchester City F.C. season|2022–23]], as Manchester City sealed the [[Treble (association football)|continental treble]] in their most successful season to date. In June 2025, he joined [[SSC Napoli|Napoli]] on a free transfer.

De Bruyne made his full international debut in 2010, and he has since earned over 120 [[Caps (football)|caps]], scoring 38 goals for Belgium. He was a member of the Belgian squads that reached the quarter-finals at the [[2014 FIFA World Cup]], [[UEFA Euro 2016]] and the [[2026 FIFA World Cup|2026 World Cup]]. De Bruyne was named in the [[FIFA World Cup awards#Fans' winners (2002, 2010–2018)|Fan Dream Team]] of the [[2018 FIFA World Cup|2018 World Cup]], as Belgium finished in [[2018 FIFA World Cup#Third place play-off|third place]], as well as appearing at [[UEFA Euro 2020|Euro 2020]], the [[2022 FIFA World Cup|2022 World Cup]] and [[UEFA Euro 2024|Euro 2024]].

De Bruyne has been named in the [[UEFA Champions League#Awards|UEFA Champions League Squad of the Season]] and [[IFFHS World Team#Men's winners|IFFHS Men's World Team]] six times each, [[European Sports Magazines#ESM Team of the Year|ESM Team of the Year]] and the [[FIFPRO World 11]] five times each, the [[UEFA Team of the Year]] three times, and the ''[[France Football]]'' World XI and the Bundesliga Team of the Year once each. He has also won the [[Premier League Playmaker of the Season]] three times, the [[PFA Players' Player of the Year]] twice, [[Manchester City F.C.#Player of the Year|Manchester City's Player of the Year]] four times, the [[UEFA Champions League Best Midfielder|UEFA Champions League Midfielder of the Season]], the Bundesliga Player of the Year, the [[Footballer of the Year (Germany)]], the [[Belgian Sportsman of the Year]] and the [[International Federation of Football History & Statistics#The World's Best Playmaker|IFFHS World's Best Playmaker]] three times each. He was nominated for the prestigious [[Ballon d'Or]] award several times, ending third in the 2022 edition,<ref name=":3">{{cite web |date=17 October 2022 |title=Ballon d'Or 2022 as it happened – Karim Benzema wins Ballon d'Or, Sadio Mane second |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/ballon-d-or/2022/ballon-d-or-2022-karim-benzema-wins-ballon-d-or-sadio-mane-second_sto9185294/story.shtml |access-date=20 October 2022 |publisher=Eurosport}}</ref> and fourth in 2023.<ref name=":5">{{cite web |date=4 November 2023 |title=Result of 2023 Ballon d'Or Top 10 voting points: Messi 462 pts, Haaland 357 pts |url=https://m.allfootballapp.com/news/Headline/Result-of-2023-Ballon-d%E2%80%99Or-Top-10-voting-points-Messi-462-pts-Haaland-357-pts/3214832 |website=All Football |access-date=23 June 2024 |archive-date=25 October 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251025021143/https://m.allfootballapp.com/news/Headline/Result-of-2023-Ballon-d%E2%80%99Or-Top-10-voting-points-Messi-462-pts-Haaland-357-pts/3214832 |url-status=live }}</ref>

Gent|KAA Gent]] under the guidance of coaches Jan Troos and [[Charly Musonda (footballer, born 1969)|Charly Musonda]]. They focused on his technique: basics, passing, shooting, dribbling. Later in an interview De Bruyne mentioned that their individual coaching had a great impact on his development.<ref>{{Cite web |title=DE STORY VAN KEVIN DE BRUYNE (1) |url=https://boeken.cafe/de-story-van-kevin-de-bruyne-1/ |access-date=22 April 2025 |website=Boeken.café |language=nl-NL |archive-date=9 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250709042037/https://boeken.cafe/de-story-van-kevin-de-bruyne-1/ |url-status=live }}</ref> In 2005 he moved to [[K.R.C. Genk|Genk]], where De Bruyne continued his development in their youth set-up and was rewarded for his progress by being promoted to the first team squad in 2008. ===Chelsea===
[[File:Kevin De Bruyne Chelsea vs AS-Roma 10AUG2013.jpg|thumb|upright|De Bruyne warming up with Chelsea in 2013]]

On 31 January 2012, on the winter transfer deadline day, [[Premier League]] club Chelsea and Genk announced the permanent signing of De Bruyne, with the fee rumoured to be in the region of £7 million.<ref>{{cite news| title = Genk confirm De Bruyne sale| url = http://www1.skysports.com/football/news/11095/7467271/Genk-confirm-De-Bruyne-sale| publisher = Sky Sport| date = 31 January 2012| access-date = 31 January 2012| first = Graeme| last = Bailey| archive-date = 17 December 2018| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20181217020217/https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11095/7467271/Genk-confirm-De-Bruyne-sale| url-status = live}}</ref> He signed a five-and-a-half-year contract at [[Stamford Bridge (stadium)|Stamford Bridge]], but would stay at Genk for the remainder of the 2011–12 season. De Bruyne told the club website, "To come to a team like Chelsea is a dream but now I have to work hard to achieve the level that's necessary."<ref>{{cite news|title=De Bruyne becomes a blue |url=http://www.chelseafc.com/page/LatestNews/0,,10268~2594667,00.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120201210838/http://www.chelseafc.com/page/LatestNews/0,,10268~2594667,00.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=1 February 2012 |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=31 January 2012 |access-date=7 July 2014 }}</ref><ref>{{cite news| title = Chelsea sign Kevin De Bruyne from Genk| url = https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/16721393| work = BBC Sport| date = 31 January 2012| access-date = 31 January 2012| archive-date = 31 January 2012| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20120131175505/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/16721393.stm| url-status = live}}</ref> On 18 July 2012, De Bruyne made his debut for Chelsea in a friendly match against [[Major League Soccer]] (MLS) side [[Seattle Sounders FC]] in a 4–2 win. De Bruyne also played the first half against [[Ligue 1]] giants [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] at [[Yankee Stadium]], New York City.

====Return to Chelsea====
After a successful loan spell in the Bundesliga with Werder Bremen, De Bruyne was linked with a move to stay in Germany with either [[Borussia Dortmund]] or [[Bayer 04 Leverkusen|Bayer Leverkusen]]. Incoming manager [[José Mourinho]], however, assured De Bruyne he was a part of Chelsea's plan for the future, and the player officially returned to Chelsea on 1 July 2013.<ref>{{cite web|title=De Bruyne to fight for Chelsea place|url=http://espnfc.com/news/story/_/id/1481782/de-bruyne-fight-chelsea-place?cc=5901|publisher=ESPNFC|date=21 June 2013|access-date=10 August 2013|archive-date=8 January 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140108080625/http://espnfc.com/news/story/_/id/1481782/de-bruyne-fight-chelsea-place?cc=5901|url-status=live}}</ref>

De Bruyne injured a knee while scoring his first goal for Chelsea, in a pre-season friendly game against a Malaysia XI,<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea: Kevin De Bruyne set for scan on knee injury |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/23400115 |first=Richard |last=Conway |website=BBC Sport |date=22 July 2013 |access-date=3 September 2014 |archive-date=9 December 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131209203831/http://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/football/23400115 |url-status=live }}</ref> but was fit to make his competitive debut on the opening day of the [[2013–14 Premier League]] season against [[Hull City A.F.C.|Hull City]], and made an assist for the first goal in a 2–0 win.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2013/aug/18/chelsea-hull-city-premier-league |title=José Mourinho enjoys stylish return as Chelsea cruise against Hull |first=Daniel |last=Taylor |newspaper=The Guardian |date=18 August 2013 |access-date=3 September 2014 |archive-date=12 June 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180612211000/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2013/aug/18/chelsea-hull-city-premier-league |url-status=live |issn=0261-3077}}</ref>

On 18 January 2014, [[VfL Wolfsburg|Wolfsburg]] signed De Bruyne for a fee of £18 million (€22 million).<ref>{{Cite news |last=Association |first=Press |date=18 January 2014 |title=Chelsea sell Kevin De Bruyne to Wolfsburg |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2014/jan/18/chelsea-sell-kevin-de-bruyne-wolfsburg |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181106031122/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2014/jan/18/chelsea-sell-kevin-de-bruyne-wolfsburg |archive-date=6 November 2018 |access-date=29 March 2026 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077}}</ref> On 25 January 2014, he made his debut for Wolfsburg in a 3–1 home loss against [[Hannover 96]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/wolfsburg/team-news/team-news-de-bruyne-straight-in-for-wolfsburg_132637.html |title=Team News: Kevin de Bruyne straight in for Wolfsburg |work=Sports Mole |date=25 January 2014 |access-date=7 July 2014 |archive-date=18 June 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180618130025/https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/wolfsburg/team-news/team-news-de-bruyne-straight-in-for-wolfsburg_132637.html |url-status=live }}</ref> On 12 April 2014, De Bruyne assisted 2 goals in their 4–1 home win against [[1. FC Nürnberg]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.whoscored.com/Matches/724028/Live/Germany-Bundesliga-2013-2014-Wolfsburg-Nurnberg |title=Wolfsburg-Nurnberg Live |work=Whoscored.com |access-date=7 July 2014 |archive-date=29 January 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160129080041/https://www.whoscored.com/Matches/724028/Live/Germany-Bundesliga-2013-2014-Wolfsburg-Nurnberg |url-status=live }}</ref> After a week he scored his first goal for Wolfsburg in 3–1 away win against [[Hamburger SV]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.bundesliga.com/en/liga/news/2013/0000291918.php |title=De Bruyne: 'We want nine points' |publisher=Bundesliga |date=20 April 2014 |access-date=7 July 2014 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140422233138/http://www.bundesliga.com/en/liga/news/2013/0000291918.php |archive-date=22 April 2014 }}</ref> He also scored in the last two matches of the [[2013–14 Bundesliga|Bundesliga]] helping his team to win against [[VfB Stuttgart]] and [[Borussia Mönchengladbach]].

====2014–15 season====

De Bruyne scored his first goal of the [[2014–15 VfL Wolfsburg season|2014–15 season]] on 2 October 2014, volleying in a clearance from outside the box to salvage a 1–1 draw against [[LOSC Lille Métropole|Lille]] in the [[2014-15 UEFA Europa League|Europa League]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/news/0257-0def869751c4-1379e300168b-1000--wolfsburg-rally-to-peg-back-losc/ |title=Wolfsburg rally to peg back LOSC |publisher=UEFA |date=2 October 2014 |access-date=27 August 2026 |archive-date=11 March 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260311052554/https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/news/0257-0def869751c4-1379e300168b-1000--wolfsburg-rally-to-peg-back-losc/ |url-status=live }}</ref> In |url=http://www.bundesliga.com/en/el/news/2014/0000305024.php |title=De Bruyne Double Fires Wolfsburg to First European Win |work=Bundesliga |date=23 October 2014 |access-date=23 October 2014 Wolfsburg 4–1 Bayern Munich|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/30991047|access-date=17 March 2015|work=BBC Sport|date=30 January 2015|archive-date=20 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151220135834/http://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/30991047|url-status=live}}</ref> On 1 March 2015, De Bruyne assisted three goals in a 5–3 win over his former club [[Werder Bremen]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Werder Bremen 3–5 VfL Wolfsburg |url=http://www.espn.co.uk/football/sport/match/540771.html |publisher=ESPN (UK) |date=1 March 2015 |access-date=17 March 2015 |archive-date=21 March 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200321175836/http://www.espn.co.uk/football/sport/match/540771.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

On 12 March 2015, De Bruyne scored two goals in a 3–1 first leg Europa League round of 16 victory over [[Inter Milan|Internazionale]].<ref>{{cite web|url = https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/news/0253-0d804a13c2bf-a8774397b62f-1000--de-bruyne-powered-wolfsburg-snap-back-at-inter/|title = De Bruyne-powered Wolfsburg snap back at Inter|publisher = UEFA|date = 12 March 2015|access-date = 15 March 2015|archive-date = 13 November 2018|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20181113001907/https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/season=2015/matches/round=2000589/match=2014610/postmatch/report/index.html#de+bruyne+unpicks+inter|url-status = live}}</ref> On 15 March 2015, he scored one goal and assisted another two in 3–0 victory over [[SC Freiburg]].<ref>{{cite news|url = https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/31875612|title = VfL Wolfsburg 3–0 Sport-Club Freiburg|date = 15 March 2015|access-date = 17 March 2015|work = BBC Sport|archive-date = 24 September 2015|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150924222335/http://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/31875612|url-status = live}}</ref>

De Bruyne ended the league season with 10 goals and 21 assists, the latter a new [[Bundesliga records#Assists|Bundesliga record]], as Wolfsburg finished second in the [[2014–15 Bundesliga|Bundesliga]] and qualified for the [[2015–16 UEFA Champions League]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.rtbf.be/sport/football/etranger/allemagne/detail_de-bruyne-entre-dans-l-histoire-de-la-bundesliga?id=8982166|title=De Bruyne entre dans l'histoire de la Bundesliga|language=fr|date=16 May 2015|work=RTBF Sport|access-date=31 May 2015|archive-date=23 July 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180723093237/https://www.rtbf.be/sport/football/etranger/allemagne/detail_de-bruyne-entre-dans-l-histoire-de-la-bundesliga?id=8982166|url-status=live|trans-title=De Bruyne makes Bundesliga history}}</ref>{{Cref2|N1}} On 30 May 2015, he started and scored in the [[2015 DFB-Pokal Final]] as ''Die Wölfe'' defeated [[Borussia Dortmund]] 3–1 at the [[Olympiastadion (Berlin)|Olympiastadion]] in Berlin.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/32938029|title=Borussia Dortmd 1–3 VfL Wolfsburg|date=30 May 2015|work=BBC Sport|access-date=14 February 2018|archive-date=24 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150924223916/http://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/32938029|url-status=live}}</ref>

De Bruyne ended his break-out season with 16 goals and 27 assists in all competitions,<ref name=":4">{{cite web|title='Kevin De Bruyne is off to Man City' says Wolfsburg director Klaus Allofs|url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/2585622/kevin-de-bruyne-is-off-to-manchester-city-says-wolfsburg|publisher=[[ESPN]]|access-date=28 August 2015|date=28 August 2015|archive-date=10 August 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180810072559/http://www.espn.com/soccer/story/2585622/kevin-de-bruyne-is-off-to-manchester-city-says-wolfsburg|url-status=live}}</ref> and was named the 2015 [[Footballer of the Year (Germany)|Germany Footballer of the Year]].<ref name="Sporza">{{cite web|title=De Bruyne is Speler van het Jaar volgens Duitse Journalisten|url=http://sporza.be/cm/sporza/voetbal/buitenland/Duitsland/1.2400701|date=26 July 2015|work=[[Sporza]]|language=nl|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160716195857/http://sporza.be/cm/sporza/voetbal/buitenland/Duitsland/1.2400701|archive-date=16 July 2016|access-date=26 July 2015|trans-title=De Bruyne is Player of the Year according to German journalists}}</ref>

====2015–16 season====
De Bruyne began the season by winning the [[2015 DFL-Supercup]] against [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]], providing the cross for [[Nicklas Bendtner]]'s 89th-minute equaliser for a 1–1 draw and then scoring in the subsequent [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shootout]].<ref name=supercup>{{cite news|last1=Dunbar|first1=Ross|title=Bendtner leads Wolfsburg over Bayern Munich on penalties in German Super Cup clash|url=http://www.foxsports.com/soccer/story/bendtner-leads-wolfsburg-over-bayern-munich-on-penalties-in-german-super-cup-clash-080115?vid=null|access-date=3 August 2015|work=Fox Sports|date=1 August 2015|archive-date=3 July 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180703050953/https://www.foxsports.com/soccer/story/bendtner-leads-wolfsburg-over-bayern-munich-on-penalties-in-german-super-cup-clash-080115?vid=null|url-status=live}}</ref> On 8 August 2015, he continued his good form by scoring his first goal of the season, and providing two assists in a 4–1 win at [[Stuttgarter Kickers]] in the first round of the [[2015–16 DFB-Pokal|DFB-Pokal]].<ref>{{cite web|title=De Bruynes artwork rewarded wide awake Wolves|url=https://www.kicker.de/stg-kickers-gegen-wolfsburg-2015-dfb-pokal-2841065/spielbericht|publisher=Kicker|access-date=10 August 2015|date=8 August 2015|archive-date=23 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190523203751/https://www.kicker.de/news/fussball/dfbpokal/spielrunde/dfb-pokal/2015-16/1/2841065/spielbericht_stuttgarter-kickers-26_vfl-wolfsburg-24.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

In August, in the midst of transfer speculation, De Bruyne said that he would not force Wolfsburg to sell him, but also said that he could not ignore interest from [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]], saying: "If an offer does come, I will hear about it and how much it is, but I have not yet heard anything... I would not go to England just to prove that I can play there. I do not have to go to England... If I go there it's because for me and for my family it is a good choice. That's the key for me."<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.goal.com/en-gb/news/2892/transfer-zone/2015/08/03/14113752/de-bruyne-i-will-not-force-wolfsburg-to-sell-me |title=Manchester City transfer news: Kevin De Bruyne: I will not force Wolfsburg to sell me |work=Goal (website) |date=3 August 2015 |access-date=10 August 2015 |archive-date=15 December 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191215182807/https://www.goal.com/en-gb/news/2892/transfer-zone/2015/08/03/14113752/de-bruyne-i-will-not-force-wolfsburg-to-sell-me |url-status=live }}</ref>

On 10 August, it was reported that Manchester City had made a second bid for De Bruyne worth £47 million. Wolfsburg sporting director, [[Klaus Allofs]], said the club would fight to keep him, saying "I think some other clubs have definitely turned Kevin's head... Some huge figures are doing the rounds and I can understand why Kevin is leaving everything open."<ref>{{cite news |last=Jackson |first=Jamie |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2015/aug/10/kevin-de-bruyne-manchester-city-wolfsburg-47m |title=Manchester City make second bid of £47m for Wolfsburg's Kevin De Bruyne |work=The Guardian |date=10 August 2015 |access-date=10 August 2015 |archive-date=15 December 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191215182802/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2015/aug/10/kevin-de-bruyne-manchester-city-wolfsburg-47m |url-status=live }}</ref> On 27 August, it was reported that City had made a further bid for De Bruyne worth £58 million. Klaus Allofs said that City had made an "astonishing" wage offer to De Bruyne.<ref>{{cite news |title = Kevin de Bruyne: Man City offer 'astonishing' wages |url = https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/34081920 |website = BBC Sport |date = 27 August 2015 |access-date = 27 August 2015 |archive-date = 30 August 2015 |archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150830000612/http://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/football/34081920 |url-status = live }}</ref>

On 10 September 2016, De Bruyne scored and assisted in the first [[Manchester derby]] of the [[2016–17 Premier League|season]] which City won 2–1 and was awarded the ''Man of the Match''.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/37263921|title=Manchester United 1–2 Manchester City|date=10 September 2016|work=BBC Sport|access-date=27 December 2019|archive-date=21 March 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190321081208/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/37263921|url-status=live}}</ref> On 17 September, De Bruyne was awarded the ''Man of the Match'', in a 4–0 win over Bournemouth. ====2019–20 season====
On 30 November 2019, De Bruyne scored a half-volley in a 2–2 draw against Newcastle in the league, that strike was later voted as [[Premier League Goal of the Month]] for November.<ref>{{Cite news|title=Shelvey stunner holds Man City|work=BBC Sport|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/50526605|access-date=5 March 2021|archive-date=24 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210124004100/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/50526605|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last=Edwards|first=John|title=De Bruyne strike scoops Goal of the Month|url=https://www.mancity.com/news/first-team/first-team-news/2019/december/kevin-de-bruyne-wins-premier-league-goal-of-the-month|access-date=5 March 2021|website=mancity.com}}</ref> On 15 December, he scored a brace in a 3–0 [[2019–20 Premier League|Premier League]] win over Arsenal at the Emirates.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/50702875|title=Manchester City pushed Arsenal deeper into crisis as they won with embarrassing ease at Emirates Stadium.|publisher=BBC|date=15 December 2019|access-date=26 February 2020|archive-date=30 December 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191230011815/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/50702875|url-status=live}}</ref>

De Bruyne scored his 50th City goal in all competitions on 26 February 2020 in their 2–1 victory, coming from behind, over [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] in their Champions League [[2019–20 UEFA Champions League#Round of 16|Round of 16]] clash.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sport.bt.com/news/manchester-city-fight-back-to-beat-real-madrid-at-bernabeu-S11364433721545|title=Manchester City fight back to beat Real Madrid at Bernabeu|website=BT Sport|date=26 February 2020|access-date=26 February 2020|archive-date=27 February 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200227000841/https://sport.bt.com/news/manchester-city-fight-back-to-beat-real-madrid-at-bernabeu-S11364433721545|url-status=live}}</ref>

In the final Premier League match of the season, City beat [[Norwich City F.C.|Norwich City]] 5–0 at home. De Bruyne scored two goals and registered his 20th league assist, which equalled [[Thierry Henry]]'s record for the most assists in a season, and also won his second [[Premier League Playmaker of the Season|Playmaker of the Season]] award.<ref name=":1">{{cite web|date=26 July 2020|title=Kevin de Bruyne: Twentieth assist of season equals Thierry Henry's record|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/53545450|access-date=26 July 2020|work=BBC Sport|archive-date=27 July 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200727001119/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/53545450|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/manchester-city/story/4146843/man-city-kevin-de-bruyne-premier-league-assist-record-thierry-henry|title=Man City's De Bruyne equals Premier League assist record for single season|publisher=ESPN|date=26 July 2020|access-date=27 July 2020|archive-date=27 July 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200727072103/https://www.espn.com/soccer/manchester-city/story/4146843/man-city-kevin-de-bruyne-premier-league-assist-record-thierry-henry|url-status=live}}</ref> In addition he became the first player in history to reach 20 assists in a single season in two of [[Big Five (association football)|Europe's top five leagues]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.goal.com/en/news/two-assists-taken-away-de-bruyne-premier-league-share-record/2vikmfoncye185ixnubn94i4|title='You took two away from me!' – De Bruyne happy to share Premier League assists record with Henry|website=Goal (website)|date=26 July 2020|access-date=27 July 2020|archive-date=28 July 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200728120503/https://www.goal.com/en/news/two-assists-taken-away-de-bruyne-premier-league-share-record/2vikmfoncye185ixnubn94i4|url-status=live}}</ref> His long range curler in that game also won him [[Premier League Goal of the Month]] for the second time in the season.<ref>{{cite web|title=De Bruyne completes double with Budweiser Goal of the Month|date=3 August 2020 |url=http://www.premierleague.com/news/1747213|access-date=5 March 2021|publisher=Premier League|archive-date=9 August 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200809173603/https://www.premierleague.com/news/1747213|url-status=live}}</ref>

At the end of the season he was awarded the [[Premier League Player of the Season]] after scoring 13 goals, providing 20 assists and creating 104 chances from open play, the most for a player in any of Europe's top five leagues since 2006.<ref>{{Cite news |date=16 August 2020 |title=Kevin de Bruyne: Manchester City midfielder named Premier League player of season |work=BBC Sport |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/53797353 |access-date=16 August 2020 |archive-date=27 September 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200927021728/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/53797353/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite tweet|user=OptaJoe |number=1294934100265050112 |date=16 August 2020 |title=104 – Kevin De Bruyne created 104 chances in open play in the Premier League in 2019–20, the most for a player in any of Europe's top five leagues since this data is available for each competition (2006-07+). Worthy.}}</ref>

He was also named in the [[PFA Team of the Year (2010s)|PFA Team of the Year]] and won the [[PFA Players' Player of the Year|PFA Player of the Year]] award, becoming the first ever Manchester City player to win it.<ref name=":2">{{cite web|title=Man City midfielder De Bruyne beats Liverpool stars to PFA Player of the Year award {{!}} Goal.com|url=https://www.goal.com/en/news/man-city-midfielder-de-bruyne-beats-liverpool-stars-to-pfa/g0h1skp0eo0a1l1vxx8u5f6qf|access-date=8 September 2020|website=Goal (website)|archive-date=27 September 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200927021733/https://www.goal.com/en/news/man-city-midfielder-de-bruyne-beats-liverpool-stars-to-pfa/g0h1skp0eo0a1l1vxx8u5f6qf/|url-status=live}}</ref>

====2020–21 season====
[[File:2021-12-07 Fußball, Männer, UEFA Champions League, RB Leipzig - Manchester City FC 1DX 2723 by Stepro (cropped).jpg|thumb|De Bruyne on the ball for [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]] in the Champions League against [[RB Leipzig]] in 2021]]

On 21 September 2020, De Bruyne scored and assisted in a 3–1 away win over [[Wolverhampton Wanderers F.C.|Wolverhampton Wanderers]] in City's first game of the season.<ref>{{cite web|title=Man City hold off Wolves fightback to claim victory|date=18 September 2020 |url=http://www.premierleague.com/news/1834283|access-date=21 September 2020|publisher=Premier League|archive-date=27 September 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200927021742/https://www.premierleague.com/news/1834283/|url-status=live}}</ref> With the crucial visit of the Premier League champions, Liverpool, De Bruyne assisted Gabriel Jesus' equaliser before winning a penalty, which he subsequently fired wide. The game ended in a 1–1 draw.<ref>{{Cite news|title=De Bruyne misses penalty in draw|work=BBC Sport|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/54766716|access-date=24 November 2020|archive-date=27 February 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210227080825/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/54766716|url-status=live}}</ref> On 7 April, De Bruyne signed a four-year contract,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/56659261 |title=Kevin de Bruyne: Man City midfielder signs new deal that runs until 2025 |website=BBC Sport |date=7 April 2021 |access-date=7 April 2021 |archive-date=14 June 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210614202841/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/56659261 |url-status=live }}</ref> after negotiating it with help of statistical data to make case for a 30% pay increase.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Glendenning |first=Barry |date=24 May 2021 |title=Premier League 2020-21 review: players of the season |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2021/may/24/premier-league-2020-21-review-players-of-the-season |access-date=29 March 2026 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077}}</ref>

On 25 April 2021, De Bruyne's free-kick was headed into the goal by [[Aymeric Laporte]], allowing City to win 1–0 against Tottenham Hotspur in the [[2021 EFL Cup Final|EFL Cup Final]] at [[Wembley Stadium]].<ref name="bbc 2021">{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/56790307 |title=Manchester City 1–0 Tottenham Hotspur |website=BBC Sport |date=25 April 2021 |access-date=25 April 2021 |archive-date=29 April 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210429085606/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/56790307 |url-status=live }}</ref> On 28 April, he scored a goal in a 2–1 away win over Paris Saint-Germain in the [[2020–21 UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] semi-finals.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/56880443 |title=Paris Saint Germain 1–2 Manchester City |website=BBC Sport |date=28 April 2021 |access-date=28 April 2021 |archive-date=3 May 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210503084542/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/56880443 |url-status=live }}</ref> On 29 May, De Bruyne had a head injury after colliding with [[Antonio Rüdiger]] in the second half of the [[2021 UEFA Champions League Final|Champions League Final]], to be substituted by Gabriel Jesus; however, his team lost 1–0 against his former club Chelsea.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4211224/2021/05/29/kevin-de-bruyne-suffers-head-injury-in-champions-league-final/ |title=Kevin de Bruyne suffers head injury in Champions League final |website=The Athletic |date=29 May 2021 |access-date=30 May 2021 |archive-date=2 June 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210602215140/https://theathletic.com/news/kevin-de-bruyne-injury-man-city-chelsea-champions-league-final/TXqts3Ex1HLF |url-status=live }}</ref> Medical scans after the game revealed De Bruyne to have suffered [[Nasal fracture|acute nose bone]] and [[Orbit (anatomy)|left orbital]] fractures, placing doubt on his participation in the rescheduled [[UEFA Euro 2020]] tournament.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://soccer.nbcsports.com/2021/05/30/de-bruyne-injury-news-update-latest/|title=Kevin de Bruyne injury update|first=Joe|last=Prince-Wright|work=[[NBC Sports]]|publisher=[[NBC]]|date=30 May 2021|access-date=30 May 2021|archive-date=31 May 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210531120748/https://soccer.nbcsports.com/2021/05/30/de-bruyne-injury-news-update-latest/|url-status=live}}</ref>

At the end of the season, De Bruyne was awarded with the PFA Player's Player of the Year award.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/57376601|title=De Bruyne wins second PFA men's award|work=BBC Sport|access-date=6 June 2021|archive-date=7 June 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210607161041/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/57376601|url-status=live}}</ref>

|url=https://www.goal.com/en/news/watch-de-bruyne-scores-fastest-ever-champions-league-semi-final-goal-as-man-city-get-off-to-perfect-start-against-real-madrid/bltd5429f1c8755aea7 |title=Watch: De De Bruyne was again bestowed with the [[Premier League Player of the Season]] award, becoming the fourth player to win the award more than once.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11095/12618147/kevin-de-bruyne-man-city-playmaker-pips-mohamed-salah-to-win-premier-league-player-of-the-year-award|title=Kevin De Bruyne: Man City playmaker pips Mohamed Salah to win Premier League Player of the Year award|date=21 May 2022|website=skysports.com|publisher=[[Sky Sports]]|access-date=28 June 2022|archive-date=28 June 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220628225525/https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11095/12618147/kevin-de-bruyne-man-city-playmaker-pips-mohamed-salah-to-win-premier-league-player-of-the-year-award|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.premierleague.com/news/2621844|title=De Bruyne voted EA SPORTS Player of the Season|date=22 May 2022|publisher=Premier League|access-date=28 June 2022|archive-date=4 June 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220604175747/https://www.premierleague.com/news/2621844|url-status=live}}</ref> He also went on to win Manchester City's Player of the Year award for the fourth time. As a result, he tied [[Richard Dunne]] for the most player of the year awards at the club.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mancity.com/news/mens/kevin-de-bruyne-voted-manchester-city-s-etihad-player-of-the-season-63788651|title=DE BRUYNE VOTED MANCHESTER CITY'S ETIHAD PLAYER OF THE SEASON|author=Clayton, David|date=22 May 2022|website=mancity.com|publisher=[[Manchester City F.C.]]}}{{Dead link|date=September 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref> In addition, he ended the season as the club's top scorer in the Premier League with 15 goals, which was also his personal best record.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/3316370/2022/05/26/how-de-bruyne-turned-from-provider-to-goalscorer-to-lead-manchester-city-to-the-premier-league-title/ |title=How De Bruyne turned from provider to goalscorer to lead Manchester City to the Premier League title |publisher=The Athletic |date=26 May 2022 |access-date=18 July 2023 |archive-date=18 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230718173447/https://theathletic.com/3316370/2022/05/26/how-de-bruyne-turned-from-provider-to-goalscorer-to-lead-manchester-city-to-the-premier-league-title/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

hand.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/live-blogs/manchester-city-arsenal-premier-league-live-score-updates-result/gSSAeDyINcUm/ |title=How Manchester City dominated Arsenal 4–1 in |url=https://www.goal.com/en/news/watch-man-city-star-kevin-de-bruyne-hammers-champions-league-semi-final-first-leg-equaliser-against-real-madrid/blt77246db5e800823b |title=WATCH: Man City star Kevin |url-status=live }}</ref>

====2023–24 season====
De Bruyne started the [[2023–24 Manchester City F.C. season|2023–24 season]] coming on as a substitute in the [[2023 FA Community Shield]] against Arsenal on 6 August, missing a penalty as the Gunners won the [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|shoot-out]] 4–1.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2023/aug/06/arsenal-v-manchester-city-community-shield-live |title=Arsenal 1–1 Man City (4–1 on pens): as it happened |first=Rob |last=Smyth |work=The Guardian |date=6 August 2023 |accessdate=12 August 2023 |archive-date=17 August 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230817102238/https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2023/aug/06/arsenal-v-manchester-city-community-shield-live |url-status=live |issn=0261-3077}}</ref> On 11 August, he suffered a reoccurrence of a hamstring injury in the opening league game of the season against [[Burnley F.C.|Burnley]], it was later confirmed he would be out for four to five months.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4772984/2023/08/15/de-bruyne-injury-update-manchester-city/ |title=Kevin De Bruyne injury 'serious', Manchester City midfielder out for 'few months' |first=Mark |last=Critchley |work=The Athletic |date=15 August 2023 |access-date=15 August 2023 |archive-date=15 August 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230815150659/https://theathletic.com/4772984/2023/08/15/de-bruyne-injury-update-manchester-city/ |url-status=live }}</ref> He made his return from injury on 7 January 2024, providing an assist in a 5–0 win over [[Huddersfield Town A.F.C.|Huddersfield Town]] in the [[2023–24 FA Cup|FA Cup]] third round.<ref>{{cite web |first=Gary |last=Rose |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/67907682 |title=Kevin de Bruyne: Man City boss Pep Guardiola says 'the people love him' as midfielder returns |work=BBC Sport |date=7 January 2024 |access-date=7 January 2024 |archive-date=7 January 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240107212609/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/67907682 |url-status=live }}</ref> On 13 January, he came off the bench, scoring his first goal of the season and assisting another in a 3–2 comeback away victory over Newcastle United.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/live/football/67927667 |title=Newcastle United 2–3 Manchester City |work=BBC Sport |date=13 January 2024 |access-date=14 January 2024 |archive-date=13 January 2024 ==International career==
[[File:Vincent Kompany Simon Mignolet Kevin De Bruyne vs USA.jpg|thumb|De Bruyne (right) lining up for Belgium in 2013, alongside [[Vincent Kompany]] and [[Simon Mignolet]]]]

De Bruyne represented [[Belgium national football team|Belgium]] at [[Belgium national under-18 football team|under-18]], [[Belgium national under-19 football team|under-19]], and [[Belgium national under-21 football team|under-21]] levels. He made his [[Belgium national football team|senior team]] debut on 11 August 2010 in an [[Exhibition game|international friendly match]] against [[Finland national football team|Finland]] in [[Turku]]; the game ended in a 1–0 loss for Belgium.<ref>{{Cite news|title=13 fun facts about Kevin De Bruyne|url=https://www.goal.com/en-cm/lists/13-fun-facts-about-kevin-de-bruyne/blt02c4e080a8fed912|website=[[Goal (website)|Goal]]|date=22 February 2023|access-date=12 July 2024|archive-date=12 July 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240712162809/https://www.goal.com/en-cm/lists/13-fun-facts-about-kevin-de-bruyne/blt02c4e080a8fed912|url-status=live}}</ref> Before making his full debut for Belgium's senior side, De Bruyne was eligible to play for [[Burundi national football team|Burundi]], his mother's birthplace.<ref name="fightforchance">{{cite news|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/premier-league/kevin-de-bruyne-interview-ill-fight-for-chance-at-chelsea-8845258.html|title=Kevin De Bruyne interview: I'll fight for chance at Chelsea...|newspaper=The Independent|access-date=5 June 2015|archive-date=25 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150925215906/http://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/premier-league/kevin-de-bruyne-interview-ill-fight-for-chance-at-chelsea-8845258.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

De Bruyne became a regular member of Belgium's team during the [[2014 FIFA World Cup qualification - UEFA Group A|2014 FIFA World Cup qualification]] campaign, where he scored four goals as the Red Devils qualified for their first major tournament in 12 years.<ref>{{cite news|title=Kevin De Bruyne|url=https://www.fifa.com/worldcup/players/player=358120/news.html|publisher=[[FIFA]]|access-date=22 June 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140622045843/http://www.fifa.com/worldcup/players/player=358120/news.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=22 June 2014}}</ref>

On 17 June 2021, De Bruyne scored his first and the winning goal in Belgium's second match of [[UEFA Euro 2020]], a 2–1 victory over [[Denmark national football team|Denmark]],<ref>{{cite web |last=Marsh |first=Charlotte |title=Denmark 1–2 Belgium: Kevin De Bruyne inspires Red Devils to victory as they reach Euro 2020 last 16 |url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/19692/12335073/denmark-1-2-belgium-kevin-de-bruyne-inspires-red-devils-to-victory-as-they-reach-last-16 |publisher=Sky Sports |date=17 June 2021 |access-date=6 August 2021 |archive-date=31 July 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210731111424/https://www.skysports.com/football/news/19692/12335073/denmark-1-2-belgium-kevin-de-bruyne-inspires-red-devils-to-victory-as-they-reach-last-16 |url-status=live }}</ref> having earlier in the game assisted the team's first goal.<ref>{{cite web |last=Glendenning |first=Barry |title=Denmark 1–2 Belgium: Euro 2020 |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2021/jun/17/denmark-v-belgium-euro-2020-live |work=[[The Guardian]] |date=17 June 2021 |access-date=20 June 2021 |archive-date=19 June 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210619142613/https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2021/jun/17/denmark-v-belgium-euro-2020-live |url-status=live |issn=0261-3077}}</ref> During the round of 16 clash with [[Portugal national football team|Portugal]], De Bruyne suffered an ankle injury from a tackle from behind, by Portugal's [[Joao Palhinha]]. On 2 July Belgium manager [[Roberto Martinez]] said that De Bruyne could recover in time for the quarter-final match, later that day, despite not training all week<ref>{{cite news |last=Braw |first=Joe |title=Belgium give fitness update on Man City star Kevin de Bruyne for Italy Euro 2020 clash |url=https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/sport/football/football-news/de-bruyne-injury-belgium-italy-20952371.amp |date=2 July 2021 |newspaper=[[Manchester Evening News]] |access-date=2 July 2021 |archive-date=12 July 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210712054406/https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/sport/football/football-news/de-bruyne-injury-belgium-italy-20952371.amp |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/29908/12346693/kevin-de-bruyne-and-eden-hazard-last-minute-decisions-for-belgiums-euro-2020-quarter-final-against-italy-says-roberto-martinez|title=Kevin de Bruyne and Eden Hazard last-minute decisions for Belgium's Euro 2020 quarter-final against Italy, says Roberto Martinez|work=Sky Sports |access-date=2 July 2021|archive-date=12 July 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210712001414/https://www.skysports.com/football/news/29908/12346693/kevin-de-bruyne-and-eden-hazard-last-minute-decisions-for-belgiums-euro-2020-quarter-final-against-italy-says-roberto-martinez|url-status=live}}</ref> and he was later confirmed in the starting line-up.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/belgium-italy-live-stream-euro-2020-b1877068.html |title=Belgium vs Italy Live: Euro 2020 team news, line-ups and more today {{!}} The Independent |website=The Independent |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210702170518/https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/belgium-italy-live-stream-euro-2020-b1877068.html |archive-date=2 July 2021}}</ref>

De Bruyne started all three games in the [[2022 FIFA World Cup]] as Belgium were eliminated in the [[2022 FIFA World Cup Group F|group stage]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Belgium 1–0 Canada|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/63644791|access-date=21 March 2023|date=23 November 2022|website=BBC Sport|publisher=BBC|archive-date=21 March 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230321193329/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/63644791|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Belgium 0–2 Morocco|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/63692164|access-date=21 March 2023|date=27 November 2022|website=BBC Sport|publisher=BBC|archive-date=21 March 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230321193329/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/63692164|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Croatia 0–0 Belgium|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/63739245|access-date=21 March 2023|date=1 December 2022|website=BBC Sport|publisher=BBC|archive-date=26 February 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230226160755/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/63739245|url-status=live}}</ref>

==Personal life==
[[File:Kevin De Bruyne at Samsung.jpg|thumb|upright|De Bruyne in 2012]]

===Family and relationships===
De Bruyne's mother is Belgian.<ref name="Terreur">{{cite news |last=Terreur |first=Kristof |date=20 October 2017 |title=Kevin De Bruyne: the stubborn boy who developed into a world beater |work=The Guardian |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2017/oct/20/kevin-de-bruyne-stubborn--world-beater |access-date=8 September 2018 |archive-date=20 October 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171020160741/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2017/oct/20/kevin-de-bruyne-stubborn--world-beater |url-status=live|issn=0261-3077}}</ref> She was born in [[Burundi]] and has also lived in the [[Ivory Coast]].{{citation needed|date=April 2026}} She grew up in London, after her [[Flanders|Flemish]] parents moved to England for work reasons. Only when she met Kevin's father, Herwig, she returned to Belgium.<ref name="Terreur"/>

De Bruyne's parents settled in Drongen, a sub-municipality of the city of [[Ghent]], in Flanders, the [[Dutch language|Dutch]]-speaking part of Belgium.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Pep Guardiola to make surprise visit to Belgium on June 2nd – report – City Watch |url=https://www.mcfcwatch.com/2018/03/20/pep-guardiola-to-make-surprise-visit-to-belgium-on-june-2nd-report/ |access-date=10 May 2018 |archive-date=15 December 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191215182807/https://www.mcfcwatch.com/2018/03/20/pep-guardiola-to-make-surprise-visit-to-belgium-on-june-2nd-report/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=29 September 2017 |title=Kevin De Bruyne: een jongen uit Drongen |language=nl-NL |work=Staantribune |url=https://staantribune.nl/een-jongen-uit-drongen-hoe-het-begon-voor-kevin-de-bruyne/ |url-status=dead |access-date=10 May 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180511013605/https://staantribune.nl/een-jongen-uit-drongen-hoe-het-begon-voor-kevin-de-bruyne/ |archive-date=11 May 2018|trans-title=Kevin De Bruyne: a boy from Drongen}}</ref> Aside from Dutch, his mother tongue, De Bruyne also speaks English, French and German.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://premierskillsenglish.britishcouncil.org/players/player-week/kevin-de-bruyne|title=Kevin De Bruyne|website=premierskillsenglish.britishcouncil.org|date=7 May 2017|access-date=10 May 2018|archive-date=19 July 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190719160900/https://premierskillsenglish.britishcouncil.org/players/player-week/kevin-de-bruyne|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I3z_4jZR-ek|title=Kevin de Bruyne im DAZN Interview vor Schalke vs Manchester City|publisher=DAZN_DE on Youtube|date=20 February 2019|access-date=29 December 2019|archive-date=27 August 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200827163900/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I3z_4jZR-ek|url-status=live}}</ref>

As a child, De Bruyne and his parents regularly visited his grandparents in London. At the time of his move to Chelsea in 2012, De Bruyne stated: "We used to go every year at Christmas and during school holidays. It's my second home."<ref>{{cite web |date=31 January 2012 |title=De Bruyne komt beetje thuis in Londen |trans-title=De Bruyne comes home to London a bit |url=https://www.nieuwsblad.be/cnt/dp3lig4f |website=[[Het Nieuwsblad]] |language=nl |access-date=4 September 2023 |archive-date=5 April 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230405121335/https://www.nieuwsblad.be/cnt/dp3lig4f |url-status=live}}</ref>

De Bruyne has been in a relationship with Michèle Lacroix since 2014.<ref>{{cite web |last=Newman |first=Benjamin |url=http://www.101greatgoals.com/blog/michele-lacroix-new-blonde-girlfriend-of-chelseas-de-bruyne-has-posted-pictures-of-the-couple-on-facebook/ |title=Michèle Lacroix, new blonde girlfriend of Chelsea's De Bruyne, has posted pictures of the couple on Facebook |work=101 Great Goals |date=3 January 2014 |access-date=22 March 2015 |archive-date=2 April 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402102410/http://www.101greatgoals.com/blog/michele-lacroix-new-blonde-girlfriend-of-chelseas-de-bruyne-has-posted-pictures-of-the-couple-on-facebook/ |url-status=dead}}</ref> The couple married in June 2017<ref>{{cite web|url=https://futballnews.com/kevin-de-bruyne-celebrates-his-wife-michele/|title=Kevin De Bruyne Celebrates His Wife Michèle|website=futballnews.com|date=27 June 2020|access-date=30 July 2020|archive-date=27 August 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200827163848/https://futballnews.com/kevin-de-bruyne-celebrates-his-wife-michele/|url-status=live}}</ref> and have three children together.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://futballnews.com/kevin-de-bruyne-and-his-wife-michele-lacroix-introduce-their-newborn-baby-suri/ |title=Kevin De Bruyne and his wife Michele Lacroix introduce their newborn baby Suri |website=futballnews.com |date=6 September 2020 |access-date=17 October 2020 |archive-date=1 October 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221001142301/https://futballnews.com/kevin-de-bruyne-and-his-wife-michele-lacroix-introduce-their-newborn-baby-suri/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

De Bruyne's autobiography, titled ''Keep It Simple'', was published by Borgerhoff & Lamberigts in October 2014,<ref name=northcroft>{{cite news |first=Jonathan |last=Northcroft |title=City Whizzkid |newspaper=[[The Sunday Times]] |date=25 October 2015}}</ref> following an incident between De Bruyne and his compatriot, footballer [[Thibaut Courtois]], in which De Bruyne's then-girlfriend left him for Courtois. De Bruyne wrote in his autobiography, "Although I still cannot believe what Courtois has done, we continue to work together professionally."<ref>{{cite web|title='In one night, Thibaut gave me what I missed with Kevin for years'. Truth behind 'hatred' between De Bruyne and Courtois|url=https://tribuna.com/en/news/2021-04-30-in-one-night-thibaut-gave-me-what-i-missed-with-kevin-for-years-truth-behind-hatred-betwe/|access-date=20 February 2022|website=Tribuna.com|date=30 April 2021|archive-date=20 February 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220220175342/https://tribuna.com/en/news/2021-04-30-in-one-night-thibaut-gave-me-what-i-missed-with-kevin-for-years-truth-behind-hatred-betwe/|url-status=live}}</ref>

===Philanthropy===
De Bruyne was an ambassador for the 2014 [[Special Olympics]], which took place in [[Antwerp]], and was involved in a controversial advertisement campaign via his personal [[Instagram]] account. Employing the slogan (in Dutch): "Would you still be my fan if I looked like this?", De Bruyne was depicted resembling a person with [[Down's syndrome]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=UEFA.com |title=De Bruyne offers support to Special Olympics {{!}} Inside UEFA |url=https://www.uefa.com/insideuefa/social-responsibility/news/0219-0e8ca1ed158e-714b6623df09-1000--de-bruyne-offers-support-to-special-olympics/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201018202647/https://www.uefa.com/insideuefa/social-responsibility/news/0219-0e8ca1ed158e-714b6623df09-1000--de-bruyne-offers-support-to-special-olympics/ |archive-date=18 October 2020 |access-date=29 March 2026 |website=UEFA.com |language=en}}</ref> Since 2016 the [[Kevin De Bruyne Cup]], an international youth football tournament, has been organised in Drongen, Belgium.<ref>{{Cite web |title=KDB Cup |url=https://kdbcup.be/en/kdb-cup/ |access-date=29 March 2026 |website=KDB Cup - Kevin De Bruyne |language=en-GB |archive-date=19 April 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260419074305/https://kdbcup.be/en/kdb-cup/ |url-status=live }}</ref> De Bruyne was chosen by [[UEFA]] as ambassador for 2018. He presented a check worth 100,000 euros to the [[International Committee of the Red Cross]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=De Bruyne schenkt 100.000 euro van UEFA aan het goede doel |trans-title=De Bruyne donates 100,000 euros from UEFA to charity |url=https://www.nieuwsblad.be/cnt/dmf20180308_03397149 |access-date=29 March 2026 |website=Het Nieuwsblad |archive-date=23 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240623110737/https://www.nieuwsblad.be/cnt/dmf20180308_03397149 |url-status=live }}</ref> In 2019, De Bruyne and [[Romelu Lukaku]] handed out shoes to needy children in regional hospitals for a special campaign 'Kicks for Kids' organised by [[Roc Nation Sports]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Het hart op de juiste plaats: De Bruyne en Lukaku maken kinderen in nood blij met opvallende kerstactie |trans-title=Heart in the right place: De Bruyne and Lukaku make children in need happy with striking Christmas campaign |url=https://www.hln.be/time-out/het-hart-op-de-juiste-plaats-de-bruyne-en-lukaku-maken-kinderen-in-nood-blij-met-opvallende-kerstactie~a4917032/ |access-date=29 March 2026 |website=www.hln.be |archive-date=23 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240623103053/https://www.hln.be/time-out/het-hart-op-de-juiste-plaats-de-bruyne-en-lukaku-maken-kinderen-in-nood-blij-met-opvallende-kerstactie~a4917032/ |url-status=live }}</ref> De Bruyne has also been involved in other charitable initiatives, including the "[[Common Goal (charity)|Common Goal]]" campaign, which encourages professional footballers to donate 1% of their wages to support various global social causes. In addition, he has donated money to support [[cancer research]] and has been involved in charity matches to raise money for various causes.<ref>{{Cite web |date=23 June 2024 |title=13 fun facts about Kevin De Bruyne |url=https://www.goal.com/en/lists/13-fun-facts-about-kevin-de-bruyne/blt02c4e080a8fed912#cs35b3a2e1b4fc9783 |website=Goal (website) |access-date=23 June 2024 |archive-date=23 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240623110735/https://www.goal.com/en/lists/13-fun-facts-about-kevin-de-bruyne/blt02c4e080a8fed912#cs35b3a2e1b4fc9783 |url-status=live }}</ref>

In 2023, De Bruyne and his wife were named as ‘godparents’ of the [[Ronald McDonald House Charities|Ronald McDonald Children's Fund]], which ensures that parents with hospitalised children will be able to stay nearby.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Jones |first=Rory |date=20 March 2023 |title=Kevin De Bruyne lands McDonald's endorsement deal |url=https://www.sportspro.com/news/kevin-de-bruyne-michele-lacroix-mcdonalds-manchester-city-endorsement-deal/ |access-date=29 March 2026 |website=SportsPro |language=en-GB}}</ref>
