On 11 July 2018, [[Sporting CP]] announced that Nani would be rejoining the club.<ref>[https://www.si.com/soccer/2018/07/11/sporting-cp-officially-confirm-signing-former-manchester-united-star-nani Sporting CP Officially Confirm the Signing of Former Manchester United Star Nani] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180712002841/https://www.si.com/soccer/2018/07/11/sporting-cp-officially-confirm-signing-former-manchester-united-star-nani |date=12 July 2018 }}, [[Sports Illustrated]], 11 July 2018</ref> He scored twice in his second game on 18 August, a 2–1 home win over [[Vitória Setúbal]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Sporting vence Vitória de Setúbal com 'bis' de Nani|trans-title=Sporting defeat Vitória de Setúbal with brace from Nani|url=https://www.rtp.pt/noticias/futebol-nacional/sporting-vence-vitoria-de-setubal-com-bis-de-nani_d1093929 |access-date=9 December 2021 |publisher=Rádio e Televisão de Portugal |date=18 August 2018 |language=Portuguese}}</ref> In one of his final games on 26 January, the [[2019 Taça da Liga Final]] in Braga, he scored Sporting's last penalty as they defeated Porto following a 1–1 draw.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Cole |first1=Richard |title=Penalties smile on Sporting again as Lions retain Taça da Liga crown |url=https://portugoal.net/club-news/1045-penalties-give-sporting-the-taca-da-liga |access-date=9 December 2021 |publisher=PortuGOAL |date=26 January 2019}}</ref>

===Orlando City===
On 18 February 2019, Nani moved to [[Orlando City SC|Orlando City]], signing a three-year contract on a [[Designated Player Rule|Designated Player]] deal.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.orlandocitysc.com/post/2019/02/18/orlando-city-sc-signs-four-time-premier-league-champion-uefa-euros-champion-nani|title=Orlando City SC Signs Four-Time Premier League Champion, UEFA Euros Champion Nani | Orlando City Soccer Club|access-date=19 February 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190219020154/https://www.orlandocitysc.com/post/2019/02/18/orlando-city-sc-signs-four-time-premier-league-champion-uefa-euros-champion-nani|archive-date=19 February 2019|url-status=live}}</ref> He made his club debut on 2 March, coming on as a 70th minute substitute in Orlando's season opener at home against [[New York City FC]]; the game ended in a 2–2 draw, with Nani registering an assist on [[Dom Dwyer]]'s equaliser.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.mlssoccer.com/post/2019/03/02/orlando-city-sc-2-new-york-city-fc-2-2019-mls-match-recap |title=Orlando City SC 2, New York City FC 2 – 2019 MLS Match Recap |publisher=MLS Soccer |last1=Quillen |first1=Ian Nicholas |date=2 March 2019 |access-date=11 October 2020 }}</ref> He scored his first goals for the team on 6 April 2019, when he netted twice in Orlando's 4–3 home win over [[Colorado Rapids]], including the game–winning penalty in the 89th minute.<ref>{{cite web |title=Orlando City SC 4, Colorado Rapids 3 2019 MLS Match Recap |url=https://matchcenter.mlssoccer.com/matchcenter/2019-04-06-orlando-city-sc-vs-colorado-rapids/recap |website=mlssoccer.com |access-date=7 April 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191212142950/https://matchcenter.mlssoccer.com/matchcenter/2019-04-06-orlando-city-sc-vs-colorado-rapids/recap |archive-date=12 December 2019 |url-status=live }}</ref>

On 31 July 2020, he missed a penalty in regulation time against [[Los Angeles FC]] in the quarter-finals of the [[MLS is Back Tournament]] but later assisted the last-minute equalizer and scored the winning penalty during an extra-time [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|shootout]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Parsons|first=Brant|title=Watch: Orlando City's Nani scores the game-winning penalty kick|url=https://www.orlandosentinel.com/sports/orlando-city-soccer/os-sp-orlando-city-game-winner-lafc-20200801-ij23p3db5vasbmvklsfkilzyny-story.html|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200801031130/https://www.orlandosentinel.com/sports/orlando-city-soccer/os-sp-orlando-city-game-winner-lafc-20200801-ij23p3db5vasbmvklsfkilzyny-story.html|archive-date=1 August 2020|access-date=1 August 2020|website=Orlando Sentinel|date=August 2020 }}</ref> In the semi-finals against [[Minnesota United FC|Minnesota United]], Nani scored two first-half goals to help his team reach the final with a 3–1 win.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2020/aug/07/orlando-city-minnesota-united-mls-is-back-semifinal |title=Nani double lifts Orlando City past Minnesota into MLS is Back final |website=www.theguardian.com |date=6 August 2020 |access-date=20 June 2023}}</ref> However, Orlando City eventually finished runners-up in the tournament, losing to [[Portland Timbers]] in the final.<ref>{{cite web |title=Portland Timbers win MLS is Back Tournament after edging Orlando City in final |url=https://www.goal.com/en/news/portland-timbers-win-mls-is-back-tournament-after-edging-orlando-/b192fyxhsx91zw36gwhkkgpi |website=www.goal.com}}</ref>

On 6 May 2021, Nani's goal against [[FC Cincinnati]] in a 3–0 victory five days earlier saw him awarded [[2021 Major League Soccer season#Goal of the Week|Goal of the Week]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=1 May 2021 |title=ORLvsCIN 05-01-2021 |url=https://www.mlssoccer.com/competitions/mls-regular-season/2021/matches/orlvscin-05-01-2021/ |access-date=18 September 2024 |website=[[Major League Soccer]]}}</ref> On 2 August, Nani was named [[2021 Major League Soccer season#Player / Team of the Week|Player of the Week]] for providing a goal and an assist in a 3–2 victory over [[Atlanta United FC|Atlanta United]] two days earlier.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hunte |first=Sydney |date=30 June 2021 |title=Recap: Orlando City SC 3, Atlanta United 2 |url=https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/recap-orlando-city-sc-3-atlanta-united-2 |access-date=18 September 2024 |website=[[Major League Soccer]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2 August 2021 |title=Orlando City's Nani named Week 16 MLS Player of the Week |url=https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/orlando-city-s-nani-named-week-16-mls-player-of-the-week |access-date=18 September 2024 |website=[[Major League Soccer]]}}</ref> On 21 May, the MLS Disciplinary Committee suspended Nani for two games for making physical contact with referee [[Alex Chilowicz]] during a match at [[D.C. United]] five days earlier on 16 May.<ref>{{cite web |author1=The Associated Press |title=Nani suspended for 2 games for making contact with official |url=https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/nani-suspended-for-2-games-for-making-contact-with-official/ |website=[[The Seattle Times]] |access-date=26 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210728021208/https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/nani-suspended-for-2-games-for-making-contact-with-official/ |archive-date=28 July 2021 |date=21 May 2021 |url-status=live}}</ref> On 26 November, Nani announced he was leaving Orlando City following the expiration of his contract.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nani announces departure from Orlando City SC after contract expires |url=https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/nani-announces-departure-from-orlando-city-sc-after-contract-expires |website=Major League Soccer}}</ref>

===Venezia===
On 14 January 2022, he signed a contract with Italian [[Serie A]] club [[Venezia F.C.|Venezia]] until the end of the 2022–23 season.<ref>{{cite web|publisher=[[Venezia F.C.|Venezia]]|url=https://www.veneziafc.it/en/news/nani-joins-venezia-fc|title=NANI JOINS VENEZIA FC|date=14 January 2022|access-date=14 January 2022}}</ref> The contract was terminated by mutual consent on 8 July 2022.<ref>{{cite web|publisher=Venezia|url=https://www.veneziafc.it/en/news/luis-nani-departs-venezia-fc|title=LUÍS NANI DEPARTS VENEZIA FC|date=8 July 2022|access-date=10 July 2022}}</ref>

===Melbourne Victory===
On 12 July 2022, Nani signed a two-year contract with [[A-League Men]] club [[Melbourne Victory FC|Melbourne Victory]].<ref>{{cite web|publisher=[[Melbourne Victory FC|Melbourne Victory]]|url=https://melbournevictory.com.au/news/melbourne-victory-signs-portuguese-legend-luis-nani|title= Melbourne Victory Signs Portuguese Legend Luis Nani|date=12 July 2022|access-date=12 July 2022}}</ref>

Three days later, he made his unofficial debut for his new team, coming on as a late substitute in a 4–1 loss to former side Manchester United.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nani makes Victory debut as Manchester United stay perfect in pre-season |url=https://keepup.com.au/news/united-beat-victory-perfect-in-pre-season/ |website=KEEPUP |language=en-AU |date=15 July 2022}}</ref> On 6 January 2023, during an [[2022–23 A-League Men|A-League Men]] game against [[Brisbane Roar FC|Brisbane Roar]], he [[Anterior cruciate ligament injury|ruptured his anterior cruciate ligament]] in an accidental clash with opponent [[Connor Chapman]], and was ruled out for the rest of the season.<ref>{{Cite web |date=7 January 2023 |title=Injury Update: Luis Nani |url=https://melbournevictory.com.au/news/injury-update-luis-nani |access-date=10 January 2023 |website=Melbourne Victory}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=8 January 2023 |title=Injury shocker: ALM star Nani ruptures ACL |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/melbourne-victory-ausmelbourne_victory_fc/story/4847605/melbourne-victory-marquee-signing-luis-nani-ruptures-acl |access-date=10 January 2023 |website=ESPN.com }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=8 January 2023 |title=Injury blow for Victory's Nani as ACL rupture confirmed |work=Reuters |url=https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/sports/injury-blow-victorys-nani-acl-rupture-confirmed-2023-01-08/ |access-date=10 January 2023 }}</ref>

On 31 May 2023, the club confirmed Nani's departure.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://melbournevictory.com.au/news/luis-nani-departs-melbourne-victory|title=Luis Nani departs Melbourne Victory|website=[[Melbourne Victory FC|Melbourne Victory]]|date=31 May 2023}}</ref>

=== Adana Demirspor ===
On 13 July 2023, [[Süper Lig]] club [[Adana Demirspor]] announced the signing of Nani on a one-year contract, with an option for a further year.<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 July 2023 |title=Nani oficializado como reforço do Adana Demirspor |trans-title=Nani officialized as reinforcement of Adana Demirspor |url=https://www.record.pt/internacional/detalhe/nani-oficializado-como-reforco-do-adana-demirspor |access-date=13 July 2023 |publisher=[[Record (Portuguese newspaper)|Record]] |language=pt-PT}}</ref> He was in the squad for 28 league matches and 5 European Cup qualifiers and scored 4 goals in Adana Demirspor. On 13 May 2024, it was announced that he had left the club.<ref>{{cite web |title=Yukatel Adana Demirspor ayrılığı duyurdu |trans-title=Yukatel Adana Demirspor announces separation |url=https://beinsports.com.tr/haber/yukatel-adana-demirspor-ayriligi-duyurdu |website=beinsports |date=13 May 2024 |access-date=13 May 2024 |language=tr-TR}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Turkish Football Federation Page of Nani |url=https://www.tff.org/Default.aspx?pageId=30&kisiId=1821848 |website=TFF |access-date=13 May 2024}}</ref>
[[File:Nani in December 2024.png|thumb|Nani in 2024]]

=== Estrela Amadora ===
On 8 December 2024, after playing for [[Estrela Amadora]], Nani announced his retirement from professional football.<ref>{{Cite web |date=8 December 2024 |title=Ex-Man Utd, Portugal winger Nani retires |url=https://www.espn.co.uk/football/story/_/id/42856547/ex-man-united-portugal-star-nani-retires-professional-football |access-date=8 December 2024 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cn5472vqqq6o|title=Nani: Former Man Utd, Sporting and Portugal winger retires|date=8 December 2024|website=BBC Sport}}</ref>

On 14 September 2025, Nani made a guest appearance in Russia’s [[Media Football League|Media League Cup]], playing for media club [[Alfa-Bank]]a against [[FC Amkal Moscow|Amkal]] and scoring from the penalty spot in a 3–1 defeat.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-09-15 |title=Нани дебютировал в Медиалиге! Вышел под Дору, сыграл пяткой и исполнил сальто после гола - Made in MediaFootball - Блоги Sports.ru |url=https://www.sports.ru/mediafootball/blogs/3350460.html |access-date=2025-12-07 |website=Спортс’’ |language=ru}}</ref>

=== Aktobe ===
In January 2026, Nani came out of retirement to sign for [[Kazakhstan Premier League]] side [[FC Aktobe|Aktobe]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Nani out of retirement to play in Kazakhstan at 39|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cgk80xn55lzo|website=[[BBC]]|date=26 January 2026|access-date=26 January 2026}}</ref>

Nani made his Kazakhstan Premier League debut on 7 March 2026, coming off the bench in the 71st minute against [[FC Tobol]]. It took the Portuguese winger just three minutes to provide an assist for [[Ivan Ordets]], helping his team, Aktobe, cruise to a 4-1 victory.<ref>[https://globalsportsarchive.com/en/soccer/match/2026-03-07/aqtobe-fk-vs-tobyl-fk/4109333 Aqtöbe FK vs Tobyl FK - March 7, 2026 - Kazakhstan Premier League 2026 - Soccer | Global Sports Archive]</ref>

Nani scored his first brace in Kazakhstan on 30 April 2026, in a [[2026 Kazakhstan Cup]] match between Aktobe and [[FC Yelimay]]. His goals helped his team advance to the quarterfinals of the [[2026 Kazakhstan Cup]].<ref>[https://globalsportsarchive.com/en/soccer/match/2026-04-30/aqtobe-fk-vs-elimai-fk/4246123]</ref> His first goal in the Kazakhstan Football Championship was scored on 21 June 2026, in the 22nd minute of the match against Astana. <ref>[https://www.sports.kz/news/luish-nani-zabil-pervyiy-gol-v-kpl-video Луиш Нани забил первый гол в КПЛ]</ref><ref>[https://globalsportsarchive.com/en/soccer/athlete/nani/984]</ref>

|title=European U-21 Championship 2007 – Final Tournament Details |publisher=Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation |first=Marcel |last=Haisma |access-date=29 January 2011 ===Portugal senior team===
[[File:Nani Portugal.jpg|thumb|upright|Nani in action for Portugal in 2008]]
Nani made his first appearance for the senior [[Portugal national football team|Portuguese team]] on 1 September 2006, and marked his debut with a goal in Portugal's 4–2 friendly defeat to [[Denmark national football team|Denmark]].<ref name="who_are"/> Nani was omitted from Portugal's 1–1 draw with [[Armenia national football team|Armenia]], but was recalled for Euro 2008 qualifiers against [[Poland national football team|Poland]] and [[Serbia national football team|Serbia]] in September.<ref>{{cite news |first=Robin |last=Hackett |title=Scolari recalls Nani |url=http://www.skysports.com/story/0,19528,11667_2695520,00.html |work=Sky Sports |publisher=BSkyB |date=30 August 2007 |access-date=30 August 2007 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121023082641/http://www.skysports.com/story/0,19528,11667_2695520,00.html |archive-date=23 October 2012 |url-status=live }}</ref> He also provided the assist for [[Ricardo Quaresma]]'s goal in a friendly against [[Italy national football team|Italy]] on 6 February 2008.<ref>{{cite news |title=Italy 3–1 Portugal: Rampant Azzurri looking good |url=http://soccernet-akamai.espn.go.com/report?id=234403&league=FIFA.FRIENDLY&&cc=3888 |work=ESPNsoccernet |publisher=ESPN Internet Ventures |date=6 February 2008 |access-date=29 November 2008 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090412183926/http://soccernet-akamai.espn.go.com/report?id=234403&league=FIFA.FRIENDLY&&cc=3888 |archive-date=12 April 2009 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Nani was ruled out of Portugal's friendly with [[Greece national football team|Greece]] in March 2008 due to injury.<ref>{{cite news |title=United duo out for Portugal |url=http://www.skysports.com/story/0,19528,11667_3343764,00.html |work=Sky Sports |publisher=British Sky Broadcasting |date=24 March 2008 |access-date=24 March 2008 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080325134114/http://www.skysports.com/story/0,19528,11667_3343764,00.html |archive-date=25 March 2008 |url-status=live }}</ref>

====UEFA Euro 2008====
Nani was a regular member of the Portugal squad in [[UEFA Euro 2008 qualifying|Euro 2008 qualification]], and scored one of the goals in the 2–1 away win over [[Belgium national football team|Belgium]] on 2 June 2007.<ref>{{cite news |title=Belgium 1–2 Portugal |url=http://www.free-football.tv/news/Belgium1-2Portugal.html |work=free-football.tv |publisher=Free Football |date=4 June 2007 |access-date=4 June 2007 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071025064707/http://www.free-football.tv/news/Belgium1-2Portugal.html |archive-date=25 October 2007}}</ref> Nani received a call-up to [[Luiz Felipe Scolari]]'s 23-man squad for [[UEFA Euro 2008|Euro 2008]] alongside Manchester United teammate Cristiano Ronaldo.<ref>{{cite news |title=Scolari names Portugal squad |url=http://www.skysports.com/story/0,19528,11966_3557371,00.html |work=Sky Sports |publisher=British Sky Broadcasting |date=12 May 2008 |access-date=12 May 2008 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080514042028/http://www.skysports.com/story/0,19528,11966_3557371,00.html |archive-date=14 May 2008 |url-status=live }}</ref> During the campaign, Nani played three matches and started just one,<ref name="Nani2010"/> but did provide the assist for [[Hélder Postiga]]'s goal during a substitute appearance in the 3–2 quarter-final defeat to [[Germany national football team|Germany]] on 19 June.<ref>{{cite news |first=Andrew |last=McKenzie |title=Portugal 2–3 Germany |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/football/euro_2008/7363493.stm |work=BBC Sport |publisher=British Broadcasting Corporation |date=19 June 2008 |access-date=19 June 2008 }}</ref>

Islands national football team|Faroe Islands]] on 20 August 2008.<ref>{{cite news |title=Portugal 5–0 Faroe Islands |url=http://soccernet.espn.go.com/world-cup/player/bio?id=67716&cc=5739&ver=global ====UEFA Euro 2012====
[[File:Lukas Podolski - Nani 20120609.jpg|thumb|upright|left|Nani battling for the ball with [[Lukas Podolski]] in their [[UEFA Euro 2012|Euro 2012]] [[UEFA Euro 2012 Group B#Germany vs Portugal|group stage match]]]]
Nani scored twice and assisted once in [[Paulo Bento]]'s first game in charge of Portugal in a 3–1 [[UEFA Euro 2012 qualifying Group H|Euro 2012 qualifying]] win over Denmark on 8 October 2010.<ref>{{cite news |title=Portugal 3–1 Denmark |url=http://soccernet.espn.go.com/report?id=299346&cc=5739 |publisher=ESPN Soccernet |date=8 October 2010 |access-date=8 October 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101025003859/http://soccernet.espn.go.com/report?id=299346&cc=5739 |archive-date=25 October 2010 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Nani scored twice and set up another again in a 5–3 win over Iceland on 7 October 2011.

====2014 FIFA World Cup====
Nani started in the opening match of the [[2014 FIFA World Cup|2014 World Cup]] for [[Portugal national football team|Portugal]] against Germany.<ref>{{cite news|title=Mühsamer Auftakt: Gomez löst den Knoten|url=https://www.kicker.de/deutschland-gegen-portugal-2012-europameisterschaft-1122667/analyse|access-date=9 June 2012|newspaper=[[Kicker (sports magazine)|kicker]]|date=9 June 2012|language=de|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120610174902/http://www.kicker.de/news/fussball/em/startseite/europameisterschaft/2012/1/1122667/spielbericht_deutschland_portugal.html|archive-date=10 June 2012|url-status=live}}</ref> After the match, he stated how the team played well despite the loss and how "the referee has discriminated against us, but that's normal, Portugal against big teams never get help".<ref>{{cite news|title=Die Deutschen hatten Glück beim Tor von Gomez|trans-title=The Germans had luck at goal from Gomez|url=https://www.welt.de/sport/fussball/em-2012/article106485434/Die-Deutschen-hatten-Glueck-beim-Tor-von-Gomez.html|access-date=9 June 2012|newspaper=[[Die Welt]]|date=9 June 2012|language=de|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120610101343/http://www.welt.de/sport/fussball/em-2012/article106485434/Die-Deutschen-hatten-Glueck-beim-Tor-von-Gomez.html|archive-date=10 June 2012|url-status=live}}</ref> In the team's second fixture, Nani scored the opening goal for Portugal in a 2–2 draw with the [[United States men's national soccer team|United States]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.fifa.com/worldcup/matches/round=255931/match=300186483/match-report.html|title=Varela strikes to save Portugal|publisher=FIFA.com|date=23 June 2014|access-date=23 June 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140626032918/http://www.fifa.com/worldcup/matches/round=255931/match=300186483/match-report.html|archive-date=26 June 2014|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Style of play==
{{Quote box
| width = 25%
| align = right
| quote = "Nani's got the potential to do what he wants. He's one of the sharpest players around, has a great strike with both feet – he's got the potential to be a top, top player."
| source = – Manchester United teammate [[Rio Ferdinand]] on Nani<ref name="NaniESPN">{{cite web |url=http://soccernet.espn.go.com/players/stats?id=67716&cc=5739 |title=Nani |access-date=6 November 2010 |publisher=ESPN |work=ESPN Soccernet |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070910035727/http://soccernet.espn.go.com/players/stats?id=67716&cc=5739 |archive-date=10 September 2007 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
}}
In the early stages of his career at Manchester United, Nani's ability and playing style often invited comparisons with club and international teammate [[Cristiano Ronaldo]]; however, Nani's style developed into more that of a traditional [[Winger (association football)|winger]] than Ronaldo's evolution into a centre forward.

While being able to play on both wings, Nani was more comfortable on the right side, where he was known to utilise his pace along with intricate [[Dribbling#Association football|dribbling]] skills and [[Dummy (football)#Association football|trickery]] to create space in wide areas and provide [[Cross (association football)|crosses]] for teammates. Though capable of cutting inside from either wing to strike at goal from distance, Nani scored fewer goals but produced a substantially higher proportion of assists than his compatriot Ronaldo. Due to his potent attacking talents, he could play a variety of additional roles as a [[Forward (association football)|forward]], including as an [[inverted winger]] on the left, [[second striker]], or even in a more central position as a main [[Striker (association football)|striker]], as he played frequently for Portugal.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.premierleague.com/page/Statistics|title=Barclays Premier League top scorers, player news & teams of the week|publisher=Premier League|access-date=30 January 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101203132930/http://www.premierleague.com/page/Statistics|archive-date=3 December 2010|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2016/jul/09/nani-portugal-centre-stage-euro-2016|title=Nani out of the wings for Portugal to share centre stage at Euro 2016|work=The Guardian|author1=Andy Brassell|date=9 July 2016|access-date=29 August 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160820074715/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2016/jul/09/nani-portugal-centre-stage-euro-2016|archive-date=20 August 2016|url-status=live}}</ref>

==Celebration==
Nani [[Goal celebration|celebrated goals]] with a [[somersault]] referred to in Portuguese as a "mortal" ("leap of death"), similar to that of [[Obafemi Martins]] and [[Lomana LuaLua]]. The celebration derived from Nani's background in [[capoeira]], which he used to practice as a child.<ref>{{cite news |first=Amy |last=Lawrence |title=Dancing Nani leads Portugal's new generation |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2007/jun/10/newsstory.sport2 |work=The Guardian |date=10 June 2007 |access-date=9 January 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131203063457/http://www.theguardian.com/football/2007/jun/10/newsstory.sport2 |archive-date=3 December 2013 |url-status=live }}</ref> For a while, it was reported that United manager Sir Alex Ferguson had banned Nani's celebration due to fear for his safety.<ref>{{cite news |first=David |last=McDonnell |title=Fergie bans Nani's celebration |url=https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/football/2007/07/27/fergie-bans-nani-celebration-89520-19528747/ |work=Daily Mirror |date=27 July 2007 |access-date=12 May 2008 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080226154004/http://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/football/2007/07/27/fergie-bans-nani-celebration-89520-19528747/ |archive-date=26 February 2008 |url-status=dead}}</ref> However, Nani denounced the reports in August 2007, stating it was "not true" and that "Ferguson has never spoken to me about this subject and I am going to continue to celebrate goals in this way. The conversations he has had with me are normal conversations, like he has with all players".<ref>{{cite news |first=Ben |last=Hibbs |title=Nani feels settled at United |url=http://www.manutd.com/en/News-And-Features/Football-News/2007/Aug/Nani-feels-settled-at-United.aspx |publisher=Manchester United F.C. |date=23 August 2007 |access-date=25 August 2007 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121114204506/http://www.manutd.com/en/News-And-Features/Football-News/2007/Aug/Nani-feels-settled-at-United.aspx |archive-date=14 November 2012 |url-status=live }}</ref>

'''Sergio Busquets Burgos''' ({{IPA|ca|busˈkɛts|lang}},<ref>{{cite web|url=http://forvo.com/word/carles_busquets/|title=How to pronounce Carles Busquets|publisher=Forvo|date=12 October 2008|access-date=11 May 2018|archive-date=12 May 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180512044049/https://forvo.com/word/carles_busquets/|url-status=live}}</ref> {{IPA|es|ˈseɾxjo βusˈkets|lang}};{{efn-ua|In isolation, ''Busquets'' is pronounced {{IPA|es|busˈkets|}}.}} born 16 July 1988) is a Spanish former professional [[Association football|footballer]] who played as a [[defensive midfielder]] and spent most of his career at [[La Liga]] club [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]]. He is currently the assistant manager of [[Segunda Federación]] club [[FC Barcelona Atlètic|Barcelona B]]. A [[deep-lying playmaker]] known for his short and calm passing and singular reading of the game, Busquets is regarded as one of the best defensive midfielders of all time.<ref name="busquets ranked_1">{{cite news|url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11095/10054186/barcelona-midfielder-sergio-busquets-is-among-best-in-the-world-says-terry-gibson|title=Barcelona midfielder Sergio Busquets is among best in the world, says Terry Gibson|date=11 November 2015|publisher=Sky Sports|access-date=8 November 2019|archive-date=8 November 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191108162150/https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11095/10054186/barcelona-midfielder-sergio-busquets-is-among-best-in-the-world-says-terry-gibson|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="busquets ranked_2">{{cite web|url=https://www.goal.com/en-kw/news/casemiro-spains-busquets-is-worlds-best-in-my-position/w49b9j2eulgt1gft8kf6k3tx8|title=Casemiro: Spain's Busquets is world's best in my position|first=Dejan|last=Kalinic|date=29 June 2018|website=Goal.com|access-date=8 November 2019|archive-date=8 November 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191108160651/https://www.goal.com/en-kw/news/casemiro-spains-busquets-is-worlds-best-in-my-position/w49b9j2eulgt1gft8kf6k3tx8|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Roden">{{cite web |author1=Lee Roden |date=5 February 2016 |title=Is it time to acknowledge Sergio Busquets as the best midfielder in the world? |url=https://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/it-time-acknowledge-sergio-busquets-best-midfielder-world |access-date=15 June 2022 |website=FourFourTwo |archive-date=16 August 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220816050151/https://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/it-time-acknowledge-sergio-busquets-best-midfielder-world |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=9 December 2024 |title=Ranking The 25 Best Soccer Midfielders of All Time |url=https://www.si.com/soccer/ranking-the-25-best-soccer-midfielders-of-all-time |access-date=30 September 2025 |website=SI}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Churchill |first=Max |date=18 January 2025 |title=The 10 greatest defensive midfielders in football history ranked - Rodri 8th |url=https://www.givemesport.com/greatest-defensive-midfielders-in-football-history-ranked/ |access-date=30 September 2025 |website=GiveMeSport}}</ref> In addition, he is also one of a select number of players who have [[List of men's footballers with 1,000 or more official appearances|amassed over 1,000 career appearances]].

Busquets arrived in [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]]'s first team in July 2008 and went on to receive the [[La Liga Awards|La Liga's Breakthrough Player]] in 2009. From the [[2009–10 FC Barcelona season|2009–10]] season, he was a first team regular and was a key playing contributor to the club for 14 years, until his departure at the end of the [[2022–23 FC Barcelona season|2022–23 season]]. Busquets made over 700 total appearances for the club, winning 33 trophies, including nine [[La Liga]] titles, seven [[Copa del Rey]] titles and three [[UEFA Champions League]]s. With the initial management guidance by [[Pep Guardiola]] and using the [[tiki-taka]] football philosophy, Busquets was part of a widely lauded midfield combination trio with [[Andrés Iniesta]] and [[Xavi (footballer, born 1980)|Xavi]]; from 2008 to 2015 the trio together were instrumental in Barcelona's exceptional on-field successes in seven seasons, winning five La Liga titles, three Copa del Rey titles, three Champions League titles and the continental [[Treble (association football)|treble]] (all three titles simultaneously) twice, in [[2008–09 FC Barcelona season|2008–09]] and [[2014–15 FC Barcelona season|2014–15]].<ref>{{cite web |title=2008-20. The best years in our history |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/card/643923/2008-16-the-best-years-in-our-history |access-date=11 May 2025 |publisher=FC Barcelona}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Marshall |first=Jan-Michael |date=4 May 2021 |title=Passing of the Torch: From Iniesta, Busquets and Xavi to Pedri, Busquets and De Jong |url=https://barcauniversal.com/passing-of-the-torch-from-iniesta-busquets-and-xavi-to-pedri-busquets-and-de-jong/ |access-date=11 May 2025 |website=Barca Universal}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=31 May 2022 |title=Arguments Over Best Midfield Trio Resumes Between Real Madrid And Barcelona Fans |url=https://www.sportbible.com/football/arguments-over-best-midfield-trio-between-madrid-and-barcelona-fans-20220531 |access-date=11 May 2025 |website=SPORTbible}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=1 October 2024 |title=Andres Iniesta retires: How he, Xavi and Busquets changed football at Barcelona |url=https://www.nationalworld.com/sport/football/andres-iniesta-retires-xavi-sergio-busquets-barcelona-4805001 |access-date=11 May 2025 |website=NationalWorld}}</ref> After joining [[Major League Soccer]] side [[Inter Miami CF|Inter Miami]] in 2023 and winning three trophies, Busquets retired from football at the end of the [[2025 Major League Soccer season|2025 season]].

Busquets made his senior international debut for [[Spain national football team|Spain]] in April 2009, making 143 appearances for the national side, scoring twice. He helped his country win the [[2010 FIFA World Cup]] and [[UEFA Euro 2012]] tournaments, and he also featured at three other [[FIFA World Cup|World Cups]] and two [[UEFA European Championship|European Championships]]. He retired from international football following the [[2022 FIFA World Cup|2022 World Cup]].

==Club career==

=== Barcelona ===
Born in [[Sabadell]], Barcelona, Catalonia, Busquets began playing football with local team Badia del Vallès,<ref>[http://www.cdbadiadelvalles.es/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=68&Itemid=270 Jugadores salidos de Badia (Players who came from Badia)] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151222115834/http://www.cdbadiadelvalles.es/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=68&Itemid=270|date=22 December 2015}}; CD Badia del Vallès, 20 December 2015 {{in lang|es}}</ref> followed by spells with Barberà Andalucía, [[UE Lleida|Lleida]] and Jàbac Terrassa,<ref>[http://www.sport.es/es/personajes/barca/sergio-busquets S. Busquets] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151223082310/http://www.sport.es/es/personajes/barca/sergio-busquets/ |date=23 December 2015 }}; at [[Sport (Spanish newspaper)|Sport]] {{in lang|es}}</ref> before joining [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]]'s youth ranks in 2005.<ref name=BLAU>[http://www.blaugranas.com/wiki/sergio_busquets Sergio Busquets] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180616001934/http://www.blaugranas.com/wiki/sergio_busquets |date=16 June 2018 }}; at Blaugranas {{in lang|es}}</ref> He scored seven goals in 26 games for the [[FC Barcelona (youth)|''Juvenil A'' team]] in his second season and, two years later, Busquets was promoted to the [[FC Barcelona Atlètic|B team]] under [[Pep Guardiola]], and helped them [[2007–08 Tercera División|achieve promotion]] to the [[Segunda División B|third division]].<ref>[https://bleacherreport.com/articles/769301-fc-barcelona-the-meteoric-rise-of-sergio-busquets FC Barcelona: The meteoric rise of Sergio Busquets] ; [[Bleacher Report]], 16 July 2011</ref><ref>[http://www.mundodeportivo.com/futbol/fc-barcelona/20160224/302409643719/sergio-busquets-el-dia-que-empezo-todo.html Sergio Busquets: El día que empezó todo (Sergio Busquets: The day it all started)] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170906181102/http://www.mundodeportivo.com/futbol/fc-barcelona/20160224/302409643719/sergio-busquets-el-dia-que-empezo-todo.html |date=6 September 2017 }}; [[Mundo Deportivo]], 25 February 2016 {{in lang|es}}</ref> In that same season, he would make his first-team debut, coming on as a [[Substitute (association football)|substitute]] in the [[Copa Catalunya]].<ref>[http://arxiu.fcbarcelona.cat/web/castellano/futbol/temporada_10-11/plantilla/jugadors/busquets.html Sergio Busquets Burgos] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200808114613/http://arxiu.fcbarcelona.cat/web/castellano/futbol/temporada_10-11/plantilla/jugadors/busquets.html |date=8 August 2020 }}; FC Barcelona, 3 April 2017 {{in lang|es}}</ref>

[[File:S. Busquets (2009-05).jpg|thumb|Busquets attending a press conference for [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] in 2009]]

Busquets played his first [[La Liga]] match on 13 September 2008, featuring 90 minutes in a 1–1 home draw to [[Racing de Santander|Racing Santander]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.marca.com/marcador/futbol/2008_09/primera/jornada_2/bar_rac/|title=Trata de arrancarlo, Pep|trans-title=Get this thing started, Pep|work=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]]|location=Madrid|language=es|date=13 September 2008|access-date=9 July 2014|archive-date=14 July 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140714200327/http://www.marca.com/marcador/futbol/2008_09/primera/jornada_2/bar_rac/|url-status=live}}</ref> During Barcelona's [[2008–09 UEFA Champions League]] clash against [[FC Basel|Basel]] at [[St. Jakob-Park]] on 22 October 2008, he scored the second goal in the 15th minute in a 5–0 [[2008–09 UEFA Champions League group stage#Group C|group stage]] win;<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uefa.com/competitions/ucl/history/season=2009/round=15276/match=302726/report=rp.html|title=Basel overwhelmed by five-star Barça|publisher=UEFA|date=22 October 2008|access-date=22 October 2008|archive-date=9 July 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090709235916/http://www.uefa.com/competitions/ucl/history/season=2009/round=15276/match=302726/report=rp.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> in early December, in another start, he scored his second with ''Barça'' in the competition, netting in the 83rd minute of a 2–3 home loss against [[FC Shakhtar Donetsk|Shakhtar Donetsk]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uefa.com/competitions/ucl/history/season=2009/round=15276/match=302782/report=rp.html|title=Shakhtar brush aside youthful Barcelona|publisher=UEFA|date=9 December 2008|access-date=15 January 2010|archive-date=10 July 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090710003220/http://www.uefa.com/competitions/ucl/history/season=2009/round=15276/match=302782/report=rp.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

On 22 December 2008, Busquets signed a contract extension until 2013 with a buy-out clause of €80 million.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uefa.com/competitions/ucl/news/kind=1/newsid=789548.html|title=Busquets thrilled to commit future to Barça|publisher=UEFA|date=22 December 2008|access-date=22 December 2008|archive-date=23 December 2008|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081223120617/http://www.uefa.com/competitions/ucl/news/kind=1/newsid=789548.html|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.tribalfootball.com/busquets-signs-new-barcelona-contract-218065|title=Busquets signs new Barcelona contract|work=Tribal Football|date=23 December 2008|access-date=23 December 2008|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081227213332/http://www.tribalfootball.com/busquets-signs-new-barcelona-contract-218065|archive-date=27 December 2008}}</ref> On 7 March 2009, he scored his first league goal, in a 2–0 home win over [[Athletic Bilbao]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.marca.com/marcador/futbol/2008_09/primera/jornada_26/bar_ath/|title=Vuelve el espectáculo|trans-title=Showtime is back|work=Marca|language=es|date=7 March 2009|access-date=8 May 2017|archive-date=30 March 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190330192025/https://www.marca.com/marcador/futbol/2008_09/primera/jornada_26/bar_ath/|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 27 May 2009, having been regularly played as he competed for the spot with internationals [[Seydou Keita (footballer)|Seydou Keita]] and [[Yaya Touré]], he also featured in Barcelona's starting eleven in the [[2009 UEFA Champions League Final|Champions League final]], a 2–0 win over [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]] in [[Rome]]; with that victory, [[Carles Busquets]] and Sergio Busquets became only the third father-and-son combo to both have won Europe's top club competition playing for the same team, joining [[Cesare Maldini]] and [[Paolo Maldini]] (won it with [[AC Milan|Milan]]) and [[Manuel Sanchís]] and [[Manolo Sanchís]] ([[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]]).<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.mundodeportivo.com/20090529/los-busquets-hacen-historia_53711968607.html|title=Los Busquets hacen historia|trans-title=The Busquets make history|work=Mundo Deportivo|language=es|date=29 May 2009|access-date=8 May 2017|archive-date=10 October 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171010054730/http://www.mundodeportivo.com/20090529/los-busquets-hacen-historia_53711968607.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

Busquets' fine form continued in the [[2009–10 FC Barcelona season|2009–10 campaign]],<ref>[https://www.nytimes.com/2009/11/26/sports/soccer/26iht-SOCCER.html?_r=1&partner=rss&emc=rss Barcelona responds like a true champion] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180202071930/http://www.nytimes.com/2009/11/26/sports/soccer/26iht-SOCCER.html?_r=1&partner=rss&emc=rss |date=2 February 2018 }}; [[The New York Times]], 25 November 2009</ref><ref>[https://www.bbc.co.uk/blogs/philminshull/2010/03/distractions_looming_as_barca.html Distractions looming as Barca bid for the double] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190405233158/https://www.bbc.co.uk/blogs/philminshull/2010/03/distractions_looming_as_barca.html |date=5 April 2019 }}; [[BBC]], 16 March 2010</ref> with Guardiola preferring him to Touré as Barcelona's central holding midfielder. In the second leg of the [[2009–10 UEFA Champions League knockout phase#Semi-finals|Champions League semi-final]] 1–0 victory (and an eventual 2–3 aggregate defeat) against [[Inter Milan]] at the [[Camp Nou]] on 28 April 2010, he went down to the ground after [[Thiago Motta]] had raised his arm and appeared to push Busquets directly in the face.<ref name=DT>{{cite news|url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/european/championsleague/7650407/Barcelona-v-Inter-Milan-Thiago-Motta-fumes-at-Sergio-Busquets-terrible-behaviour.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100429102040/http://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/european/championsleague/7650407/Barcelona-v-Inter-Milan-Thiago-Motta-fumes-at-Sergio-Busquets-terrible-behaviour.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=29 April 2010|title=Barcelona v Inter Milan: Thiago Motta fumes at Sergio Busquets' 'terrible behaviour'|work=[[The Daily Telegraph]]|location=London|last=Mole|first=Giles|date=29 April 2010|access-date=29 April 2010}}</ref> As a result of this action, the former was shown a [[red card (association football)|red card]] and dismissed for violent conduct, whilst the latter was subsequently criticised by both Motta and the media for apparently feigning injury.<ref name=DT/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/europe/8645184.stm|title=Barcelona 1–0 news|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/european/banned-motta-asks-uefa-to-act-over-busquets-theatre-1958467.html|title=Banned Motta asks Uefa to act over Busquets 'theatre'|work=[[The 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100501152945/http://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/european/banned-motta-asks-uefa-to-act-over-busquets-theatre-1958467.html|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite Busquets was again ever-present in [[2010–11 FC Barcelona season|2010–11]], even playing as a [[central defender|centre back]] on occasions.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.elmundo.es/elmundodeporte/2011/09/16/futbol/1316180392.html|title=Ya sabemos que Busquets es un inútil|trans-title=We all know that Busquets is worthless|work=[[El Mundo (Spain)|El Mundo]]|language=es|date=16 September 2011|access-date=8 May 2017|archive-date=10 October 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171010005744/http://www.elmundo.es/elmundodeporte/2011/09/16/futbol/1316180392.html|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://futbol.as.com/futbol/2016/03/15/champions/1458010558_586403.html|title=El día que Sergio Busquets y Mascherano se ordenaron|trans-title=The day Sergio Busquets and Mascherano got it together|work=[[Diario AS]]|language=es|date=15 March 2016|access-date=8 May 2017|archive-date=4 August 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160804031559/http://futbol.as.com/futbol/2016/03/15/champions/1458010558_586403.html|url-status=live}}</ref> On 27 January 2011, he signed a contract extension that would keep him at the club until 2015 – the buyout clause was increased to €150 million.<ref>[http://soccernet.espn.go.com/news/story/_/id/871569/busquets-signs-new-barca-deal?cc=4716 Busquets signs new Barca deal] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110130061537/http://soccernet.espn.go.com/news/story/_/id/871569/busquets-signs-new-barca-deal?cc=4716 |date=30 January 2011 }}; [[ESPN Soccernet]], 27 January 2011</ref> On 8 March 2011, playing at centre back, he scored an [[own goal]] from a [[corner kick]] against [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]], in [[2010–11 UEFA Champions League knockout phase#Round of 16|the season's Champions League round-of-16]], levelling the score at 1–1; Barcelona eventually won the game 3–1 (and 4–3 on aggregate).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/01ef-0e7766c115fe-29d0b38b2775-1000--brilliant-barcelona-outgun-ten-man-arsenal/|title=Brilliant Barcelona outgun ten-man Arsenal|publisher=UEFA|date=8 March 2011|access-date=9 March 2011|archive-date=9 March 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110309205720/http://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/matches/season=2011/round=2000119/match=2003764/postmatch/report/index.html#brilliant+barcelona+outgun+arsenal|url-status=live}}</ref> On 28 May, Busquets played the full match during his side's 3–1 [[2011 UEFA Champions League Final|Champions league final]] victory against [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]] at [[Wembley Stadium|Wembley]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.skysports.com/football/barcelona-vs-man-utd/report/234950|title=No answer to Barca genius|last=Dunn|first=Alex|publisher=Sky Sports|date=28 May 2011|access-date=7 December 2020|archive-date=10 September 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230910183229/https://www.skysports.com/football/barcelona-vs-man-utd/report/234950|url-status=live}}</ref>

Busquets scored a rare goal on 24 April 2012 – only his sixth official one in four years – netting from an easy tap-in after an [[Isaac Cuenca]] cross to make it 1–0 for the hosts in the second leg of the [[2011–12 UEFA Champions League knockout phase#Semi-finals|Champions League semi-finals]] against [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]]. Barcelona could only draw 2–2 against ten men as the English club came back from being 0–2 down; his team eventually lost 2–3 on aggregate, after already having lost 1–0 in the first leg at [[Stamford Bridge (stadium)|Stamford Bridge]].<ref>[https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/01fc-0e7df449e8f5-b7a861c948eb-1000--ten-man-chelsea-hold-off-barca-to-reach-final/ Ten-man Chelsea hold off Barça to reach final] ; UEFA, 24 April 2012</ref>

On 16 July 2013, the day he celebrated his 25th birthday, Busquets agreed to a new deal until 2018, with the buyout clause remaining unaltered.<ref>{{cite magazine|url=http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/soccer/news/20130716/sergio-busquets-barcelona-contract.ap/|archive-url=https://archive.today/20131024005355/http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/soccer/news/20130716/sergio-busquets-barcelona-contract.ap/|url-status=dead|archive-date=24 October 2013|title=Barcelona renews Sergio Busquets' contract through 2018|magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]]|location=New York|date=16 July 2013|access-date=23 October 2013}}</ref> On 1 August 2014, after the retirement of long time club captain and defender [[Carles Puyol]] and at the veteran's personal request, he was given the number 5 shirt for [[2014–15 FC Barcelona season|the upcoming campaign]] and was named one of the four captains for the club alongside [[Xavi (footballer, born 1980)|Xavi]], [[Andrés Iniesta]] and [[Lionel Messi]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.marca.com/2014/08/01/en/football/barcelona/1406892472.html|title=Busquets inherits Puyol's number 5 shirt|work=Marca|date=1 August 2014|access-date=8 May 2017|archive-date=2 February 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180202012630/http://www.marca.com/2014/08/01/en/football/barcelona/1406892472.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

[[File:2015 UEFA Super Cup 61.jpg|thumb|left|upright|Busquets during the [[2015 UEFA Super Cup]] against [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]]]]

Busquets started on 6 June in the [[2015 UEFA Champions League Final|2015 Champions League final]], as the team won their fifth accolade in [[UEFA Champions League|the competition]] by beating [[Juventus FC|Juventus]] 3–1 at [[Berlin]]'s [[Olympiastadion Berlin|Olympiastadion]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/0252-0cd2c6a4864d-8c8d00efd1bd-1000--barcelona-see-off-juventus-to-claim-fifth-title/|title=Barcelona see off Juventus to claim fifth title|publisher=UEFA|date=6 June 2015|access-date=7 June 2015|archive-date=31 March 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190331044142/https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/season=2015/matches/round=2000552/match=2015227/postmatch/report/index.html|url-status=live}}</ref> This made Barcelona the first club in history to win [[Treble (association football)|the treble]] of domestic league, domestic cup and European Cup twice, and [[Dani Alves]], Busquets, [[Andrés Iniesta]], Lionel Messi, [[Pedro (footballer, born July 1987)|Pedro]], [[Gerard Piqué]] and [[Xavi (footballer, born 1980)|Xavi]] the only players to achieve the same feat.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.fcbarcelona.com/football/first-team/detail/article/barca-make-history-with-second-treble|title=Barça make history with second treble!|publisher=FC Barcelona|date=6 June 2015|access-date=7 June 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150607120500/http://www.fcbarcelona.com/football/first-team/detail/article/barca-make-history-with-second-treble|archive-date=7 June 2015|url-status=dead}}</ref>

On 3 October 2015, Busquets captained Barcelona for the first time in the absence of regular captain Iniesta and vice-captain Messi in a 1–2 [[Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán Stadium|away]] defeat to [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/34381483|title=Sevilla 2–1 Barcelona|website=BBC Sport|date=3 October 2015|access-date=4 December 2020|archive-date=8 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201108093422/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/34381483|url-status=live}}</ref>
[[File:FC Red Bull Salzburg gegen CF Barcelona (Testspiel 4. August 2021) 57.jpg|thumb|253x253px|Busquets playing for [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] in 2021]]
Busquets opened the scoring in a 3–0 win against [[UD Las Palmas|Las Palmas]] on 1 October 2017, with the match being played behind closed doors at the [[Camp Nou]] due to the ongoing [[2017 Catalan independence referendum|Catalan independence referendum]].<ref name="theg_Barc">{{Cite web| title = Barcelona 3-0 Las Palmas: La Liga – as it happened| last = Fisher| first = Ben| work = The Guardian| date = 1 October 2017| access-date = 17 January 2020| url = https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2017/oct/01/barcelona-v-las-palmas-la-liga-live| archive-date = 16 April 2019| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20190416190905/https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2017/oct/01/barcelona-v-las-palmas-la-liga-live| url-status = live}}</ref> Around a year later, he signed a new contract until June 2023, which increased his buyout clause from €200 million to €500 million.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Martin |first1=Richard |title=Barca raise Busquets buy-out clause in new contract |url=https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-soccer-spain-fcb-busquets/barca-raise-busquets-buy-out-clause-in-new-contract-idUKKCN1M71PO |access-date=30 June 2020 |publisher=[[Reuters]] |date=27 September 2018 |archive-date=1 July 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200701203628/https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-soccer-spain-fcb-busquets/barca-raise-busquets-buy-out-clause-in-new-contract-idUKKCN1M71PO |url-status=dead }}</ref> On 24 November 2018 he played his 500th game for Barcelona away to [[Atlético Madrid]],<ref>{{cite news |last1=Oliva Gispert |first1=Ignasi |title='He'd never even played as a six' – The rise of 500-club genius Sergio Busquets |url=https://www.goal.com/en-gb/news/busquets-was-never-a-midfielder/127bqho8qn4kh1rx3m2k1rts62 |access-date=30 June 2020 |publisher=Goal |date=24 November 2018 |archive-date=30 June 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200630173450/https://www.goal.com/en-gb/news/busquets-was-never-a-midfielder/127bqho8qn4kh1rx3m2k1rts62 |url-status=live }}</ref> and he made his 100th Champions League appearance on 11 December, in a 1–1 [[2018–19 UEFA Champions League group stage#Group B|group stage]] [[Camp Nou|home]] draw against [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.|Tottenham Hotspur]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/941107/sergio-reaches-champions-league-century|title=Sergio reaches Champions League century|publisher=FC Barcelona|date=13 December 2018|access-date=31 March 2019|archive-date=31 March 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190331143334/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/941107/sergio-reaches-champions-league-century|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 9 January 2021, Busquets made his 600th appearance for Barcelona in a 4–0 win against [[Granada CF|Granada]] at the [[Nuevo Estadio de Los Cármenes|Los Cármenes]]. Only his contemporaries Xavi, Iniesta and Messi had played more games in the history of the club.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Brennan |first1=Feargal |title=Sergio Busquets hails Barcelona's progress in 2021 |url=https://www.football-espana.net/2021/01/11/sergio-busquets-hails-barcelonas-progress-in-2021 |access-date=14 January 2021 |publisher=Football España |date=11 January 2021 |archive-date=16 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211016133724/https://www.football-espana.net/2021/01/11/sergio-busquets-hails-barcelonas-progress-in-2021 |url-status=live }}</ref> In August, he became club captain after Messi left for [[Paris Saint-Germain FC|Paris Saint-Germain]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Torres |first1=M. Carmen |title=Barcelona announce new captains |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/barcelona/2021/08/09/611149c146163f064b8b45c9.html |access-date=11 August 2021 |work=Marca |date=9 August 2021 |archive-date=16 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211016133722/https://www.marca.com/en/football/barcelona/2021/08/09/611149c146163f064b8b45c9.html |url-status=live }}</ref> On 12 January 2023, Busquets made his 700th appearance for Barcelona in his team's penalty shoot-out victory after a 2–2 draw against [[Real Betis]] at the [[King Fahd International Stadium]] in [[2023 Supercopa de España]] semi-final.<ref>{{cite news |title=Sergio Busquets makes 700th appearance for FC Barcelona |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3015828/sergio-busquets-makes-700th-appearance-for-fc-barcelona |publisher=fcbarcelona.com |date=12 January 2023 |access-date=20 February 2023 |archive-date=9 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240209181952/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3015828/sergio-busquets-makes-700th-appearance-for-fc-barcelona |url-status=live }}</ref> In the next match, three days later, Busquets participated in his team's 3–1 win against [[Real Madrid F.C.|Real Madrid]] in the [[2023 Supercopa de España final]], becoming the player with the [[El Clásico#Most appearances|most matches in the history of El Clásico]] with 45 matches, jointly with [[Lionel Messi]] and [[Sergio Ramos]]. In addition he became the player with the most wins in [[El Clásico]] matches, with 21 matches, jointly with [[Paco Gento]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Sergio Busquets, a bigger legend than ever |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3024118/sergio-busquets-a-bigger-legend-than-ever |publisher=fcbarcelona.com |date=16 January 2023 |access-date=20 February 2023 |archive-date=20 February 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230220032733/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3024118/sergio-busquets-a-bigger-legend-than-ever |url-status=live }}</ref> On 2 March, in the next El Clásico match, Busquets broke both records as Barcelona won 0–1 in the [[2022–23 Copa del Rey#Semi-finals|first leg of the 2023 Copa del Rey semi-final]].

On 10 May 2023, Busquets announced he would leave Barcelona by the end of the season.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3334561/sergio-busquets-to-leave-fc-barcelona-at-the-end-of-the-season |date=10 May 2023 |publisher=FC Barcelona |title=Sergio Busquets to leave FC Barcelona at the end of the season |access-date=10 May 2023 |archive-date=9 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240209182649/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3334561/sergio-busquets-to-leave-fc-barcelona-at-the-end-of-the-season |url-status=live }}</ref>

=== Inter Miami ===
[[File:Sergio Busquets NE Revolution Inter Miami 7.9.25-160 (cropped).jpg|thumb|upright|Busquets with Inter Miami in 2025]]
On 23 June 2023, [[Inter Miami CF|Inter Miami]] announced that they had signed Busquets.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/66006109 |date=23 June 2023 |publisher=BBC Sport |title=Sergio Busquets: Inter Miami announce signing of Barcelona captain |access-date=16 July 2023 |archive-date=15 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230715032014/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/66006109 |url-status=live }}</ref> On 16 July, Busquets officially signed a two-and-a-half-year deal with Inter Miami.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.intermiamicf.com/news/inter-miami-cf-signs-legendary-midfielder-sergio-busquets |date=16 July 2023 |publisher=Inter Miami CF |title=Inter Miami CF Signs Legendary Midfielder Sergio Busquets |access-date=16 July 2023 |archive-date=18 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230718214911/https://www.intermiamicf.com/news/inter-miami-cf-signs-legendary-midfielder-sergio-busquets |url-status=live }}</ref> He was also joined at the club with former Barcelona teammates Messi and [[Jordi Alba]], and later followed by [[Luis Suárez (Uruguayan footballer)|Luis Suárez]] at the end of 2023. He won his first title with the club on 20 August 2023, helping Inter Miami beat [[Nashville SC]] in the [[2023 Leagues Cup final]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=mlssoccer |title=Lionel Messi sets world record as Inter Miami win Leagues Cup {{!}} MLSSoccer.com |url=https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/lionel-messi-sets-world-record-as-inter-miami-win-leagues-cup |access-date=21 August 2023 |website=mlssoccer |language=en |archive-date=20 August 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230820131821/https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/lionel-messi-sets-world-record-as-inter-miami-win-leagues-cup |url-status=live }}</ref> On 7 March, Busquets and Inter Miami made their debuts in the [[2024 CONCACAF Champions Cup|CONCACAF Champions Cup]] against Nashville SC.<ref>{{Cite web |date=5 March 2024 |title=Inter Miami meet Nashville in Messi's Champions Cup debut |url=https://www.concacaf.com/champions-cup/news/inter-miami-meet-nashville-in-messi-s-champions-cup-debut/ |access-date=8 March 2024 |website=[[CONCACAF]]}}</ref> He would assist in [[Luis Suárez (Uruguayan footballer)|Luis Suárez]]'s stoppage time equalizing goal, helping the first leg end 2–2.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Walker |first=Teresa M. |date=7 March 2024 |title=Luis Suarez, Lionel Messi rally Inter Miami for a 2-2 tie with Nashville |url=https://apnews.com/article/concacaf-champions-cup-messi-miami-nashville-3796113f1b44e564481ef82495487f74 |access-date=8 March 2024 |work=[[Associated Press]]}}</ref> On 20 April 2024, Busquets scored his only goal for the club in a 3–1 win over Nashville SC.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Deen |first=Safid |date=20 April 2024 |title=Lionel Messi scores two goals to take MLS lead, fuels Inter Miami 3-1 win over Nashville |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/mls/2024/04/20/is-messi-playing-tonight-inter-miami-vs-nashville-stream-live-updates-score-highlights/73380191007/ |access-date=20 April 2024 |work=[[USA Today]]}}</ref>

On 25 September 2025, Busquets announced that he would be retiring from football at the end of the MLS season.<ref>{{Cite web |last=read |first=OneFootball·1 min |date=26 September 2025 |title=🚨 Breaking news: Sergio Busquets retires from football |url=https://ca.sports.yahoo.com/news/breaking-news-sergio-busquets-retires-023700423.html |access-date=26 September 2025 |website=Yahoo Sports |language=en-US}}</ref> With Inter Miami reaching the [[MLS Cup 2025|2025 MLS Cup championship game]], Busquets made his final professional appearance on 6 December in a 3–1 victory over [[Vancouver Whitecaps FC]]; his teammate and former Barcelona colleague Jordi Alba also retired following the match.<ref>{{cite web |last=Abnos |first=Alexander |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2025/dec/06/inter-miami-mls-cup-messi-busquets-alba-vancouver |title=Double-post salvation gives Busquets and Alba a fitting farewell in MLS Cup final |publisher=The Guardian |date=7 December 2025 }}</ref>

On 11 October 2008, Busquets earned his first [[cap (sport)|cap]] for [[Spain national under-21 football team|Spain's under-21]] in their [[2009 UEFA European Under-21 Championship qualification play-offs]] first-leg away match against [[Switzerland national under-21 football team|Switzerland]]. He scored in the 17th minute of a 1–2 loss,<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.elconfidencial.com/archivo/2008/10/11/deportes_97_espana.html|title=España sub'21 cae en Suiza y emplaza la clasificación para la vuelta|trans-title=Spain under-21 fall in Switzerland and postpone qualification to second leg|work=[[El Confidencial]]|language=es|date=11 October 2008|access-date=8 May 2017|archive-date=7 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171107012120/http://www.elconfidencial.com/archivo/2008/10/11/deportes_97_espana.html|url-status=live}}</ref> though they eventually emerged victorious 4–3 on aggregate.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.europapress.es/deportes/futbol-00162/eurocopa/noticia-futbol-sub-21-cronica-espana-suiza-20081015002724.html|title=Crónica del España-Suiza, 3–1|trans-title=Spain-Switzerland match report, 3–1|publisher=[[Europa Press (news agency)|Europa Press]]|language=es|date=15 October 2008|access-date=8 May 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160624111148/http://www.europapress.es/deportes/futbol-00162/eurocopa/noticia-futbol-sub-21-cronica-espana-suiza-20081015002724.html|archive-date=24 June 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref> On 28 December, he played his first game for the [[Catalonia national football team|Catalan representative side]], starting in a 2–1 win over [[Colombia national football team|Colombia]] at the Camp Nou.<ref>{{cite news |title=Selección Colombia perdió 2–1 con Cataluña en un partido amistoso |trans-title=Colombia national team lost 2–1 to Catalonia in friendly match |url=https://www.futbolred.com/archivo/documento/CMS-4739023 |access-date=7 June 2021 |publisher=Fútbol Red |date=28 December 2008 |language=Spanish |archive-date=7 June 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210607215905/https://www.futbolred.com/archivo/documento/CMS-4739023 |url-status=live }}</ref>

Busquets was selected by manager [[Vicente del Bosque]] for the [[2010 FIFA World Cup]] in the same country, assuming the holding midfielder role naturalized Brazilian [[Marcos Senna]] had previously occupied in the conquest of [[UEFA Euro 2008]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.marca.com/2010/05/28/futbol/mundial_2010/selecciones/espana/1275055692.html|title=Busquets espera estar a la altura de Marcos Senna|trans-title=Busquets hopes to live up to Marcos Senna|work=Marca|language=es|date=28 May 2010|access-date=8 May 2017|archive-date=7 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171107005949/http://www.marca.com/2010/05/28/futbol/mundial_2010/selecciones/espana/1275055692.html|url-status=live}}</ref> He played all of the tournament's games and minutes for the eventual world champions, save the last 30 minutes of the 0–1 group-stage loss against [[Switzerland national football team|Switzerland]] in [[Durban]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fifa.com/worldcup/news/newsid=1247333/index.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100619063128/http://www.fifa.com/worldcup/news/newsid=1247333/index.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=19 June 2010|title=Swiss happy to accept Spanish 'gift'|publisher=FIFA|date=16 June 2010|access-date=8 May 2017}}</ref> He finished the tournament with the third–highest pass success rate, alongside his teammate Puyol, completing 88% of his passes.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fifa.com/worldcup/news/spain-s-2010-conquerors-in-numbers-2904843 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180607103350/http://www.fifa.com/worldcup/news/spain-s-2010-conquerors-in-numbers-2904843 |url-status=dead |archive-date=7 June 2018 |title=Spain's 2010 conquerors in numbers |publisher=FIFA |date=22 August 2017 |access-date=18 May 2020 }}</ref>

Busquets had been accused of [[Diving (association football)|play-acting]] in the past, due to his tendency of exaggerating fouls. Often considered to be one of the most underrated footballers in the world,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.blamefootball.com/2018/02/22/sergio-busquets-underrated-midfielder/|title=Why Sergio Busquets is the most underrated midfielder|work=Blame Football|author=Kunal|date=22 February 2018|access-date=29 September 2018|archive-date=29 September 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180929075941/http://www.blamefootball.com/2018/02/22/sergio-busquets-underrated-midfielder/|url-status=live}}</ref> Busquets earned praise from his peers, with former teammate [[Lionel Messi]] saying "When there will be trouble, Busquets will always be there."<ref>{{cite web|url=https://talksport.com/football/422228/lionel-messi-sergio-busquets-barcelona-pep-guardiola/|title=ENFORCER Lionel Messi knew Sergio Busquets was good enough for Barcelona after three days of training, claims Pep Guardiola|publisher=[[Talksport]]|last=Coleman|first=Joe|date=14 September 2018|access-date=29 September 2018|archive-date=29 September 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180929041340/https://talksport.com/football/422228/lionel-messi-sergio-busquets-barcelona-pep-guardiola/|url-status=live}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Busquets' father, [[Carles Busquets|Carles]], was also a footballer. He played as a [[goalkeeper (association football)|goalkeeper]] for Barcelona for several years during the 1990s, although almost exclusively as a backup.<ref>[http://www.elpais.com/articulo/deportes/tranquilo/pondre/nervioso/elpepidep/20090526elpepidep_2/Tes "Tú, tranquilo; ya me pondré nervioso yo" ("You, be cool; i'll be nervous for two")] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200819070717/https://elpais.com/diario/2009/05/26/deportes/1243288802_850215.html |date=19 August 2020 }}; El País, 26 May 2009 {{in lang|es}}</ref>

In 2014, Busquets started a relationship with Elena Galera. They have three sons, Enzo, Levi and Romeo.<ref>[http://www.sport.es/es/noticias/fuera-de-juego/hijo-sergio-busquets-llama-enzo-4964025 El hijo de Sergio Busquets se llama Enzo (The son of Sergio Busquets is called Enzo)] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160311025714/http://www.sport.es/es/noticias/fuera-de-juego/hijo-sergio-busquets-llama-enzo-4964025 |date=11 March 2016 }}; Sport, 10 March 2016 {{in lang|es}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Sergio Busquets da la bienvenida a su segundo hijo |trans-title=Sergio Busquets welcomes his second son |url=https://www.lavanguardia.com/gente/20180918/451887322557/sergio-busquets-padre-segundo-hijo.html |access-date=11 August 2021 |work=La Vanguardia |date=18 September 2018 |language=Spanish |archive-date=11 August 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210811180403/https://www.lavanguardia.com/gente/20180918/451887322557/sergio-busquets-padre-segundo-hijo.html |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=26 September 2024 |title=¡Boda y bebé! Sergio Busquets y Elena Galera reciben a su tercer hijo tras comprometerse |url=https://www.hola.com/us-es/celebrities/20240927720743/sergio-busquet-elena-galera-reciben-tercer-hijo-romeo/ |website=[[¡Hola!]] |language=es |access-date=27 September 2025}}</ref> He has an Arabic tattoo on his left forearm translating to "A thing for you, the life in my country", dedicated to his maternal grandfather to whom he was very close.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://fcbtransfers.blogspot.com.ng/2008/10/arabic-tattoo-of-busquets.html|title=The Arabic tattoo of Busquets|publisher=FC Barcelona Blog|date=25 October 2008|access-date=2 July 2017|archive-date=30 August 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170830053531/http://fcbtransfers.blogspot.com.ng/2008/10/arabic-tattoo-of-busquets.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

==Coaching career==
On 17 August 2026, Busquets became assistant to [[Juliano Belletti]] at [[FC Barcelona Atlètic|Barcelona Atlètic]], while taking the coaching course.<ref>{{cite web |last=Imber |first=Leon |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7518539/2026/08/17/sergio-busquets-coaching-barcelona-atletic/ |title=Sergio Busquets returns to Barcelona with reserve team coaching role |publisher=The New York Times |date=17 August 2026 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Carné |first=Jordi |date=2026-08-17 |title=Oficial: Sergio Busquets vuelve al Barça como técnico |url=https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/barca/oficial-sergio-busquets-vuelve-barca-133425447 |access-date=2026-08-17 |website=Diario Sport |language=es}}</ref>

'''Eric Sylvain Abidal''' ({{IPA|fr|eʁik abidal}}; born 11 September 1979) is a French former professional [[association football|footballer]] who played as a [[left-back]] or [[centre-back]].<ref name="a"/><ref name="b"/>

He played mainly for [[Olympique Lyonnais|Lyon]] and [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]], totalling 19 trophies with both teams, including two [[UEFA Champions League|Champions Leagues]] with the latter. His later career was marred by a liver tumour, which resulted in a [[Liver transplantation|transplant]]. A [[France national football team|France international]] for nine years, Abidal represented the nation in two [[FIFA World Cup|World Cups]] – [[2006 FIFA World Cup|finishing second in 2006]] – and [[UEFA Euro 2008|Euro 2008]].

==Club career==
===Early career===
Born in [[Saint-Genis-Laval]], Lyon Metropolis to Martiniquais parents<ref name=Lequipe/> Abidal started playing with [[AS Lyon Duchère]], an amateur team in the suburbs. He started his professional career with [[AS Monaco FC]],<ref name=Graft>{{cite web|url=http://uk.uefa.com/uefasupercup/news/newsid=1665733.html|title=Graft not glitz defines Abidal's Monaco memories|publisher=UEFA|first=Graham|last=Hunter|date=24 August 2011|access-date=10 November 2012|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131023063606/http://uk.uefa.com/uefasupercup/news/newsid%3D1665733.html|archive-date=23 October 2013}}</ref> making his [[Ligue 1]] debut on 16 September 2000 in a 3–0 home win against [[Toulouse FC]] but only appearing in 22 league matches over the course of two full seasons.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.francefootball.fr/diaporama/Ils-sont-passes-de-lille-a-monaco-ou-inversement/6343/#1|title=Ils sont passés de Lille à Monaco, ou inversement|trans-title=They went from Lille to Monaco, or the other way around|publisher=[[France Football]]|language=fr|access-date=9 March 2020}}</ref>

Abidal transferred to fellow top-division club [[Lille OSC]] for [[2002–03 Ligue 1|2002–03]],<ref name=Returns>{{cite web|url=https://edition.cnn.com/2012/10/10/sport/football/abidal-barcelona-liver-football/index.html|title=Barcelona star Abidal returns to training after liver transplant|publisher=[[CNN]]|date=10 October 2012|access-date=10 November 2012}}</ref> reuniting with former manager [[Claude Puel]]<ref name=Graft/> and being first-choice during his spell. Subsequently, he returned to his native region and joined [[Olympique Lyonnais]].<ref name=Returns/>

===Lyon===
During his later years in France, where he won three consecutive national championships – of the seven the team won – Abidal's confidence was shown when Lyon played [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]] and he was in charge of marking [[Cristiano Ronaldo]]: ''"As a defender, my aim is to infuriate the opponent,"'' he explained. ''"I want him to be so sick of the sight of me that he has to move somewhere else on the pitch to get away."''<ref name=Focus>{{cite web|url=http://www.channel4.com/sport/french_football/focus/abidal.html|title=French Focus: Eric Abidal (Lyon)|publisher=[[Channel 4]]|access-date=9 October 2007}}</ref> His defensive teammates at ''L'OL'' included [[François Clerc]], [[Grégory Coupet]] and [[Anthony Réveillère]], as well as [[Brazil national football team|Brazilian]] internationals [[Cláudio Caçapa|Caçapa]] and [[Cris (footballer, born 1977)|Cris]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2006/apr/04/minutebyminute.sport|title=Milan 3–1 Lyon (Agg: 3–1)|newspaper=[[The Guardian]]|date=4 April 2006|access-date=10 November 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/europe/6378137.stm|title=Roma 0–0 Lyon|website=[[BBC Sport]]|date=21 February 2007|access-date=10 November 2012}}</ref>

On 10 November 2004, Abidal scored the first goal of his career, in a 3–2 loss at former club Lille in [[2004–05 Coupe de la Ligue|the second round]] of the [[Coupe de la Ligue]]. As a result of his exploit, his parents agreed to get married after a 35-year union.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uefa.com/news/newsid=258405.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131026064958/http://www.uefa.com/news/newsid=258405.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=26 October 2013|title=Abidal punishment|publisher=UEFA|date=19 November 2004|access-date=28 July 2019}}</ref>

Abidal missed the first months of the [[2005–06 Ligue 1|2005–06 campaign]] after fracturing his [[metatarsus]] in a [[Exhibition game|friendly game]] with [[Once Caldas]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/01ab-0ea707683b6a-8e479ebd2d93-1000--lyon-learn-worst-about-abidal/|title=Lyon learn worst about Abidal|publisher=UEFA|date=25 July 2005|access-date=19 September 2012}}</ref> He still managed to appear in 15 matches as Lyon won its fifth national championship in a row (the second with the player).<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2006/apr/17/newsstory.sport4|title=Bordeaux slip gives Lyon fifth straight title|newspaper=The Guardian|date=17 April 2006|access-date=10 November 2012}}</ref>

===Barcelona===
[[File:Forcejeo Real Madrid - FC Barcelona.jpg|thumb|right|Abidal (far right) playing against [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]].]]
[[File:Jeffren-Abidal-Bojan.jpg|thumb|200px|left|Abidal (center) with [[Jeffrén Suárez]] (left) and [[Bojan Krkić]] during a training session with [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]].]]

On 29 June 2007, Abidal signed a four-year contract with [[FC Barcelona]] for €9 million, after repeatedly stating that he would not return to training with Lyon if he was not allowed to move.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cnn.com/2007/SPORT/football/06/29/barca.abidal.reut/index.html?section=cnn_latest|title=Abidal completes move to Barcelona|publisher=CNN|date=29 June 2007|access-date=30 June 2007}}{{Dead link|date=September 2010|bot=RjwilmsiBot}}</ref> He was given the number 22 jersey, as the number 20 he wore at Lyon was already taken by [[Deco]]; club president [[Joan Laporta]] also mentioned that his contract contained a €90 million release clause, and that Lyon would receive an extra €500,000 if Barcelona won the [[UEFA Champions League]] in any of the following four seasons.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fifa.com/worldfootball/clubfootball/news/newsid=541071.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070702032829/http://www.fifa.com/worldfootball/clubfootball/news/newsid=541071.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=2 July 2007|title=Abidal joins Barcelona|publisher=FIFA|date=29 June 2007|access-date=30 July 2007}}</ref>
