'''Daniel Olmo Carvajal''' ({{IPA|es|dˈani ˈolmo}}; born 7 May 1998) is a Spanish professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as an [[attacking midfielder]] or [[Winger (association football)|left winger]] for {{Spanish football updater|Barcelona}} club [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] and the [[Spain national football team|Spain national team]].

After a period at [[La Masia]], Olmo made his professional debut for [[GNK Dinamo Zagreb|Dinamo Zagreb]] in Croatia in 2015. He made 124 total appearances for the club, scoring 34 goals and winning the [[Croatian Football League|league]] five times and the [[Croatian Football Cup|cup]] three times. In 2020, he joined [[RB Leipzig]], where he won two [[DFB-Pokal]]s in [[2022 DFB-Pokal final|2022]] and [[2023 DFB-Pokal final|2023]] as well as the [[2023 DFL-Supercup]], where he scored a hat-trick, before rejoining boyhood club Barcelona in 2024.

Olmo won the [[2019 UEFA European Under-21 Championship|2019 UEFA European Championship]] with the [[Spain national under-21 football team|Spain under-21 team]], and a silver medal at the [[Football at the 2020 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament|2020 Olympic tournament]]. He made his senior international debut in 2019, and was part of the teams that reached the semi-finals of [[UEFA Euro 2020]], and won the [[2023 UEFA Nations League Finals|2023 UEFA Nations League]]. He was a key member of the Spain teams that won [[UEFA Euro 2024|Euro 2024]] (finishing as the tournament's [[UEFA European Championship awards#Top goalscorers|joint-top scorer]]) and the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]].

==Club career==
===Early career===
Born in [[Terrassa]], [[Province of Barcelona|Barcelona]], [[Catalonia]], Olmo arrived in [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]]'s youth academy aged nine, from neighbours [[RCD Espanyol|Espanyol]].<ref name="Profile"/><ref>{{cite web |last1=Pandey |first1=Kaustubh |title=Lowdown on Manchester United target Dani Olmo: Scout Report |url=https://www.calciomercato.com/en/news/lowdown-on-manchester-united-target-dani-olmo-scout-report-54073 |publisher=Calcio Mercato |access-date=18 August 2019 |date=3 July 2019 |archive-date=15 December 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191215163625/https://www.calciomercato.com/en/news/lowdown-on-manchester-united-target-dani-olmo-scout-report-54073 |url-status=live }}</ref>

[[File:Dani Olmo 2022.jpg|thumb|Olmo in 2022|305x305px]]
Olmo played four games in RB Leipzig's victory in the [[DFB-Pokal]] in [[2021–22 DFB-Pokal|2021–22]], scoring to conclude a 2–0 home win over [[Hansa Rostock]] in the last 16 on 19 January.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Soccer-RB Leipzig stroll into German Cup quarter-finals |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-soccer-germany-rbl-hro-report-idUKKBN2JT231 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221008172103/https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-soccer-germany-rbl-hro-report-idUKKBN2JT231 |archive-date=8 October 2022 |access-date=2025-04-06 |work=U.S. |language=en-US |url-status=live }}</ref> He was a 69th-minute substitute for [[Kevin Kampl]] in the [[2022 DFB-Pokal Final|final]] on 21 May, and scored in the penalty shoot-out win after a 1–1 draw with [[SC Freiburg]]; with two minutes of extra time remaining, he was tackled in the penalty area by [[Nicolas Höfler]] and Kampl was sent off from the substitutes' bench for demanding a penalty kick.<ref>{{Cite web |last=AFP |date=2022-05-22 |title=RB Leipzig win first German Cup trophy {{!}} New Straits Times |url=https://www.nst.com.my/sports/football/2022/05/798291/rb-leipzig-win-first-german-cup-trophy |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221007174252/https://www.nst.com.my/sports/football/2022/05/798291/rb-leipzig-win-first-german-cup-trophy |archive-date=7 October 2022 |access-date=2025-04-06 |website=NST Online |language=en}}</ref> On 30 July, again on for Kampl, he scored a consolation goal in a 5–3 loss to Bayern Munich in the [[2022 DFL-Supercup]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-07-30 |title=Mane on target as five-star Bayern Munich down RB Leipzig to win DFL-Supercup |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/bundesliga/2022/07/30/62e5930ce2704e14448b45f6.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221007174248/https://www.marca.com/en/football/bundesliga/2022/07/30/62e5930ce2704e14448b45f6.html |archive-date=7 October 2022 |access-date=2025-04-06 |website=MARCA |language=en}}</ref>

On 12 August 2023, Olmo scored a [[hat-trick]] in the [[2023 DFL-Supercup|DFL-Supercup]] against Bayern Munich,<ref>{{Cite news |title=Leipzig stun Bayern with Olmo hat-trick to spoil Kane debut |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/leipzig-stun-bayern-with-olmo-hat-trick-spoil-kane-debut-2023-08-12/#:~:text=MUNICH,%20Germany,%20Aug%2012%20(,Kane's%20debut%20for%20the%20Bavarians. |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230815184445/https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/leipzig-stun-bayern-with-olmo-hat-trick-spoil-kane-debut-2023-08-12/#:~:text=MUNICH,%20Germany,%20Aug%2012%20(,Kane's%20debut%20for%20the%20Bavarians. |archive-date=15 August 2023 |access-date=2025-04-06 |work=Reuters |language=en-US |url-status=live }}</ref> providing the only goals scored in the match.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2023-08-12 |title=German Super Cup: Kane brought off bench but Bayern beaten by Leipzig |language=en-GB |work=BBC Sport |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/live/football/66489164 |access-date=2023-08-12 |archive-date=18 August 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230818201925/https://www.bbc.com/sport/live/football/66489164 |url-status=live }}</ref>

===Return to Barcelona===
====2024–25 season====
On 9 August 2024, Olmo returned to his youth career club Barcelona, signing a six-year contract in a deal reportedly worth in the region of €60 million.<ref>{{Cite web |title=FC Barcelona sign Dani Olmo |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4078339/fc-barcelona-sign-dani-olmo |access-date=2025-04-06 |website=www.fcbarcelona.com |language=en |archive-date=26 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250726021710/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4078339/fc-barcelona-sign-dani-olmo |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last1=Herrero |first1=Laia Cervelló |last2=more |date=2024-08-06 |title=Barcelona agree deal in principle to sign Dani Olmo from RB Leipzig |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/5620891/2024/08/06/barcelona-dani-olmo-transfer/ |access-date=2025-04-06 |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |issn=0362-4331 |archive-date=4 September 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250904025218/https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/5620891/2024/08/06/barcelona-dani-olmo-transfer/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

On 27 August 2024, after missing the games against [[Valencia CF|Valencia]] and [[Athletic Bilbao]] as he was unable to be registered due to salary-cap issues, Olmo made his debut. He came off the bench to replace [[Ferran Torres]] against [[Rayo Vallecano]] in the second half and scored the winning goal in the 82nd minute, giving his club a 1–2 away win. On 3 November, after returning from injury, Olmo scored his fourth and fifth goals in five games for Barcelona in a 3–1 win against [[RCD Espanyol|Espanyol]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-08-27 |title=Olmo seals Barca win with goal in 'dream debut' |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/41018984/dani-olmo-barcelona-win-goal-dream-return |access-date=2025-04-06 |website=ESPN.com |language=en |archive-date=10 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241110090559/https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/41018984/dani-olmo-barcelona-win-goal-dream-return |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Barcelona 3-1 Espanyol (3 Nov, 2024) Game Analysis - ESPN (UK) |url=https://www.espn.co.uk/football/report/_/gameId/704773 |access-date=2025-04-06 |website=ESPN |language=en |archive-date=20 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250220161226/https://www.espn.co.uk/football/report/_/gameId/704773 |url-status=live }}</ref> On 26 November, he scored his first [[UEFA Champions League]] goal for Barcelona in a 3–0 victory over [[Stade Brestois 29|Brest]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Iveson |first=Ali |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/champions-league/2024-2025/barcelona-v-brest-uefa-champions-league-live_sto10402005/story.shtml |title=Barcelona 3-0 Stade Brestois - Robert Lewandowski scores 100th UEFA Champions League goal in comfortable win |publisher=Eurosport |date=26 November 2024 |access-date=27 November 2024 |archive-date=6 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250106140024/https://www.eurosport.com/geoblocking.shtml |url-status=live }}</ref> Due to Barcelona’s failure to register him and teammate [[Pau Víctor]] in time for 2025, Olmo had the option of becoming a [[free agent]] and could negotiate with any club.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sanderson |first=Tom |title=FC Barcelona Could Lose $273 Million In Olmo Registration Debacle |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2025/01/01/fc-barcelona-could-lose-273-million-in-olmo-registration-debacle/ |access-date=2025-01-01 |work=[[Forbes]] |language=en |archive-date=2 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250102073235/https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2025/01/01/fc-barcelona-could-lose-273-million-in-olmo-registration-debacle/ |url-status=live }}</ref> Subsequently, [[Consejo Superior de Deportes]] approved the registration of Olmo and Pau Víctor on 8 January 2025, meaning that both players could play for the club in [[La Liga]], [[UEFA Champions League]], [[Copa del Rey]] and the eventual [[Supercopa de España]] final against [[Real Madrid]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dani Olmo and Pau Víctor registered for La Liga |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/4196546/dani-olmo-and-pau-victor-registered-for-la-liga |access-date=2025-01-08 |publisher=[[FC Barcelona]] |language=en |archive-date=14 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250114125011/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/4196546/dani-olmo-and-pau-victor-registered-for-la-liga |url-status=live }}</ref>

====2025–26 season====
Olmo scored his first goal of the season on 21 September 2025 in a 3–0 victory over [[Getafe CF|Getafe]] in La Liga, in which he also assisted the first goal to [[Ferran Torres]].<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |title=La Liga Round 5 - Barca vs Girona |url=https://www.fotmob.com/en-GB/matches/getafe-vs-barcelona/2dfbe4 |access-date=2025-12-13 |website=Fotmob |archive-date=6 January 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260106075936/https://www.fotmob.com/en-GB/matches/getafe-vs-barcelona/2dfbe4 |url-status=live }}</ref>

On 2 December 2025, right after scoring in a La Liga match against [[Atlético Madrid]], Olmo landed awkwardly on the ground and was subsequently substituted. It was later confirmed that he had dislocated his shoulder and would be out for a duration of approximately one month.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |title=Dani Olmo has a dislocated shoulder |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4413539/dani-olmo-has-a-dislocated-shoulder |access-date=2025-12-13 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=16 December 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251216094334/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4413539/dani-olmo-has-a-dislocated-shoulder |url-status=live }}</ref>

[[GNK Dinamo Zagreb|Dinamo Zagreb]] director Tomislav Svetina said that the club was doing all it could to get the teenager [[Croatian nationality law|Croatian citizenship]] as Olmo himself showed a |title=Kane, Olmo among 6 Euro Golden Boot winners |url=https://www.espn.com/football/story/_/id/40558317/euro-2024-golden-boot-harry-kane-dani-olmo-6-winners |access-date=2025-04-06 |website=ESPN.com |language=en |archive-date=7 August 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240807103800/https://www.espn.com/football/story/_/id/40558317/euro-2024-golden-boot-harry-kane-dani-olmo-6-winners |url-status=live }}</ref>

On 25 May 2026, Olmo was selected in the 26-man squad for the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/spain-squad-announcement-luis-de-la-fuente|title=Yamal, Rodri and Cucurella in strong Spain squad|date=25 May 2026|access-date=12 June 2026|language=en|archive-date=3 July 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260703093136/https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/spain-squad-announcement-luis-de-la-fuente|url-status=live}}</ref> He provided an assist in a 2–0 victory over [[France national football team|France]] in the semi-final, recording his eighth assist in a major tournament and equaling the record set by Spanish midfielder [[Cesc Fàbregas]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Sagar |first=Sunaadh |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49363150/fifa-world-cup-2026-stats-lamine-yamal-6-0-kylian-mbappe-spain-unai-simon-set-wc-record-6-france-worst-60-years |title=FIFA World Cup 2026 stats: Yamal 6 - 0 Mbappé; Spain, Simón set WC record with 6; France's 0.3 worst in 60 years |publisher=ESPN |date=14 July 2026 |access-date=15 July 2026 |archive-date=15 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260715163523/https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49363150/fifa-world-cup-2026-stats-lamine-yamal-6-0-kylian-mbappe-spain-unai-simon-set-wc-record-6-france-worst-60-years |url-status=live }}</ref> On 19 July, Olmo started in [[2026 FIFA World Cup final|final]] as Spain beat defending champions [[Argentina national football team|Argentina]] 1–0 after extra time.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Spain 1-0 Argentina: Ferran Torres scores as Spain win World Cup for second time |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cgk4ymn3n72t#Line-ups |access-date=2026-07-26 |website=BBC Sport |language=en-GB |archive-date=26 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260726155811/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cgk4ymn3n72t#Line-ups |url-status=live }}</ref>

==Personal life==
Olmo's father, [[Miquel Olmo|Miquel]], is a retired footballer. As a [[Forward (association football)|forward]], he played professionally for lower-league teams.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.vozpopuli.com/deportes/Miquel_Olmo-Dani_Olmo-Futbol_Club_Barcelona-La_Masia_0_720827969.html|title=Al Barça se le fugan los canteranos: Dani Olmo rompe su contrato y se marcha al Dinamo de Zagreb|publisher=Voz Populy|language=es|date=1 August 2014|access-date=24 February 2017|archive-date=16 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180616053355/https://www.vozpopuli.com/deportes/Miquel_Olmo-Dani_Olmo-Futbol_Club_Barcelona-La_Masia_0_720827969.html|url-status=live}}</ref> Dani's older brother Carlos is also a footballer and plays as a [[Defender (association football)|defender]]; he spent several years in Croatia for Dinamo's reserves and [[NK Lokomotiva Zagreb|Lokomotiva Zagreb]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Manchón |first1=Martín |title=Carlos, el Olmo que sigue en Zagreb |url=https://as.com/futbol/2020/03/25/migrantes_del_balon/1585167878_636575.html |access-date=7 October 2022 |work=Diario AS |date=25 March 2020 |language=Spanish |archive-date=1 October 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221001204905/https://as.com/futbol/2020/03/25/migrantes_del_balon/1585167878_636575.html |url-status=live }}</ref> Olmo speaks [[Spanish language|Spanish]], [[Catalan language|Catalan]], [[English language|English]], [[German language|German]], and [[Croatian language|Croatian]] fluently.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://direktno.hr/sport/bravo-ljudino-dani-olmo-sjetio-se-vukovara-nije-cudo-da-je-miljenik-navijaca-139571|title=BRAVO, LJUDINO! ===Kashiwa Reysol=== Born on 12 April 1990, in [[Kashiwa, Chiba]], Japan, Sakai was introduced to football by his two older brothers and joined a school football team when he was in the third grade of elementary school.{{cite news |script-title=ja:『試合に出られなくても腐らないことが大事』酒井 宏樹（柏レイソル）|url=https://www.sakaiku.jp/column/interview/2011/001193.html|publisher=Sakaiku Official Website|language=ja|date=3 web|url=http://www.laprovence.com/article/om/4853182/hiroki-sakai-je-mets-toute-ma-force-au-service-du-collectif.html|title=Hiroki Sakai : "Je mets toute ma force au service du collectif"|website=La 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180224111911/http://www.laprovence.com/article/om/4853182/hiroki-sakai-je-mets-toute-ma-force-au-service-du-collectif.html|archive-date=24 February 2018|url-status=dead}}
{{cite news|title=Hiroki Sakai : "Je mets toute ma force au service du collectif"|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/om/4853182/samourai-paroles-dun.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=24 February 2018|access-date=23 September 2024}} Sakai spent 10 years with the school football team before joining [[Kashiwa Reysol]] U15 side in 2003.{{cite news |script-title=ja:酒井宏「お前だけ応援」工藤の言葉背負う|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/brazil2014/news/p-sc-tp0-20140519-1303210.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=19 May 2014|access-date=19 June 2018}} Sakai progressed through the ranks of the Kashiwa Reysol and learned his guidance under [[Tatsuma Yoshida]].{{cite web|url=https://blog.reysol.co.jp/news/2007/005108.html|title=柏レイソルU-18 比嘉 厚平選手、酒井 宏樹選手が|website=Kashiwa Reysol|language=ja|date=7 December 2007|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240917203206/https://blog.reysol.co.jp/news/2007/005108.html|archive-date=17 September 2024|url-status=live}}
{{cite news |script-title=ja:【全文掲載】酒井宏樹が魅せる、アーリークロスの原点【鈴木潤】|url=http://news.livedoor.com/article/detail/6685945/|publisher=Live Door News|language=ja|date=23 June 2012|access-date=19 June 2018}}
{{cite news |script-title=ja:史上初の「兄弟対決」が示した明るい未来 柏レイソルのクラブコンセプト|url=https://sports.yahoo.co.jp/column/detail/201209100014-spnavi|publisher=Sports Navi|language=ja|date=1 September 2012|access-date=19 June 2018}} Eventually, he worked his way through to the U16 and U18 side despite suffering injuries along the way.{{cite web|url=http://blog.reysol.co.jp/news/2006/009506.html|script-title=ja:U-16日本代表フランス遠征メンバーに柏レイソルU-18から4選手|publisher=Kashiwa Reysol|language=ja|date=4 April 2006|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180609154154/http://blog.reysol.co.jp/news/2006/009506.html|archive-date=9 June 2018|url-status=dead}}

{{Cite web |last= |date=2011-12-10 |title=Por valorização olímpica, Kashiwa não aceita vender Sakai ao Santos |url=https://www.terra.com.br/esportes/futebol/mundialdeclubes/por-valorizacao-olimpica-kashiwa-nao-aceita-vender-sakai-ao-santos,6029fa79ac49a310VgnCLD200000bbcceb0aRCRD.html |access-date=2023-04-30 |website=Terra |language=pt-BR}} Ahead of the 2010 season, Sakai was promoted to Kashiwa Reysol's first team, where he signed a contract with the club and was given the number 30 shirt.{{cite web|url=https://www.reysol.co.jp/news/topteam/031379.html|title=2010年契約更新選手について|website=Kashiwa Reysol|language=ja|date=9 January 2010|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240912161547/https://www.reysol.co.jp/news/topteam/031379.html|archive-date=12 September 2024|url-status=live}}

League Website|language=ja|date=23 January 2010|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180615185652/https://www.jleague.jp/jsgoal_archive/official/detail.php?press_code=95608|archive-date=15 June 2018|url-status=live}}
{{cite web|url=http://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2010/100314.php |script-title=ja:2010 Jリーグディビジョン2 第2節|publisher=Kashiwa Reysol|language=ja|date=14 March 2010|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180615220831/http://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2010/100314.php|archive-date=15 June 2018|url-status=live}}
{{cite web|url=http://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2010/100530.php |script-title=ja:2010 Jリーグディビジョン2 第15節|publisher=Kashiwa Reysol|language=ja|date=30 May 2010|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180615220839/http://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2010/100530.php|archive-date=15 June 2018|url-status=live}} It wasn't until on 5 May 2010 when he made his Kashiwa Reysol debut, coming on as a substitute for [[Yohei Kurakawa]] in the 77th minute, in a 1–1 draw against [[Ventforet Kofu]].{{cite web|url=http://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2010/100505.php |script-title=ja:2010 Jリーグディビジョン2 第11節|publisher=Kashiwa Reysol|language=ja|date=5 May 2010|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180615220822/http://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2010/100505.php|archive-date=15 June 2018|url-status=live}} Sakai then made his first start for the side on 25 July 2010, starting the whole game and set up one of the goals, in a 2–2 draw against [[JEF United Chiba]].{{cite web|url=https://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2010/100725.php |script-title=ja:2010 Jリーグディビジョン2 第19節|publisher=Kashiwa Reysol|language=ja|date=25 July 2010|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180615230208/https://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2010/100725.php|archive-date=15 June 2018|url-status=live}} It wasn't until on 31 October 2010 when he scored his first goal for the club, in a 4–1 win over [[Mito HollyHock]].{{cite web |script-title=ja:[Jリーグ・J2 2010] 水戸ホーリーホック vs 柏レイソル|url=https://soccer-douga.com/douga/1221/|publisher=Soccer Douga|language=ja|date=31 October 2010|access-date=19 June 2018}} Sakai later helped Kashiwa Reysol secure promotion to [[J1 League|J. League Division 1]].{{cite web|url=https://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2010/101123.php|title=2010 Jリーグディビジョン2 第36節|website=Kashiwa Reysol|language=ja|date=22 November 2010|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110225023804/https://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2010/101123.php|archive-date=25 February 2011|url-status=live}} Although he was featured several times later in the season, Sakai went on to make 12 appearances and scoring once for the side.{{cite web|url=http://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2010/101107.php |script-title=ja:2010 Jリーグディビジョン2 第33節|publisher=Kashiwa Reysol|language=ja|date=7 November 2010|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180615220828/http://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2010/101107.php|archive-date=15 June 2018|url-status=live}}
{{cite web|url=http://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2010/101120.php |script-title=ja:2010 Jリーグディビジョン2 第35節|publisher=Kashiwa Reysol|language=ja|date=20 November 2010|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180615225528/http://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2010/101120.php|archive-date=15 June 2018|url-status=live}} Ahead of the 2011 season, the club announced that Sakai were among players to agree to stay at Kashiwa Reysol and was given a number 4 shirt.{{cite web|url=https://www.jleague.jp/jsgoal_archive/official/detail.php?press_code=00112692 |script-title=ja:2011年シーズン 契約合意選手について|publisher=J. {{cite web|url=https://www.reysol.co.jp/news/topteam/031318.html|title=2011年シーズン 選手・スタッフについて|website=Kashiwa Reysol|language=ja|date=23 January 2011|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240912172217/https://www.reysol.co.jp/news/topteam/031318.html|archive-date=12 September 2024|url-status=live}} However, he missed the start of the season, due to a metatarsal fracture injury, causing to miss six matches.{{cite news |script-title=ja:第1節(3月5日)柏vs清水プレビュー&予想先発|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?81202-73806-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=4 March 2011|access-date=19 June 2018}}
{{cite news |script-title=ja:【柏】酒井が実戦復帰「早く戻れました」|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/news/f-sc-tp1-20110308-746235.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=8 March 2011|access-date=19 June 2018}} It wasn't until on 23 April 2011 when Sakai made his first appearance of the season, in a 1–0 win over [[Omiya Ardija]].{{cite web|url=https://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2011/110423.php|title=2011 Jリーグディビジョン1 第7節|website=Kashiwa Reysol|language=ja|date=23 April 2011|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110429151110/https://www.reysol.co.jp/game/results/2011/110423.php|archive-date=29 April 2011|url-status=live}} He then quickly established himself in the starting eleven, playing in the right–back position.{{cite news |script-title=ja:首位レイソルの原動力、田中順也。圧倒的な攻撃力を支える左足の秘密。|url=http://number.bunshun.jp/articles/-/133787|publisher=Number Bunshun|language=ja|date=18 June 2011|access-date=19 June 2018}} On 12 May 2011, it was announced that Sakai signed another contract with the club.{{cite news |script-title=ja:柏の生え抜き酒井がJ1初出場初先発、プロA契約もゲット!|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?83402-77161-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=23 April 2011|access-date=19 June 2018}}

Marinos]] in the opening game of the season.{{cite news |script-title=ja:酒井Ｕ23最終戦へ弾み弾／Ｊ１|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/news/p-sc-tp1-20120312-916134.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=12 March 2012|access-date=19 June 2018}}

{{cite news|title=Sorg noch im Hintertreffen|url=https://www.kicker.de/sorg-noch-im-hintertreffen-632150/artikel|publisher=[[Kicker (magazine)|Kicker]]|language=de|date=2 August 2015|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150803144350/http://www.kicker.de/news/fussball/bundesliga/startseite/632150/artikel_sorg-noch-im-hintertreffen.html|archive-date=3 August 2015|url-status=live}}

FC Köln]].{{cite news|title=Andreasen zieht drei Punkte dem Fair Play vor|url=https://www.kicker.de/koeln-gegen-hannover-2015-bundesliga-2855012/analyse|publisher=[[Kicker (magazine)|Kicker]]|language=de|date=18 October 2015|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151021182626/http://www.kicker.de/news/fussball/bundesliga/spieltag/1-bundesliga/2015-16/9/2855012/spielanalyse_1-fc-koeln-16_hannover-96-58.html|archive-date=21 October 2015|url-status=live}} Sakai was then sidelined again between late–November and early–December when he suffered injuries for the second time this season.{{cite news|title=5 AUSFÄLLE! {{cite news|title=Zieler bleibt fraglich - Sakai fällt aus|url=https://www.kicker.de/zieler-bleibt-fraglich---sakai-faellt-aus-640350/artikel|publisher=[[Kicker (magazine)|Kicker]]|language=de|date=2 December 2015|access-date=19 June 2018}} Since returning from injuries, Sakai regained back his first team place in the right–back position.{{cite news|title=Schaafs Personalpuzzle - Warten auf Hugo Almeida|url=https://www.kicker.de/schaafs-personalpuzzle---warten-auf-hugo-almeida-642998/artikel|publisher=[[Kicker (magazine)|Kicker]]|language=de|date=14 January 2016|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151204024930/http://www.kicker.de/news/fussball/bundesliga/startseite/640350/artikel_zieler-bleibt-fraglich---sakai-faellt-aus.html|archive-date=4 December 2015|url-status=live}}

Bundesliga]] after a 14-year stay in Bundesliga.{{cite news|title=Hannover suffer relegation to Bundesliga 2|url=https://www.bundesliga.com/en/news/Bundesliga/blmd31n-hannover-96-suffer-bundesliga-relegation.jsp|publisher=Bundesliga Official Website|date=24 April 2016|access-date=19 June 2018|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160425110812/http://www.bundesliga.com/en/news/Bundesliga/blmd31n-hannover-96-suffer-bundesliga-relegation.jsp|archive-date=25 April 2016|url-status=dead}} Shortly after, Sakai missed the rest of the season with a muscle injury.{{cite news|title=96: Sakai nicht im Kader - Kiyotake fraglich|url=https://www.kicker.de/96_sakai-nicht-im-kader---kiyotake-fraglich-651315/artikel|publisher=[[Kicker (magazine)|Kicker]]|language=de|date=6 May 2016|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160507130950/http://www.kicker.de/news/fussball/bundesliga/startseite/651315/artikel_96_sakai-nicht-im-kader---kiyotake-fraglich.html|archive-date=7 May 2016|url-status=live}} At the end of the 2015–16 season, he went on to make 28 appearances and scoring once in all competitions. Following Hannover 96's relegation, Sakai expressed his desire to leave the club.{{cite news |script-title=ja:酒井宏、ドイツ国外へ移籍の意思固める「全世界をターゲットにしている」|url=https://www.footballchannel.jp/2016/05/29/post154929/|publisher=Football Channel Website|language=ja|date=29 May 2016|access-date=19 June 2018}} ===Marseille=== After Hannover 96's relegation, Sakai moved to [[Ligue 1]] side [[Olympique de Marseille|Marseille]] on a free transfer on 23 June 2016.{{cite news|title=L'international japonais Hiroki Sakai signe à l'OM (officiel)|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/L-international-japonais-hiroki-sakai-signe-a-l-om-officiel/698471|publisher=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=23 June 2016|access-date=19 June 2018}}{{cite news |script-title=ja:酒井宏 マルセイユ移籍発表 即クラブサイトで"動画デビュー" |url=https://www.sponichi.co.jp/soccer/news/2016/06/25/kiji/K20160625012841730.html|publisher=Sponichi Annex|language=ja|date=25 June 2016|access-date=19 June 2018}} It was revealed that his then national team manager [[Vahid Halilhodžić]] convinced him to join Olympique de Marseille.{{cite news |script-title=ja:酒井宏樹にあった名門クラブ加入の可能性 マルセイユを選んだ理由とは？|url=http://www.sanspo.com/smp/soccer/news/20170921/fra17092116500003-s.html|publisher=Sanspo|language=ja|date=21 September 2017|access-date=19 June 2018}} In addition, he became the second [[Japan]]ese player to join Olympique de Marseille since [[Kōji Nakata]].{{cite news |script-title=ja:酒井宏 フランス名門マルセイユから食指！２３日にメディカル予定|url=https://www.sponichi.co.jp/soccer/news/2016/06/20/kiji/K20160620012813470.html|publisher=Sponichi Annex|language=ja|date=20 June 2016|access-date=19 June 2018}}
{{cite web|url=https://www.om.net/actualites/253750/hiroki-sakai-deuxieme-japonais-de-lom|title=Hiroki Sakai, deuxième Japonais de l'OM|publisher=Olympique de Marseille Official Website|language=fr|date=24 June 2016|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180618210555/https://www.om.net/actualites/253750/hiroki-sakai-deuxieme-japonais-de-lom|archive-date=18 June 2018|url-status=live}}
{{cite news|title=Mercato : que vaut vraiment Hiroki Sakai?|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/om/4013177/que-vaut-vraiment-hiroki-sakai.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=2 July 2016|access-date=23 September 2024}} Upon joining the club, Sakai was given a number two shirt ahead of the new season.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.net/actualites/258166/saison-2016-17-les-numeros-des-olympiens|title=Saison 2016-17 : les numéros des Olympiens|publisher=Olympique de Marseille Official Website|language=fr|date=7 September 2016|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180618213905/https://www.om.net/actualites/258166/saison-2016-17-les-numeros-des-olympiens|archive-date=18 June 2018|url-status=live}} Sakai made his Olympique de Marseille debut in the opening game of the season, where he set up a goal for [[Florian Thauvin]], in a 4–0 win over [[Toulouse FC|Toulouse]].{{cite news |script-title=ja:マルセイユ酒井宏 新天地でフル出場！開幕戦ドローも手応え|url=https://www.sponichi.co.jp/soccer/news/2016/08/16/kiji/K20160816013176170.html|publisher=Sponichi Annex|language=ja|date=16 August 2016|access-date=19 June 2018}}
{{cite news|title=L'OM tenu en échec au Vélodrome par Toulouse (0-0)|url=https://www.eurosport.fr/football/ligue-1/2016-2017/l-om-tenu-en-echec-au-velodrome-par-toulouse-0-0_sto5722995/story.shtml|publisher=Eurosport|language=fr|date=15 August 2016|access-date=19 June 2018}} Sakai quickly established himself in the starting eleven for the side, playing in the right–back position.{{cite news|title=Marseille avec une défense new-look pour affronter Toulouse|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Marseille-avec-une-defense-new-look-pour-affronter-toulouse/716904|publisher=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=14 August 2016|access-date=19 June 2018}}
{{cite news |script-title=ja:酒井宏、フル出場で先制起点「すごくうれしかった」|url=https://www.sponichi.co.jp/soccer/news/2016/12/19/kiji/20161219s00002025125000c.html|publisher=Sponichi Annex|language=ja|date=19 December 2016|access-date=19 June 2018}}

{{cite news|title=OM : une charnière à recomposer|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/4460289/om-une-charniere-a-recomposer.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=22 May 2017|access-date=23 September 2024}} At one point, Sakai played in the right–midfield position once during a 0–0 draw against [[Le Classique|rivals]] against [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] on 23 October 2016.{{cite news |script-title=ja:酒井宏、パリＳＧ完封に貢献 ５バック「すごく難しかった」|url=https://www.sponichi.co.jp/soccer/news/2016/10/24/kiji/K20161024013594900.html|publisher=Sponichi Annex|language=ja|date=24 October 2016|access-date=19 June 2018}}

{{cite news|title=OM-Bordeaux : Sakai toujours incertain|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/4177834/om-bordeaux-sakai-toujours-incertain.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=28 October 2016|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news |script-title=ja:マルセイユ・酒井宏、右脚故障で欠場「肉離れの可能性も」|url=https://www.sponichi.co.jp/soccer/news/2016/10/30/kiji/K20161030013630290.html|publisher=Sponichi Annex|language=ja|date=30 October 2016|access-date=19 June 2018}} After missing one match, Sakai returned from injury, coming on as a second–half substitute, in a 3–1 loss against [[Montpellier HSC]] on 4 November 2016.{{cite news|title=OM : Njie et Sakai de retour, Hubocan à la maison|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/4186994/om-njie-et-sakai-de-retour-hubocan-a-la-maison.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=4 November 2016|access-date=23 September 2024}} As the 2016–17 season progressed, he continued to have discipline issues that saw him suspended on two separate occasions.{{cite news |script-title=ja:マルセイユ快勝 酒井宏樹は出場停止|url=https://www.sponichi.co.jp/soccer/news/2017/02/19/kiji/20170219s00002000153000c.html|publisher=Sponichi Annex|language=ja|date=19 February 2017|access-date=19 June 2018}}

{{cite web|url=https://www.om.net/actualites/317410/bordeaux-om-un-destin-maitriser|title=Bordeaux-OM : un destin à maîtriser|publisher=Olympique de Marseille Official Website|language=fr|date=14 May 2017|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180618053227/https://www.om.net/actualites/317410/bordeaux-om-un-destin-maitriser|archive-date=18 June 2018|url-status=live}} In his first season at Olympique de Marseille, Sakai made make 40 appearances in all competitions. Reflecting on his performances, his teammate [[Florian Thauvin]] and Manager [[Rudi Garcia]] both praised his commitment and performance when the club were in a financial problems during the season.{{cite news |script-title=ja:「率直に言って脱帽さ！」酒井宏樹がマルセイユの宝になるまで【現地記者分析】|url=http://www.goal.com/jp/ニュース/率直に言って脱帽さ酒井宏樹がマルセイユの宝になるまで現地記者分析/1qs9ffqgb1nyc19zom602lzn04|publisher=Goal.com|language=ja|date=16 May 2017|access-date=19 June 2018}} At the start of the 2017–18 season, Sakai continued to establish himself in the starting eleven as a right–back despite facing competition from with [[Bouna Sarr]] over the position.{{cite news|title=Bouna Sarr (OM): "Pas envie de passer encore une saison sur le banc"|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Bouna-sarr-om-pas-envie-de-passer-encore-une-saison-sur-le-banc/827217|publisher=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=20 August 2017|access-date=19 June 2018}}
{{cite news|title=DJA DJÉDJÉ N'EXCLUT PAS UN RETOUR À L'OM|url=http://sport24.lefigaro.fr/football/transferts/fil-info/dja-djedje-n-exclut-pas-un-retour-a-l-om-878086|publisher=Le Figaro|language=fr|date=27 September 2017|access-date=19 June 2018}}
{{cite news|title=OM-PSG : Thauvin, coeur de lion|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/om/4676626/thauvin-coeur-de-lion.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=23 October 2017|access-date=23 September 2024}} Sakai stated in an interview with France Football that he has settled in France, having suffered difficulties in his previous season.{{cite news|title=Le projet de l'OM en une de France Football|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Medias/Actualites/Le-projet-de-l-om-en-une-de-france-football/835403|publisher=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=18 September 2017|access-date=19 June 2018}} His performance in a 2–0 win over Toulouse on 24 September 2017 led him to be named Team of the Week.{{cite news|title=LIGUE 1 : NOTRE ÉQUIPE-TYPE DE LA 7E JOURNÉE|url=http://sport24.lefigaro.fr/football/ligue-1/actualites/ligue-1-notre-equipe-type-de-la-7e-journee-877847|publisher=Le Figaro|language=fr|date=25 September 2017|access-date=19 June 2018}} Following good performance for the side this season so far, Sakai signed a four–year contract with the club, keeping him until 2021, on 29 September 2017.{{cite news|title=Hiroki Sakai prolonge jusqu'en 2021 avec l'OM|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Hiroki-sakai-prolonge-jusqu-en-2021-avec-l-om/838397|website=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=29 September 2021|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news |script-title=ja:酒井宏樹、マルセイユと2021年まで契約延長「これからも全力でプレーします！」|url=https://www.footballchannel.jp/2017/09/29/post233511/|publisher=Football Channel Website|language=ja|date=29 September 2017|access-date=19 June 2018}} Having played in the right–back position in the first half of the season, he switched to playing in the left–back position following the departure of [[Patrice Evra]] and injury of [[Jordan Amavi]].{{cite news|title=OM : SAKAI POUR REMPLACER AMAVI À GAUCHE?|url=http://sport24.lefigaro.fr/football/ligue-europa/fil-info/om-sakai-pour-remplacer-amavi-a-gauche-887840|publisher=Le Figaro|language=fr|date=6 December 2017|access-date=19 June 2018}}

{{cite news|title=OM : "À Marseille, je retrouve l'émotion du foot" (Andoni Zubizarreta)|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/om/5179350/avec-garcia-on-fait-les-choses-ensemble.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=3 October 2018|access-date=23 September 2024}} During a 3–2 loss against [[Olympique Lyonnais|Lyon]] on 18 March 2018, he suffered an injury in the first–half and was substituted as a result, leading him to be sidelined between 7–10 days.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.net/actualites/346654/entre-7-et-10-jours-dindisponibilite-pour-sakai|title=Entre 7 et 10 jours d'indisponibilité pour Sakai|publisher=Olympique de Marseille Official Website|language=fr|date=19 March 2018|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180618205136/https://www.om.net/actualites/346654/entre-7-et-10-jours-dindisponibilite-pour-sakai|archive-date=18 June 2018|url-status=live}} Sakai made his return from injury on 5 April 2018 in the first leg of the UEFA Europa League quarter–final, in a 1–0 loss to [[RB Leipzig]].{{cite news|title=Marseille : le coup tactique de Rudi Garcia à Leipzig|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Marseille-le-coup-tactique-de-rudi-garcia-a-leipzig/890248|publisher=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=6 April 2018|access-date=19 June 2018}} On 12 April 2018, he scored his first UEFA Europa League goal on his 28th birthday in the quarter–final return leg, in a 5–2 win over RB Leipzig to progress into the next round and a 5–3 aggregate victory.{{cite news|title=LA SAUCE SAKAI|url=http://www.sofoot.com/la-sauce-sakai-454454.html|publisher=So Foot|language=fr|date=12 April 2018|access-date=19 June 2018}}
{{cite news|title=Marseille's Hiroki Sakai scores goal on 28th birthday|url=https://www.japantimes.co.jp/sports/2018/04/13/soccer/marseilles-hiroki-sakai-scores-goal-28th-birthday/|publisher=The Japan Times|date=13 April 2018|access-date=19 June 2018}} Nine days later after the win, however, Sakai sustained an injury during a 5–1 win over [[LOSC Lille|Lille]] and was substituted in the first half as a result; which he was sidelined for three weeks.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.net/actualites/349964/trois-semaines-dabsence-pour-sakai|title=Trois semaines d'absence pour Sakai|publisher=Olympique de Marseille Official Website|language=fr|date=23 April 2018|access-date=19 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180618205148/https://www.om.net/actualites/349964/trois-semaines-dabsence-pour-sakai|archive-date=18 June 2018|url-status=live}} Despite recovering from his injury in mid–May, he, however, was featured on the substitute bench throughout 90 minutes, as Marseille lost 3–0 to [[Atlético Madrid]] in the [[2018 UEFA Europa League Final|UEFA Europa League Final]].{{cite news|title=L'OM perd gros à Guingamp au terme d'un match fou|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/L-om-perd-gros-a-guingamp-au-terme-d-un-match-fou/900395|publisher=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=11 May 2018|access-date=19 June 2018}}

At the start of the 2018–19 season, Sakai continued to remain in the first team as Marseille's first choice right–back.{{cite news|title=OM : défendre aussi bien, attaquer mieux|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/om/5088565/defendre-aussi-bien-attaquer-mieux.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=30 July 2018|access-date=23 September 2024}}

{{cite news|title=OM - Guingamp : le festival après l'ennui|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/om/5155021/om-guingamp-le-festival-apres-lennui.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=17 September 2018|access-date=23 September 2024}} By September, he set up two goals in the league, including one, which turned out to be a winning goal against [[RC Strasbourg Alsace|RC Strasbourg]].{{cite news|title=Monaco-OM : et en plus, la victoire est méritée|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/om/5134900/monaco-om-une-victoire-meritee.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=3 September 2018|access-date=23 September 2024}}

{{cite news|title=OM : Hiroki Sakai fête ce soir sa 100e avec le maillot olympien|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5213187/om-hiroki-sakai-fete-ce-soir-sa-100e-avec-le-maillot-olympien.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=25 October 2018|access-date=23 September 2024}} Despite suffering two separate injuries by the end of the year, he switched into playing both left–back and centre–back positions.{{cite news|title=Nice-OM : Hiroki Sakai forfait de dernière minute|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5208272/nice-om-hiroki-sakai-forfait-de-derniere-minute.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=22 October 2018|access-date=23 September 2024}}

Les priorités de l'OM pour 2019|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/om/5301402/un-attaquant-un-lateral-gauche-les-priorites-de-lom-pour-2019.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=25 December 2018|access-date=23 September 2024}} After spending a month with Japan in the AFC Asian Cup, Sakai made his first appearance for the club, starting a match, in a 1–0 win against [[FC Girondins de Bordeaux|Girondins de Bordeaux]] on 5 February 2019.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/5815-om-bordeaux-1-0-lom-se-donne-de-lair|title=OM - Bordeaux (1-0) : L'OM se donne de l'air|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=5 February 2019|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240915161556/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/5815-om-bordeaux-1-0-lom-se-donne-de-lair|archive-date=15 September 2024|url-status=live}} Since returning to the first team, he regained his first team place in the right–back position.{{cite news|title=Hiroki Sakai : "De la sérénité dans le groupe" avant Dijon-OM|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/om/5360673/de-la-serenite-dans-le-groupe.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=8 February 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}}{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/5932-une-coherence-collective|title=Une cohérence collective|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=17 February 2019|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240915173601/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/5932-une-coherence-collective|archive-date=15 September 2024|url-status=live}}

{{cite news|title=Toulouse-OM : auteur de son premier but en Ligue 1, Sakai est votre Olympien du match|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5508128/toulouse-om-auteur-de-son-premier-but-en-ligue-1-sakai-est-votre-olympien-du-match.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=19 May 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}}{{cite news|title=OM : ce Hiroki Sakai qu'on aime|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/sports/5510862/ce-hiroki-sakai-quon-aime.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=21 May 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}} Despite missing one more match due to suspension, Sakai went on to make 32 appearances and scoring once in all competitions.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/6235-om-angers-reprendre-son-elan|title=OM - Angers (2-2) : le compte-rendu|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=31 March 2019|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240915175609/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/6250-om-angers-2-2-le-compte-rendu|archive-date=15 September 2024|url-status=live}} At the end of the 2018–19 season, he was named Olympique de Marseille Player of the Season.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/6745-hiroki-sakai-votre-olympien-de-la-saison-2018-19|title=Hiroki Sakai, votre Olympien de la saison 2018-19|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=15 June 2019|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20230203175125/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/6745-hiroki-sakai-votre-olympien-de-la-saison-2018-19|archive-date=3 February 2023|url-status=live}}
{{cite news |title=OM – L'exemplaire Hiroki Sakaï élu joueur de la saison par les supporters|url=https://www.goal.com/fr/news/om-lexemplaire-hiroki-sakai-elu-joueur-de-la-saison-par-les/1h2co8k3pelay1dhrx238omveu|publisher=[[Goal (website)|Goal]]|language=fr|date=15 June 2019|access-date=16 June 2019}} Ahead of the 2019–20 season, Sakai was linked with a move to [[Premier League]] side [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.|Tottenham Hotspur]], but he ended up staying at the club.{{cite news|title=Tottenham considering Marseille right-back Hiroki Sakai|url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11675/11738842/tottenham-considering-marseille-right-back-hiroki-sakai|website=Sky Sports|date=10 June 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}} Sakai started in the first four league matches of the 2019–20 season, playing in the right–back position.{{cite news|title=OM - Hiroki Sakai : "J'ai reçu des offres, mais..."|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/om/5628671/jai-recu-des-offres-mais.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=10 August 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/18056-nice-om-1-2-premiere-victoire-pour-lom|title=Nice-OM (1-2) : Première victoire pour l'OM|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=28 August 2019|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240915200804/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/18056-nice-om-1-2-premiere-victoire-pour-lom|archive-date=15 September 2024|url-status=live}}
{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/18920-om-asse-lom-enchaine-pour-son-anniversaire|title=OM - ASSE : L'OM enchaîne pour son anniversaire|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=1 September 2019|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240915201604/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/18920-om-asse-lom-enchaine-pour-son-anniversaire|archive-date=15 September 2024|url-status=live}} On 29 August 2019, he signed a contract extension with Marseille, keeping him until 2022.{{cite news|title=Marseille : Hiroki Sakai prolonge jusqu'en 2022|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Marseille-hiroki-sakai-prolonge-jusqu-en-2022/1053441|website=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=29 August 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}} However, Sakai suffered a calf injury that saw him out for two matches.{{cite news|title=Ligue 1: Marseille confirme, Monaco infirme|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/sports/5675162/ligue-1-marseille-confirme-monaco-infirme.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=15 September 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=OM : gêne au mollet gauche pour Sakai|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5676372/om-gene-au-mollet-gauche-pour-sakai.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=16 September 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=OM : "C'est trop tôt pour s'enflammer", affirme Villas-Boas|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5681091/om-cest-trop-tot-pour-senflammer-affirme-villas-boas.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=19 September 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}} He made his return to the starting line–up against [[Dijon FCO]] on his 100th league appearance, in a 0–0 draw on 24 September 2019.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/19805-dijon-om-100e-en-l1-pour-sakai|title=Dijon - OM : 100e en L1 pour Sakai|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=24 September 2019|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240916065514/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/19805-dijon-om-100e-en-l1-pour-sakai|archive-date=16 September 2024|url-status=live}}
{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/19799-dijon-om-0-0-le-compte-rendu|title=Dijon – OM (0-0) : Le compte-rendu|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=24 September 2019|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191101190304/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/19799-dijon-om-0-0-le-compte-rendu|archive-date=1 November 2019|url-status=live}}
{{cite news|title=OM-Strasbourg : Sakai a reçu son maillot floqué du chiffre "100"|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5727698/om-sakai-a-recu-son-maillot-floque-du-chiffre-100.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=20 October 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}} Sakai then played three consecutive times in the left–back position between 4 October 2019 and 27 October 2019.{{cite news|title=Ligue 1: Marseille et Rennes au ralenti|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/sports/5696792/ligue-1-marseille-et-rennes-au-ralenti.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=29 September 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=Amiens-OM : le placage fatal de Caleta Car, le sommeil de Germain... les notes et appréciations des Olympiens|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/om/5705653/caleta-car-jeu-de-mains.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=5 October 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=PSG-OM: Marseille en quête d'exploit, Paris veut conserver sa suprématie|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/sports/5737200/psg-om-marseille-en-quete-dexploit-paris-veut-conserver-sa-suprematie.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=27 October 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}} Following this, he resumed playing in the right–back position once again.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/21704-om-lille-2-1-victoire-lenvie|title=OM - Lille (2-1) : Victoire à l'envie!|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=2 November 2019|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240917091604/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/21704-om-lille-2-1-victoire-lenvie|archive-date=17 September 2024|url-status=live}}
{{cite news|title=OM : défense, le chantier constant|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/om/5775400/defense-le-chantier-constant.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=24 November 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}}

{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/24119-granville-om-0-3-laventure-continue|title=Granville - OM (0-3) : L'aventure continue|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=17 January 2020|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200203071620/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/24119-granville-om-0-3-laventure-continue|archive-date=3 February 2020|url-status=live}}
{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/24371-om-angers-0-0-lom-tenu-en-echec|title=OM - Angers (0-0) : l'OM tenu en échec|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=25 January 2020|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240917145414/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/24371-om-angers-0-0-lom-tenu-en-echec|archive-date=17 September 2024|url-status=live}} During a 2–0 win against [[Angers SCO]] on 3 December 2019, Sakai suffered a shoulder injury and was taken off at half–time.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/22697-angers-om-0-2-recu-5-sur-5|title=Angers - OM (0-2) : Reçu 5 sur 5|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=3 December 2019|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240917100144/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/22697-angers-om-0-2-recu-5-sur-5|archive-date=17 September 2024|url-status=live}} But he was able to make a full recovery and made his return to the starting line–up, in a 3–1 win against Bordeaux on 8 December 2019.{{cite news|title=Angers-OM : on n'a pas aimé la blessure de Sakai|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5790631/angers-om-on-na-pas-aime-la-blessure-de-sakai.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=4 December 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=OM : Sakai n'est pas inquiet|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5792344/sakai-nest-pas-inquiet.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=5 December 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/22907-om-bordeaux-3-1-la-serie-continue|title=OM - Bordeaux (3-1) : la série continue!|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=8 December 2019|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240917101633/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/22907-om-bordeaux-3-1-la-serie-continue|archive-date=17 September 2024|url-status=live}} However, Sakai found himself suspended on two occasions, including one when he received a second bookable offence, in a victory against [[Trélissac-Antonne Périgord FC|Trélissac]] on penalties following a 1–1 draw in the third round of Coupe de France.{{cite news|title=PSG-OM : averti, Sakai sera suspendu pour la réception de Lyon|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5738385/psg-om-averti-sakai-sera-suspendu-pour-la-reception-de-lyon.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=28 October 2019|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/23600-trelissac-om-1-1-2-tab-4-lom-se-sort-du-piege|title=Trélissac - OM (1-1, 2 tab à 4) : l'OM se sort du piège|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=5 January 2020|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200203071622/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/23600-trelissac-om-1-1-2-tab-4-lom-se-sort-du-piege|archive-date=3 February 2020|url-status=live}}
{{cite news|title=OM : Sakai ratera le déplacement à Rennes|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5833289/om-sakai-ratera-le-deplacement-a-rennes.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=6 January 2020|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=Lille-OM : Alvaro et Sakai suspendus en cas d'avertissement|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5893607/lille-om-alvaro-et-sakai-suspendus-en-cas-davertissement.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=16 February 2020|access-date=23 September 2024}} Sakai suffered a further setback when he suffered an adductor injury that saw him out for two matches.{{cite news|title=OM-Nantes : Payet bien présent, Sakai blessé de dernière minute et absent du groupe olympien|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5900696/om-nantes-payet-bien-present-sakai-absent-du-groupe-olympien.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=21 February 2020|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=Nîmes-OM : Sakai absent du groupe olympien|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5909252/nimes-om-sakai-absent-du-groupe-olympien.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=26 February 2020|access-date=23 September 2024}} It wasn't until on 6 March 2020 when he made his return from injury, coming on as a 77th-minute substitute, in a 2–2 draw against Amiens.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/33944-om-amiens-2-2-lom-rejoint-sur-le-fil|title=OM - Amiens (2-2) : L'OM rejoint sur le fil|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=6 March 2020|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200929181120/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/33944-om-amiens-2-2-lom-rejoint-sur-le-fil|archive-date=29 September 2020|url-status=live}} This turned out to be the last match of the season, due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in France|COVID-19 pandemic]], which caused the season to end abruptly.{{cite news|title=Coronavirus : la FFF suspend l'ensemble de ses compétitions|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Coronavirus-la-fff-suspend-l-ensemble-de-ses-competitions/1119249|website=L'Equipe|language=fr|date=12 March 2020|access-date=14 October 2024}}
{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4808/le-club/35761-lolympique-de-marseille-2e-du-championnat-de-france-2019-2020|title=L'Olympique de Marseille, 2e du Championnat de France 2019-2020|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=2 May 2020|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240917152826/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4808/le-club/35761-lolympique-de-marseille-2e-du-championnat-de-france-2019-2020|archive-date=17 September 2024|url-status=live}} At the end of the 2019–20 season, Sakai made 25 appearances in all competitions. Following this, he underwent a surgery on his ankle.{{cite news|title=OM : Sakai va être opéré|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5936043/om-sakai-va-etre-opere.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=17 March 2020|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=OM : Sakai opéré avec succès|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5936188/om-sakai-opere-avec-succes.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=17 March 2020|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=OM : opéré de la cheville, Sakai récupère bien|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/5956615/om-opere-de-la-cheville-sakai-recupere-bien.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=9 April 2020|access-date=23 September 2024}} The start of the 2020–21 season saw Sakai retain his first team place, playing in the right–back position.{{cite news|title=Mercato OM : Christopher Rocchia a des prétendants|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/6018027/mercato-om-rocchia-a-des-pretendants.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=15 June 2020|access-date=23 September 2024}}

{{cite news|title=André Villas-Boas (OM) après la défaite face à Saint-Étienne : " C'est un gros échec "|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Andre-villas-boas-om-apres-la-defaite-face-a-saint-etienne-c-est-un-gros-echec/1173019|website=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=17 September 2020|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=André Villas-Boas (OM) a opté pour du classique pour affronter l'OL|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Andre-villas-boas-om-a-opte-pour-du-classique-pour-affronter-l-ol/1179827|website=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=4 October 2020|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=Quel joker pour l'OM en défense?|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Article/Quel-joker-pour-l-om-en-defense/1180652|website=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=6 October 2020|access-date=23 September 2024}} During a match against Paris Saint-Germain on 13 September 2020, he was caught in the centre of attention after Spanish radio station [[Cadena SER]] claimed to have footage of [[Neymar]] racially abusing him.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/41618-psg-om-0-1-de-vrais-guerriers|title=PSG - OM (0-1) : De vrais guerriers|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=13 September 2020|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200926005611/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/41618-psg-om-0-1-de-vrais-guerriers|archive-date=26 September 2020|url-status=live}}
{{cite news|title=Comment l'OM a sacrifié ses attaquants pour consolider son bloc contre le PSG|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Article/Psg-om-comment-villas-boas-a-sacrifie-ses-attaquants-pour-consolider-son-bloc/1171584|website=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=14 September 2020|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=PSG-OM : Neymar (PSG) accusé de racisme envers Hiroki Sakai (OM)?|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Psg-om-neymar-psg-accuse-de-racisme-envers-hiroko-sakai-om/1174827|website=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=22 September 2020|access-date=23 September 2024}} In response to the attention, Sakai denied any racist comments from Neymar on social media.{{Cite web|last=Thomas|first=Josh|date=1 October 2020|title=Neymar defended by Marseille's Sakai over racism claim|website=[[Goal (website)|Goal]]|url=https://www.goal.com/en-us/news/neymar-defended-by-marseilles-sakai-over-racism-claim/1gmm44hy0nq1a10twwg7wnniik|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201209164918/https://www.goal.com/en-us/news/neymar-defended-by-marseilles-sakai-over-racism-claim/1gmm44hy0nq1a10twwg7wnniik|archive-date=9 December 2020|access-date=3 October 2020}} He set up the opening goal of the game for [[Florian Thauvin]], in a 3–1 win against Bordeaux on 17 October 2020.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/41618-psg-om-0-1-de-vrais-guerriers|title=PSG - OM (0-1) : De vrais guerriers|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=17 October 2020|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200926005611/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/41618-psg-om-0-1-de-vrais-guerriers|archive-date=26 September 2020|url-status=live}} Since the start of the 2020–21 season, Sakai started in every match until he missed one match, due to suspension.{{cite news|title=Ligue 1 : Nagatomo (OM) de retour dans le groupe pour le match à Strasbourg|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Ligue-1-nagatomo-om-de-retour-dans-le-groupe-pour-le-match-a-strasbourg/1191455|website=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=5 November 2020|access-date=23 September 2024}} Sakai made his return to the starting line–up against [[FC Nantes]] on 28 November 2020 and helped the club win 3–1.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/44534-om-nantes-3-1-om-plaisir|title=OM - Nantes (3-1) : OM plaisir|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=28 November 2020|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20201128182353/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/44534-om-nantes-3-1-om-plaisir|archive-date=28 November 2020|url-status=live}} Following his return from suspension, he regained his first team place, playing in the right–back position.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/45247-om-monaco-2-1-connectes|title=OM - Monaco (2-1) : Connectés|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=12 December 2020|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20201212180321/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/45247-om-monaco-2-1-connectes|archive-date=12 December 2020|url-status=live}}
{{cite news|title=" Les joueurs sont déjà passés à autre chose ", assure André Villas-Boas, l'entraîneur de l'OM|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/-les-joueurs-sont-deja-passes-a-autre-chose-assure-andre-villas-boas-l-entraineur-de-l-om/1207185|website=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=18 December 2020|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/46270-dijon-om-0-0-lom-sans-solution|title=Dijon - OM (0-0) : l'OM sans solution|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=9 January 2021|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20210109230256/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/46270-dijon-om-0-0-lom-sans-solution|archive-date=9 January 2021|url-status=live}} However in mid–February, Sakai suffered a stomach problem that saw him out for one match.{{cite news|title=L'OM avec Amavi mais sans Sakai pour le déplacement à Bordeaux|url=https://www.laprovence.com/actu/en-direct/6264662/lom-avec-amavi-mais-sans-sakai-pour-le-deplacement-a-bordeaux.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=13 February 2021|access-date=23 September 2024}} He made his return from an illness, starting a match, in a 3–2 win against [[OGC Nice]] on 17 February 2021.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/47590-om-nice-3-2-vivant-et-bien-vivant|title=OM - Nice (3-2) : Vivant et bien vivant|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=17 February 2021|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20210217215518/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/47590-om-nice-3-2-vivant-et-bien-vivant|archive-date=17 February 2021|url-status=live}} However, his return was short–lived when Sakai received a straight red card at the last minute for a foul on [[Kader Bamba]], as Marseille drew 1–1 against FC Nantes in a follow–up.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/47737-nantes-om-1-1-lom-ramene-un-point|title=Nantes - OM (1-1) : l'OM ramène un point|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=20 February 2021|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20210220182450/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/47737-nantes-om-1-1-lom-ramene-un-point|archive-date=20 February 2021|url-status=live}} After serving a two match suspension, he returned as a substitute, in a 3–1 win against [[Stade Brestois 29|Stade Brestois]] on 13 March 2021.{{cite news|title=Commission de discipline : deux matches pour Sakai (OM), trois pour Kamara (Dijon)|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Commission-de-discipline-deux-matches-pour-sakai-om-trois-pour-kamara-dijon/1226619|website=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=24 February 2021|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/48573-om-brest-3-1-cest-cadeau|title=OM - Brest (3-1) : C'est cadeau!|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=13 March 2021|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20210313184254/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/48573-om-brest-3-1-cest-cadeau|archive-date=13 March 2021|url-status=live}} Despite suffering sciatica problems on three separate occasions later in the 2020–21 season, Sakai made two starts, playing either centre–back position, winning both matches.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/49035-om-dijon-2-0-deux-coups-de-tete|title=OM - Dijon (2-0) : Deux coups de tête|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=4 April 2021|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20210404213521/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/49035-om-dijon-2-0-deux-coups-de-tete|archive-date=4 April 2021|url-status=live}}
{{cite news|title=Jorge Sampaoli, après la victoire de l'OM contre Dijon : " On doit mieux jouer "|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Jorge-sampaoli-apres-la-victoire-de-l-om-contre-dijon-on-doit-mieux-jouer/1239438|website=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=4 April 2021|access-date=23 September 2024}}

{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/49461-om-lorient-3-2-au-buzzer|title=OM - Lorient (3-2) : Au buzzer|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=17 April 2021|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240917194434/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/49461-om-lorient-3-2-au-buzzer|archive-date=17 September 2024|url-status=live}}
{{cite news|title=Jorge Sampaoli (OM) : " On espère que Thauvin va continuer dans le projet "|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Jorge-sampaoli-om-on-espere-que-thauvin-va-continuer-dans-le-projet/1245210|website=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=22 April 2021|access-date=23 September 2024}} He made his last appearance for the club, starting in the left–back position, in a 3–2 win against Angers OSC on 16 May 2021.{{cite web|url=https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/50576-om-angers-3-2-milik-place-lom|title=OM - Angers (3-2) : Milik place l'OM|website=Olympique de Marseille|language=fr|date=16 May 2021|access-date=23 September 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20210516220258/https://www.om.fr/fr/actualites/4803/equipe-pro/50576-om-angers-3-2-milik-place-lom|archive-date=16 May 2021|url-status=live}}
{{cite news|title=L'OM sans Hiroki Sakai ni Florian Thauvin face à Metz mais avec Pape Gueye|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/L-om-sans-hiroki-sakai-ni-florian-thauvin-face-a-metz-mais-avec-pape-gueye/1254863|website=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=22 May 2021|access-date=23 September 2024}} At the end of the [[2020–21 Olympique de Marseille season|2020–21 season]], Sakai made 29 appearances in all competitions. On 24 May 2021, Sakai announced that he was leaving the club despite having a year contract left.{{cite news|title=Transferts : Hiroki Sakai (OM) en route vers Urawa Red Diamonds?|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Transferts-hiroki-sakai-om-en-route-vers-urawa-red-diamonds/1250909|website=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=10 May 2021|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=OM. Le défenseur japonais Hiroki Sakai annonce quitter le club et l'Europe|url=https://www.ouest-france.fr/sport/football/olympique-de-marseille/om-le-defenseur-japonais-hiroki-sakai-annonce-quitter-le-club-et-l-europe-50e6b064-bc78-11eb-b948-e0a0bd45eea2|website=Ouest France|language=French|date=24 May 2021|access-date=1 March 2024}}
{{cite news|title=Hiroki Sakai confirme son départ de l'OM|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Hiroki-sakai-confirme-son-depart-de-l-om/1255458|website=L’Equipe|language=fr|date=24 May 2021|access-date=23 September 2024}} During his time at Marseille, Sakai was a fan favourite among the club's supporters.{{cite news|title=OM : Hiroki Sakai, ce Marseillais d'adoption|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/om/4382380/marseillais-dadoption-sakai.html|website=La Provence|language=fr|date=28 March 2017|access-date=23 September 2024}}
