{{cite news|title=[ACL]20歳の新川がプロ初ゴール、名古屋は無敗で決勝Tへ|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?54086-35449-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=20 May 2009|access-date=5 April 2020}} His second goal of the season came on 26 April 2009, scoring an equaliser goal, in a 2–1 win against [[Yokohama F. Marinos]].{{cite news|title=小川ＦＫ決勝弾で名古屋を救った／Ｊ１|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/news/p-sc-tp0-20090427-487616.html|website=Nikkan Sports|language=Japanese|date=26 April 2009|access-date=25 May 2024}} However by early–July, he suffered a calf injury that saw him out for two weeks.{{cite news|title=吉田が肉離れ、名古屋は両CBが欠場へ|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?56213-38354-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=5 July 2009|access-date=5 April 2020|archive-date=2 April 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200402182830/https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?56213-38354-fl|url-status=dead}} Yoshida made his first team return for Nagoya Grampus on 18 July 2009, starting the match, in a 1–1 draw against [[Kyoto Sanga FC|Kyoto Sanga]].{{cite web|url=https://nagoya-grampus.jp/game/result/2009/07182009j118vsfc/|title=2009J1リーグ第18節：名古屋グランパスvs京都サンガF.C.|publisher=Nagoya Grampus|language=ja|date=18 July 2009|access-date=5 April 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200402193434/https://nagoya-grampus.jp/game/result/2009/07182009j118vsfc/|archive-date=2 April 2020|url-status=live}} He scored his third goal of the season, in a 2–1 win against [[FC Tokyo]] eleven days later on 29 July 2009, but the club was eliminated in the J.League Cup following a 6–3 on aggregate.{{cite web|url=https://nagoya-grampus.jp/game/result/2009/07292009j2vsfc/index.html|title=2009Jリーグヤマザキナビスコカップ準々決勝第2戦：名古屋グランパスvsFC東京|website=Nagoya Grampus|language=ja|date=29 July 2009|access-date=25 May 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20211010071110/https://nagoya-grampus.jp/game/result/2009/07292009j2vsfc/index.html|archive-date=10 October 2021|url-status=live}} Since returning to the first team from injury, Yoshida regained his first team place for the club's remaining matches of the 2009 season.{{cite news|title=鹿島vs名古屋 試合後の選手コメント|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?59758-43220-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=27 September 2009|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=[戦評]名古屋DFの"足下"が不安。ACLの課題だ|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?60662-44436-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=18 October 2009|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=[ACL]名古屋は準決勝で夢散る、日本勢3連覇ならず|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?61107-45038-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=28 October 2009|access-date=5 April 2020}} He later added two more goals throughout September, scoring against [[Kashiwa Reysol]] and [[Kawasaki Frontale]].{{cite web|url=https://nagoya-grampus.jp/game/result/2009/09122009j125vs/index.html|title=2009J1リーグ第25節：名古屋グランパスvs柏レイソル|website=Nagoya Grampus|language=ja|date=12 September 2009|access-date=25 May 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220528135006/https://nagoya-grampus.jp/game/result/2009/09122009j125vs/index.html|archive-date=28 May 2022|url-status=live}}

Marinos]].{{cite web|url=https://nagoya-grampus.jp/game/result/2009/10042009j128vsfc/index.html|title=2009J1リーグ第28節：名古屋グランパスvsFC東京|website=Nagoya Grampus|language=ja|date=4 October 2009|access-date=25 May 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220528145748/https://nagoya-grampus.jp/game/result/2009/10042009j128vsfc/index.html|archive-date=28 May 2022|url-status=live}}

2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100225092547/http://www.ad.nl/ad/nl/1452/VVV-Venlo/article/detail/464932/2010/02/20/Yoshida-mag-voetballen-voor-VVV.dhtml|archive-date=25 February 2010|url-status=dead}}
{{cite web|url=http://www.wsn.com/2009/12/28/football/news/asia/nagoyas-yoshida-to-join-venlo_26909/|title=Nagoya's Yoshida to join Venlo|publisher=WSN|date=2 January 2010|access-date=28 December 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100102014453/http://www.wsn.com/2009/12/28/football/news/asia/nagoyas-yoshida-to-join-venlo_26909/|archive-date=2 January 2010|url-status=dead}} He had desired to play for a club in Europe since he was young. [[Keisuke Honda]], who was his teammate at [[Nagoya Grampus]], introduced his agent, [[Tetsuro Kiyooka]] to support his future vision.{{cite news|title=Venlo chief eyes new Japanese talent|url=https://www.japantimes.co.jp/sports/2014/04/03/soccer/venlo-chief-eyes-new-japanese-talent/|work=The Japan Times|date=3 April 2014}} Indeed, Yoshida followed the footsteps of Keisuke Honda who also played for VVV-Venlo before he joined them.{{cite web|url=http://www.goal.com/en/news/11/transfer-zone/2009/12/29/1714116/japan-defender-maya-yoshida-leaves-nagoya-grampus-for-vvv|title=Japan Defender Maya Yoshida Leaves Nagoya Grampus For VVV Venlo|publisher=Goal.com|date=29 December 2009|access-date=15 July 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100204221825/http://www.goal.com/en/news/11/transfer-zone/2009/12/29/1714116/japan-defender-maya-yoshida-leaves-nagoya-grampus-for-vvv|archive-date=4 February 2010|url-status=dead}} However, Yoshida's start to VVV-Venlo career suffered a setback when he fractured his foot and left him out for the rest of the 2009–10 season.{{cite news |date=13 January 2010 |title=不運! VVV・吉田が初実戦で骨折 |url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?64170-49319-fl |access-date=5 April 2020 |publisher=Web Gekisaka |language=ja |archive-date=2 April 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200402205535/https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?64170-49319-fl |url-status=dead }}
{{cite news |date=10 March 2010 |title=Yoshida hervat groepstraining bij VVV Venlo |url=https://www.fcupdate.nl/voetbalnieuws/140791/yoshida-hervat-groepstraining-bij-vvv-venlo/ |access-date=5 April 2020 |publisher=FC Update |language=nl }} At the start of the 2010–11 season, Yoshida continued to recover from his fractured foot.{{cite news|title=VVV Venlo heeft Japanner Yoshida bijna terug|url=https://www.fcupdate.nl/voetbalnieuws/157873/vvv-venlo-heeft-japanner-yoshida-bijna-terug/|publisher=FC Update|language=nl|date=30 September 2010|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Yoshida meldt zich eindelijk weer bij VVV Venlo|url=https://www.fcupdate.nl/voetbalnieuws/158815/yoshida-meldt-zich-eindelijk-weer-bij-vvv/|publisher=FC Update|language=nl|date=12 October 2010|access-date=5 April 2020}} On 30 October 2010, he made his VVV-Venlo debut, coming on as a 75th-minute substitute, and set up the club's third goal of the game, in a 5–3 loss against [[FC Groningen]].{{cite web|url=http://www.vi.nl/Nieuws-item/189128/FC-Groningen-vergroot-problemen-VVV-en-Van-Dijk.htm|title=FC Groningen vergroot problemen VVV en Van Dijk|website=Voetbal International|language=nl|date=30 October 2010|access-date=25 May 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20101101221710/http://www.vi.nl/Nieuws-item/189128/FC-Groningen-vergroot-problemen-VVV-en-Van-Dijk.htm|archive-date=1 November 2010|url-status=dead}} Since making his debut for VVV-Venlo, Yoshida quickly became a first team regular for the club.{{cite news|title=Basisdebuut Yoshida, weinig zorgen Van Arum|url=https://www.fcupdate.nl/voetbalnieuws/161618/basisdebuut-yoshida-weinig-zorgen-van-arum/|publisher=FC Update|language=nl|date=12 November 2010|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=VVV吉田が古巣・名古屋優勝に喜びの声|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?76946-67843-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=24 November 2010|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=VVV、吉田先発後初勝ち点|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?77703-68900-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=11 December 2010|access-date=5 April 2020}} After spending January with Japan in the Asian Cup and winning the tournament, he made his first team return, starting the match, in a 3–0 win against [[NAC Breda]] on 5 February 2011.{{cite news|title=VVV geeft kampioen Yoshida warm onthaal|url=https://www.fcupdate.nl/voetbalnieuws/168373/vvv-geeft-kampioen-yoshida-warm-onthaal/|publisher=FC Update|language=nl|date=2 February 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida later regained his first team place for the remaining matches of the season, as VVV-Venlo qualified for the relegation play–offs.{{cite news|title=[オランダ]VVV連敗、吉田&カレンは出場|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?80792-73223-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=21 February 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=[オランダ]VVVは降格PO圏内確定、吉田&カレンは揃って先発|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?83125-76747-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=17 April 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=宮市初の欠場で日本人対決ならず、VVVは自動降格回避、フェイエはEL絶望的|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?83806-77652-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=1 May 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}} He started all the four matches in the relegation play–offs and helped the club retain their Eredivisie league status.{{cite news|title=カレン先制！VVVが先勝／オランダ|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/world/news/f-sc-tp3-20110520-778419.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=20 May 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=VVVカレン連発！3回戦へ／オランダ|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/world/news/f-sc-tp3-20110522-779729.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=22 May 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=カレン好機つくりVVV先勝／オランダ|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/world/news/f-sc-tp3-20110527-781880.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=27 May 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=吉田&カレンのVVV、1部残留が決定|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?85211-79506-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=30 May 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}} At the end of the 2010–11 season, Yoshida went on to make twenty–four appearances in all competitions. At the start of the 2011–12 season, Yoshida continued to retain his first team place for VVV-Venlo, playing in the centre–back position.{{cite news|title=VVVvsユトレヒト 試合後の吉田・カレンの一問一答|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?88536-83812-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=7 August 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=VVVがドロー、吉田&カレンはフル出場|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?89124-84658-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=22 August 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=吉田が開幕から18戦連続先発のVVVは逆転勝利、カレンは今季初の欠場|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?95100-93509-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=23 January 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} He scored a bicycle kick goal for VVV-Venlo off a corner kick on 11 September 2011 against [[PSV Eindhoven]], as the match ended in a 3–3 draw.{{cite news|title=Stuntploeg VVV-Venlo snoept PSV knap punten af|url=https://www.vi.nl/nieuws/stuntploeg-vvvvenlo-snoept-psv-knap-punten-af|website=Voetbal International|language=nl|date=11 September 2011|access-date=25 May 2024}} This goal was awarded as "Goal of the Season 2011–2012" of the [[Eredivisie]].{{cite news|title=Yoshida aiming for first Saints goal|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/10383308.yoshida-aiming-for-first-saints-goal/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=26 April 2013|access-date=5 April 2020}} The Yoshida scored his second goal of the season, in a 4–1 win against [[RKC Waalwijk]] on 22 October 2011.{{cite news|title=Wildschut inspireert VVV-Venlo tot ruime zege op RKC|url=https://www.vi.nl/nieuws/wildschut-inspireert-vvvvenlo-tot-ruime-zege-op-rkc|website=Voetbal International|language=nl|date=22 October 2011|access-date=25 May 2024}} On 18 February 2012, he scored his third goal of the season, in a 4–1 win against [[De Graafschap]].{{cite news|title=VVV maakt bij De Graafschap einde aan uitcomplex|url=https://www.vi.nl/nieuws/vvv-maakt-bij-de-graafschap-einde-aan-uitcomplex|publisher=Voetbal International|language=nl|date=18 February 2012|access-date=25 May 2024}} Yoshida's fourth goal of the season came on 3 March 2012, in a 2–1 win against [[NAC Breda]].{{cite news|title=VVV-Venlo houdt zegereeks intact tegen NAC Breda|url=https://www.vi.nl/nieuws/vvvvenlo-houdt-zegereeks-intact-tegen-nac-breda|website=Voetbal International|language=nl|date=3 March 2012|access-date=25 May 2024}} He scored his fifth goal of the season against [[Roda JC Kerkrade|Roda JC]], but was sent off in the 73rd minute for an unprofessional foul, in a 3–1 loss.{{cite news|title=Van Veldhoven: "Wereld ziet er weer anders uit"|url=https://www.fcupdate.nl/voetbalnieuws/200023/van-veldhoven-wereld-ziet-er-weer-anders-uit/|publisher=FC Update|language=nl|date=10 March 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Aanklager wil Yoshida drie wedstrijden schorsen|url=https://www.fcupdate.nl/voetbalnieuws/200208/aanklager-wil-yoshida-drie-wedstrijden-schorsen/|publisher=FC Update|language=nl|date=10 March 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} After serving a two match suspension, Yoshida returned to the starting line-up, starting the match, in a 2–0 loss against PSV Eindhoven on 31 March 2012.{{cite news |date=12 March 2012 |title=Yoshida mist duels met NEC en Heerenveen |url=https://www.fcupdate.nl/voetbalnieuws/200214/yoshida-mist-duels-met-nec-en-heerenveen/ |access-date=5 April 2020 |publisher=FC Update |language=nl}}
{{cite news |date=31 March 2012 |title=出場停止明けの吉田が3戦ぶり先発も...VVVは4連敗 |url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?97394-97149-fl |access-date=5 April 2020 |publisher=Web Gekisaka |language=ja}} He later started all the four matches in the relegation play–offs and helped the club retain their Eredivisie league status once again.{{cite news|title=吉田フル出場のVVV、昇降格プレーオフ第1戦は2部相手にスコアレスドロー|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?99262-99902-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=11 May 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=吉田フル出場のVVV、壮絶な打ち合い制し昇降格プレーオフ決勝へ|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?99427-100109-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=14 May 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=吉田フル出場のVVVが敵地で先勝、1部残留に王手|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?99562-100365-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=17 May 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=吉田フル出場のVVV、2戦合計4-3で1部残留決める|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?99737-100561-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=20 May 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida's experience in the relegation play–offs led him to write a blog about the subject.{{cite news|title=「プレーオフってなんでこんなキツいの?」 残留へ残り1勝のVVV吉田が心境綴る|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?99576-100384-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=18 May 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} At the end of the 2011–12 season, Yoshida went on to make thirty–seven appearances and scoring five times in all competitions as a central defender. In the 2012–13 season, Yoshida made two appearances for VVV-Venlo, including making his last appearance against [[ADO Den Haag]] on 25 August 2012, in which he set up the club's first goal of the game, losing 4–2.{{cite news|title=Utrecht zet zonder al te veel moeite VVV-Venlo opzij|url=https://www.vi.nl/nieuws/utrecht-zet-zonder-al-te-veel-moeite-vvvvenlo-opzij|website=Voetbal International|language=nl|date=18 August 2012|access-date=25 May 2024}}
{{cite news|title=ADO pakt eerste overwinning van seizoen|url=http://www.ad.nl/nederlands-voetbal/ado-pakt-eerste-overwinning-van-seizoen~a2a12abc/|publisher=Algemeen Dagblad|language=nl|date=25 August 2012|access-date=25 May 2024}} ===Southampton=== [[File:Yoshida.jpg|thumb|left|upright|Yoshida playing for [[Southampton F.C.|Southampton]] in 2017]] On 30 August 2012, Yoshida agreed to join newly–promoted [[Premier League]] side [[Southampton F.C.|Southampton]] on a three-year contract for a fee thought to be in the region of £3 million and was joined by his teammate, [[Tadanari Lee]].{{cite web|title=Japan's Yoshida Set For Saints|url=http://www.saintsfc.co.uk/news/article/japans-yoshida-set-for-saints-343281.aspx|publisher=Southampton F.C.|date=30 August 2012|access-date=30 August 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120901102921/http://www.saintsfc.co.uk/news/article/japans-yoshida-set-for-saints-343281.aspx|archive-date=1 September 2012|url-status=dead}}
{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/19426865 |title=Southampton sign Maya Yoshida, Japan's Olympic captain|date=30 August 2012|publisher=BBC Sport|access-date=1 September 2012}} Upon joining the club, he told the ''[[Southern Daily Echo]]'' that the move to England would help him grow as a player.{{cite news|title=Maya Yoshida moved to Southampton to grow as a player in the Premier League|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/9934463.maya-yoshida-moved-to-southampton-to-grow-as-a-player-in-the-premier-league/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=18 September 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida made his debut for the Saints on 15 September 2012, against [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]] in a 6–1 defeat, coming on as a 28th-minute substitute for [[Jos Hooiveld]].{{Cite news|title=Arsenal 6–1 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/19528203|publisher=BBC Sport|date=15 September 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} He then made his home debut a week later on 22 September 2012 in a 4–1 win over [[Aston Villa F.C.|Aston Villa]], playing the whole 90 minutes.{{cite news|last=Lewis|first=Aimee|title=Southampton 4–1 Aston Villa|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/19615244|publisher=BBC Sport|access-date=5 April 2020|date=22 September 2012}} Since joining the club, Yoshida quickly became a first team regular, playing in the centre–back position and forming a partnership with [[José Fonte]].{{cite news|title=Saints' fab four to take centre stage on Merseyside|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/9954466.saints-fab-four-to-take-centre-stage-on-merseyside/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=28 September 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Clyne boost for Saints defence|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/9995548.clyne-boost-for-saints-defence/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=19 October 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Yoshida: Saints can rule Britannia|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/10131042.yoshida-saints-can-rule-britannia/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=29 December 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} During a 1–1 draw against [[Swansea City A.F.C.|Swansea City]] on 10 November 2012, Yoshida made a poor control to the ball that led to [[Nathan Dyer]] scoring an equaliser.{{cite news|title=Southampton 1–1 Swansea City|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/20189996|publisher=BBC Sport|date=10 November 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} Despite, he continued to retain his first team place against [[Queens Park Rangers F.C.|Queens Park Rangers]] and helped them win 3–1 on 15 November 2012.{{cite news|title=Queens Park Rangers 1–3 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/20278600|publisher=BBC Sport|date=15 November 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} Along the way, he was rotated to playing in the left–back and right–back positions.{{cite news|title=Adkins urged to Shaw up defence|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/10009574.adkins-urged-to-shaw-up-defence/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=26 October 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Southampton linked to £8m move for Italian defender Davide Astori|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/10132439.southampton-linked-to-8m-move-for-italian-defender-davide-astori/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=31 December 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Boruc save earns Saints point|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/10279353.boruc-save-earns-saints-point/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=9 March 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} Since making his debut for Southampton, Yoshida started in every match for the Saints and helped improve the results on both the club and the player, himself.{{cite news|title=Ex-Saint Watson: Adkins needs battlers to complement his creative stars|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/10140225.ex-saint-watson-adkins-needs-battlers-to-complement-his-creative-stars/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=4 January 2013|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Yoshida could be first to book World Cup ticket|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/10312573.yoshida-could-be-first-to-book-world-cup-ticket/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=26 March 2013|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Yoshida dreams of United move|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/10368837.yoshida-dreams-of-united-move/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=26 April 2013|access-date=5 April 2020}} Having started the 2012–13 season at the bottom of the table, results improved and he helped Southampton avoid relegation by finishing fourteenth place.{{cite news|title=Maya's happy shock at Saints recovery|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/10383719.mayas-happy-shock-at-saints-recovery/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=27 April 2013|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Southampton 1–1 Stoke City|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/22499096|publisher=BBC Sport|date=14 May 2013|access-date=5 April 2020}} In his first season at Southampton, he went on to make thirty–four appearances in all competitions. However at the start of the 2013–14 season, Yoshida's first team opportunities became limited under the management of [[Mauricio Pochettino]] and he found himself on the substitute bench.{{cite news|title=Artur boost for England|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/10661094.artur-boost-for-england/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=6 September 2013|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Osvaldo leads the way for Saints stars|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/10666485.osvaldo-leads-the-way-for-saints-stars/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=10 September 2013|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=COMMENT: Bad night for Saints and their forgotten trio of Cork, Yoshida and Gazzaniga|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/10855810.comment-bad-night-for-saints-and-their-forgotten-trio-of-cork-yoshida-and-gazzaniga/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=4 December 2013|access-date=5 April 2020}} Despite this, he made his first appearance of the season, in a 5–1 win against [[Barnsley F.C.|Barnsley]] on 27 August 2013.{{cite news|title=Barnsley 1–5 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/23763998|publisher=BBC Sport|date=27 August 2013|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida then scored his first goal for Southampton in a 2–1 defeat to [[Sunderland A.F.C.|Sunderland]] in the [[Football League Cup|League Cup]] on 6 November 2013.{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/24739094|title=Sunderland 2 – 1 Southampton|publisher=BBC Sport|date=6 November 2013 |access-date=6 November 2013}} A month later on 4 December 2013, he made his first Premier League appearance, starting the match, in a 3–2 loss against [[Aston Villa F.C.|Aston Villa]].{{cite news|title=Southampton 2–3 Aston Villa|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/25115885|publisher=BBC Sport|date=4 December 2013|access-date=5 April 2020}} At the start of January, Yoshida had a first team run in following an injury to [[Dejan Lovren]], starting the next six matches as the results improved.{{cite news|title=Southampton 2–2 Arsenal|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/25822287|publisher=BBC Sport|date=28 January 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Fulham 0–3 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/25892225|publisher=BBC Sport|date=1 February 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Yoshida produces "faultless" performance|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/11003202.yoshida-produces-faultless-performance/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=12 February 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Maya never thought to quit 'fantastic' Saints|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/11000502.maya-never-thought-to-quit-fantastic-saints/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=11 February 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}} He scored his first Premier League goal in a 3–1 defeat at [[West Ham United F.C.|West Ham United]] on 22 February 2014 after a [[Steven Davis]] free kick.{{cite web|last=Hassan|first=Nabil|title=West Ham 3 – 1 Southampton |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/26202718 |publisher=BBC Sport|access-date=21 March 2014|date=22 February 2014}} But following Lovren's return, he was once again behind the pecking order in the centre–back competitions, as well as, his own injury concerns.{{cite news |date=9 March 2014 |title=吉田ベンチのサウサンプトンはクリスタル・パレスに完封勝利 |url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?134281-134281-fl |access-date=5 April 2020 |publisher=Web Gekisaka |language=ja}}
{{cite news |date=28 March 2014 |title=サウサンプトンDF吉田麻也が全治約6、7週間の負傷、指揮官「W杯は間に合うだろう」 |url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?135395-135395-fl |access-date=5 April 2020 |publisher=Web Gekisaka |language=ja}}{{cite news|title=Poch wants to beef up small squad|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/11164546.poch-wants-to-beef-up-small-squad/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=23 April 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}} At the end of the 2013–14 season, Yoshida went on to make fourteen appearances and scoring two times in all competitions. At the start of the 2014–15 season, Yoshida regained his first team place, playing in the centre–back position, following Lovren's departure.{{cite news|title=Ronald Koeman says the arrival of Florin Gardos represents the last centre-half signing of the summer at Southampton|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/11414036.ronald-koeman-says-the-arrival-of-florin-gardos-represents-the-last-centre-half-signing-of-the-summer-at-southampton/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=17 August 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Southampton 0–0 West Bromwich Albion|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/28816296|publisher=BBC Sport|date=24 August 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=West Ham United 1–3 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/28906779|publisher=BBC Sport|date=30 August 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Ronald Koeman hails Southampton's defence|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/11547457.ronald-koeman-hails-southamptons-defence/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=21 October 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}} However, during a 1–0 win against [[Swansea City A.F.C.|Swansea City]] on 20 September 2014, he suffered ankle injury and was substituted in the second half, resulting in him out for four weeks.{{cite news|title=Saints manager expects James Ward-Prowse, Maya Yoshida and Toby Alderweireld to make quick returns from injury|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/11486987.saints-manager-expects-james-ward-prowse-maya-yoshida-and-toby-alderweireld-to-make-quick-returns-from-injury/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=21 September 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Swansea City 0–1 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/29187272|publisher=BBC Sport|date=20 September 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}} Although Yoshida returned from injury, he was placed on the substitute bench until on 30 November 2014 against [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]], coming on as a second–half substitute, in a 3–0 loss.{{cite news|title=Saints stars benefit from extra days of rest|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/11620792.saints-stars-benefit-from-extra-days-of-rest/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=30 November 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Saints suffer City defeat|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/11635659.saints-suffer-city-defeat/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=30 November 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=COMMENT: Morgan Schneiderlin injury against Manchester City exposes Saints' lack of squad depth compared to Premier League title chasers|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/11635816.comment-morgan-schneiderlin-injury-against-manchester-city-exposes-saints-lack-of-squad-depth-compared-to-premier-league-title-chasers/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=1 December 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}} His next goal came on 20 December 2014, in a 3–0 victory over [[Everton F.C.|Everton]], with Steven Davis again providing the assist.{{cite web|last1=Cryer|first1=Andy|title=Southampton 3 – 0 Everton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/30459790|publisher=BBC Sport|access-date=31 December 2014|date=20 December 2014}} Two weeks later on 8 January 2015, Southampton announced that Yoshida and the club had agreed terms to an extension of his contract until 2018.{{cite web|last1=Lucas|first1=Jim|title=Yoshida extends Saints deal until 2018|url=http://www.saintsfc.co.uk/news/article/20150102-maya-yoshida-contract-2177890.aspx|website=Southampton FC|access-date=8 January 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150102173933/http://www.saintsfc.co.uk/news/article/20150102-maya-yoshida-contract-2177890.aspx|archive-date=2 January 2015|url-status=dead}} After spending January with Japan's campaign at the AFC Asian Cup, he returned to the starting line-up and played the whole game, in a 1–0 loss against Swansea City on 1 February 2015.{{cite news|title=Sadio Mane and Maya Yoshida to return for Saints|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/11762900.sadio-mane-and-maya-yoshida-to-return-for-saints/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=31 January 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Southampton 0–1 Swansea City|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/30971834|publisher=BBC Sport|date=1 February 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}} In a follow–up match against Queens Park Rangers, Yoshida played an important role in the game when he set up the only goal of the game, in a 1–0 win.{{cite news|title=Queens Park Rangers 0–1 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/31071178|publisher=BBC Sport|date=14 February 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}} Towards the end of the season, he found himself in and out of the starting line-up in the first team and demoted on the substitute bench.{{cite news|title=Ronald Koeman says Maya Yoshida can solve Southampton's left-back dilemma|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/11781904.ronald-koeman-says-maya-yoshida-can-solve-southamptons-left-back-dilemma/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=15 February 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=麻也7戦ぶり出場なしのサウサンプトンはチェルシーと分ける|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?158941-158941-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=16 March 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Southampton 2–0 Hull City|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/32179964|publisher=BBC Sport|date=11 April 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}} Despite this, Yoshida helped the club finish seventh place in the league, resulting in their qualifying for the UEFA Europa League next season.{{cite news|title=Maya Yoshida believes that he and Southampton are ready to play in Europe|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/12916984.maya-yoshida-believes-that-he-and-southampton-are-ready-to-play-in-europe/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=28 April 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}} At the end of the 2014–15 season, he went on to make twenty–three appearances and scoring once in all competitions. [[File:Southampton FC versus FC Augsburg (36304197506).jpg|thumb|right|300px|Yoshida pictured with the young mascots ahead of a friendly match against [[FC Augsburg]] in 2017]] At the start of the 2015–16 season, Yoshida started the season well when he helped a clean sheet in both legs by beating [[SBV Vitesse|Vitesse]] 5–0 on aggregate in the third round of the UEFA Europa League.{{cite news|title=Southampton 3–0 Vitesse|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/33667103|publisher=BBC Sport|date=30 July 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Vitesse 0–1 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/33738509|publisher=BBC Sport|date=6 August 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}} However, Yoshida was unable to help Southampton reach the group stage of the tournament after losing 2–1 on aggregate against [[FC Midtjylland|Midtjylland]].{{cite news|title=Southampton 1–1 FC Midtjylland|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/33994069|publisher=BBC Sport|date=20 August 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=FC Midtjylland 1–0 Southampton (agg 2–1)|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/34056532|publisher=BBC Sport|date=27 August 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}} Despite this, Yoshida helped the club keep three consecutive clean sheets between 23 August 2015 and 23 September 2015.{{cite news|title=Watford 0–0 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/33950776|publisher=BBC Sport|date=23 August 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Southampton 3–0 Norwich City|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/34031790|publisher=BBC Sport|date=30 August 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=West Bromwich Albion 0–0 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/34160768|publisher=BBC Sport|date=12 September 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}} Having started playing in the centre–back position, he played in the right–back position, due to increase competitions among the centre–backs.{{cite news|title=Newcastle United 2–2 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/33750572|publisher=BBC Sport|date=9 August 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Is it fair to label Saints 'dull' away from home after their last two trips to Watford and West Bromwich both ended in sterile draws?|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/13720004.is-it-fair-to-label-saints-dull-away-from-home-after-their-last-two-trips-to-watford-and-west-bromwich-both-ended-in-sterile-draws/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=15 September 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Steven Caulker is ready to compete for his place at Saints after Virgil van Dijk's arrival from Celtic on transfer deadline day|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/13712976.steven-caulker-is-ready-to-compete-for-his-place-at-saints-after-virgil-van-dijks-arrival-from-celtic-on-transfer-deadline-day/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=12 September 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}} During a match against [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]] on 21 September 2015, Yoshida was at fault when his back pass backfired, allowing [[Anthony Martial]] to score, as Southampton loss 3–2.{{cite news|title=Southampton 2–3 Manchester United|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/34236981|publisher=BBC Sport|date=21 September 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}} Following this, Yoshida mostly appeared for the club from the substitute bench, due to strong competitions in the defence.{{cite news|title=Maya Yoshida will fight for his Southampton place|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/13882668.maya-yoshida-will-fight-for-his-southampton-place/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=21 October 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Southampton manager Ronald Koeman taking the positives out of defeat against Manchester City with Liverpool next up|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/14111004.southampton-manager-ronald-koeman-taking-the-positives-out-of-defeat-against-manchester-city-with-liverpool-next-up/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=30 November 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Saints defender Virgil van Dijk picked up an injury on international duty but expects to be fit for the Stoke game|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/14036347.saints-defender-virgil-van-dijk-picked-up-an-injury-on-international-duty-but-expects-to-be-fit-for-the-stoke-game/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=18 November 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Maya Yoshida knows he must up his game at Saints if Ronald Koeman is to select him more often in the Premier League|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/14264412.maya-yoshida-knows-he-must-up-his-game-at-saints-if-ronald-koeman-is-to-select-him-more-often-in-the-premier-league/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=10 February 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}} On 28 October 2015, he scored his first goal of the 2015–16 season with a 20-yard strike against [[Aston Villa F.C.|Aston Villa]] in the League Cup.{{cite web|last1=Wilson|first1=Jeremy|title=Southampton 2 Aston Villa 1, match report: Maya Yoshida and Graziano Pelle goals end Villa's cup hopes |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/competitions/league-cup/11961167/Southampton-2-Aston-Villa-1-match-report-Maya-Yoshida-and-Graziano-Pelle-goals-end-Villas-cup-hopes.html|work=The Daily Telegraph|access-date=29 October 2015|date=28 October 2015}}
{{cite web|last1=Prentki|first1=Tom|title=Southampton 2 – Aston Villa 1: Yoshida and Pelle goals sink managerless Villains|url=https://www.express.co.uk/sport/football/615433/Southampton-Aston-Villa-Capital-One-Cup-match-report-Maya-Yoshida-Graziano-Pelle|publisher=Daily Express|access-date=29 October 2015|date=28 October 2015}} Yoshida's second goal of the season came on 6 February 2016 in a 1–0 victory at [[St Mary's Stadium|St. Mary's]] over West Ham United.{{cite news|last1=Smith|first1=Alan|title=Maya Yoshida celebrates as 10-man Southampton keep out West Ham|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2016/feb/06/southampton-west-ham-premier-league-match-report|access-date=7 February 2016|publisher=The Observer|date=6 February 2016}} The club later finished sixth place in the league, resulting their qualification of the UEFA Europa League once again next season.{{cite news|title=Southampton 4–1 Crystal Palace|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/36240425|publisher=BBC Sport|date=15 May 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}} At the end of the 2015–16 season, he went on to make twenty–seven appearances and scoring two times in all competitions. At the start of the 2016–17 season, Yoshida started the match against [[Watford F.C.|Watford]] in the opening game of the season, resulting a 1–1 draw.{{cite news|title=Southampton 1–1 Watford|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/36994444|publisher=BBC Sport|date=13 August 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}} However, he became a backup in the club's centre–back position behind [[Virgil van Dijk]] and Fonte.{{cite news|title=Jose Fonte and Cedric Soares could be involved for Southampton against Watford|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/14677279.jose-fonte-and-cedric-soares-could-be-involved-for-southampton-against-watford/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=12 August 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=COMMENT: Claude Puel faces tricky selection dilemma ahead of two important games for Southampton|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/14742017.comment-claude-puel-faces-tricky-selection-dilemma-ahead-of-two-important-games-for-southampton/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=12 September 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Forgotten man Florin Gardos could be set for St Mary's return|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/14875164.forgotten-man-florin-gardos-could-be-set-for-st-marys-return/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=9 November 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}} Despite this, national newspaper [[Daily Mirror]] mentioned Yoshida in their article of Premier League pace-setters.{{cite news |date=6 October 2016 |title=英に衝撃！吉田麻也の足の速さがウォルコットと同じ |url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/world/news/1720579.html |access-date=5 April 2020 |publisher=Nikkan Sports |language=ja}}
{{cite news |date=6 October 2016 |title=Maya Yoshida is as quick as Theo Walcott - 7 shock discoveries from the list of Premier League pace-setters |url=https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/row-zed/maya-yoshida-quick-theo-walcott-8986588 |access-date=5 April 2020 |work=Daily Mirror}} On 6 November 2016, he made his return to the starting line-up against [[Hull City A.F.C.|Hull City]] and won a penalty, leading [[Charlie Austin]] to successfully convert, leading Southampton losing 2–1.{{cite news|title=Hull City 2–1 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/37814323|publisher=BBC Sport|date=6 November 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}} Amid to the league, Yoshida started all six matches in the UEFA Europa League.{{cite news|title=Come on Claude Puel - let your stars shine|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/14954021.come-on-claude-let-your-stars-shine/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=8 December 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}} He helped the Saints keep two clean sheets in the first two UEFA Europa League matches.{{cite news|title=Southampton 3–0 Sparta Prague|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/37302387|publisher=BBC Sport|date=15 September 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Hapoel Be'er Sheva 0–0 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/37498546|publisher=BBC Sport|date=29 September 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}} After a famous 2–1 win against [[Inter Milan]] on 3 November 2016, as the club's forms declined and were eliminated from the tournament.{{cite news|title=Southampton 2–1 Inter Milan|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/37847418|publisher=BBC Sport|date=3 November 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=THE VERDICT: The final word on Southampton's 1-1 draw with Hapoel Be'er Sheva|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/14955968.the-verdict-the-final-word-on-southamptons-1-1-draw-with-hapoel-beer-sheva/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=9 December 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}} On 7 January 2017, Yoshida scored his first goal of the season, in a 2–2 draw against [[Norwich City F.C.|Norwich City]] in the third round of the EFL Cup.{{cite news|title=Norwich City 1–2 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/38474591|publisher=BBC Sport|date=7 January 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}} Following the match, he dedicated his goal to his newly born baby daughter.{{cite news |date=8 January 2017 |title="おしゃぶりパフォ"の麻也「赤ちゃんがゴールをプレゼントしてくれた」 |url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?207436-207436-fl |access-date=5 April 2020 |publisher=Web Gekisaka |language=ja}} Yoshida captained Southampton for the first time and helped the club beat Norwich City 1–0 in the third round of the FA Cup replay.{{cite news|title=Southampton 1–0 Norwich City|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/38579247|publisher=BBC Sport|date=18 January 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}} Despite indifferent form on the part of both Yoshida and the Saints as a whole, Southampton became the first team in history to reach the [[2017 EFL Cup Final|final]] without conceding a single goal after beating [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]] 2–0 on aggregate in the EFL semi–finals.{{cite news|title=Southampton 1–0 Liverpool|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/38504049|publisher=BBC Sport|date=11 January 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Liverpool 0–1 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/38659708|publisher=BBC Sport|date=25 January 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida previously helped Southampton keep three clean sheets in a built up to the EFL Cup semi–finals.{{cite news|title=Southampton 2–0 Crystal Palace|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/37357875|publisher=BBC Sport|date=21 September 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Southampton 1–0 Sunderland|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/37700028|publisher=BBC Sport|date=26 October 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Arsenal 0–2 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/38073806|publisher=BBC Sport|date=30 November 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}} However, he started in the final, as Southampton loss 3–2 to Manchester United on 26 February 2017. Following Fonte's departure from the club, Yoshida regained his first team place for the rest of the season.{{cite news|title=How Maya Yoshida tried to help Jack Stephens through a difficult time at Saints|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/15051579.how-maya-yoshida-tried-to-help-jack-stephens-through-a-difficult-time-at-saints/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=27 January 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Five things for Southampton to consider for the remainder of their season|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/15120308.five-things-for-southampton-to-consider-for-the-remainder-of-their-season/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=1 March 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Saints must shackle rejuvenated Manchester City striker Sergio Aguero|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/15218017.saints-must-shackle-rejuvenated-manchester-city-striker-sergio-aguero/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=12 April 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}} On 5 April 2017, he scored his second goal of the season, in a 3–1 win against [[Crystal Palace F.C.|Crystal Palace]].{{cite news|title=Southampton 3–1 Crystal Palace|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/39426765|publisher=BBC Sport|date=5 April 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}} After the match, Manager [[Claude Puel]] praised Yoshida's performance, saying he was "fantastic" and mentioned that he could be "a captain" for Southampton.{{cite news|title=Claude Puel hails Yoshida - and talks about Martin Caceres' potential debut|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/15208775.claude-puel-hails-yoshida-and-talks-about-martin-caceres-potential-debut/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=7 April 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}} In a follow–up, Yoshida captained the Saints once again, in a 1–0 win against [[West Bromwich Albion F.C.|West Bromwich Albion]].{{cite news|title=West Bromwich Albion 0–1 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/39464041|publisher=BBC Sport|date=8 April 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}} He then made his 100th appearance for Southampton and Premier League overall, becoming the first Japanese player to reach the milestone, in a 0–0 draw against Hull City on 29 April 2017.{{cite news|title=プレミア5年目で達成...100試合出場の吉田麻也「日本サッカー界にとって大きな一歩」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?215027-215027-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=30 April 2017|access-date=5 April 2020|archive-date=4 April 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230404135147/https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?215027-215027-fl|url-status=dead}}
{{cite news|title=日本人初のプレミア100試合出場の麻也「とにかく感謝しかない」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?215139-215139-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=30 April 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}} At the end of the 2016–17 season, which saw the club finish in seventh place, Yoshida went on to make thirty–seven appearances and scoring two times in all competitions. In the 2017–18 season, Yoshida appeared in the first three league matches of the season, including winning a penalty and it was successfully converted by Austin, in a 3–2 win against West Ham United on 19 August 2017.{{cite news|title=Steven Davis has opened the door for Virgil van Dijk to return to the Saints fold amid his ongoing transfer saga|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/15470307.steven-davis-has-opened-the-door-for-virgil-van-dijk-to-return-to-the-saints-fold-amid-his-ongoing-transfer-saga/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=14 August 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Southampton 3–2 West Ham United|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/40908330|publisher=BBC Sport|date=19 August 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Virgil van Dijk will have to "fight" for his place in the Saints team if he stays beyond the end of the transfer window, according to Steven Davis|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/15498059.virgil-van-dijk-will-have-to-fight-for-his-place-in-the-saints-team-if-he-stays-beyond-the-end-of-the-transfer-window-according-to-steven-davis/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=28 August 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}} It was announced on 24 August 2017 that Yoshida signed a further extension of his contract with Southampton until 2020.{{cite web|last1=Media|first1=SFC|title=Yoshida signs new Saints deal|url=https://southamptonfc.com/news/2017-08-24/maya-yoshida-new-southampton-three-year-contract-announcement|website=Southampton F.C.|access-date=21 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170906072414/https://southamptonfc.com/news/2017-08-24/maya-yoshida-new-southampton-three-year-contract-announcement|archive-date=6 September 2017|url-status=live}} He continued to remain in competitions among the centre–backs, which saw him placed on the substitute bench.{{cite news|title=Wesley Hoedt talks about potential partnership with fellow Netherlands international Virgil van Dijk at Saints|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/15530372.wesley-hoedt-talks-about-potential-partnership-with-fellow-netherlands-international-virgil-van-dijk-at-saints/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=13 September 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Maya Yoshida knows Saints' centre-backs will feel pressure of Virgil van Dijk's return|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/15540694.maya-yoshida-knows-saints-centre-backs-will-feel-pressure-of-virgil-van-dijks-return/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=18 September 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Mauricio Pellegrino has considered a change of formation at Saints - could he finally implement it after the international break?|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/15581154.mauricio-pellegrino-has-considered-a-change-of-formation-at-saints-could-he-finally-implement-it-after-the-international-break/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=7 October 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}} On 30 September 2017, Yoshida scored his first goal of the season, scoring from a volley in the 75th minute in a 2–1 loss against Stoke City.{{cite news|title=Stoke City 2–1 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/41370358|publisher=BBC Sport|date=30 September 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}} By the end of 2017, he captained six out of the eight matches for the Saints.{{cite news|title=Southampton 1–1 Arsenal|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/42212590|publisher=BBC Sport|date=10 December 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Manchester United 0–0 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/42411000|publisher=BBC Sport|date=30 December 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Southampton 1–2 Crystal Palace|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/42411056|publisher=BBC Sport|date=2 January 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida also scored his second goal of the season, in a 4–1 loss against [[Leicester City F.C.|Leicester City]] on 13 December 2017.{{cite news|title=Southampton 1–4 Leicester City|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/42247116|publisher=BBC Sport|date=13 December 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}} However, Yoshida suffered a hamstring injury that kept him out for two weeks.{{cite news|title=Southampton manager Mauricio Pellegrino defends his tactics after 2-2 draw with Watford|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/15826714.southampton-manager-mauricio-pellegrino-defends-his-tactics-after-2-2-draw-with-watford/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=14 April 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}} On 27 January 2018, he made return from injury, coming on as a 67th-minute substitute, in a 1–0 win against Watford.{{cite news|title=Southampton 1–0 Watford|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/42756109|publisher=BBC Sport|date=27 January 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida's return was short–lived when he suffered a knee injury that kept him out for two months.{{cite news|title=Southampton defender Maya Yoshida out for at least a month with a knee injury|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/16041398.southampton-defender-maya-yoshida-out-for-at-least-a-month-with-a-knee-injury/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=22 February 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Maya Yoshida gets ready to fight for his Southampton place|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/16119839.maya-yoshida-gets-ready-to-fight-for-his-southampton-place/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=28 March 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}} On 8 April 2018, Yoshida returned to the starting line-up and played for 72 minutes before being substituted, in a 3–2 loss against Arsenal.{{cite news|title=Arsenal 3–2 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/43609100|publisher=BBC Sport|date=8 April 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}} Throughout the 2017–18 season, the club have found themselves in a relegation zone, putting their Premier League status under threat.{{cite news|title=Southampton's Maya Yoshida says every player must "take responsibility"|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/15791772.southamptons-maya-yoshida-says-every-player-must-take-responsibility/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=25 September 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Southampton are in a 'do-or-die' position, says Yoshida|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/16134748.southampton-are-in-a-do-or-die-position-says-yoshida/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=4 April 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}} However, in the penultimate match of the season, a 1–1 draw with Everton on 5 May 2018, he was sent–off for a second bookable offence, so was suspended for the visit to Swansea City from which Southampton needed a win to survive at their hosts' expense.{{cite news|title=Everton 1–1 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/43931930|publisher=BBC Sport|date=5 May 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}} The match was won by Southampton, so Swansea City were relegated.{{cite news|title=Swansea City 0–1 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/43353971|publisher=BBC Sport|date=8 May 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}} At the end of the 2017–18 season, Yoshida went on to make twenty–eight appearances and scoring two times in all competitions. Ahead of the 2018–19 season, Yoshida was linked a move away from Southampton, with Saudi Arabian side [[Al Hilal SFC|Al Hilal]] interested.{{cite news|title=中東移籍報道の吉田麻也、やはりサウサンプトン残留か...地元紙報道|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?245383-245383-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=22 May 2018|access-date=5 April 2020|archive-date=14 April 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220414182516/https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?245383-245383-fl|url-status=dead}} But the transfer speculation came to an end after Yoshida announced his intention to stay at the club.{{cite news|title=Maya Yoshida's future is decided|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/16238218.maya-yoshidas-future-is-decided/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=21 May 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}} At the start of the season, he found his first team opportunities limited under the management of [[Mark Hughes]].{{cite news|title=Lawrie McMenemy on Southampton's win over Brighton & Hove Albion|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/16608293.lawrie-mcmenemy-on-southamptons-win-over-brighton/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=1 September 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=サウサンプトンファンは吉田麻也の出場を熱望...「なぜキャプテンよりフートなんだ?」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?255029-255029-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|date=23 September 2018|access-date=5 April 2020|archive-date=5 July 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220705194521/https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?255029-255029-fl|url-status=dead}}
{{cite news|title=サウサンプトン専門メディアが吉田麻也の起用を提言「ベステルゴーアのパートナーにふさわしい」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?255331-255331-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=27 September 2018|access-date=5 April 2020|archive-date=16 April 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220416074819/https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?255331-255331-fl|url-status=dead}} On 27 August 2018, Yoshida made his first appearance of the season, starting the match, in a 1–0 win against [[Brighton & Hove Albion F.C.|Brighton & Hove Albion]] in the second round of the EFL Cup.{{cite news|title=Brighton & Hove Albion 0–1 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/45254464|publisher=BBC Sport|date=28 August 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}} He soon had a first team run, starting a lot of matches by the end of 2018.{{cite news|title=How Southampton players rated against Watford|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/17217295.how-southampton-players-rated-against-watford/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=12 November 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Southampton defender Maya Yoshida chasing another cup run|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/17256170.southampton-defender-maya-yoshida-chasing-another-cup-run/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=26 November 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Southampton manager Ralph Hasenhuttl has a defensive dilemma ahead of Arsenal|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/17293248.southampton-manager-ralph-hasenhuttl-has-a-defensive-dilemma-ahead-of-arsenal/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=13 December 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}} Following his international commitment with Japan at the AFC Asian Cup came to an end, Yoshida returned to the starting line-up and helped the Saints keep a clean sheet, in a 2–0 win against Fulham on 27 February 2019.{{cite news|title=Saints 1 Cardiff City 2: Southampton suffer injury-time heartbreak|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/17421468.saints-1-cardiff-city-2-southampton-suffer-injury-time-heartbreak/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=9 February 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Southampton out of the relegation zone after 2-0 win over Fulham|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/17464433.southampton-out-of-the-relegation-zone-after-2-0-win-over-fulham/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=27 February 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} Since returning to the first team, he regained his place for the rest of the season and helped Southampton avoid relegation once again.{{cite news|title=Ralph Hasenhuttl's started better than Mauricio Pochettino|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/17481709.ralph-hasenhuttls-started-better-than-mauricio-pochettino/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=7 March 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=THE VERDICT: The final word on Southampton's 3-1 defeat to Newcastle|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/17588291.the-verdict-the-final-word-on-southamptons-3-1-defeat-to-newcastle/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=22 April 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Southampton defender Maya Yoshida outlines target for safety|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/17581352.southampton-defender-maya-yoshida-outlines-target-for-safety/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=18 April 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} Despite being out with an illness that eventually saw him out for the rest of the 2018–19 season, Yoshida went on to make twenty appearances in all competitions.{{cite news|title=Southampton defender Maya Yoshida won't be risked for Huddersfield finale|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/17632223.southampton-defender-maya-yoshida-wont-be-risked-for-huddersfield-finale/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=10 May 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} In the 2019–20 season, Yoshida made his first appearance of the season, starting the match, in a 2–1 loss against [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]] on 17 August 2019.{{cite news|title=Southampton 1-2 Liverpool|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/49302580|publisher=BBC Sport|date=17 August 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} He soon had a first team run ins for the next two months.{{cite news|title=Southampton defender Maya Yoshida discusses Chelsea|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/17936972.southampton-defender-maya-yoshida-discusses-chelsea/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=1 October 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Sheffield United 0-1 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/49617983|publisher=BBC Sport|date=14 September 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Wolverhampton Wanderers 1-1 Southampton|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/50024400|publisher=BBC Sport|date=19 October 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} Following a [[Southampton F.C. 0–9 Leicester City F.C.|9–0]] loss to Leicester City in October, Yoshida was dropped to the bench and only played two further times for the team.{{cite news|title=Maya Yoshida believes it's a good time for Southampton to hit reset|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/18052024.maya-yoshida-believes-good-time-southampton-hit-reset/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=23 November 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Maya Yoshida: No one saw my Southampton exit coming|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/18226699.maya-yoshida-no-one-say-southampton-exit-coming/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=11 February 2020|access-date=5 April 2020}} On 30 June 2020, he confirmed his departure from the club after eight years.{{cite news|title=Maya Yoshida pens touching tribute to Southampton fans|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/18553071.maya-yoshida-pens-touching-tribute-southampton-fans/|website=Daily Echo|date=30 June 2020|access-date=20 August 2021}} ===Sampdoria=== On 31 January 2020, Yoshida joined [[Serie A]] side [[U.C. Sampdoria|Sampdoria]] on loan until the end of the season.{{cite web|title=Yoshida joins Sampdoria on loan|url=https://www.southamptonfc.com/news/2020-01-31/announcement-maya-yoshida-southampton-sampdoria-loan-deal|publisher=Southampton F.C.|access-date=1 February 2020|date=31 January 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200131202549/https://www.southamptonfc.com/news/2020-01-31/announcement-maya-yoshida-southampton-sampdoria-loan-deal|archive-date=31 January 2020|url-status=live}}
{{cite web|title=Yoshida joins from Southampton|url=https://www.sampdoria.it/en/yoshida-joins-from-southampton/|publisher=Sampdoria|access-date=1 February 2020|date=31 January 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200131232521/https://www.sampdoria.it/en/yoshida-joins-from-southampton/|archive-date=31 January 2020|url-status=live}} Local newspaper the [[Southern Daily Echo]] described Yoshida's departure as the "end of an era".{{cite news|title=Maya Yoshida has left Southampton to join Sampdoria| url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/18202922.southampton-defender-maya-yoshida-set-join-sampdoria/|publisher=[[Southern Daily Echo]]|date=31 January 2020|access-date=5 April 2020}} Having appeared on the substitute bench for two matches, Yoshida made his Sampdoria debut against [[Hellas Verona F.C.|Hellas Verona]] on 8 March 2020 and played the whole game, as the club won 2–1.{{cite news|title=吉田麻也はベンチ入りも出番なし、サンプドリアがトリノ撃破で4戦ぶり白星|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?297479-297479-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=9 February 2020|access-date=5 April 2020}}

{{cite news|title=Quagliarella ribalta il Verona e tiene la Sampdoria in zona A|url=https://www.gazzetta.it/Calcio/Serie-A/08-03-2020/quagliarella-ribalta-verona-tiene-sampdoria-zona-a-3601551803092.shtml|publisher=La Gazzetta Dello Sport|language=it|date=8 March 2020|access-date=5 April 2020}} Following his debut for Sampdoria, he quickly became a fan favourite among the club's supporters.{{cite news|title=Sampdoria, "Cianin" Yoshida è già l'idolo della tifoseria|url=https://www.ilsecoloxix.it/sport/2020/03/10/news/cianin-yoshida-e-gia-l-idolo-dei-tifosi-1.38576181|website=Il Secolo XIX (subscription required)|language=it|date=10 March 2020|access-date=20 August 2021|archive-date=21 August 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210821044641/https://www.ilsecoloxix.it/sport/2020/03/10/news/cianin-yoshida-e-gia-l-idolo-dei-tifosi-1.38576181|url-status=dead}} However, this turns out to be his only appearance for Sampdoria, as the season was suspended because of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite news|title=Emergenza Coronavirus: confermato lo stop alle attività fino al 3 aprile|url=https://www.figc.it/it/federazione/news/emergenza-coronavirus-confermato-lo-stop-alle-attivit%C3%A0-fino-al-3-aprile/|website=[[Italian Football Federation]]|language=it|date=20 March 2020|access-date=20 August 2021}}

The transfer was first reported via [[Twitter]] by [[Fabrizio Romano]] a few hours before the official announcement, with the Italian sports journalist adding that Yoshida had previously turned down several other offers, including one from [[Trabzonspor]]: the centre-back himself eventually expressed his surprise towards the accuracy of Romano's report in a [[Retweet|quote retweet]], writing, "This guy is incredible… even my wife didn't know about [[Trabzonspor]]".{{Cite web |last=Mukherjee|first=Soham|date=6 July 2023|title='Tell your wife to follow me!' - Transfer journalist Romano in cheeky dig at Yoshida after Schalke deal confirmed|url=https://www.goal.com/en/news/romano-yoshida-schalke-deal-confirmed/blt01b64c7ca3c9bf89|access-date=30 August 2023|website=Goal.com}}

2024|url-status=live}} A month later on 22 April 2024, Yoshida scored his second goal of the season, in a 4–3 win against [[San Jose Earthquakes]].{{cite
