Gabriel Pec, Riqui Puig, Joseph Paintsil and Maya Yoshida each score as Galaxy win 100th edition of Cali Clásico against San Jose|website=LA Galaxy|date=22 April 2024|access-date=25 May 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240423045339/https://www.lagalaxy.com/news/match-report-gabriel-pec-riqui-puig-joseph-paintsil-and-maya-yoshida-each-score-as-galaxy-win-100th-edition-of-cali-clasico-against-san-jose|archive-date=23 April 2024|url-status=live}} Yoshida was crowned MLS champion after defeating the [[New York Red Bulls]] in [[MLS Cup 2024]].{{cite web |last=Baxter |first=Kevin |url=https://www.latimes.com/sports/soccer/galaxy/story/2024-12-07/galaxy-vs-new-york-red-bulls-mls-cup-final-recap |title=The Galaxy are back after beating the Red Bulls for the franchise’s sixth MLS Cup |publisher=Los Angeles Times |date=7 December 2024 }} ==International career== [[File:JPN-TUR 20190109 Asian Cup 6.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Yoshida and Turkmenistan's [[Arslanmyrat Amanow]] at the [[2019 AFC Asian Cup]]]] ===Youth/Olympics career === Yoshida was first called up to Japan's U-23 team in April 2008 for the first time following good performance at Nagoya Grampus.{{cite news|title=好調・名古屋の19歳、DF吉田がU-23代表初招集|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?36158-16846-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=19 April 2008|access-date=5 April 2020|archive-date=1 April 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200401185305/https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?36158-16846-fl|url-status=dead}}
{{cite web|publisher=Sports Reference|title=Maya Yoshida Biography and Statistics|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/yo/maya-yoshida-1.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200515000000/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/yo/maya-yoshida-1.html|url-status=dead|access-date=25 July 2009|archive-date=15 May 2020}} A month later on 22 May 2008, he made his Japan U23 debut in the [[2008 Toulon Tournament|Toulon Tournament]] and started the whole game, in a 2–1 win against [[France national football team|France]].{{cite news|title=U-23デビューの吉田、空中戦で強さ発揮|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?37671-18397-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=22 May 2008|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida went on to make two appearances in the tournament, as Japan U-23 finished fourth place after reaching the semi–finals.{{cite news|title=U-23代表は4位終戦も実り多い大会に|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?37912-18673-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=30 May 2008|access-date=5 April 2020}} It was announced on 14 July 2008 that Yoshida was called up to the Japan U-23 team for the [[2008 Summer Olympic]] in Beijing.{{cite news|title=[速報]北京五輪メンバー発表|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?39697-20525-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=14 July 2008|access-date=5 April 2020}} After appearing twice as an unused substitute, he made his debut in the tournament, starting the match, in a 1–0 loss against [[Netherlands national under-21 football team|Netherlands]] on 13 August 2008 and the Samurai Blue was eliminated from the tournament.{{cite news|title=[五輪]日本vs.米国 スタメン発表|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?40688-21069-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=8 August 2008|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=[五輪]日本vsナイジェリア スタメン発表|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?40817-21691-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=10 August 2008|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=[五輪]反町ジャパンは3連敗、意地見せられず|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?40969-21839-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=13 August 2008|access-date=5 April 2020}} Four years later, Yoshida was called up to the Japan U-23 team for the second time ahead of the [[2012 Summer Olympics]] in London.{{cite news|title=ja:U−23日本代表メンバー選考に見られた2つの特徴 ロンドン五輪での戦い方に変化はあるのか|url=https://sports.yahoo.co.jp/column/detail/201207030003-spnavi|publisher=Sports Navi|language=ja|date=3 July 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite web|url=http://www.jfa.or.jp/national_team/topics/2012/324.html|title=U-23日本代表 メンバー|website=Japan Football Association|date=2 July 2012|access-date=25 May 2024|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120704142243/http://www.jfa.or.jp/national_team/topics/2012/324.html|archive-date=4 July 2012|url-status=live}} Ahead of the tournament, he was named as captain by Manager [[Takashi Sekizuka]].{{cite news|title=主将はOA枠の吉田 五輪サッカー日本男子|url=https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXNSSXKA0439_S2A720C1000000/|publisher=Nikkei|language=ja|date=22 July 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida's first match as captain came on 26 July 2012 against [[Spain national under-23 football team|Spain]] and helped the Samurai Blue keep a clean sheet, in a 1–0 win.{{cite news|title=【スペイン】現地メディアが報じた「五輪代表、日本に敗北」|url=https://sportiva.shueisha.co.jp/clm/football/wfootball/2012/07/27/post_142/|publisher=Sporiva Shueisha|language=ja|date=27 July 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} In the next two matches, he helped the Japan U-23 team keep two more clean sheets against [[Morocco national under-23 football team|Morocco U23]] and [[Honduras national under-23 football team|Honduras U23]] with a win and draw respectively, resulting in Japan U23 qualifying for the knockout stage.{{cite news|title=永井が劇的V弾!!U-23日本代表が連勝で3大会ぶりのベスト8進出決定|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?102804-104552-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=30 July 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=U－23日本代表、ホンジュラスに引き分けで予選無敗の1位で突破／ロンドン五輪|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20120802/63815.html|publisher=Soccer King|language=ja|date=2 August 2012|access-date=5 April 2020|archive-date=16 May 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210516214220/https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20120802/63815.html|url-status=dead}} Yoshida scored his first goal of the tournament, scoring a header from [[Hiroshi Kiyotake]]'s free kick, in a 3–0 against [[Egypt national under-23 football team|Egypt U23]] in the quarter–finals.{{cite news|title=永井!吉田!大津!U-23代表が3発完封で44年ぶりのベスト4進出決定|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?103087-104872-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=4 August 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} However, he continued to lead Japan U23 finished fourth place in the Olympics after losing to [[Mexico national under-23 football team|Mexico U23]] and [[South Korea national under-23 football team|South Korea U23]].{{cite news|title=初の決勝ならず...U-23代表はメキシコに逆転負けで3位決定戦へ|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?103250-105056-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=8 August 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=主将として導いた4強、吉田「オーバーエイジを引き受けてよかった」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?103384-105205-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=11 August 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} After the match, Yoshida said: "I can appreciate that the team whose initial expectation was not so high has advanced to the top four for the first time in 44 years. I do not think why I could not go on it or got a medal The Olympics are a gathering of young athletes called the U-23, and it is important that as many athletes go into the national team as A and stand on the World Cup stage."{{cite news|title=4位を悔しがるDF吉田「韓国には二度と負けたくない」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?103474-105317-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=12 August 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} In June 2021, Yoshida was named in the squad for his third [[2020 Summer Olympics|Olympic]] [[Football at the 2020 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament|tournament]], this time on home soil, as one of three available over-age players.{{Cite web|title=U-24日本代表メンバー 第32回オリンピック競技大会（2020／東京） サッカー競技（男子） キリンチャレンジカップ2021【7.12@大阪、7.17@兵庫】|url=https://www.jfa.jp/national_team/u24_2021/news/00027265/|access-date=1 July 2021|website=Japan Football Association｜公益財団法人日本サッカー協会|language=ja}} It was also announced that he would be the captain for the tournament.{{cite news|title=「皆に言いたいのは...」キャプテン麻也、東京五輪をともに戦う"後輩"へメッセージ|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?335929-335929-fl|website=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=5 July 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}}
{{cite news|title=「麻也選手から『キャプテンをやることで...』と言われた」。中山雄太の思い|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?336161-336161-fl|website=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=8 July 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}} Prior to the start of the Olympics, Yoshida was featured in three out of the four friendly matches for the Samurai Blue.{{cite news|title=堂安、久保ら攻撃陣が躍動！ ベストメンバーで臨んだU－24日本、ガーナに6発快勝|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20210605/1536928.html|website=Soccer King|language=ja|date=5 June 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}}
{{cite news|title=U-24日本代表、ジャマイカに4-0で勝利 次は本大会メンバーでキリンチャレンジカップ|url=https://www.jfa.jp/news/00027184/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=13 June 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}}
{{cite news|title=U24日本代表、ホンジュラスに3得点勝利...堂安が2発、東京五輪に向けて弾み|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20210712/1548821.html|website=Soccer King|language=ja|date=12 July 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}}
{{cite news|title=U-24日本代表 優勝候補のスペインと引き分け。課題と収穫を得る試合に～キリンチャレンジカップ2021～|url=https://www.jfa.jp/national_team/u24_2021/news/00027501/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=18 July 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}} During which, he said about the Olympics event without spectators, saying: "I'm sorry for the non-audience. A lot of customers came to see us today, and the supporters' cheers helped us during the last 5 minutes and 10 minutes. It's a difficult situation. Now it's a difficult situation no matter which one you comment on."{{cite news|title=麻也、五輪無観客に苦しい胸の内「アスリートがコメントを発することが難しい状況」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?336853-336853-fl|website=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=17 July 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}}
{{cite news|title=吉田麻也が五輪無観客開催に覚悟の訴え「真剣にもう一度検討して」「選手も毎日命をかけて...」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?336869-336869-fl|website=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=17 July 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}} Yoshida soon clarified his statement, saying it was his "personal idea".{{cite news|title=吉田麻也、有観客再検討訴えた発言は「僕の個人の考えであって正解ではない」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?336961-336961-fl|website=Web Gekisaka|date=19 July 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}} He helped Japan win all three matches in [[Football at the 2020 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament – Group A|the group stage]] to advance to the knockout stage.{{cite news|title=久保建英が決勝点！ 日本、南アフリカの堅守に苦しむも東京五輪白星発進！|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20210722/1552063.html|website=Soccer King|language=ja|date=22 July 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}}
{{cite news|title=U-24日本代表 メキシコ相手に貴重な勝点3を獲得|url=https://www.jfa.jp/national_team/u24_2021/news/00027565/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=26 July 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}}
{{cite news|title=U-24日本代表 フランスに勝利してノックアウトステージ進出|url=https://www.jfa.jp/national_team/u24_2021/news/00027600/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=28 July 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}} In the [[Football at the 2020 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament – Knockout stage#Japan vs New Zealand|quarter–final]] against [[New Zealand national under-23 football team|New Zealand]], Yoshida captained the whole game throughout 120 minutes with a goalless result and successfully converted the winning kick in the penalty shootout, as the Samurai Blue won 4–2 to reach the semi–finals.{{cite news|title=U-24日本代表、PK戦を制して準決勝進出|url=https://www.jfa.jp/national_team/u24_2021/news/00027629/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=1 August 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}}
{{cite news|title=「そういう思いはもうしたくない」キャプテン吉田麻也はロンドン五輪の雪辱誓う|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?337922-337922-fl|website=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=31 July 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}} However, Japan lost the next two matches in [[Football at the 2020 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament – Knockout stage#Semi-finals|the semi–finals]] and [[Football at the 2020 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament – Knockout stage#Bronze medal match|bronze medal match]] against [[Spain national under-23 football team|Spain]] and Mexico respectively.{{cite news|title=U-24日本代表 スペインに敗れ、3位決定戦へ|url=https://www.jfa.jp/national_team/u24_2021/news/00027649/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=4 August 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}}
{{cite news|title=U-24日本代表 1-3でメキシコに敗れ、東京オリンピックを4位で終える|url=https://www.jfa.jp/national_team/u24_2021/news/00027672/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=7 August 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}} Despite failing to win a medal as he hoped for, Yoshida reflected about being captain for Japan in the Olympics, saying: "I had a lot of fun. I thought I could give everyone something, but young players could absorb a lot of things. I think I was able to grow as a player. Let's be proud and go home. I want to be proud and go home. This is not the end. Still, my soccer life will continue."{{cite news|title=力尽くした主将の望み...吉田麻也「最後、メダリストになりたい」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?338147-338147-fl|website=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=3 August 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}}
{{cite news|title=「何としても勝たせてあげたい」...3位決定戦での必勝誓う吉田麻也|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?338157-338157-fl|website=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=4 August 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}}
{{cite news|title=3度目の五輪で悲願のメダル獲得ならず...吉田麻也「それでもやっぱりサッカー人生は続く」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?338308-338308-fl|website=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=6 August 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}} ===Senior career=== [[File:Brazil-Japan, Confederations Cup 2013 (12).jpg|thumb|right|300px|Yoshida and [[Neymar]] clashing for a ball during an opening match of the [[2013 FIFA Confederations Cup|2013 Confederations Cup]] between [[Brazil national football team|Brazil]] and [[Japan national football team|Japan]]]] In December 2009, Yoshida was called up to the [[Japan national football team|senior national team]] for the first time.{{cite news|title=平均年齢20.95歳の若きA代表、イエメン戦の先発メンバーは?|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?63317-48112-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=21 December 2009|access-date=5 April 2020}} He made his full international debut for [[Japan national football team|Japan]] on 6 January 2010 in a [[2011 AFC Asian Cup]] qualifier against [[Yemen national football team|Yemen]].{{cite news|title=平山がデビュー戦でハット!!若きA代表が鮮やか逆転勝ち|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?63959-49013-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=6 January 2010|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida later reflected on his debut, saying: "Of course Yemen war of 2010 (3-2) because it was all the way to the target, I was happy."{{cite news|title=吉田麻也独占インタビュー「置かれている状況でベストを出し続ける」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?139260-139260-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=19 May 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}} After fracturing his fingers, Yoshida stated that he was determined to recovery from his injury and hope to get called up for the [[2010 FIFA World Cup|2010 World Cup]] squad.{{cite news|title=VVV吉田「W杯あきらめない」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?68325-55336-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=5 March 2010|access-date=5 April 2020|archive-date=2 April 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200402205532/https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?68325-55336-fl|url-status=dead}} However, Yoshida did not make the cut.{{cite news |script-title=ja:ファンが選んだ日本代表23人 FWは意外な結果に... |url=https://www.sponichi.co.jp/soccer/news/2010/05/09/kiji/K20100509Z00000030.html|publisher=Sponichi Annex|language=ja|date=9 May 2010|access-date=5 April 2020}} In December 2010, Yoshida was called up to the Japan's squad for the [[2011 AFC Asian Cup]] in [[Qatar]].{{cite news|title=平均年齢20.95歳の若きA代表、イエメン戦の先発メンバーは?|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?63317-48112-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=21 December 2009|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=ＶＶＶ吉田麻也が代表入り！ザックに感謝|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/f-sc-tp2-20101224-717164.html|website=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=24 December 2010|access-date=25 May 2024}} Under the management of [[Alberto Zaccheroni]], it's emerged that he is expecting to start in the centre–back position ahead of the tournament.{{cite news|title=怪我人続出でDFライン再編へ。チャンスつかむのは槙野?伊野波? それとも吉田?|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?78291-69753-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=24 December 2010|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=故障者続出のピンチもチャンスに、新22番・吉田が存在感|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?78937-70654-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=8 January 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=2日連続で一部非公開。CB先発に吉田が浮上|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?78868-70567-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=6 January 2011|access-date=5 April 2020|archive-date=3 April 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200403182456/https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?78868-70567-fl|url-status=dead}} Yoshida scored his first Japan goal, in a 1–1 draw against [[Jordan national football team|Jordan]] on 9 January 2011.{{cite news|title=ロスタイム同点 吉田が救った／アジア杯|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/asiancup/2011/news/p-sc-tp2-20110110-722813.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=10 January 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida started two more matches in the group-stage, as Japan progressed through the knockout stage.{{cite news|title=吉田AKBに負けたがシリアには勝つ|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/asiancup/2011/news/p-sc-tp2-20110113-723932.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=13 January 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=川島代役の西川がシャットアウト、"予行練習"も兼ねた完封劇|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?79415-71276-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=18 January 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}} However, Yoshida was sent–off for a second bookable offence, in a 3–2 win against [[Qatar national football team|Qatar]] in the quarter–finals of the AFC Asian Cup.{{cite news|title=香川2発!伊野波劇弾!ザックジャパンが10人で地元カタールに逆転勝利|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?79595-71538-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=21 January 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}} After serving a one match suspension, Yoshida returned to the starting line-ups in the [[2011 AFC Asian Cup Final|AFC Asian Cup Final]] against [[Australia men's national soccer team|Australia]] and played 120 minutes, as they beat the Socceroos 1–0 to win the AFC Asian Cup, thanks to [[Tadanari Lee]].{{cite news|title=川島止めた！止めた！外させた／アジア杯|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/asiancup/2011/news/p-sc-tp2-20110126-728955.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=26 January 2011|access-date=25 May 2024}}
{{cite news|title=2大会ぶり最多4度目のアジア制覇!途中出場・李の劇弾で延長戦制す|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?79959-72010-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=29 January 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}} Between 7 June 2011 and 2 September 2011, Yoshida kept three consecutive three cleans; including once against [[North Korea national football team|North Korea]], which he scored the only goal of the game.{{cite news|title=3-4-3を90分間貫くも遠いゴール...ザックジャパンは2戦連続スコアレスドロー|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?85685-80048-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=7 June 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=香川、復活2発!ザックジャパンが韓国から37年ぶり3得点で歴史的大勝|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?88671-84014-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=10 August 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=日本-北朝鮮は0-0で後半へ|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?89709-85388-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=2 September 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida kept an additional three more clean sheets between 7 October 2011 and 11 November 2011.{{cite news|title=日本－ベトナム戦 試合詳細／親善試合|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/f-sc-tp2-20111007-846263.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=7 October 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=日本8－0タジク 試合詳細／W杯予選|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/f-sc-tp2-20111011-848332.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=11 October 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=日本、4-0でタジキスタン下す W杯アジア予選|url=https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXNASDH11038_R11C11A1000001/|publisher=Nikkei Website|language=ja|date=11 November 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}} Following the Olympics, Yoshida continued to help Japan by keeping three consecutive clean sheets between 6 September 2012 and 12 October 2012 against [[United Arab Emirates national football team|UAE]], [[Iraq national football team|Iraq]] and [[France national football team|France]].{{cite news|title=ザックジャパン１－０勝利！ハーフナーが頭で決めた|url=https://www.sponichi.co.jp/soccer/news/2012/09/06/kiji/K20120906004057740.html|website=Sponichi Annex|language=ja|date=6 September 2012|access-date=22 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=前田が決勝ヘッド！日本１－０でイラクを下す|url=https://www.sponichi.co.jp/soccer/news/2012/09/11/kiji/K20120911004093740.html|website=Sponichi Annex|language=ja|date=12 September 2012|access-date=22 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=歴史的勝利は大金星か…強豪撃破で浮かび上がった日本の現在地／フランス戦|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/sk_column/article/76428.html|website=Soccer King|language=ja|date=13 October 2012|access-date=22 September 2024}} He later helped Japan qualify for the World Cup after drawing 1–1 against Australia on 4 June 2013.{{cite news|title=本田がロスタイムに同点PK!!世界最速で5大会連続のW杯出場決定|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?115582-119800-fl|publisher=Web Gekisak|language=ja|date=4 June 2013|access-date=5 April 2020}} Two days later, Yoshida was called up to the Samurai Blue for the [[2013 FIFA Confederations Cup|2013 Confederations Cup]] squad.{{cite news|script-title=ja:もし一人足せるとしたら、日本代表に誰を選ぶ？|url=https://www.footballchannel.jp/2013/06/06/post5164/|publisher=Football Channel Website|language=ja|date=6 June 2013|access-date=5 April 2020|archive-date=29 March 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200329203954/https://www.footballchannel.jp/2013/06/06/post5164/|url-status=dead}} He was featured three times in the tournament, as Japan loss all three matches and was eliminated in the group stage.{{cite news|title=日本代表、ブラジル戦完敗に落胆 コンフェデ杯|url=https://www.afpbb.com/articles/-/2950560|website=AFP BB News|language=ja|date=16 June 2013|access-date=22 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=イタリアに３発も逆転負け／コンフェデ杯|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/f-sc-tp2-20130620-1144904.html|website=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=20 June 2013|access-date=22 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=川島 意地のＰＫ阻止！３戦全敗も「自信を持って」|url=https://www.sponichi.co.jp/soccer/news/2013/06/24/kiji/K20130624006074140.html|publisher=Sponichi Annex|language=ja|date=24 June 2013|access-date=5 April 2020}} [[File:Maya Yoshida 2018.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Yoshida playing for Japan during a match against [[Belgium national football team|Belgium]] in the round of 16 of the [[2018 FIFA World Cup|FIFA World Cup]]]] In May 2014, Yoshida was named in Japan's preliminary squad for the [[2014 FIFA World Cup|2014 World Cup]] in Brazil.{{cite news|script-title=ja:日本のW杯予備登録選手をフライング発表|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/brazil2014/news/p-sc-tp0-20140510-1298516.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=10 May 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}} In the end, he made it to the final cut for the 23-man squad.{{cite news|script-title=ja:大久保、斎藤ら選出 W杯メンバー一覧|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/brazil2014/news/f-sc-tp0-20140512-1299866.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=12 May 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida started all three matches despite facing competitions from the centre–back and subsequently, Japan was eliminated from the tournament in the group stage, without winning any matches.{{cite news|title=Yoshida is first choice|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/11052965.yoshida-is-first-choice/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=5 March 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=熾烈なCB争いにも吉田「競争はウェルカム」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?140287-140287-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=5 June 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=最後まで競争を促すザック「レギュラーを決めるのは難しい」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?140345-140345-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=6 June 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|script-title=ja:日本 コートジボワールに逆転負けで黒星発進...本田先制弾も実らず|url=https://www.sponichi.co.jp/soccer/news/2014/06/15/kiji/K20140615008370750.html|publisher=Sponichi Annex|language=ja|date=15 June 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=コロンビアに敗れ、ワールドカップ敗退|url=https://www.jfa.jp/news/00001105/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=25 May 2013|access-date=25 May 2024}} Despite this, he kept a clean sheet in a 0–0 draw against [[Greece national football team|Greece]] on 20 June 2014.{{cite news|script-title=ja:サポーターも見放した！？ザック采配に厳しすぎる採点 更迭論も|url=https://www.sponichi.co.jp/soccer/news/2014/06/22/kiji/K20140622008417530.html|publisher=Sponichi Annex|language=ja|date=22 June 2014|access-date=5 April 2020}} Later in 2014, Yoshida scored his first Japan's goal in three years, as the Samurai Blue beat [[Honduras national football team|Honduras]] 6–0 on 14 November 2014.{{cite news|title=日本、ホンジュラスに6-0大勝 キリンチャレンジカップ2014|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/20141118/news/00002599/|publisher=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=14 November 2014|access-date=25 May 2024}} In December 2014, Yoshida was selected as a member of the Japanese team for the [[2015 AFC Asian Cup]] in Australia.{{cite news|title=アジアカップ日本代表23選手が発表…本田、香川、清武らが選出|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20141215/259077.html|publisher=Soccer King|language=ja|date=15 December 2014|access-date=25 May 2024}} He played Japan's opener match against debutant [[Palestine national football team|Palestine]] and scored the final goal in a 4–0 win.{{cite news|script-title=ja: パレスチナに4-0快勝で連覇へ好発進 ～AFCアジアカップ第1戦～|url= https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/asiancup2015/news/00003163/|publisher=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=13 January 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida helped Japan keep two more clean sheets to advance through to the quarter–finals.{{cite news|title=連覇懸かる日本代表、本田のPKでアジアカップ連勝…グループ首位で最終節へ|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20150116/271947.html|publisher=Soccer King|language=ja|date=16 January 2015|access-date=25 May 2024}}
{{cite news|script-title=ja: 本田が3戦連弾＆香川は代表9戦ぶり得点…日本3連勝でアジア杯、グループ首位通過|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20150120/273304.html|publisher=Soccer King|language=ja|date=20 January 2015|access-date=25 May 2024}} However, he conceded a goal from [[Ali Mabkhout]] before Japan equalised and the match was played throughout 120 minutes; ultimately, they were eliminated after losing in penalty–shootout.{{cite news|title= UAEにPK戦で惜敗、4強入り逃す ～AFCアジアカップ準々決勝～|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/asiancup2015/news/00004707/|publisher=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=23 January 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}} After the match, Yoshida acknowledged his fault for conceding a goal from the opposition team.{{cite news|title=痛恨の今大会初失点...麻也「失点は僕のミス」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?156103-156103-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=23 January 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}} Throughout Japan's matches in the World Cup qualifying round, Yoshida then scored again in a 3–0 win against [[Cambodia national football team|Cambodia]] on 3 September 2015.{{cite news|title=カンボジアに3-0勝利で、ワールドカップ予選初白星|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/20150903/news/00007294/|publisher=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=3 September 2015|access-date=25 May 2024}} He later helped Japan keep two more clean sheets for Samurai Blue against [[Afghanistan national football team|Afghanistan]] and [[Syria national football team|Syria]].{{cite news|title=ハリルジャパン、"敵地"でようやくゴールラッシュ…香川豪快ミドル弾など6発大勝|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20150908/348188.html|publisher=Soccer King|language=ja|date=8 September 2015|access-date=25 May 2024}}
{{cite news|title=日本E組首位！3得点シリア撃破／W杯2次予選詳細|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/1550010.html |publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=8 October 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida kept four more clean sheets for Japan in the World Cup qualifying round between 12 November 2015 and 29 March 2016.{{cite news|title=SAMURAI BLUE、カンボジアに2-0勝利|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue_2015/news/00008014/|website=Japan Football Association|date=18 November 2015|access-date=25 May 2024}}
{{cite news|title=SAMURAI BLUE、シリアに5-0勝利で1位突破 ～FIFAワールドカップアジア2次予選最終戦～|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/news/00009301/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=30 March 2016|access-date=25 May 2024}} During the run, he scored two goals against [[Singapore national football team|Singapore]] and Afghanistan.{{cite news|title= SAMURAI BLUEシンガポールに3-0勝利で首位奪回 ～FIFAワールドカップ予選第5戦～|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/20151112/news/00007965/|publisher=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=12 November 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=【日本 5-0 アフガニスタン】岡崎のファインゴールを皮切りにゴールラッシュで大勝！|url=https://www.soccerdigestweb.com/news/detail/id=14853|publisher=Soccer Digest Web|language=ja|date=24 March 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}} Three months later on 3 June 2016, Yoshida scored a brace, scoring in the fourth and five goal, in a 7–2 win against [[Bulgaria national football team|Bulgaria]] to help the Samurai Blue reach the final of the [[Kirin Cup Soccer#2016 Kirin Cup Soccer|Kirin Cup Soccer]].{{cite news|title=ハリル日本、ブルガリアに7発圧勝／キリン杯詳細|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/1657223.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=3 June 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}} However, Japan loss 2–1 in the Kirin Cup Soccer final against [[Bosnia and Herzegovina national football team|Bosnia and Herzegovina]] on 7 June 2016.{{cite news|title=SAMURAI BLUE、ボスニアに逆転負けで準優勝 ～キリンカップ決勝～|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/kirincupsoccer_2016/news/00010028/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=7 June 2016|access-date=25 May 2024}} The following March, he captained Samurai Blue for the first time in his career and helped the Japan beat UAE 2–0.{{cite news|title=「長谷部さんがいなくて負けたと言われたくなかった」 UAEの前に立ちはだかった"キャプテン"麻也|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?212093-212093-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=22 March 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=SAMURAI BLUE、UAEに快勝 ～ アジア最終予選（Road to Russia）第6戦～|url=https://www.jfa.jp/national_team/news/00013057/|publisher=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=24 March 2017|access-date=25 May 2024}} After the match, Yoshida said: "I have played several times in my team, but it is a big thing to be the captain of the national team. I felt it."{{cite news|title=キャプテンマークを巻いた麻也「誇りになる1日だった」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?212107-212107-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=24 March 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}} In a follow–up match against [[Thailand national football team|Thailand]], he scored again, in a 4–0 win.{{cite news|title=日本、4発快勝でW杯出場へ前進！ 香川、岡崎、久保、吉田がゴール...川島はPK阻止|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20170328/568484.html|publisher=Soccer King|language=ja|date=28 March 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}} Three months later, on 31 August 2017, Yoshida started the match and beat Australia 2–0, earning Japan a place in the World Cup in Russia.{{cite news|title=日本6大会連続W杯！浅野V弾／アジア最終予選詳細|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/1880295.html |publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=31 August 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}} [[File:Qatar - Japan, AFC Asian Cup 2019 38.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Yoshida booked for handball during a match against [[Qatar national football team|Qatar]] in the [[2019 AFC Asian Cup Final|AFC Asian Cup final]]; leading to a penalty converted successfully from the opposition team and resulting Japan losing 3–1]] On 31 May 2018, Yoshida was selected in the 23-man squad for the [[2018 FIFA World Cup]] in Russia.{{cite web|url=https://www.japantimes.co.jp/sports/2018/05/31/soccer/nishino-reveals-23-man-squad-world-cup|title=Nishino reveals 23-man squad for World Cup|work=The Japan Times|date=31 May 2018|access-date=7 July 2018}}
{{cite news|title= 2018FIFAワールドカップロシア SAMURAI BLUE（日本代表）メンバー・スケジュール|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/news/00017671/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=31 May 2018|access-date=25 May 2024}} It was expected once again that Yoshida will be starting in the centre–back position ahead of the tournament.{{cite news|title=新システムの手応えは!? 麻也「試合をやってみないと分からない」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?245914-245914-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=29 May 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}}{{cite news|title=米メディアがロシアW杯へ臨む日本代表を解説...攻撃陣の要は本田圭佑?|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?243639-243639-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=2 May 2018|access-date=5 April 2020|archive-date=1 May 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220501030331/https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?243639-243639-fl|url-status=dead}}
{{cite news|title=ベルギーメディアがベスト16で対戦の西野ジャパンを分析「我々を窮地に追い込む可能性がある」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?248562-248562-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=30 June 2018|access-date=5 April 2020|archive-date=14 April 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220414192006/https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?248562-248562-fl|url-status=dead}} He played every single minute in all the group stage matches against [[Colombia national football team|Colombia]], [[Senegal national football team|Senegal]] and [[Poland national football team|Poland]].{{cite news|title=SAMURAI BLUE、香川選手と大迫選手の得点でコロンビアに勝利～2018FIFAワールドカップロシア～|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/news/00017859/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=19 June 2018|access-date=22 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=SAMURAI BLUE、セネガルと引き分けて16強進出へ前進～2018FIFAワールドカップロシア～|url=https://jfa.jp/samuraiblue/news/00017902/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=25 June 2018|access-date=23 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=SAMURAI BLUE、ポーランドに黒星も2位で16強に進出～2018FIFAワールドカップロシア～|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/news/00017935/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=28 June 2018|access-date=22 September 2024}} However, Japan was knocked out of the tournament after losing 3–2 to [[Belgium national football team|Belgium]] in the round of 16 match.{{cite news|title=SAMURAI BLUE、ベルギーに逆転負けで8強に1歩及ばず～2018FIFAワールドカップロシア～|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/worldcup_2018/news/00017982/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=3 July 2018|access-date=22 September 2024}} His performance in the World Cup earned praises from the British media, such as, [[The Guardian]] and [[BBC Sport]].{{cite news|title=吉田麻也の名前も...英紙がここまでのロシアW杯ベストイレブンを選出|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?248211-248211-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=26 June 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=吉田麻也が最高点獲得で英メディアのMOMに!ルカクを90分間抑えたことを評価|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?248864-248864-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=3 July 2018|access-date=5 April 2020|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220416074838/https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?248864-248864-fl|archive-date=16 April 2022|url-status=dead}} In December 2018, Yoshida was one of 23 Japanese players selected for the [[2019 AFC Asian Cup]].{{cite web|title=SAMURAI BLUE (Japan National Team) Squad, Schedule - AFC Asian Cup UAE 2019 (1/5-2/1)|url=https://www.jfa.jp/eng/news/00019975/|date=13 December 2018|website=Japan Football Association|access-date=5 April 2020}} Ahead of the tournament, he was given the captaincy once again.{{cite news|title=若手にのしかかる期待...麻也はプレッシャーを歓迎「戦えないとやっていけない」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?263682-263682-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=8 January 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida started the tournament as captain well when he helped Japan win 3–2 against [[Turkmenistan national football team|Turkmenistan]].{{cite news|title=日本大迫2発、堂安弾でヒヤヒヤ勝利／アジア杯詳細|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/201901080001324.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=10 January 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida led the Samurai Blue all the way to the final, as well as, keeping four clean sheets along the way.{{cite news|title=日本代表、2連勝でアジア杯決勝T進出！ 原口のPK弾でオマーンを下す|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20190114/891839.html|publisher=Soccer King|language=ja|date=14 January 2011|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=日本8強！冨安V弾サウジ下す／アジア杯決勝T詳細|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/201901210000391.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=21 January 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=日本代表、堂安の"VAR弾"でベスト4進出！ FIFAランク100位のベトナムに辛くも勝利|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20190124/897439.html|publisher=Soccer King|language=ja|date=24 January 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=大迫2発だ！原口1発だ！日本3発決勝 イラン撃破|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/201901290000012.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=29 January 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} In the [[2019 AFC Asian Cup Final|AFC Asian Cup final]] against Qatar, he started and captained Japan, as the Samurai Blue loss 3–1, finishing as runner–up in the tournament.{{cite news|title=SAMURAI BLUE、カタールに敗れて準優勝～AFCアジアカップUAE2019（1/5～2/1）～|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/news/00020414/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=1 February 2019|access-date=22 September 2024}} During the match, he was penalised for handball, leading Qatar to successfully convert the penalty to give the opposition team a 3–1 lead.{{cite news|title=吉田麻也のハンドでのPK判定に海外有力メディアも同情 「これまで見た中で最もバカげたPKの一つ」|url=https://www.goal.com/jp/%E3%83%8B%E3%83%A5%E3%83%BC%E3%82%B9/%E5%90%89%E7%94%B0%E9%BA%BB%E4%B9%9F%E3%81%AE%E3%83%8F%E3%83%B3%E3%83%89%E3%81%A7%E3%81%AEpk%E5%88%A4%E5%AE%9A%E3%81%AB%E6%B5%B7%E5%A4%96%E6%9C%89%E5%8A%9B%E3%83%A1%E3%83%87%E3%82%A3%E3%82%A2%E3%82%82%E5%90%8C%E6%83%85-%E3%81%93%E3%82%8C%E3%81%BE%E3%81%A7%E8%A6%8B%E3%81%9F%E4%B8%AD%E3%81%A7%E6%9C%80%E3%82%82%E3%83%90%E3%82%AB%E3%81%92%E3%81%9Fpk%E3%81%AE%E4%B8%80%E3%81%A4/1aouv8fuff1uq1t4dsoox87tak|publisher=Goal.com|language=ja|date=2 February 2019|access-date=25 May 2024}} After the match, Yoshida said: "I felt that the team had a good performance in the (semi-final) match against Iran, and they felt that they were going to be able to go this way and be able to go this way. I couldn't control, and I didn't win. I feel unhappy."{{cite news|title=悔恨のキャプテン...麻也「チームの油断や隙を律することができず不甲斐ない」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?265399-265399-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=2 February 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} However, Yoshida's call-up to the tournament caused squad selection problems for new Southampton manager [[Ralph Hasenhüttl]] during his absence.{{cite news|title=Southampton boss Ralph Hasenhuttl discusses Maya Yoshida|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/17417412.southampton-boss-ralph-hasenhuttl-discusses-maya-yoshida/|publisher=DSouthern Daily Echo|date=8 February 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} In response, he acknowledged the risk he took by playing for Japan in the Asian Cup.{{cite news|title=Southampton defender Maya Yoshida is itching to play again|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/17461314.southampton-defender-maya-yoshida-is-itching-to-play-again/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=27 February 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} ～キリンチャレンジカップ2019（9/5＠鹿嶋）、2022FIFAワールドカップカタールアジア2次予選（9/10＠ミャンマー）～|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/news/00022519/|publisher=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=30 August 2019|access-date=25 May 2024}} He was also given the captaincy.{{cite news|title=7か月ぶり復帰のキャプテン麻也に絶対の信頼、森保監督「心配してない」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?283893-283893-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=2 September 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} Yoshida captained the remaining matches of 2019 with clean sheets.{{cite news|title=森保ジャパンが強豪パラグアイを破る／スコア詳細|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/201909040000723.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=4 September 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=日本がミャンマーに快勝！ カタールW杯へ好発進...久保はアジア予選最年少出場記録を更新|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20190910/978162.html|publisher=Soccer King|language=ja|date=10 September 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=日本3発快勝！南野2発＆浅野弾／W杯2次予選詳細|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/201910150000027.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=15 October 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} During this run, he scored his first international goal of the year, in a 6–0 win against [[Mongolia national football team|Mongolia]] on 10 October 2019.{{cite news|title=森保日本6発快勝、モンゴル撃破／W杯2次予選詳細|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/201910100000497.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=10 October 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} On 14 November 2019, Yoshida also played his 100th match for Japan against [[Kyrgyzstan national football team|Kyrgyzstan]].{{cite web|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/18029630.southampton-defender-maya-yoshida-closes-landmark-moment/|title=Southampton defender Maya Yoshida closes in on landmark moment|website=Southern Daily Echo|date=12 November 2019}}
{{cite news|title=日本南野弾など2発で完封勝利／W杯2次予選詳細|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/201911140000536.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=14 November 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} Almost a year later, in October 2020, he was called up to the Samurai Blue squad.{{cite news|title=南野拓実が代表10番！鎌田9、久保建英17／一覧|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/202010060000931.html|website=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=6 October 2020|access-date=20 August 2021}} He started four matches as captain by the end of the year and helped Japan keep three consecutive clean sheets before losing to [[Mexico national football team|Mexico]] on 17 November 2020.{{cite news|title=Samurai Blue 約1年ぶりの試合でカメルーン代表とドロー|url=https://www.jfa.jp/news/00025474/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=10 October 2020|access-date=20 August 2021}}
{{cite news|title=植田直通が劇的ゴール！ 日本、コートジボワールを下して2020年初勝利|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20201014/1130374.html|website=Soccer King|language=ja|date=14 October 2020|access-date=20 August 2021}}
{{cite news|title=SAMURAI BLUE、後半躍動し南野選手のPKでパナマ代表に勝利|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/20201117/news/00025716/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=13 November 2020|access-date=22 September 2024}}
{{cite news|title=SAMURAI BLUE メキシコ代表に後半2失点で今季初黒星|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/news/00025747/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=17 November 2020|access-date=25 May 2024}} At the beginning of 2021, Yoshida continued to retain his captaincy and helped the Samurai Blue kept another three consecutive clean sheets against [[South Korea national football team|South Korea]], [[Mongolia national football team|Mongolia]] and [[Myanmar national football team|Myanmar]] in the [[2022 FIFA World Cup qualification (AFC)|FIFA World Cup qualification]].{{cite news|title=Samurai Blue 韓国代表に3-0快勝|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/news/00026593/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=26 March 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}}
{{cite news|title=日本、W杯予選最多14ゴールでモンゴルに大勝！ 無傷の5連勝で最終予選進出に王手|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20210330/1242763.html|website=Soccer King|language=ja|date=31 March 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}}
{{cite news|title=大迫が圧巻5ゴール！ 南野は6戦連発、日本代表がミャンマーに10得点圧勝で最終予選進出|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20210528/1533996.html|website=Soccer King|language=ja|date=28 May 2021|access-date=20 August 2021}} After losing 1–0 against [[Saudi Arabia national football team|Saudi Arabia]] on 7 October 2021, he confronted the section of Saudi Arabia supporters, angrily accusing them of making fun of him while conducting a post-match interview.{{cite news|title=【Match Report】SAMURAI BLUE、サウジアラビアに0-1惜敗で勝点積み上げならず|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/worldcup_2022/final_q/news/00028072/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=8 October 2021|access-date=25 May 2024}}
{{cite news|title=吉田麻也、予選敗退なら「すっぱり辞める」 屈辱敗戦を糧に逆転切符へ覚悟|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/202110080000924.html|website=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=8 October 2021|access-date=25 May 2024}} Despite this, Yoshida led Japan to qualify for the [[2022 FIFA World Cup|FIFA World Cup]] in Qatar after Samurai Blue beat Australia 2–0.{{cite news|title=【Match Report】SAMURAI BLUE、三笘選手の2得点でオーストラリアに勝利、7大会連続出場決定|url=https://www.jfa.jp/news/00029276/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=24 March 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}} In a follow–up match against [[Vietnam national football team|Vietnam]], he scored a second–half equaliser, in a 1–1 draw.{{cite news|title=【Match Report】SAMURAI BLUE、吉田選手の得点でベトナムに引き分けてアジア最終予選2位で終了|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/news/00029319/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=29 March 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}} Two months later, Yoshida was called up to the Japan's squad for the [[2022 Kirin Cup Soccer|Kirin Cup Soccer]].{{cite news|title=ブラジル戦など4連戦に臨む日本代表メンバー28名が発表！ 伊藤洋輝が初招集|url=https://www.soccer-king.jp/news/japan/national/20220520/1650133.html|website=Soccer King|language=ja|date=29 May 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}} He played in both matches for the Samurai Blue in the tournament, as Japan finished as runners-up after losing 3–0 against [[Tunisia national football team|Tunisia]].{{cite news|title=【Match Report】SAMURAI BLUE、ガーナ代表に4-1快勝でキリンカップ決勝進出|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/kirincupsoccer_2022/news/00029809/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=11 June 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}}
{{cite news|title=【Match Report】SAMURAI BLUE、チュニジア代表に後半3失点でキリンカップ優勝を逃す|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/news/00029839/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=15 June 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}} His performances at Schalke 04 led to uncertainties on whether Yoshida would be included in the Japan's World Cup squad in Qatar. But on 1 November 2022, he was included as part of the Samurai Blue's 26 man squad for the [[2022 FIFA World Cup|FIFA World Cup]] in [[Qatar]].{{cite news|title=FIFAワールドカップカタール2022™ SAMURAI BLUE（日本代表）メンバー|url=https://www.jfa.jp/news/00030869/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=1 November 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}} Yoshida, once again, was placed as captain ahead of the tournament and formed a centre–back partnership with [[Ko Itakura]] and [[Shogo Taniguchi]].{{cite news|title=板倉とのCBコンビで先発濃厚の吉田麻也「ここで頭と心のギアを上げないと」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/japan/detail/?372991-372991-fl|website=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=17 November 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}}
{{cite news|title=「サウジが大きなことを成し遂げたので…」吉田麻也がアジア勢勝利に刺激を受け奮起！ 強豪ドイツ撃破も「次が大事」と冷静コメント【W杯】|url=https://www.soccerdigestweb.com/news/detail/id=121090|website=Soccer Digest Web|language=ja|date=24 November 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}}
{{cite news|title=日本の歴史を塗り替える日に…吉田麻也「このチャンスは4年後にしか来ない」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/japan/detail/?374461-374461-fl|website=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=5 December 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}} He played all three matches in the group and led Japan reach the group stage for the second time in a row.{{cite news|title=【Match Report】SAMURAI BLUE、ドイツに歴史的な逆転勝利で白星発進|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/worldcup_2022/news/00031096/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=24 November 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}}
{{cite news|title=【Ｗ杯】日本、コスタリカ堅守に０－１黒星…１勝１敗で決勝トーナメント進出は一転してピンチに|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/qatar2022/news/202211270001610.html|website=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=27 November 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}}
{{cite news|title=【Match Report】SAMURAI BLUE、スペインに逆転勝ちで2大会連続の16強進出|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/worldcup_2022/news/00031164/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=2 December 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}} After the match against [[Spain national football team|Spain]], Yoshida reflected on the performance: "I have no words. I can't quit playing for the national team because of [[2022 FIFA World Cup Group E#Japan vs Spain|this]]. It was awesome."{{cite news|title=「言葉にならない。最高」主将の吉田麻也がスペイン撃破の喜びを語る！「もっと上に行きたい。日本の歴史を塗り替えたい」【Ｗ杯】|url=https://www.soccerdigestweb.com/news/detail/id=121970|website=Soccer Digest Web|language=ja|date=2 December 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}} On 5 December 2022, Yoshida set up a goal for [[Daizen Maeda]], who scored a goal at the 43rd minute to put Samurai Blue in front during the round of 16 game against [[Croatia national football team|Croatia]], which eventually ended 1–1 with Japan crashing out after their defeat on penalties, which he was one of the three players unsuccessfully converted in the shootout.{{cite news|title=【Match Report】SAMURAI BLUE、クロアチアにPK戦で敗れて16強越えならず|url=https://www.jfa.jp/samuraiblue/worldcup_2022/news/00031190/|website=Japan Football Association|language=ja|date=6 December 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}}
{{cite news|title= Japan – Kroatien: Tränen nach Drama – Ausgerechnet ER wird zum tragischen Helden|url=https://www.derwesten.de/sport/fussball/japan-kroatien-wm-2022-maya-yoshida-fc-schalke-04-s04-elfmeterschiessen-id300338075.html|website=Der Westen|language=de|date=5 December 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}} After Japan's elimination in the World Cup, Yoshida hinted at retiring from international football.{{cite news|title=【W杯】吉田麻也、代表からの引退示唆「僕はもうそこには」「ゆっくり考えます」／一問一答|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/qatar2022/news/202212060000340.html|website=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=6 December 2022|access-date=25 May 2024}} Yoshida played his final game for the ''Samurai Blue'' on 31 May 2026, starting as captain in a 1–0 friendly win against [[Iceland national football team|Iceland]]. He received a [[Guard of honour#Sports|guard of honour]] from both sets of players as he was substituted off in the 14th minute, handing the captain's armband to [[Wataru Endo]].{{Cite web |date=2026-06-01 |title=Saints hero Yoshida given standing ovation on final appearance for Japan |url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/26154071.southampton-hero-yoshidas-standing-ovation-final-japan-appearance/ |access-date=2026-06-01 |website=Daily Echo |language=en}} ==Personal life== Yoshida has two brothers: Mirei and Honami He later credited his older brother, Honami, for playing an important role in his football career.{{cite web |date=25 May 2014 |title=【W杯23戦士名鑑（6）】DF吉田麻也 兄貴たちへ恩を返す"嫁にしたい"強い男 |url=http://www.zakzak.co.jp/sports/soccer/news/20140525/soc1405250830002-n1.htm |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200331193903/http://www.zakzak.co.jp/sports/soccer/news/20140525/soc1405250830002-n1.htm |archive-date=31 March 2020 |access-date=5 April 2020 |publisher=Zakzak |language=ja}} Before he was born, his name "Maya" was originally planned for a girl when his mother was pregnant. But the name was kept even if it was a boy who was born. Yoshida revealed on his blog on 26 September 2012 that he was married.{{cite news|title=吉田麻也さんのブログを読んで書いた結婚記事を読んでから結婚報告ブログを読んだ件。|url=https://news.livedoor.com/article/detail/6992247/?escode=pcmax|publisher=News Livedoor|language=ja|date=27 September 2012|access-date=5 April 2020}} Four years later, Yoshida revealed he was a first time father when his wife gave birth to a baby daughter.{{cite news|title=吉田麻也がついにパパに! 長女誕生をブログで報告「子育てブログに変わるかも」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?205558-205558-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=16 December 2016|access-date=5 April 2020}} During his time at Southampton, Yoshida resided in [[Winchester]].{{cite web|url=https://www.southamptonfc.com/news/2019-04-08/programme-feature-interview-maya-yoshida-april-2019|title=Feature Interview: Maya Yoshida|publisher=Southampton F.C.|date=8 April 2019|access-date=5 April 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200405162619/https://www.southamptonfc.com/news/2019-04-08/programme-feature-interview-maya-yoshida-april-2019|archive-date=5 April 2020|url-status=live}} After spending seven years at Southampton, Yoshida revealed in an interview with SunSport that he had become a permanent resident in the United Kingdom and feels 25 per cent English.{{cite news|title=吉田麻也 英国の永住権を取得「公式にイングランド人になりました」在英6年半で|url=https://www.sponichi.co.jp/soccer/news/2019/03/10/kiji/20190310s00002021352000c.html|publisher=Sponichi Annex|language=ja|date=10 March 2019|access-date=10 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=イングランドで6年半。永住権取得の 吉田麻也の言葉はズシリと重い|url=https://sportiva.shueisha.co.jp/clm/football/wfootball/2019/03/12/_split_25/|publisher=Sportiva Shueisha|language=ja|date=12 March 2019|access-date=10 April 2020}} His family runs a boarding house in Nagasaki for children who cannot go to high school. Growing up, Yoshida revealed that he is a fan of the [[anime]] and [[manga]] series ''[[Dragon Ball Z]]'', and had an entire collection of ''Dragon Ball Z'' memorabilia until his father donated them to charity. Yoshida reflected on this, saying it helped him to think generously and give back to society.{{cite news|title=Maya Yoshida: 'My dad is the most crazy Japanese man. But his gestures inspired me'|url=https://inews.co.uk/sport/football/premier-league/maya-yoshida-southampton-charity-interview-saints-foundation-495708|publisher=iNews|date=16 August 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}} In November 2007, Yoshida affiliated himself with [[FIFA]] [[Sports agent|Players' Agent]] [[Tetsuro Kiyooka]], in hopes of moving to Europe. It worked when he joined VVV-Venlo, three years after becoming Kiyooka's client.{{cite news |date=27 November 2007 |title=名古屋の19歳DF吉田が海外視野に代理人契約 |url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?30486-11129-fl |access-date=5 April 2020 |publisher=Web Gekisaka |language=ja |archive-date=31 March 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200331193521/https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?30486-11129-fl |url-status=dead }} Since moving to Europe, Yoshida created a personal blog, where he reflected about his experience living and playing in a different continent.{{cite news|title=VVVの吉田麻也がブログ開設|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/world/news/f-sc-tp3-20100320-607997.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=20 March 2010|access-date=5 April 2020}} On every anniversary of the [[Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki|Atomic bombings]], Yoshida, who is from Nagasaki, spoke out about his thoughts of the event.{{cite news|title=吉田麻也、原爆投下70年目の思い「戦争、原爆についてきちんと学んでいこう」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?169278-169278-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=9 August 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=長崎出身の吉田麻也、原爆の日に世界へメッセージ|url=https://www.nikkansports.com/soccer/japan/news/1869503.html|publisher=Nikkan Sports|language=ja|date=9 August 2017|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=FC Schalke 04: S04-Star Yoshida postet schreckliches Foto – der Grund ist traurig|url=https://www.derwesten.de/sport/fussball/s04/fc-schalke-04-s04-maya-yoshida-nagasaki-bombenabwurf-1945-hiroshima-id236112479.html|website=Der Westen|language=de|date=9 August 2022|access-date=25 May 2024|archive-date=25 May 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240525064522/https://www.derwesten.de/sport/fussball/s04/fc-schalke-04-s04-maya-yoshida-nagasaki-bombenabwurf-1945-hiroshima-id236112479.html|url-status=dead}} In May 2018, Yoshida published his first book titled ''Unbeatable Mind''.{{cite news|title=Maya Yoshida's written about his 'Unbeatable Mind'|url=https://www.dailyecho.co.uk/sport/16248065.maya-yoshidas-written-about-his-unbeatable-mind/|publisher=Southern Daily Echo|date=25 May 2018|access-date=5 April 2020}} In addition to his native [[Japanese language|Japanese]], Yoshida speaks fluent [[English language|English]] since he first studied the language in middle school,{{cite news|title=英移籍の可能性報じられる岡崎に麻也「英語の勉強を」|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?155288-155288-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=10 January 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=吉田麻也が流暢な英語を披露、公式会見でさすがの語学力発揮|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?263677-263677-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=8 January 2019|access-date=5 April 2020}}
{{cite news|title=先発出場&決勝点で冗舌に?吉田が英語インタビューで笑いを誘う|url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?182504-182504-fl|publisher=Web Gekisaka|language=ja|date=7 February 2019|access-date=5 April 2020|archive-date=14 April 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220414184043/https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?182504-182504-fl|url-status=dead}} as well as having studied [[Italian language|Italian]] and [[Spanish language|Spanish]] during his professional footballing career,{{cite news |date=12 February 2020 |title=吉田麻也、新型コロナでセリエA延期も「ピンチをチャンスに。イタリア語の勉強に励みたい」 |url=https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?299604-299604-fl |access-date=5 April 2020 |publisher=Web Gekisaka |language=ja |archive-date=1 May 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220501152653/https://web.gekisaka.jp/news/detail/?299604-299604-fl |url-status=dead }}{{cite news|title=Maya Yoshida interview: 'If people call this success, it is not enough for me'|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/news-and-comment/maya-yoshida-interview-if-people-call-this-success-it-is-not-enough-for-me-10107108.html |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/20220512/https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/news-and-comment/maya-yoshida-interview-if-people-call-this-success-it-is-not-enough-for-me-10107108.html |archive-date=12 May 2022 |url-access=subscription |url-status=live|work=The Independent|date=12 March 2015|access-date=5 April 2020}}{{cite news|title=Yoshida e quello "speak" in diretta.
