us|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/sport/9255713.samba-need-blackburn-rovers-fans-us/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=16 September 2011|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Kean presents the case for Blackburn Rovers' defence|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/sport/9306559.kean-presents-case-blackburn-rovers-defence/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=14 October 2011|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=No need to panic, insists Blackburn Rovers defender|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/sport/9311343.no-need-panic-insists-blackburn-rovers-defender/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=18 October 2011|access-date=3 May 2020}} On 15 October 2011, Samba scored his first goal of [[2011–12 Blackburn Rovers F.C. season|2011–12 season]] against [[Queens Park Rangers F.C.|Queens Park Rangers]] in a 1–1 draw.{{cite news|title=FULL-TIME: QPR 1 Blackburn Rovers 1|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/sport/9308469.full-time-qpr-1-blackburn-rovers-1/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=15 October 2011|access-date=3 May 2020}} He scored his second goal against [[Norwich City F.C.|Norwich City]] in a 3–3 draw on 29 October 2011.{{cite news|title=FULL TIME: Norwich City 3 Blackburn Rovers 3|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/sport/9333883.full-time-norwich-city-3-blackburn-rovers-3/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=29 October 2011|access-date=3 May 2020}} However, during a 1–0 loss against Chelsea on 5 November 2011, Samba suffered a hamstring injury and was substituted at half time, leading him to be sidelined throughout November.{{cite news|title=FULL TIME: Blackburn Rovers 0 Chelsea 1|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/sport/9347040.full-time-blackburn-rovers-0-chelsea-1/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=5 November 2011|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Blackburn Rovers manager Steve Kean fears lengthy Chris Samba absence|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/sport/9347117.blackburn-rovers-manager-steve-kean-fears-lengthy-chris-samba-absence/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=5 November 2011|access-date=3 May 2020}} On 3 December 2011, he returned to the starting line–up against [[Swansea City A.F.C.|Swansea City]] and set up the club's third goal of the game, in a 4–3 win.{{cite news|title=Blackburn Rovers 4–3 Swansea City|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/15901858|publisher=BBC Sport|date=3 December 2011|access-date=3 May 2020}} Samba set up two goals in the next two matches against Sunderland and [[West Bromwich Albion F.C.|West Bromwich Albion]].{{cite news|title=Sunderland 2–1 Blackburn Rovers|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/16021619|publisher=BBC Sport|date=11 December 2011|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Blackburn Rovers 1–2 West Bromwich Albion|url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/eng_prem/16124142.stm|publisher=BBC Sport|date=17 December 2011|access-date=3 May 2020}} Manager Kean felt that Samba has been treated unfairly by referees in a number of matches, due to his physical presence.{{cite news|title=Kean fears Samba is being unfairly treated|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/sport/9425684.kean-fears-samba-unfairly-treated/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=17 December 2011|access-date=3 May 2020}} On 31 December 2011, Samba was part of the squad that recorded a win against Manchester United, defeating [[Alex Ferguson]]'s side at [[Old Trafford]] 2–3. A foul on Samba in the [[penalty area]] by [[Dimitar Berbatov]] resulted in Blackburn being awarded a penalty which Blackburn scored.{{cite news|title=FULL TIME: Manchester United 2 Blackburn Rovers 3|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/sport/9446212.full-time-manchester-united-2-blackburn-rovers-3/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=31 December 2011|access-date=3 May 2020}} By the time he left the club, Samba went on to make seventeen appearances and scoring two times in all competitions. The following, Samba handed in a transfer request following a bid from Queens Park Rangers, which was rejected.{{cite news|title=Blackburn turn down QPR's bid for defender Christopher Samba| url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/16442700|publisher=BBC Sport|date=6 January 2012|access-date=24 February 2012}}
{{cite news|title=Blackburn Rovers determined to hold on to skipper Samba|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/sport/9453926.blackburn-rovers-determined-hold-skipper-samba/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=5 January 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} On 14 January, Samba missed Blackburn's victory over Fulham, though manager Steve Kean attributed this to a stomach virus.{{cite news|title=Blackburn Rovers captain Samba a doubt after missing training with illness|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/news/9471939.blackburn-rovers-captain-samba-doubt-missing-training-illness/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=13 January 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Samba should make Everton return, says Blackburn Rovers boss|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/sport/9473552.samba-make-everton-return-says-blackburn-rovers-boss/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=16 January 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} On 17 January 2012, Blackburn turned down Samba's transfer request and issued a statement saying that the Rovers captain was not for sale.{{cite news|title=Blackburn Rovers turn down Chris Samba's transfer request|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2012/jan/17/blackburn-chris-samba-transfer-request|newspaper=The Guardian|date=17 January 2012|access-date=24 February 2012}} The player, himself, issued a statement the previous day, saying, "In my five years at Blackburn Rovers I have always given 100% in every game I have played. I have had several opportunities to leave but I have always stayed. I have decided now is the right time for me to pursue a new challenge and I have asked the club to respect my decision and allow me to leave. I thank the fans for their support and I hope they feel I have served them and their club well."{{cite news|title=Blackburn Rovers defender Samba reveals transfer request|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/sport/9474420.blackburn-rovers-defender-samba-reveals-transfer-request/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=16 January 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} Samba continued issuing a statement to leave the club, citing not "100 per cent for the club" anymore.{{cite news|title=Samba again calls for Ewood Park exit|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/sport/9497279.samba-calls-ewood-park-exit/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=27 January 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} As a result, he was dropped from the starting line–up and never played for the side again.{{cite news|title=Christopher Samba left out of Blackburn squad to face Arsenal|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/16862359|publisher=BBC Sport|date=2 February 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Samba's return to be delayed, reveals boss|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/sport/9527148.sambas-return-delayed-reveals-boss/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=13 February 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} By the time Samba left the club, he made 185 appearances and scoring 18 times in all competitions. Samba said about his departure, saying: "Blackburn is still in my heart; it was a big part of my life. I am sorry where they are now. It was very difficult, but then Steve Kean was doing quite well in the Championship and they sacked him. Now they have sacked [[Henning Berg]]. The main thing: I am sorry for the fans. We had a good identity together, and now they have lost a bit of that identity".{{cite news|title=Christopher Samba: With Guus Hiddink I knew the project was real|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2013/jan/10/christopher-samba-russian-football-anzhi-makhachkala|work=The Guardian|date=10 January 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} Samba also credited both Manager Hughes and Allardyce as the two managers, who played a major role in his football career.{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Хьюз и Эллардайс – два самых важных тренера в моей карьере"|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/1027914203.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=12 March 2015|access-date=3 May 2020}} ===Anzhi Makhachkala=== [[File:Christopher Samba 2012.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Samba pictured in his first spell at [[FC Anzhi Makhachkala|Anzhi Makhachkala]] in 2012.]] On 24 February 2012, Samba completed a move to Russian club [[FC Anzhi Makhachkala|Anzhi Makhachkala]] on a four-year deal for an undisclosed fee thought to be in the region of £12.3 million, with a salary of £100,000 per week.{{cite news|title=Samba heads to Russia|url=http://www.rovers.co.uk/page/NewsDetail/0,,10303~2623128,00.html|publisher=Blackburn Rovers F.C.|date=24 February 2012|access-date=28 February 2012|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120228082036/http://www.rovers.co.uk/page/NewsDetail/0%2C%2C10303~2623128%2C00.html|archive-date=28 February 2012}}
{{cite news|title=Samba seals Anzhi switch|url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12691/7544955/Samba-seals-Anzhi-switch|publisher=Sky Sports|date=24 February 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} Following his move to Russia, he was given the number 22 shirt.{{cite news|title=Самба заявлен за "Анжи под 22-м номером|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/485770/|publisher=Sports Express|language=ru|date=25 February 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} Upon joining the club, Samba said the move was unexpected, yet a new challenge in his career and a new experience.{{cite news|title= Кристофер Самба: "Переход в "Анжи" стал довольно неожиданным"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/485810/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=25 February 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Анжи" предоставил мне возможность получить новый опыт"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/486377/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=28 February 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} [[File:Christopher Samba.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Samba playing for Anzhi Makhachkala in his second season.]] Samba made his debut for Anzhi on 5 March 2012, with the team defeating [[FC Dynamo Moscow|Dynamo Moscow]] 1–0, therefore keeping a [[Shutout|clean sheet]].{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Очень легко адаптировался к тому стилю игры, который проповедует Хиддинк"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/487793/|publisher=Sports Express|language=ru|date=5 March 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} After the match, he was named Matchday 33’s Team of the Week.{{cite news|title=Символическая сборная 33-го тура|url=https://www.championat.com/football/article-3157553-simvolicheskaja-sbornaja-33-go-tura.html|publisher=Championat.ru|language=ru|date=6 March 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} Since making his debut for the club, Samba quickly established himself in the starting eleven, forming a partnership with [[João Carlos Pinto Chaves|João Carlos]].{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Моя мечта - играть в Лиге чемпионов"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/reviews/802558/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=6 March 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Самба: постараемся сдержать Кураньи и Воронина|url=https://www.championat.com/football/article-3161671-samba-postaraemsja-sderzhat-kurani-i-voronina.html|publisher=Championat.ru|language=ru|date=12 April 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Поле в Казани худшее из всех, что я видел за карьеру"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/493209/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=1 April 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} His performance earned him the club's Player of the Month for March.{{cite news|title=Самба признан лучшим игроком ФК "Анжи" в марте по версии болельщиков|url=https://rsport.ria.ru/20120403/589504642.html|publisher=R Sport|language=ru|date=3 April 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} He scored his first goal for the team on 6 May 2012 in the 3–1 home win over [[FC Rubin Kazan|Rubin Kazan]] in a [[Russian Football Premier League|Russian Premier League]] match.{{cite news|title="Анжи" обыграл "Рубин" и гарантировал себе участие в еврокубках|url=https://www.championat.com/football/news-1174190-anzhi-obygral-rubin.html|publisher=Championat.ru|language=ru|date=6 May 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} After the match, Samba was named Matchday 43’s Team of the Week.{{cite news|title=Символическая сборная 43-го тура Премьер-Лиги|url=https://www.championat.com/football/article-3164747-simvolicheskaja-sbornaja-43-go-tura-premer-ligi.html|publisher=Championat.com|language=ru|date=10 May 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} Despite missing two matches during the 2011–12 season, he went on to make ten appearances and scored once in all competitions.{{cite news|title=К матчу с "Локомотивом" Самба, Гаджибеков и Жусилей должны быть в строю|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/497511/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=25 April 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Самба не сыграет с "Зенитом"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/500306/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=10 May 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} At the start of the 2012–13 season, Samba helped the club keep six clean sheets and progress to the UEFA Europa League Group Stage after beating the teams of [[Budapest Honvéd FC|Budapest Honvéd]], [[SBV Vitesse|Vitesse]] and [[AZ Alkmaar]].{{cite news|title="Анжи" победил "Гонвед" с минимальным перевесом|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/europa-league/news/513194/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=19 July 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title="Анжи" разгромил "Гонвед"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/europa-league/news/514532/page3/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=26 July 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title="Анжи" в Раменском со счётом 2:0 победил "Витесс"|url=https://www.championat.com/football/news-1267364-anzhi-v-ramenskom-so-schjotom-20-pobedil-vitess.html|publisher=Championat.ru|language=ru|date=2 August 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title="Витесс" — "Анжи" — 0:2: махачкалинцы вышли в следующий раунд Лиги Европы|url=https://www.championat.com/football/news-1274924-vitess---anzhi---02-makhachkalincy-vyshli-v-sledujushhij-raund-ligi-evropy.html|publisher=Championat.com|language=ru|date=9 August 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title="Анжи" — "АЗ Алкмар" — 1:0: гол Траоре принёс махачкалинцам победу в первой игре|url=https://www.championat.com/football/news-1287748-anzhi---az-alkmar-gol-traore-prinjos-makhachkalincam-pobedu-v-pervom-matche.html|publisher=Championat.com|language=ru|date=23 August 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Очередной триумф "Анжи"|url=https://www.championat.com/football/article-3177221-anzhi-so-schjotom-50-razgromil-az-alkmar-v-matche-ligi-evropy.html|publisher=Championat.com|language=ru|date=31 August 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} He also started the season as well in the league, assisting two goals in the first two league matches against [[FC Kuban Krasnodar|Kuban Krasnodar]] and [[FC Rostov]].{{cite news|title=Вторая минимальная победа "Анжи"|url=https://www.championat.com/football/article-3172313-vtoraja-minimalnaja-pobeda-anzhi.html|publisher=Championat.com|language=ru|date=22 July 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title="Ростов" не удержал победу над "Анжи"|url=https://news.sportbox.ru/Vidy_sporta/Futbol/Russia/premier_league/spbnews_NI324170_Rostov-ne-uderzhal-pobedu-nad-Anzhi?page_offset=0&page_size=30|publisher=Sports Box|language=ru|date=29 July 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} On 2 September 2012, he scored his first goal of the season, in a 2–1 loss against [[PFC Krylia Sovetov Samara|Krylia Sovetov Samara]].{{cite news|title="Крылья Советов" проиграли "Анжи"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/521911/|publisher=Sports Express|language=ru|date=2 September 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} Samba continued to regain his first team place, playing in the centre–back position.{{cite news|title=Владимир Габулов: "Самба не раз брал без спроса мои перчатки"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/europa-league/news/518001/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=10 August 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Никита Бурмистров: "Самый веселый в "Анжи" – Самба"|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/143383371.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=14 September 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Без Диарра, Жусилея и Ахмедова на оборону приходилось больше нагрузки"|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/144263834.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=26 October 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} Two months later on 4 November 2012, he scored his second goal of the season, in a 3–1 win against [[FC Akhmat Grozny|Terek Grozny]].{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба забил гол в ворота "Терека"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/536117/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=4 November 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} Three weeks later on 22 November 2012, Samba scored his third goal of the season, in a 2–0 win against [[Udinese Calcio|Udinese]] to qualify for the UEFA Europa League Knockout Stage.{{cite news|title="Анжи" переиграл "Удинезе" и вышел в плей-офф Лиги Европы|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/europa-league/news/540384/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=22 November 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} However, during the match, he received a heavy blow to the head and was sidelined as a result.{{cite news|title=Защитник "Удинезе", столкнувшийся с Самба, перенес операцию на лице|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/italy/news/540768/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=22 November 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Лежа на газоне, не понимал, где я нахожусь"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/europa-league/news/540472/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=23 November 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} On 2 December 2012, Samba returned to the starting line–up and helped the side win 2–0 against CSKA Moscow.{{cite news|title=Сергей Кирьяков: "Судейство в матче "Анжи" – ЦСКА было адекватным"|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/145173406.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=2 December 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} By the time he departed Anzhi Makhachkala in January, Samba went on to make twenty–nine appearances and scoring three times in all competitions. ====First racism incident in Russia==== [[File:Samba Christopher.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Samba pictured after the match while playing for Anzhi Makhachkala.]] During a match between Anzhi and [[FC Lokomotiv Moscow|Lokomotiv Moscow]] on 17 March 2012, which Lokomotiv won 1–0, a crowd at Lokomotiv allegedly threw a banana at Samba after the match.{{cite news|title=Самба: такие люди не желают быть узнанными|url=https://www.championat.com/football/article-3159399-samba-takie-ljudi-ne-zhelajut-byt-uznannymi.html|publisher=Championat.ru|language=ru|date=23 March 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title="ЛОКОМОТИВ" - "АНЖИ" - 1:0 НА ЭТОТ РАЗ ЖЕРТВОЙ БАНАНОМЕТАТЕЛЯ СТАЛ САМБА|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/newspaper/2012-03-19/4_1/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=19 March 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} In response, Samba threw the banana back into the crowd, which he expressed regret in doing. Samba spoke out saying that he was saddened by the incident happening close to children. "I am very sad that this happened in front of children who were sitting in the same stand," the Congo international told reporters after the game. "It is a really bad example for them."{{cite news|title=Самба вернул банан обратно на трибуну|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/490513/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=18 March 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} Following the incident, Anzhi issued a statement, describing the action of the banana throwing as "idiotic."{{cite news|title="Анжи" выступил с заявлением по "банановому делу" в Черкизове|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/490603/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=19 March 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Anzhi regrets 'idiotic' banana throwing incident|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/soccer/news?slug=capress-soc_russia_racism-17400127|archive-url=https://archive.today/20120714214816/http://sports.yahoo.com/soccer/news?slug=capress-soc_russia_racism-17400127|url-status=dead|archive-date=14 July 2012|publisher=Yahoo! Sport|date=19 March 2012|access-date=26 April 2012}} This banana incident thrown at Samba led [[Sergey Fursenko]], the president of the [[Russian Football Union]] (RFS), to promise that the authorities were already investigating the incident to identify the person who threw the banana at Samba.{{cite news|title=Anzhi Makhachkala call on Lokomotiv Moscow to identify person who threw banana at defender Christopher Samba|url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/9154215/Anzhi-Makhachkala-call-on-Lokomotiv-Moscow-to-identify-person-who-threw-banana-at-defender-Christopher-Samba.html|publisher=The Telegraph|date=19 March 2012|access-date=26 April 2012|first=Max|last=de Haldevang}}
{{cite news|title=Создана специальная комиссия Комитета РФС по этике для борьбы с расизмом на стадионах|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/news/491038/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=21 March 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} Both clubs (Anzhi Makhachkala and Lokomotiv) issued a joint statement, vowing to find the fan who racially abused Samba and publicly punish him.{{cite news|title=Anzhi Makhachkala & Lokomotiv Moscow vow to make an example out of fan who racially abused Christopher Samba|url=http://www.goal.com/en/news/553/russia/2012/03/23/2986349/anzhi-makhachkala-lokomotiv-moscow-vow-to-make-an-example-out-of-|publisher=Goal.com|date=23 March 2012|access-date=26 April 2012|first=Enis|last=Koylu}}
{{cite news|title=Герман Ткаченко: "С больной головы на здоровую"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/490803/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=20 March 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Черкизовское "дело о банане" может повлечь за собой поправки к одному из основных документов РФС.|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/newspaper/2012-03-23/4_4/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=23 March 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} However, Anzhi Makhachkala publicly criticised Lokomotiv's "interference" after the club claimed its fans did not throw a banana at Samba, with Anzhi's vice-president German Chistyakov saying, "It seems FC Lokomotiv is trying to interfere in the investigation... We are confident this is nothing but an absolute nonsense and foolishness."{{cite news|title=Anzhi angered by Lokomotiv's Samba banana row claims|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/17479438|publisher=BBC Sport|date=22 March 2012|access-date=26 April 2012}} On 30 March 2012, the Russian Football Union confirmed the authorities had identified the thrower and that the thrower was a college student from Moscow.{{cite news|title=Spartak Moscow's Emenike fined despite racist abuse|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/17572890|publisher=BBC Sport|date=31 March 2012|access-date=19 December 2012}}
{{cite news|title=Владимир Васильев: "Мы не можем назвать имя "бананщика" в целях его личной безопасности"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/492749/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=30 March 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} Weeks after the incident, Samba vowed to stay at Anzhi despite the racism he experienced.{{cite news|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2012/apr/09/chris-samba-anzhi-makhachkala-racism|title=Chris Samba to stay with Anzhi Makhachkala despite racist taunts|newspaper=The Guardian|access-date=26 April 2012 | date = 9 April 2012}} Samba said: {{cquote|"I feel extremely passionately about racism in football and will never let the small community of racists break me, I'm a strong character and will keep fighting for my team. I am thoroughly enjoying my time in Russia and although I was of course angry at the racism incident, along with the rest of the football world, racist issues here are no different to what I have experienced in other countries.}} Nine months after incident, Samba spoke out on racism, accusing [[FC Zenit Saint Petersburg|Zenit Saint Petersburg]] supporters, specifically a small group of Zenit fans who are openly against homosexual or non-white players playing for Zenit, as racist and described their actions as "living in another century."{{cite news|title=Zenit St Petersburg fans are no good and racist – Christopher Samba|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/20781804|publisher=BBC Sport|date=19 December 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Фанаты "Зенита" - расисты"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/546187/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=19 December 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} But he later clarified the interview, regarding the club's supporters, saying: "I have no personal complaints against the fans of Zenit Saint Petersburg. Some groups of fans scare me. And not only this, but also other clubs that are negatively opposed to black players".{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "У меня нет личных претензий к болельщикам "Зенита"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/546352/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=20 December 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} ===Queens Park Rangers=== On 31 January 2013, Samba joined [[Queens Park Rangers F.C.|Queens Park Rangers]] for a reported fee of £12.5 million, signing a four-and-a-half-year deal.{{cite web|url=http://www.qpr.co.uk/news/article/310113-samba-seals-switch-630071.aspx|title=EXCLUSIVE: R'S SEAL SAMBA SWITCH|publisher=Queens Park Rangers F.C.|date=31 January 2013|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130203103112/http://www.qpr.co.uk/news/article/310113-samba-seals-switch-630071.aspx|archive-date=3 February 2013|url-status=dead}} Following his transfer move, QPR manager [[Harry Redknapp]] commented that "Chris is just what we need. He's a monster. Great in the air, quick, a leader, strong, fantastic in both boxes, hard as nails. He's a proper centre-half. He was willing to take a massive pay cut."{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/21274454|title=Christopher Samba: QPR sign Anzhi defender for £12.5m|publisher=BBC Sport|date=31 January 2013|access-date=9 June 2013}} Samba made his Queens Park Rangers debut, starting the whole game, in a 0–0 draw against Norwich City on 2 February 2013.{{cite news|title=Queens Park Rangers 0–0 Norwich City|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/21209130|publisher=BBC Sport|date=2 February 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} Since making his debut for the club, he quickly established himself in the starting eleven, playing in the centre–back position.{{cite news|title=Monday Night Football: QPR defending unexplainable, says Sky Sports' Gary Neville|url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11711/8524466/monday-night-football-qpr-defending-unexplainable-says-sky-sports-gary-neville|publisher=Sky Sports|date=25 February 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite web|url=https://www.qpr.co.uk/news/archive/harry-no-fresh-injury-worries/|title=HARRY – NO FRESH INJURY WORRIES|publisher=Queens Park Rangers F.C.|date=28 March 2013|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200502203713/https://www.qpr.co.uk/news/archive/harry-no-fresh-injury-worries/|archive-date=2 May 2020|url-status=live}}
{{cite web|url=https://www.qpr.co.uk/news/archive/joe-s-praise-for-january-signings/|title=JOE'S PRAISE FOR JANUARY SIGNINGS|publisher=Queens Park Rangers F.C.|date=13 March 2013|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200502203709/https://www.qpr.co.uk/news/archive/joe-s-praise-for-january-signings/|archive-date=2 May 2020|url-status=live}} The club's poor results since joining Queens Park Rangers has led Samba commenting that he was ashamed over the defeats.{{cite news|title= Christopher Samba 'ashamed' of QPR defeat at Swansea|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/21535099|publisher=BBC Sport|date=21 February 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} During a 3–2 loss against Fulham on 1 April 2013, Samba was at fault when "he gave away the penalty for the opener, then getting robbed of possession to set up the second".{{cite news|title=Fulham 3–2 Queens Park Rangers|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/21921182|publisher=BBC Sport|date=1 April 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} After the match, he issued an apology to fans via his social media account.{{cite web|url=http://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/football/news/fulham-3-1-qpr-christopher-samba-1797701|title=Hoops a daisy! QPR's Christopher Samba 'really sorry' for blunders at Fulham|first=Alex|last=Hankin|date=2 April 2013|website=mirror}} Despite expressing confidence of the relegation survival, Queens Park Rangers, however, was eventually relegated to the Championship following a 0–0 draw against [[Reading F.C.|Reading]] on 28 April 2013.{{cite news|title=Reading 0-0 Queens Park Rangers: Fittingly dismal match confirms that both clubs are relegated|url=https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/football/match-reports/reading-0-0-queens-park-rangers-1310977|publisher=Daily Mirror|date=28 April 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Chris Samba confident QPR can avoid relegation from Premier League|url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11711/8477255/chris-samba-confident-qpr-can-avoid-relegation-from-premier-league|publisher=Sky Sports|date=7 February 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} Following this, Samba suffered an injury that kept him out for the rest of the 2012–13 season.{{cite news|title=QPR 0 Arsenal 1: Walcott keeps Spurs' push for fourth at bay|url=https://www.standard.co.uk/sport/football/qpr-0-arsenal-1-walcott-keeps-spurs-push-for-fourth-at-bay-8604080.html|publisher=The Standard|date=4 May 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} Despite this, he went on to make ten appearances for the side. ===Return to Anzhi=== On 2 July 2013, Anzhi agreed a fee of £12 million to bring Samba back to Russia after only half a season with QPR following their relegation from the Premier League.{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/23145192|title=Christopher Samba: QPR agree £12m fee with Anzhi for defender|publisher=BBC Sport|date=2 July 2013| access-date=2 July 2013}} Rangers were looking to cut their wage bill after dropping out of the English Premier Division, with Samba one of the highest earners on a reported £100,000 per week.{{cite news|title=Летом "КПР" планирует продать Самба|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/england/news/568303/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=7 July 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} The move was confirmed on 5 July 2013 as he signed a four–year contract with the club.{{cite news|title=Самба заключил четырехлетний контракт с "Анжи"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/588350/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=5 July 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} Ironically, Samba said in an interview that he would never return to Russia.{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Не планирую возвращаться в Россию"|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/147289667.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=5 July 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} Samba made his second debut for Anzhi Makhachkala in the opening game of the season, coming on as a late substitute, in a 2–2 draw against Lokomotiv Moscow.{{cite news|title=Махачкалинский "Анжи" не смог дома обыграть московский "Локомотив"|url=https://rg.ru/2013/07/14/anzi-anons.html|publisher=RGRU|language=ru|date=14 July 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} In a follow–up match, he scored his first goal in his second spell for the club, in a 2–1 loss against Dynamo Moscow.{{cite news|title="Динамо" вырвало победу на 96-й минуте|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/591086/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=19 July 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} After a month at Anzhi Makhachkala, they chose to transfer list their whole squad, including Samba, himself, in a wake of the following financial restructuring.{{cite news|title=Керимов объявил игрокам о распродаже|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/594994/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=7 August 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} He announced his intention to leave the club as a result.{{cite news|title=Самба настроен покинуть "Анжи"|url=https://www.sports.ru/tribuna/blogs/ksnews/495446.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=17 August 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} Despite this, he made three more appearances, making a total of five by the time he departed Anzhi Makhachkala for the second time.{{cite news|title="Анжи" лишился очков и со сменщиком Г.Хиддинка|url=https://sportrbc.ru/news/575543f29a794710298846b2?ruid=NaN|publisher=Sport BC|language=ru|date=28 July 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title="Зенит" обыграл "Анжи", отправив в ворота соперника три безответных мяча|url=https://www.championat.com/football/news-1607484-zenit-obygral-anzhi-otpraviv-v-vorota-sopernika-tri-bezotvetnykh-mjacha.html|publisher=Championat.com|language=ru|date=17 August 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Неудачи "Анжи" продолжились поражением от "Краснодара"|url=https://sportrbc.ru/news/5755459d9a79471029885451?ruid=UET9A16tgd+lK1MBA9qgAg==|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=24 August 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} ===Dynamo Moscow=== [[File:Din-Krasn (8).jpg|thumb|left|200px|Samba playing for [[FC Dynamo Moscow|Dynamo Moscow]] in his second season.]] On 29 August 2013, [[FC Dynamo Moscow|Dynamo Moscow]] signed three players from Anzhi, with Samba being one of them.{{cite web|url=http://en.rsport.ru/football/20130829/683469749.html|title=Dynamo Snatch 3 More Anzhi Players: Samba, Gabulov, Ionov|publisher=rsport|date=29 August 2013|access-date=3 September 2013|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130903044401/http://en.rsport.ru/football/20130829/683469749.html |archive-date=3 September 2013}} He was issued the number 84 shirt. However, Samba's family were still based in England. For this reason, Samba was periodically linked with moves back to an English club.{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба получил предложение от "Вест Хэма"|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/152194052.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=19 August 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Защитник "Динамо" Самба ведет переговоры с английскими клубами|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/154683697.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=28 November 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} [[File:Christopher Samba 2014.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Samba pictured in his first season at [[FC Dynamo Moscow|Dynamo Moscow]] in away shirt.]] Having spent two matches on the substitute bench, Samba made his FC Dynamo Moscow debut, coming on as a 76th-minute substitute, in a 3–1 loss against Lokomotiv Moscow on 21 September 2013.{{cite news|title=Дан Петреску: "Практически все новички "Динамо" не полностью готовы к сезону"|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/152822166.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=12 September 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|script-title=ru:"Локомотив" обыграл "Динамо"|url=http://www.championat.com/football/news-1635908-lokomotiv-obygral-dinamo.html|publisher=Championat.com|language=ru|date=21 September 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} After making his debut, he acknowledged not being in shape as the reason on the substitute bench.{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Я пока не в лучшей форме"|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/153059289.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=21 September 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} Samba made his first start for the side, playing the whole game against Rubin Kazan five days later on 26 September 2013, but scored an own goal, in a 2–2 draw.{{cite news|title=Видео. "Рубин" — "Динамо"|url=https://www.championat.com/football/news-1640974-video-rubin---dinamo.html|publisher=Championat.com|language=ru|date=26 September 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} However, his first team opportunities became limited and was placed on the substitute bench.{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "К сожалению, "Салют" забил в первом же моменте"|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/153996692.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=30 October 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Самба: "Всегда чувствую уверенность в своих силах, знаю, чего стою"|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/155971053.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=18 January 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Динамо" по силам побороться за чемпионство»|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/155885094.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=15 January 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}} After returning to full training from injury, he made his return to the starting line–up on 8 December 2013, in a 2–0 win against [[FC Amkar Perm|Amkar Perm]].{{cite web|url=https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5305|title="Динамо" (Москва) – "Амкар" (Пермь) - 2:0 (0:0)|publisher=FC Dynamo Moscow|language=ru|date=8 December 2013|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200502193914/https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5305|archive-date=2 May 2020|url-status=live}} In a follow–up match against CSKA Moscow, Samba scored his first goal for the club, as Dynamo Moscow won 4–2.{{cite web|url=https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5498|title=Камбэк в квадрате|publisher=FC Dynamo Moscow|language=ru|date=9 March 2014|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200502193929/https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5498|archive-date=2 May 2020|url-status=live}} However, during the match, he suffered a concussion and was substituted in the 61st minute.{{cite news|title="Динамо" – ЦСКА. Самба унесли с поля на носилках|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/158496437.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=9 March 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}} After serving one match suspension, Samba returned to the starting line–up, starting the whole game, in a 0–0 draw against Rubin Kazan on 23 March 2014.{{cite web|url=https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5525|title=Не хватило бронебойных...|publisher=FC Dynamo Moscow|language=ru|date=23 March 2014|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200502193942/https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5525|archive-date=2 May 2020|url-status=live}} He then scored his second goal of the season, in a 5–0 win against [[FC Volga Nizhny Novgorod|Volga Nizhny Novgorod]] on 14 April 2014.{{cite web|url=https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5563|title="Волга" vs "Динамо" - 0:5 (0:0)|publisher=FC Dynamo Moscow|language=ru|date=14 April 2014|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200502193956/https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5563|archive-date=2 May 2020|url-status=live}} However, Samba missed the last three matches of the season, due to suspension and injury.{{cite news|title="Ростов" - "Динамо": три главных противостояния|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/reviews/826369/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=2 May 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Кокорин не сыграет с "Зенитом" из-за простуды|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/686880/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=11 May 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}} At the end of the 2013–14 season, he went on to make eleven appearances and scoring two times in all competitions. [[File:Dinamo-PSV (6).jpg|thumb|left|200px|Samba pictured in the club's pre–match against [[PSV Eindhoven]] in the [[UEFA Europa League]] match.]] At the start of the 2014–15 season, Samba started the season well when he scored the club's second goal of the game, in a 7–2 win against Rostov in the opening game of the season.{{cite news|title="Динамо" разгромило "Ростов", проведя в его ворота семь мячей|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/714543/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=3 August 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}} Ten days later on 13 August 2013, Samba scored his second goal of the season, in a 2–0 win against [[FC Ufa|Ufa]].{{cite news|title= "Динамо" победило "Уфу", Вальбуэна отдал две голевые передачи|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/717597/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=13 August 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}} He then scored in both legs against [[AC Omonia|Omonia]] in the UEFA Europa League Play–Offs, resulting a 4–3 win on aggregate to progress to the group stage.{{cite news|title="Динамо" сыграло вничью с "Омонией" в Химках|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/europa-league/news/720234/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=21 August 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title="Динамо" - в основном турнире Лиги Европы|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/europa-league/news/722456/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=28 August 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}} He continued to regain his first team place, playing in the centre–back position.{{cite news|title=10 лучших защитников РФПЛ по нашим оценкам|url=https://www.championat.com/football/article-3250875-garaj-samba-chorluka-i-drugie-luchshie-zashhitniki.html|publisher=Championat.com|language=ru|date=14 December 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Символическая сборная легионеров РФПЛ-2014/15|url=https://www.championat.com/football/article-3246747-simvolicheskaja-sbornaja-legionerov-rfpl-2014-15.html|publisher=Championat.com|language=ru|date=17 October 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Должно сойтись много факторов, чтобы "Динамо" выиграло Лигу Европы"|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/1026734257.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=25 January 2015|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Необходимо стать той же командой, что была в первой части сезона"|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/1030006250.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=24 March 2015|access-date=3 May 2020}} Samba scored his fifth goal of the season, in a 3–2 loss against Zenit Saint Petersburg on 13 September 2014.{{cite news|title=Гол Смольникова принес "Зениту" победу над "Динамо"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/727178/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=13 September 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}} However, during a 3–2 win against [[FC Torpedo Moscow|Torpedo Moscow]] on 22 September 2014, he was subjected to racist taunts from the opposition team, leading him to show an "unpleasant gesture"' to Torpedo fans.{{cite news|title=Станислав Черчесов: "Самба был заменен из-за ушиба, а не из-за уханий с трибуны"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/730176/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=22 September 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite web|url=https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5863|title="Торпедо" vs "Динамо" - 1:3 (1:1)|publisher=FC Dynamo Moscow|language=ru|date=22 September 2014|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200502194750/https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5863|archive-date=2 May 2020|url-status=live}} Although the club had to close a section of their stadium for their next match after being sanctioned by Russian Football Union (RFU), Samba, himself, was banned for two match for show an "unpleasant gesture"' to Torpedo fans.{{cite news|title=Samba banned for his reaction to racist abuse in Moscow|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/29391257|publisher=BBC Sport|date=27 September 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Torpedo Moscow: Partial fan ban over racism at Christopher Samba|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/29330275|publisher=BBC Sport|date=25 September 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}} Following this, he apologised to the supporters of Torpedo Moscow for his action.{{cite news|title=Самба извинился за жест в адрес фанатов "Торпедо" на заседании КДК|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/731499/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=27 September 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}} After serving a two match suspension, Samba returned to the starting line–up, starting the whole game, in a 2–2 draw against Lokomotiv Moscow on 2 November 2014.{{cite web|url=https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5927|title="Локомотив" (Москва) vs "Динамо" (Москва) – 4:2 (0:1)|publisher=FC Dynamo Moscow|language=ru|date=2 November 2014|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200502194121/https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5927|archive-date=2 May 2020|url-status=live}} He captained Dynamo Moscow for the first time and helped the side draw 1–1 against Rubin Kazan on 30 November 2014.{{cite web|url=https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5971|title="Рубин" (Казань) vs "Динамо" (Москва) – 1:1 (1:0)|publisher=FC Dynamo Moscow|language=ru|date=30 November 2014|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200502195019/https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5971|archive-date=2 May 2020|url-status=live}} On 26 April 2015, Samba scored his sixth goal of the season, in a 2–2 draw against Rostov.{{cite web|url=https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=11583|title="Ростов" vs "Динамо" - 2:2 (0:1)|publisher=FC Dynamo Moscow|language=ru|date=26 April 2015|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200502195031/https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=11583|archive-date=2 May 2020|url-status=live}} Despite missing two matches later in the 2014–15 season, he went on to make thirty–seven appearances and scoring six times in all competitions.{{cite news|title="Динамо" – "Химки". Венкер, Дуглас и Самба пропускают матч из-за проблем со здоровьем|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/1028368326.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=27 March 2015|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title="Урал" – "Динамо". Козлов, Самба и Ротенберг пропустят матч|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/1029838167.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=18 May 2015|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=ПСВ — "Динамо". Кокорин пропустит матч из-за перелома мизинца|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/1025566771.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=8 December 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}} [[File:Dinamo-Rostov (7).jpg|thumb|right|200px|Samba pictured during a match against Rostov in the opening game of the 2014–15 season.]] In June 2015, Dynamo Moscow were excluded from [[2015–16 UEFA Europa League|2015–16 Europa League]] contention for violating [[UEFA Financial Fair Play Regulations|Financial Fair Play]] break-even requirements.{{cite web|publisher=[[UEFA]]|url=http://www.uefa.org/mediaservices/newsid=2239253.html|title=FC Dinamo Moskva referred to Adjudicatory Chamber for break-even requirement breach|date=24 April 2015}}
{{cite web|publisher=[[Rossiya Segodnya]]|url=http://rsport.ru/football/20150619/840603225.html|script-title=ru:УЕФА отстранил "Динамо" от участия в ЛЕ-2015/16 за нарушение финансового fair play|date=19 June 2015|language=ru}} Samba reacted angrily with the respond in a Russian interview.{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Зол на решение УЕФА дисквалифицировать "Динамо"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/889999/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=25 June 2015|access-date=3 May 2020}} Consequently, most of the foreign players left the club. In August, Samba went to Turkey to arrange a transfer to [[Trabzonspor]], but the transfer fell through, with Trabzonspor manager [[Shota Arveladze]] commenting: "This is not the Samba I know, this is some kind of Mike Tyson. I need a football player, not a heavyweight boxer."{{cite web|publisher=[[Fanatik (Turkey)|Fanatik]]|url=http://www.fanatik.com.tr/2015/08/10/sota-sanki-mike-tyson-geldi-615637|title=Şota: Sanki Mike Tyson geldi|date=10 August 2015|language=tr}} He rejected a new contract from Dynamo Moscow, which began negotiation last April.{{cite news|title="Динамо" предложило новые контракты Кураньи, Самба и Джуджаку|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/1029064844.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=21 April 2015|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Самба отказался продлевать контракт с "Динамо"|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/1030267256.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=3 June 2015|access-date=3 May 2020}} Samba didn't play any games for Dynamo in the first half of the 2015–16 season, with his spot in the line–up taken by a new signing [[Vitali Dyakov]]. Dynamo manager [[Andrey Kobelev]] explained that Samba is suffering from a herniated disc in his neck and he required a surgery to correct it.{{cite web|publisher=[[Russian News Agency TASS]]|url=http://tass.ru/sport/2281996|script-title=ru:Футболисту "Динамо" Кристоферу Самба может потребоваться операция на позвоночнике|date=22 September 2015|language=ru}}
{{cite news|title=Андрей Кобелев: "Самба предстоит операция"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/929962/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=22 October 2015|access-date=3 May 2020}} After the surgery, his recovery took most of the rest of the 2015–16 season.{{cite web|publisher=[[Rossiyskaya Gazeta]]|url=http://rg.ru/2016/02/19/andrej-kobelev-dinamo-ne-mozhet-zhit-proshlym.html|script-title=ru:"Динамо" строится|date=19 February 2016|language=ru}} He previously suffered a foot injury during a friendly match against [[AFC Ajax]].{{cite news|title=М'Вила спас "Динамо" от поражения от "Аякса"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/892846/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=4 July 2015|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Самба получил повреждение стопы|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/892873/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=4 July 2015|access-date=3 May 2020}} He returned to action for Dynamo in a game against [[PFC CSKA Moscow]] on 24 April 2016.{{cite web|url=https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=12078|title=ЦСКА vs "Динамо" – 1:0 (0:0)|publisher=FC Dynamo Moscow|language=ru|date=14 April 2016|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200502195313/https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=12078|archive-date=2 May 2020|url-status=live}} Samba later made three starts for the side, adding his 2015–16 appearance to four.{{cite web|url=https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=12088|title="Динамо" vs "Амкар" – 0:0 (0:0)|publisher=FC Dynamo Moscow|language=ru|date=29 April 2016|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200502195324/https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=12088|archive-date=2 May 2020|url-status=live}}
{{cite web|url=https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=12102|title="Спартак" vs "Динамо" – 3:0 (1:0)|publisher=FC Dynamo Moscow|language=ru|date=8 May 2016|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200502195338/https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=12102|archive-date=2 May 2020|url-status=live}}
{{cite web|url=https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=12115|title="Динамо" vs "Ростов" – 1:3 (1:1)|publisher=FC Dynamo Moscow|language=ru|date=12 May 2016|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200502195351/https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=12115|archive-date=2 May 2020|url-status=live}} However, his return was short–lived when he suffered another injury and was sidelined for the rest of the 2015–16 season.{{cite news|title=Самба и Хольмен не сыграют с "Кубанью"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/1000277/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=15 May 2016|access-date=3 May 2020}} His Dynamo contract expired at the end of the 2015–16 season and was not extended.{{cite web|publisher=[[Russian News Agency TASS]]|script-title=ru:Защитник Самба и ФК "Динамо" не намерены продолжать сотрудничество|url=http://tass.ru/sport/3304254|date=22 May 2016|language=ru}} He previously hinted about not renewing his contract with the club.{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Не думаю о продлении контракта с "Динамо"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/992706/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=25 April 2016|access-date=3 May 2020}} ===Panathinaikos=== On 31 August 2016, in the last day of the pre-season summer transfer window, [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] officially announced the capture of Samba who signed a one-season contract with the Greens.{{cite web|url=http://www.sport24.gr/football/omades/Panathinaikos/sampa-na-ksanatromaksw-toys-antipaloys-epithetikous.4239529.html|title=Samba joins Panathinaikos|publisher=www.sport24.gr|date=31 August 2016|access-date=31 August 2016}} Upon joining the club, he said the move was a challenge and was hungry for football.{{cite news|title=Σάμπα: "Να τρομάξω ξανά τους αντίπαλους επιθετικούς"|url=https://www.novasports.gr/podosfairo/super_league/article/1550142/sampa_%C2%ABna_tromaxo_xana_tous_antipalous_epithetikous%C2%BB|publisher=Nova Sports|language=el|date=31 August 2016|access-date=3 May 2020}} Samba made his Panathinaikos debut on 15 September 2016 against Ajax, coming on as a 73rd-minute substitute, in a 2–1 loss.{{cite news|title=Παναθηναϊκός - Άγιαξ 1-2 (vid)|url=https://www.gazzetta.gr/football/article/980200/panathinaikos-agiax-1-2-vid|publisher=Gazzetta.gr|language=el|date=15 September 2016|access-date=3 May 2020}} Three days later on 18 September 2016, he made his league debut, starting the whole game, in a 4–0 win against [[PAS Giannina F.C.|PAS Giannina]].{{cite news|title=Παναθηναϊκός-ΠΑΣ Γιάννινα 4-0|url=https://www.gazzetta.gr/football/article/981612/panathinaikos-pas-giannina-4-0|publisher=Gazzetta.gr|language=el|date=18 September 2016|access-date=3 May 2020}} On 20 January 2017, Samba's contract was dissolved by mutual consent despite joining the club over the summer, as he has been hit with injuries since the start of the [[2016–17 Super League Greece|2016–17 season]].{{cite web|publisher=[[Panathinaikos F.C.]]|url=http://www.pao.gr/news/transfers/8700-%CE%BB%CF%8D%CF%83%CE%B7-%CF%83%CF%85%CE%BD%CE%B5%CF%81%CE%B3%CE%B1%CF%83%CE%AF%CE%B1%CF%82-%CE%BC%CE%B5-%CF%83%CE%AC%CE%BC%CF%80%CE%B1|title=Λύση συνεργασίας με Σάμπα|date=20 January 2017|language=el}}
{{cite news|title=Προσβλήθηκε από ίωση ο Σάμπα|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/omades/Panathinaikos/prosvlhthhke-apo-iwsh-o-sampa.4274701.html|publisher=Sport 24|language=el|date=21 September 2016|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Σάμπα: "Θα έπαιζα και με σπασμένο χέρι"|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/omades/Panathinaikos/sampa-tha-epaiza-kai-me-spasmeno-xeri.4325506.html|publisher=Sport 24|language=el|date=17 October 2016|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Νέα θλάση υπέστη ο Σάμπα|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/omades/Panathinaikos/nea-thlash-ypesth-o-sampa.4389548.html|publisher=Sport 24|language=el|date=24 November 2016|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Κάκωση στο γόνατο ο Σαμπά, έμφαση στην τακτική οι πράσινοι|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/omades/Panathinaikos/kakwsh-sto-gonato-o-sampa-emfash-sthn-taktikh-oi-prasinoi.4466706.html|publisher=Sport 24|language=el|date=7 January 2017|access-date=3 May 2020}} ===Aston Villa=== On 21 February 2017, it was announced that after an unsuccessful trial at [[Crystal Palace F.C.|Crystal Palace]], Samba was training at [[Aston Villa F.C.|Aston Villa]].{{cite news|title=Στην Άστον Βίλα ο Σάμπα|url=https://www.novasports.gr/podosfairo/championship/article/1361238/stin_aston_bila_o_sampa|publisher=Nova Sports|language=el|date=24 February 2017|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Crystal Palace take Christopher Samba on trial with view to free transfer|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2017/jan/24/crystal-palace-christopher-samba-trial|work=The Guardian|date=24 January 2017|access-date=3 May 2020}} On 6 March 2017, he played for [[Aston Villa F.C.|Aston Villa Under-23s]] against [[Wolverhampton Wanderers F.C.|Wolverhampton Wanderers U23]].{{cite web|url=http://www.birminghammail.co.uk/sport/football/football-news/chris-samba-heres-how-aston-12701672|title=Chris Samba: Here's how the trialist performed|publisher=Birmingham Mail|date=7 March 2017|access-date=5 July 2017}} Samba joined Aston Villa for a pre-season training camp in Portugal prior to the start of the [[2017–18 EFL Championship|2017–18 season]].{{cite web|url=http://www.birminghammail.co.uk/sport/football/football-news/aston-villa-transfers-whats-latest-13283771|title=What's the latest with Chris Samba|publisher=Birmingham Mail|date=5 July 2017|access-date=5 July 2017}} On 20 July 2017, he signed for the club on a one-year contract.{{cite web|title=Glenn Whelan and Chris Samba: Aston Villa sign Stoke City midfielder and experienced defender|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/40159674|publisher=BBC Sport|date=20 July 2017|access-date=21 July 2017}} Samba made his Aston Villa debut, coming on as a late substitute, in a 1–1 draw against [[Hull City A.F.C.|Hull City]] in the opening game of the season.{{cite news|title=Aston Villa 1–1 Hull City|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/40760772|publisher=BBC Sport|date=5 August 2017|access-date=3 May 2020}} He then made his first start for the side, starting the whole game, in a 2–1 win against [[Colchester United F.C.|Colchester United]] in the first round of the League Cup.{{cite news|title=Colchester United 1–2 Aston Villa|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/40798479|publisher=BBC Sport|date=9 August 2017|access-date=3 May 2020}} Samba played 45 minutes before being substituted at half time, as Aston Villa drew 1–1 against [[Bristol City F.C.|Bristol City]] on 25 August 2017.{{cite news|title=Why Aston Villa's Chris Samba was taken off at half-time at Bristol City|url=https://www.birminghammail.co.uk/sport/football/football-news/aston-villas-chris-samba-taken-13532195|publisher=Birmingham Mail|date=25 August 2017|access-date=3 May 2020}} Following this, he found his first team opportunities limited and was placed on the substitute bench.{{cite news|title=Revealed: Steve Bruce has this message for his Aston Villa fringe players|url=https://www.birminghammail.co.uk/sport/football/football-news/revealed-steve-bruce-message-aston-13805596|publisher=Birmingham Mail|date=24 October 2017|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Aston Villa analysis: Impressive kids, McCormack's chance, empty seats, tight game|url=https://www.birminghammail.co.uk/sport/football/football-news/aston-villa-analysis-impressive-kids-13646501|publisher=Birmingham Mail|date=20 September 2017|access-date=3 May 2020}} On 4 November 2017, he scored his first goal for the club in a 2–1 defeat to [[Sheffield Wednesday F.C.|Sheffield Wednesday]] at [[Villa Park]].{{cite web|title=Aston Villa 1–2 Sheffield Wednesday|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/41785610|publisher=BBC Sport|date=4 November 2017|access-date=25 November 2017}} Following this, Samba spent the next five months, recovering from his injury.{{cite web|url=https://www.avfc.co.uk/News/2017/12/15/injury-update-pre-derby-away|title=Injury report: Terry, Jedinak, Green, Samba, Lansbury, Hutton|publisher=Aston Villa F.C.|date=15 December 2017|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200503085801/https://www.avfc.co.uk/News/2017/12/15/injury-update-pre-derby-away|archive-date=3 May 2020|url-status=live}}
{{cite web|url=https://www.avfc.co.uk/News/2018/01/29/injury-update-samba-agbonlahor|title=Injury update: Samba/Agbonlahor|publisher=Aston Villa F.C.|date=29 January 2018|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200503085815/https://www.avfc.co.uk/News/2018/01/29/injury-update-samba-agbonlahor|archive-date=3 May 2020|url-status=live}} On 10 April 2018, he made his return to the first team, coming on as a late substitute, in a 1–0 win against [[Cardiff City F.C.|Cardiff City]].{{cite news|title=Aston Villa 1–0 Cardiff City|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/43624039|publisher=BBC Sport|date=10 April 2018|access-date=3 May 2020}} At the end of the 2017–18 season, Samba went on to make fourteen appearances and scoring once in all competitions. It was announced on 23 June 2018 that Aston Villa had released Samba.{{cite news|title=Oscar Borg, Chris Samba, Khalid Abodo: Aston Villa's released and retained lists|url=https://www.birminghammail.co.uk/sport/football/transfer-news/aston-villa-championship-released-retained-14778372|publisher=Birmingham Mail|date=23 June 2018|access-date=3 May 2020}} After spending a year without a club, Samba began studying to gain a coaching badge at the [[Irish Football Association]].{{cite news|title=This is what Chris Samba is doing 12 months after Aston Villa exit|url=https://www.birminghammail.co.uk/sport/football/football-news/what-chris-samba-doing-12-16323186|publisher=Birmingham Mail|date=24 May 2019|access-date=3 May 2020}} As a result, he quietly announced his retirement from football.{{cite web|url=https://www.rovers.co.uk/news/2020/march/an-evening-with-chris-samba/|title=An Evening with Chris Samba|publisher=Blackburn Rovers F.C.|date=11 March 2020|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200503085916/https://www.rovers.co.uk/news/2020/march/an-evening-with-chris-samba/|archive-date=3 May 2020|url-status=live}} ==International career== Samba represented the [[Congo national football team|Republic of the Congo national team]] and stated in an interview, saying: "Without them, I don't know where I would be today. Many people ask me why I do not have French nationality to have a chance to play with the France team. But it was the Congo team that gave me the opportunity to play soccer again when I needed it."{{cite news|title=Congo-Samba: "Fier de défendre mon pays"|url=https://www.afrik-foot.com/congo-samba-fier-de-defendre-mon-pays|publisher=Afrik-Foot|language=fr|date=10 June 2011|access-date=3 May 2020}} He made his Congo debut as a 20-year-old on 5 September 2004 against [[Togo national football team|Togo]] and played 61 minutes before being substituted, as the side lost 2–0.{{cite news|title=Neuer Schwung Durch Samba|url=https://www.morgenpost.de/printarchiv/sport/article104475194/Neuer-Schwung-durch-Samba.html|publisher=Berliner Morgenpost|language=de|date=5 September 2004|access-date=3 May 2020}} Samba made his second appearance for Congo a month later on 10 October 2004 against [[Zambia national football team|Zambia]] and played 45 minutes, as they lost 3–2. Following his move to Blackburn Rovers, Samba hoped the move would benefited him in order to earn a call–up from Congo.{{cite news|title=Samba makes early impression|url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/africa/6389795.stm|publisher=BBC Sport|date=23 January 2007|access-date=3 May 2020}} However, he only made five appearances for the national side and didn't get a call up until February 2012, his first time called up in five years.{{cite news|title=Samba running fast out of Rovers time|url=https://www.lancashiretelegraph.co.uk/sport/9548938.samba-running-fast-rovers-time/|publisher=The Lancashire Telegraph|date=23 February 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} A year later on 23 March 2013, Samba scored his first international goal, in a 1–0 win against [[Gabon national football team|Gabon]].{{cite news|title=CM 2014 : Christopher Samba fait chuter le Gabon|url=https://www.afrik-foot.com/cm-2014-christopher-samba-fait-chuter-le-gabon|publisher=Afrik Foot|language=fr|date=23 March 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}} In November 2014, Samba announced his intention not to play in [[2015 Africa Cup of Nations|Africa Cup of Nations]] in Equatorial Guinea, citing his commitment to Dynamo Moscow.{{cite news|title=Самба на Кубок Африки не собирается|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/748970/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=23 November 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Завершил карьеру в сборной Конго, чтобы сконцентрироваться на задачах «Динамо"|url=https://www.sports.ru/football/1025205228.html|publisher=Sports.ru|language=ru|date=23 November 2014|access-date=3 May 2020}} In November 2016, Samba was called up to the Congo squad for the first time in two years but never made the final cut.{{cite news|title=Congo : Ndinga, Oniangué et Samba présélectionnés contre l'Ouganda|url=https://www.afrik-foot.com/congo-ndinga-oniangue-et-samba-preselectionnes-contre-l-ouganda|publisher=Afrik Foot|language=fr|date=1 November 2016|access-date=3 May 2020}} ==Coaching career== On 25 November 2021, Blackburn Rovers announced that Samba had returned to the club as an academy coach.{{cite web|url=https://www.rovers.co.uk/news/2021/november/25/samba-makes-rovers-return-/ |title=Samba makes Rovers return! |publisher=Blackburn Rovers Official Site |date=25 November 2021 |accessdate=25 November 2021}} ==Personal life== Samba was born in [[Créteil]], France and raised by a large family with seven siblings. Growing up, Samba idolised [[Lilian Thuram]] and even wish to emulate him.{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Из меня получился бы хороший вольник"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/news/510283/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=3 July 2012|access-date=3 May 2020}} Samba has 6 children. The family continued to reside in England.{{cite news|title=Кристофер Самба: "Мне было хорошо в России"|url=https://www.sport-express.ru/football/rfpl/reviews/810602/|publisher=Sport Express|language=ru|date=1 February 2013|access-date=3 May 2020}}
{{cite news|title=Самба на роликах, Вальбуэна за рулеткой|url=https://www.championat.com/football/article-3253115-samba-na-rolikakh-valbujena-za-ruletkoj.html|publisher=Championat.com|language=ru|date=23 January 2015|access-date=3 May 2020}} In November 2013, Samba became a father for third time when his daughter was born.{{cite web|url=https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5242|title=У Кристофера Самба родилась дочь!|publisher=FC Dynamo Moscow|language=ru|date=8 November 2013|access-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200502195739/https://fcdynamo.ru/news/events/?id_4=5242|archive-date=2 May 2020|url-status=live}}

'''Mattia Destro''' ({{IPA|it|matˈtiːa ˈdɛstro}}; born 20 March 1991) is an Italian professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[striker (association football)|striker]]. He has also featured at international level, holding eight [[Cap (sport)#Association football|caps]] for [[Italy national football team|Italy]].

==Club career==

===Youth career===
Destro began his career with hometown club [[Ascoli Calcio 1898|Ascoli]]. In the 2004–05 season, he played in the ''Giovanissimi Nazionali'' squad,<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.ascolicalcio.net/altre_news.asp?id=618|title=Giovanissimi nazionali: Lazio-Ascoli 1–0|date=29 May 2005|access-date=12 September 2010|work=Ascoli Calcio 1898|language=it}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.ascolicalcio.net/altre_news.asp?id=390|title= Pari degli Allievi col Giulianova; Giovanissimi ok sul Tolentino|date=14 February 2005|access-date=12 September 2010|work=Ascoli Calcio 1898|language=it}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.ascolicalcio.net/altre_news.asp?id=378|title= Giovanili: Allievi corsari a Terni, pari dei Giovanissimi a Siena. La Primavera anticipa venerdì|date=7 February 2005|access-date=12 September 2010|work=Ascoli Calcio 1898|language=it}}</ref> while his father Flavio was coaching the ''Allievi Nazionali'' team. In mid-2005, he joined [[Inter Milan]]'s [[Inter Milan Youth Sector|youth system]].

Destro was the top-scorer of the ''Giovanissimi Nazionali'' team in the 2005–06 season, the second top-scorer of the ''Allievi Nazionali'' team in the 2006–07 season (behind [[Mario Balotelli]]), and the second top-scorer of the ''Primavera'' team in the 2008–09 season (behind [[Aiman Napoli]]). Destro won the league with the ''Allievi Nazionali'' team in 2008,<ref name="Allievi">{{Cite news |date=19 June 2008 |title=Under-17s: Inter 1–0 Empoli, Scudetto! |work=FC Internazionale Milano
